games.description: Un gioco di azione e piattaforma in gran parte ispirato ai successi degli anni 90. Tra un universo gotico e leggende mitologiche, è decorato come dovrebbe essere con una colonna sonora ricca ed epica per portarti in un'avventura nel più puro stile arcade.

games.canonical_title: Argonauts Agency 10: Wrath Of Olympus Collector's Edition
games.title: Argonauts Agency 10: Wrath Of Olympus Collector's Edition
games.description: The Argonauts are on the move again. Win the hearts of the gods to stop the chain of disasters.

games.canonical_title: Argonauts Agency 11: Bronze Plague Collector's Edition
games.title: Argonauts Agency 11: Bronze Plague Collector's Edition
games.description: The Argonauts are on the move again. Team up with an old ally to break the curse and save the world.

games.canonical_title: Argonauts Agency 12: Patterns of Morpheus Collector's Edition
games.title: Argonauts Agency 12: Patterns of Morpheus Collector's Edition
games.description: Jason, Medea, and Asclepius fight nightmares to restore the balance between sleep and waking life.

games.canonical_title: Argonauts Agency 13: Secret of the Labyrinth Collector's Edition
games.title: Argonauts Agency 13: Secret of the Labyrinth Collector's Edition
games.description: Explore the living Labyrinth with Jason and Medea and find your way through ever-changing paths.

games.canonical_title: Argonauts Agency 15: Curse of Wishes Collector's Edition
games.title: Argonauts Agency 15: Curse of Wishes Collector's Edition
games.description: Her wish for rest sends her on a journey where peace quickly turns into playful chaos and surprises!

games.title: Argonauts Agency 3: Chair of Hephaestus
games.description: Argonauts Agency—See how a regular chair can be the beginning of a whole investigation and amazing adventure!

games.title: Argonauts Agency 5: Captive of Circe
games.description: The Argonauts Agency – An invitation to a wedding sets in motion an incredible investigation with an unexpected twist!

games.title: Argonauts Agency 6: Missing Daughter
games.description: The Argonauts Agency – Find out how the family turmoil of the gods has affected common mortals and how it all ends!

games.title: Argonauts Agency 7: Gorgon Medusa
games.description: Argonauts 7: A journey to gather resources, fight petrification, and save your friends and all of Greece!

games.title: Argonauts Agency 8: Ares Games
games.description: Enter a world of ancient myths: Jason, Medea, and you—against the God of War’s schemes!

games.canonical_title: Argonauts Agency 9: God of Storms Collector's Edition
games.title: Argonauts Agency 9: God of Storms Collector's Edition
games.description: Pelias, the wise mentor, joins forces with Jason and Medea to uncover the deeply hidden causes of divine wrath

games.title: Argonauts Agency: Glove of Midas
games.description: The Argonauts Agency – Experiments with a magical glove lead to a hilarious blunder!

games.canonical_title: Argonauts Agency: Reflections from the Moon Collector's Edition
games.title: Argonauts Agency: Reflections from the Moon Collector's Edition
games.description: Reflections threaten the world! Find a new ally and drive them back to the Moon!

games.title: Arhaekon
games.description: Embark on a perilous journey as an Arhaekon in this challenging roguelike turn-based RPG dungeon crawler. Lead your minions through treacherous dungeons, uncover ancient treasures, and face relentless abominations in a quest for humanity's deliverance from corruption.

games.title: ARIDA: Backland's Awakening
games.description: Affronta la siccità per esplorare le storie del sertão brasiliano!

games.title: ARIE: Moonprayer
games.description: ARIE: Moonprayer is a beautiful, short 3D anime exploration experience through an ending world, where melodies weave through your final journey on earth.

games.title: Ariokan
games.description:
Ariokan is the online collectible card game where players can create new official (and balanced) cards at any time to invent new combos and break the "meta".

Generated cards can be unlocked by other players, contributing to an ever-growing library of cards, factions and combos!

games.title: Arise
games.description: Arise - The Ultimate Action RPG Multiplayer Experience!

games.title: Arise: A Simple Story
games.description: Parti per un viaggio emozionante attraverso le vite agrodolci di due persone, in cui i ricordi prendono vita e il tempo si piega alla tua volontà. Perditi nei momenti di felicità e supera le difficoltà mentre rivivi la tua vita. Una storia di gioia e dolore, una storia semplic...

games.title: Arizona Sunshine®
games.description: Affila il machete e raduna gli amici. Arizona Sunshine® porta la sua pluripremiata apocalisse zombi in una terza persona esplosiva, con modalità cooperativa online e split-screen, combattimenti brutali, umorismo nero e Bello, il tuo fedele cane sbrana-zombi.

games.title: ARK: Survival Ascended
games.description: ARK è stato reinventato da zero in questa nuova generazione di tecnologia videoludica con Unreal Engine 5! Crea una tribù, doma e alleva centinaia di dinosauri e creature uniche, esplora, crea, costruisci e combatti per raggiungere la vetta della catena alimentare!

games.title: ARK: Survival Evolved
games.description: Sei naufragato sulle sponde di un'isola misteriosa e ora dovrai imparare a sopravvivere. Usa l'astuzia per uccidere o domare le creature primitive che si aggirano sull'isola, e affronta altri giocatori per sopravvivere, dominare... e scappare!

games.title: Arkanoid - Eternal Battle
games.description: Discover or re-discover, the emblematic block breaker game in a fully modernized version! Classic elements from the franchise will definitely make a comeback, with a brand-new look, new rules, as well as new effects, bonuses and features! Including, for the very first time, a Bat

games.title: Arkbound-アークバウンド-
games.description: Arkbound is a Japanese-style hash-and-slack action RPG built in Unreal 5 with the support of blockchain technology. It seamlessly merges classic RPG nostalgia with cutting-edge Web 3 tech, easing traditional gamers into the blockchain world.

games.title: Arknights:Endfield
games.description: Arknights: Endfield è un GDR strategico in tempo reale in 3D sviluppato da HYPERGRYPH. Nei panni dell'Endministrator della Endfield Industries, ti avventurerai su Talos-II per svelarne i segreti, nonché difendere ed espandere i confini della civiltà umana.

games.title: Armor of God
games.description: A 2D pixel-art platformer where you choose which armor to wear. Full armor makes you invincible — anyone can win. Leave some behind and the game becomes a very different challenge.

games.title: Armored Warfare
games.description: Armored Warfare è un gioco online MMO gratuito in cui puoi dare vita a battaglie esplosive tra carri armati contro milioni di giocatori da ogni parte del mondo.  Scendi in campo con la potenza dei veicoli da combattimento più potenti del mondo e scatena la guerra con oltre 100...

games.title: Armory: Drone Tank
games.description: Drone Tanks is a vehicle shooter with roguelike mechanics. You take control of a remotely operated tank, battling hordes of hostile humans, mechs, drones, creatures, and even gods. Your advantage? Technology – and lots of it! Build your drone army and show them who's strongest!

games.title: ArmourX
games.description: Armour X is a free-to-play sci-fi hack-and-slash looter game where players battle alien invaders, customize gear, and earn real rewards. With fast-paced combat, deep progression, and epic loot, it delivers an intense and rewarding experience.

games.title: Arms of God
games.description: Gear up for a battle through hell in this next-gen autoshooter with Doom-inspired gore vibes, metal music, roguelite mechanics, and a satisfying combat feel. Wield five weapons at once, upgrade and merge them to forge indestructible builds, and bring divine justice to the world.

games.title: Army War: Shooting Simulator

games.title: Aron's Adventure: Magic Reborn

games.canonical_title: Around the World 2: Travel to Canada Collector's Edition

Discover  iconic locations, from majestic mountains to vibrant cities like Toronto and Vancouver. Search for hidden objects, play mini-games, and uncover Canada’s beauty. Start your journey today!

games.canonical_title: Around the World: Travel to Brazil Collector's Edition

games.description: Build and manage an artillery factory in the WWI era. Research authentic weapon components, engineer deadly firepower, test prototypes on your firing range, and compete for lucrative government contracts.

games.title: Artist Life Simulator
games.description: Live the life of a starving artist in 19th century alternative history. Survive poverty, alchoholism, madness, depression, and 67 different feelings. Paint masterpieces by combining inspirations, sell them for riches (or scraps) and create a painting that will change the world.

games.title: Arto
games.description: Ridai colore a un mondo desaturato in questo GDR d'azione. Combatti nemici e boss unici per riportare in vita il tuo mondo. Scopri vari biomi caratterizzati da uno stile grafico in continua mutazione e svariate meccaniche di gioco, con elementi hack-and-slash, furtivi e platform!

games.title: As Dusk Falls
games.description: Esplora la vita di due famiglie i cui destini si intrecciano nell'arco di trent'anni in un originale dramma interattivo di INTERIOR/NIGHT. A partire da una rapina fallita nel 1998, le vite dei personaggi dipendono dalle tue scelte.

games.title: As Far As The Eye
games.description: Lanciati in un'avventura epica. Costruisci un villaggio mobile e parti con la tua tribù in un viaggio verso il centro del mondo, ovvero l'Occhio. Questo gioco roguelike di gestione delle risorse a turni si compone di situazioni procedurali, eventi naturali, alberi delle abilit...

games.description: As I Began to Dream is a journey about a little girl and her turtle who is trapped in her dream world, dealing with her past trauma. She controls her dream world in a unique way to navigate her realm of grief.

games.title: AscendantsRising
games.description: ASCENDANTS Rising is a CO-OP Action RPG that lets you create your own unique playstyle and team to explore an ever-changing Multiverse teeming with deadly enemies, formidable Boss fights, and amazing loot.

games.title: Ascendria: The Parkour Game
games.description:
Ascendria is a climbing platformer set within a gothic castle.
Maintain your balance as you conquer challenging courses,
soak in the breathtaking views, and immerse yourself in this enchanting world!

games.title: Ascent Of Eternity
games.description: ASCENT OF ETERNITY™ is an action-rpg rogue-like magical horde-slaying third person coop game. Fire, Ice, Electric, Light, Dark, Metal, and Life. The 7 elements call for mastery. Master the elements and ascend through eternity!

games.title: Asdivine Saga

games.title: Asemblance

games.description: "Asemblance: Oversight" is a first-person exploration and puzzle-based game.  You are part of a team of scientists and engineers charged with using a classified technology to aid in recreating the human mind.

games.title: ASFComputers
games.description: ASFComputers is an idle clicker where you hack networks, grow your botnet, and farm resources. Upgrade systems, decrypt data, and expand your digital empire to dominate the cyber world.

Multigiocatore in modalità cooperativa passiva Mentre ti avventuri nel vasto open world di Ashen, potresti incontrare occasionalmente altri giocatori, così co...

Death Match And Normal Race, there will be more tracks added in the future for both modes, There is Also a secret Track in the game, the portal to it is hidden in one of the race tracks

games.title: Assassin The First List

games.title: Assassin's Creed Chronicles: China
games.description:
Exact Shao Jun’s vengeance on the Chinese Emperor in stunning 16th century China with fresh 2.5D stealth gameplay:

• Embody a stealthy Assassin with unique combat skills and gear like the Shoe Blade and the Rope Dart
• Discover the story of Shao Jun, the last remaining Assassin of the Chinese Brotherhood
• Dive into a beautiful Chinese setting by travelling across the great empire of China

games.title: Assassin's Creed Chronicles: India
games.description:
Embody Arbaaz in his quest for retribution through a colourful depiction of Colonial India in 2.5D stealth gameplay. 

• Travel across an amazing 19th Century India and its legendary landmarks. 
• Experience the thrill of a stealthy assassin with a unique set of skills and weapons such as the double kill moves and the chakram.
• Discover a brand new mode with stealth, speed and assassination rooms

games.title: Assassin's Creed Chronicles: Russia
games.description:
Unisciti a Nikolai Orelov nel suo percorso di redenzione attraverso una Russia mozzafiato in un gioco 2.5D.  
• Sopravvivi alla Rivoluzione d'Ottobre e solca il territorio russo.
• Vivi l'emozione di indossare i panni di un furtivo Assassino in un contesto moderno.
• Passa da un personaggio all'altro e sfrutta le diverse tecniche di Nikolai e Anastasia.

games.title: Assassin's Creed II Standard Edition
games.description: Un'epica storia di famiglia, vendetta e intrighi di potere, sullo sfondo del raffinato quanto sanguinoso Rinascimento italiano.

games.title: Assassin's Creed Odyssey Standard Edition
games.description: Vivi una vera e propria odissea per svelare i segreti del tuo passato, cambia il destino dell'antica Grecia e diventa una leggenda vivente

games.title: Assassin's Creed Origins Standard Edition
games.description: Svela segreti oscuri e miti dimenticati e ritorna a quell'unico momento fondante: l'origine della Confraternita degli Assassini.

games.title: Assassin's Creed Rogue Standard Edition
games.description: Ti presentiamo Assassin's Creed Rogue, il capitolo più oscuro del franchise di Assassin's Creed.  Nei panni di Shay vivrai il lento passaggio da Assassino a cacciatore di Assassini.

games.title: Assassin's Creed Syndicate Standard Edition
games.description: Londra, anno 1868. Nel bel mezzo della rivoluzione industriale, vesti i panni dell'insolente e carismatico Assassino Jacob Frye.

games.title: Assassin's Creed Unity
games.description: Assassin's Creed Unity narra la storia di Arno, un giovane che intraprende un viaggio per svelare i veri poteri celati dietro la Rivoluzione Francese.

games.title: Assassin's Creed Valhalla Standard Edition
games.description: Diventa una leggenda tra i vichinghi, scrivi il tuo nome nella Storia. Compi razzie contro i tuoi nemici, espandi il tuo insediamento e accresci il tuo potere politico.

games.title: Assassin's Creed® I: Director's Cut
games.description: Sei un Assassino, un guerriero misterioso, temuto e implacabile. Con le tue azioni puoi scatenare il caos intorno a te e la tua esistenza influenzerà questo cruciale momento storico.

games.title: Assassin's Creed® III: Remastered
games.description: Rivivi la Rivoluzione americana o scoprila per la prima volta in Assassin's Creed® III Remastered, con grafica migliorata e meccaniche di gioco ottimizzate.  In più, saranno inclusi anche Assassin's Creed Liberation Remastered e tutti i DLC.

games.title: Assassin's Creed® Mirage
games.description: Experience the story of Basim, a cunning street thief with nightmarish visions, seeking answers and justice as he navigates the bustling streets of ninth-century Baghdad. Through a mysterious, ancient organization known as the Hidden Ones, he will become a deadly Master Assassin and change his fate in ways he never could have imagined.

games.description: Uphold your pact with the Titan of Death, Epimetheus! Fight, climb and solve your way through a twisted tower as three unique adventurers, on a mission to save their village from impending doom!

games.title: Asterigos: Curse of the Stars
games.description: Parti per un viaggio irto di pericoli in questo GdR d'azione ispirato alla mitologia greca e romana. Esplora la suggestiva Aphes e fatti strada attraverso legioni di avversari unici e boss mitologici per svelare la verità sulla maledizione che opprime la città.

games.canonical_title: Asterix and Obelix Slap Them All
games.title: Asterix and Obelix Slap Them All
games.description: Vesti i panni dei due Galli più famosi del mondo e attraversa i luoghi più iconici della saga, affrontando una valanga di nemici: dal semplice legionario ai pirati, passando per i briganti o ancora i temibili Normanni!

games.canonical_title: Asterix and Obelix Slap Them All 2
games.title: Asterix and Obelix Slap Them All 2
games.description: Un gioco “Beat'em Up” con una storia originale. Esplora diversi luoghi come le rovine della foresta, un vasto accampamento romano e persino Lutezia. Questo gioco dinamico ti invita a vivere un'avventura, con una generosa distribuzione di schiaffi!

games.canonical_title: Asterix and Obelix XXXL - The Ram of Hibernia
games.title: Asterix and Obelix XXXL - The Ram of Hibernia
games.description: Unisciti ad Asterix e Obelix in una nuova storia originale... in Hibernia! Esplora questo gioco di avventura e azione in modalità cooperativa con fino a 4 giocatori!

games.title: Asterix and Obelix: Heroes
games.description: Meccaniche di gioco uniche che combinano la costruzione di un mazzo di carte con combattimenti a turni. Un'avventura originale con 24 eroi della serie a fumetti. Potenzia il tuo mazzo e prendi le giuste decisioni tattiche per sventare i piani di Cesare!

games.title: Asterogues
games.description: Distruggi i pianeti in Asterogues! Scegli il tuo personaggio tra i membri di una banda di emarginati esiliati nella Cintura degli Asteroidi, schiva i pericoli e fatti strada a suon di spari attraverso un brutale assalto di proiettili e vendicati del Sistema Solare!

games.title: Asteroids: Recharged
games.description: How long can you survive the depths of space in this fresh revival of the classic arcade shooter, all while grooving to an original score by Megan McDuffee? Pilot solo or recruit a friend for local co-op across 30 unique challenges or the endless arcade mode.

games.title: Astor: Blade of the Monolith
games.description: In this fast-paced action RPG, play as Astor, a young warrior determined to unveil the secrets behind his creators’ unforeseen demise. Wield an arsenal of runic weapons to hunt down the evil haunting the planet Gliese and save it from impending doom.

games.title: ASTRAL
games.description: ASTRAL is a first-person shooter set in a futuristic universe. Embody a GRD robot and engage adversaries in dynamic environments, spanning Earth and Off-World locations.

games.title: Astrea Six Sided Oracles
games.description: In Astrea, originale roguelike con deck di dadi, viaggerai tra le rovine di una civiltà perduta nei panni di uno dei sei impavidi Oracoli.

games.title: Astria Ascending
games.description: Esplora un vasto mondo sull'orlo del caos in un GDR giapponese maturo e ricco di emozioni. Vivi una storia epica con combattimenti a turni gratificanti e ampie possibilità di personalizzazione, realizzata in una magnifica grafica in 4K disegnata a mano.

games.title: Astro
games.description: Astro is a multiplayer fps, which explores the mind-bending opportunities of movement and gun fights in zero gravity. It focuses on the fun over realism, with deep and unique mechanics, weapons, and abilities.

games.title: Astro Burn
games.description: A fast-paced sci-fi cute-em-up filled with colourful bullet-hell chaos and giant adorable animals in huge mechs. Play as Astro a space cat, as you blast, dodge, upgrade, trigger Catnip Mode, and take down screen-filling cute critters overload in retro arcade style.

games.title: Astro Looter: Survivor
games.description: Esplora pianeti alieni per estrarre risorse, uccidere insetti alieni, costruire torrette di difesa e sopravvivere a ondate di attacchi di insetti. Astro Looter combina elementi di sopravvivenza, roguelike e tower defense in un gioco sparatutto con visuale dall'alto.

games.title: Astro Wars
games.description: Astro Wars is a Free Multiplayer Space Strategy Game. You start at the edge of the galaxy where you can build up, colonize and take over planets in competition with players from all over the world!

games.title: Astrometica
games.description: Astrometica is a fun game about surviving in space. You need to use your skills and tools to stay alive. There are many challenges to face, and you need to fight to survive. You also need to build a new base in space.

games.title: Astronauts Lament
games.description: Navigate a hostile alien planet in this 2D platformer! Dodge asteroids, toxic gas, and a mysterious stranger. With 3 lives, jump moving platforms, survive meteor showers, and aim for the highest level you can achieve. Can you escape?

games.title: Astrumis - Survive Together
games.description: Astrumis - Survive Together è un gioco horror esclusivamente cooperativo. Un giocatore controlla un sopravvissuto su un'astronave abbandonata e l'altro l'astronave stessa. Devono collaborare per sopravvivere al misterioso mostro.

games.title: Asurya's Embers
games.description: Asurya’s Embers is a 1st-person, single-player, bow-and-arrow shooter set in an ancient Himalayan village plagued by an environmental disaster wrought by the vengeful sun god, Asurya.

games.title: ASYLUM
games.description: An epic supernatural horror adventure and the spiritual successor to cult classic Scratches set in a massive, decaying mental institute. Inspired by H. P. Lovecraft, Hammer Films and twisted Euro Horror from the 80s.

games.title: Asylum Nightmares
games.description: Risvegliati in un manicomio abbandonato pieno di zombi in Asylum Nightmares. Cerca armi, risolvi enigmi e affronta i non morti per trovare la libertà. Ogni angolo nasconde un oscuro segreto e una lotta per la sopravvivenza!

games.title: At Eve's Wake Definitive Edition
games.description: Una storia horror lovecraftiana e interattiva in cui devi sopravvivere a una famiglia mai conosciuta, suddita di un oscuro padrone. Fedele al genere, il gioco ti permette di conservare le conoscenze apprese in ogni partita. Plasma il tuo destino e quello della famiglia. Accoglierai questo dono o libererai l'umanità dalla loro morsa? Ogni azione influenzerà il tuo destino e quello della famiglia.

games.title: At Fate's End
games.description: At Fate’s End is an action-adventure game where you fight the ones you love and your skill tree is your family tree. Explore a lush fantasy world, defeat the foul creatures of the realm, and face your estranged siblings in intense, emotional duels to decide your family’s fate.

games.title: Ataraxie
games.description: Nel puro stile dei Metroidvania, ATARAXIE è un gioco in 2D ambientato in un mondo composto da livelli interconnessi. Da labirinti a tombe, da deserti a fortezze, è un universo vivo e ricco che dovrai esplorare con passo sicuro.

games.title: Atari Mania
games.description: A wild journey through videogame history, Atari Mania is a microgame collection wrapped in an hilarious retro-driven narrative of exploration and surprise.

games.title: Athenian Rhapsody
games.description: Welcome to the world of Athens! Write your Rhapsody - meet friends (or make them enemies), navigate mind-bendingly hard challenges such as "Push Button" and "Spell Richard", and fight for dear life. What will your story be?

Experience the thrill of strategic card gameplay with power cards that change the rules. Play against AI opponents in stunning environments with customizable game modes.

games.description: In 'Atomic Shelter,' a post-apocalyptic survival game, we follow Maria Jose as she battles gangs, groups, and infected creatures in a ruined world. With core mechanics like crafting, strategy, and construction, players can customize their characters and expand their stories.

games.description: Ti diamo il benvenuto in Automachef, un gioco a enigmi sulla gestione delle risorse in cui puoi progettare cucine, programmare macchinari e guardare il tuo genio prendere vita! È tempo di progettare le cucine del domani, cominciando da oggi!

Espandi le tue piccole colonie fino a farle diventare città enormi e tentacolari, mentre affronti le sfide della colonizzazione di un nuovo mondo.

games.title: Avencast - Rise Of The Mage
games.description: Play Avencast, the epic roguelike action-RPG with tons of combat moves, spells, and equipment. Fight against evil forces to save your academy and vanquish the darkness. As you progress, learn powerful spells and combos to increase your chances of victory.

games.title: Avernum Escape From the Pit
games.description: Avernum is a land underground, a subterranean nation full of rogues, misfits, and brigands, struggling for survival in the monster-infested darkness. Hunt for glory and justice in the underworld. Fight for survival, freedom, and even vengeance in the epic indie cult-classic.

games.title: Avium
games.description: Avium's a sci-fi ARPG in a city ruled by those of great cybernetic wealth and influence, such as the Big Four. A Plutocracy, a "banana republic" that keeps its peace with the employment of Vigilantes like you, Diezel, a War-Suit donning, crime-fighting hero with a dark past.

games.title: Awaken
games.description: Awaken is a Fighting game & Asgard world built with Web3 infrastructure. Within Awaken, players will have a chance to immerse themselves in the traditional combat domain with real interactions seamlessly integrated into the space.

games.title: AWAKEN – Astral Blade
games.description: Tessi la tua storia personale in questa fiaba oscura. Avventurati con Tania in misteriose e antiche rovine per scoprire le sue origini e il suo destino. Riuscirai a sopravvivere in un luogo tanto oscuro e disperato?

games.title: AXIOM VERGE
games.description: Pensi di aver capito come andrà a finire Axiom Verge. Invece non è così. 5/5 stelle – Giant Bomb  ... semplicemente uno dei migliori titoli a cui abbia giocato da anni. 5/5 stelle – US Gamer  Dopo un incidente avvenuto nel laboratorio, uno scienziato si risveglia in un mondo a...

games.title: Axiom Verge 2
games.description: In questo sequel dell'acclamato Axiom Verge esplori un mondo alternativo simile alla Terra, coperto dalle rovine di un'antica civiltà tecnologicamente evoluta.  Ma qualcos'altro è in agguato appena oltre i confini della realtà, in attesa di trascinarti al suo interno.

games.title: Axyz
games.description: Axyz is a retro gravity switching puzzle game that asks the player to use their environmental and spatial awareness to beat every level. Soak in the vaporwave, switch gravity, collect tapes, and more in this tribute to 90s puzzle games.

games.title: Ayasa: Shadows of Silence
games.description: Brave the shadows in 'Ayasa: Shadows of Silence'. Journey across six realms, solve thought-provoking puzzles, and engage with a narrative rich in horror and philosophy.

games.title: Aztech Forgotten Gods
games.description: Aztech Forgotten Gods è un gioco d'azione-avventura ambientato in un universo cyber-paleolitico che segue Achtli, una giovane donna azteca, nella sua missione per diventare un'eroina sfruttando il potere delle divinità.

games.title: Aztecs: The Last Sun
games.description: Aztecs: The Last Sun is a city-building and survival experience set at the height of a dying age. Build the mighty city-state of Tenochtitlan, lead your people and earn the favor of ancient gods to stand against a looming darkness that threatens to consume your world.

games.title: Aztez
games.description: Aztez è gioco unico che unisce il genere picchiaduro a quello di strategia a turni, il tutto ambientato nel mondo dell'Impero azteco. Eventi di combattimento ad alto livello tecnico in puro stile picchiaduro e in tempo reale che metteranno fine ai conflitti attuali nel tuo imp...

games.title: Azura's Crystals
games.description: Embark on an enchanting quest as Azura and discover a world of ancient mysticism. Forge unbreakable bonds with mythical creatures using the power of Primalis Crystals. Traverse breathtaking landscapes, make difficult choices, and uncover the secrets that shape your destiny.

games.canonical_title: Baby Blues Nightmares - Toddler Horror Game
games.title: Baby Blues Nightmares - Toddler Horror Game
games.description: Baby Blues Nightmare is a survival horror stealth game where you play as a toddler going into a little adventure with your tricycle which you can fix, maintain and customize. Paddle, hide and survive but remember; try not to cry when you are scared.. or the monsters will hear.

games.title: Baby Boomer 2: 35 Years Too Soon
games.description: Nobody asked for it, yet the sequel to “Baby Boomer” is out 35 years after the original! This is literally breaking the world record for the longest time in-between video game sequels!

games.title: Baby Storm
games.description:
Tieni d'occhio i bambini mentre scatenano il caos nella scuola materna e scappano per non farsi prendere! 
Mantieni tutto in ordine, corri, pulisci e dai da mangiare ai bambini per ottenere il punteggio migliore e passare così al livello successivo, ma anche al mondo successivo!

games.title: Back
games.description: 《Back》is a FMV game. Players will take on the role of the “Ren Xing” and experience a suspenseful and bizarre journey. The player will explore a huge villa hides a huge conspiracy face different emergencies to choose different ways to respond and will determine the final outcome.

games.title: Back 4 Blood: Standard Edition
games.description: Back 4 Blood è un adrenalinico sparatutto cooperativo in prima persona con un'intensa campagna cooperativa a 4 giocatori, una modalità multigiocatore competitiva in cui puoi vestire i panni di umano o Infestato e un sistema di gioco ricco d'azione.

games.title: Back Then
games.description: We all live with the fear of reaching the shadow of dementia. The ultimate fear of forgetting. For who do we become when we forget who we are? Back Then is a first-person narrative game taking place in the mind of Thomas, an elderly writer diagnosed with Alzheimer's Disease.

games.title: Back To Life
games.description:
Wellcome to Back To Life!
A night visit to an abandoned hospital gone wrong, now you are the last survivor, find your way out without being caught by the demon and experience a great adventure

games.title: Back to the Earth
games.description:
DescrTake an exciting journey.
Find out the reason for your abduction.
Help your space brothers.
Alien adventures await you!iption is not set

games.title: Back3：Spooky
games.description:
《Back3：Spooky》 is a moderately horror-themed FMV.
[b]As the third game in the Back series, the story unfolds after protagonists Ren Xing and Gao Yan survive their escape from the strange realm in the previous Back2. embarking on a brand-new adventure.[/b]

games.title: Back:Fade
games.description: Back:Fade is a FMV. As the second installment in the Back series.After escaping the first "Otherworld".This time, you are not alone—other characters will join you. Every choice you make will shape the story, different decisions will lead to vastly different endings.

games.title: Backbeat
games.description: A mashup of puzzle and strategy games. Manipulate four threads of time to guide your band through sokoban-style puzzles. Manage squad resources over a set of limited turns. Experience a homage to 1990s ensemble dramedies

games.title: Backdraft
games.description: Draft your deck. Survive the Gauntlet. Challenge your friends. Backdraft is a roguelike deckbuilder with twelve heroes, six elements, and over 250 cards to combine, upgrade, and master.

games.title: Backfire Brigade
games.description: Backfire Brigade è un caotico gioco cooperativo di lotta antincendio da due a quattro giocatori. Coordinati con i tuoi colleghi pompieri per salvare le vittime intrappolate negli edifici in fiamme e spegnere le fiamme.

games.title: Backpack Hero
games.description: Il roguelike di gestione dell'inventario! Raccogli oggetti rari, organizza il tuo zaino e sconfiggi i nemici!

games.title: BackRooms 1995 The Final Chapter
games.description: Fifteen years after the fire, Jacob wakes up alone in a prison cell. A voice Talks To Jacob You brought something that shouldn’t exist. With inmates and officers gone, Jacob must find the VHS tape inside the prison and return to find his missing brother.

games.title: BackRooms 1995 The Lost Footage Chapter 1
games.description: My name is Jacob i am 25 years old I heard there was a lot of rumor's that if find this abandoned house you start to see things but i am here to Find my missing brother,

games.title: Backrooms Bodycam
games.description: Si tratta sempre degli stessi corridoi gialli e delle stesse stanze abitate da entità pericolose, ma ora puoi combatterle!

games.title: Backrooms Bodycam 2
games.description: Entra nel misterioso mondo dei Backrooms! Trova le armi lasciate da altri viaggiatori, affronta entità pericolose e raggiungi l’uscita!

games.title: Backrooms Bodycam 3
games.description: Venture into the mysterious world of Backrooms! Find weapons left behind by other travelers, fight off dangerous entities, and reach the exit!

games.title: Backrooms Break
games.description: Explore and break the environments of the Backrooms and Poolrooms! Utilize Thor's demolition hammer, firearms, and explosives to carve your way through the walls and entities. This isn't just another mundane walking simulator game. Now the entities are the victims.

games.title: Backrooms Doors
games.description: Backrooms Doors - È un suggestivo gioco horror in prima persona. Esplorate spazi che non possono esistere nel mondo reale e trovate la via d'uscita prima che le entità vi trovino.

games.title: Backrooms Furry
games.description: Find a way out and don't let them catch you!

games.title: Backrooms Hide And Seek
games.description: Trova tutte le foto prima che gli abitanti di questi luoghi trovino te!

games.title: Backrooms Lost Dimension
games.description:
Backrooms: Lost Dimension drags you into an endless nightmare where every step could be your last.
Uncover the secrets of forbidden dimensions, face entities that defy logic, and fight to stay sane.
Each level is a descent into fear... only the brave will uncover the truth.

games.title: Backrooms Pools
games.description: An atmospheric horror game based on the popular internet creepypasta.

games.title: Backrooms: Eight Levels
games.description: "Dio ti salvi se senti qualcosa che si aggira nelle vicinanze, perché sicuramente ha sentito anche te"

games.title: Backrooms: Lost Signal
games.description: Un gioco horror cooperativo per 1–4 giocatori. Esplora 10+ mappe Backrooms create a mano, sopravvivi a 8+ entità uniche e usa la chat vocale di prossimità per coordinarti o farti prendere dal panico. Le tue scelte influenzano la storia con finali multipli.

games.title: Backrooms: Realm of Shadows
games.description: Backrooms: Realm of Shadows is a horror game that takes place in a seemingly endless maze of interconnected rooms and hallways, known as the Backrooms.

games.title: Bad Cheese
games.description:
Bad Cheese is a psychological horror inspired by the eerie charm of 1920s animation. 
Step into the tiny paws of a mouse spending the weekend at home with a dysfunctional Dad while Mom's away. 
Be on your best behavior and KEEP DADDY HAPPY.

games.title: Bad North
games.description: ![Bad North Image](https://cdn2.unrealengine.com/Diesel%2Fproductv2%2Fbad-north%2Fhome%2Fabout-1024x865-434a624a315470d8d4e98226e0bdc16ccb3e4b5b.png)

games.title: Bad Rats Revenge
games.description: Bad Rats is a physics puzzle game where rats finally get their bloody revenge on their new prisoners: The cats. Come up with creative solutions for each puzzle using physics, functional objects, and your specially trained Rats

games.title: Bad Rats Show
games.description: Bad Rats Show is a physics puzzle game where the rats exact their bloody revenge against their main enemies: the Cats.Solve puzzles in 2D and 3D maps using physics, objects and specially trained Rats.All new Rats and Cats,but with the same classic and questionable Bad Rats humor.

games.title: Bagarre
games.description:
Bagarre is a competitive top-down PvP MOBA.

The main gameplay is a Deathmatch, with RPG and gacha elements.

Everyone starts with the same base character and theorycrafting is a core feature of the game.

games.title: Baldur's Gate Dark Alliance II
games.description: Il male indicibile è tornato nella leggendaria città di Baldur's Gate.

games.title: Baldur's Gate II: Enhanced Edition
games.description: Riscopri l'amato classico GDR, ora migliorato per gli avventurieri moderni! Raduna il tuo gruppo di eroi e prosegui la leggendaria avventura in questa epopea fantasy dalla spiccata componente narrativa in cui ogni scelta sarà fondamentale.

games.title: Baldur's Gate: Dark Alliance
games.description: Experience the massively popular world of Baldur's Gate as never before. Baldur's Gate: Dark Alliance thrusts you into an epic Dungeons & Dragons adventure filled with intense action, intricate puzzles and sinister intrigue.

games.title: Baldur's Gate: Enhanced Edition
games.description: Baldur's Gate: Enhanced Edition è l'amato classico GDR degli anni '90, migliorato per gli avventurieri moderni. Personalizza il tuo eroe, forma la tua squadra e avventurati in un epico mondo aperto dove ogni scelta ha un peso.

games.title: Ball Partner
games.description: A turn-based marbles battle game. Explore every corner of the game to find various monsters, become partners with them, train them, and challenge the tournament together to win the championship.

games.title: Ballad of Violence
games.description: Tune up and fight!

games.title: Balloon Strike
games.description: Balloon Strike is amazing Balloon Strike game in which you have bow and arrow to hit balloon and get score.
games.developer: Yash Future Tech Solutions Pvt Ltd
games.publisher: Yash Future Tech Solutions Pvt Ltd

games.title: Bandit Trap
games.description: Defend your home using inventive boobytraps as the Trapper, or team up as three sneaky Bandits and try to escape with the loot! Bandit Trap is a wild 3v1 online multiplayer game with pranks, mayhem and hilarious moments—perfect for parties, friends and family game night!

games.title: Bandits vs Lords: Epic Clash
games.description: Bandits vs Lords: crea clan, guida eserciti e conquista regni. Domina battaglie epiche!

games.canonical_title: Bandle Tale: A League of Legends Story
games.title: Bandle Tale: A League of Legends Story
games.description: Bandle Tale: A League of Legends Story è un GDR con sistema di creazione ambientato nell'estroso mondo di Bandle City. Una festa va a rotoli, il sistema dei portali collassa e il mondo piomba nel caos! Solo tu puoi ripristinare i portali e salvare Bandle City.

games.title: Bang Average Football
games.description: Experience the thrill of the beautiful game in Bang Average Football - the fast-paced, easy-to-learn football game for 1-4 players! Play against your friends for footballing glory in multiplayer, or turn a hopeless club into national champions as player-manager in Story mode!

games.title: Banished
games.description: Control a group of exiled travelers restarting their lives in the wilderness. Guide them on their journey from humble beginnings to living in a thriving village.

games.title: Banishers - Ghosts of New Eden
games.description: Dai la caccia ai fantasmi nelle vesti di due personaggi memorabili in un RPG d'azione in cui ogni scelta ha conseguenze drammatiche. Risolvi i casi di infestazione e affronta le forze sovrannaturali con i poteri di Antea e l'arsenale di Rosso.

games.title: Banners of Ruin
games.description: Costruisci un mazzo e combatti una serie di scontri a turni per le strade della città di Dawn's Point insieme a una squadra composta da un massimo di 6 personaggi. Ogni personaggio può sbloccare un set di carte e abilità uniche che potranno migliorare il tuo mazzo rendendolo p...

games.title: BAO
games.description: BAO is an RPG where you Battle Against Objects. Explore a world taken over by Evil Rugby the II where he has made a crystal infection intended to control everyone. Fight your way though hoards of controlled objects to stop Evil Rugby and bring peace back to the land.

games.title: Barbie™ Progetto Amicizia
games.description:
Vivi con Barbie™ una fantastica avventura estiva per salvare il Malibu Waves Community Center!

Aiuta amici, sblocca minigiochi e ottieni punti ristrutturando con stile.
games.developer: Xaloc Studios and Casual Brothers Ltd

games.title: Barony
games.description: Barony è il miglior gioco roguelike in prima persona con modalità cooperativa. Ti attendono misteriosi oggetti, trappole letali e mostri subdoli dei classici roguelike e GDR. Conquista il dungeon da solo o insieme agli amici in modalità cooperativa, con emblematiche ed esotich...

games.title: Barotrauma
games.description: Barotrauma is a 2D co-op submarine simulator – in space, with survival horror and RPG elements. Steer your submarine, complete missions, fight monsters, fix leaks, operate machinery, man the guns and craft items, and stay alert: danger in Barotrauma doesn’t announce itself!

games.title: Barrel Baller
games.description: Barrel Baller is 3D platformer where you control v806 autonomous hauler unit carrying out deliveries across various different planets.

games.title: Barton Lynch Pro Surfing
games.description: Barton Lynch Pro Surfing pits you against the world’s best surfer’s at the most exotic locations on the planet. An in-depth leader-board sports game meets free surf exploration at 12 massive worlds. Get pumped by the unique control, amazing weather & customization tools.

games.title: Basingstoke
games.description: Basingstoke is a tense rogue-like that mixes stealth and arcade action. Explore the smouldering ruins of Basingstoke, a world of reanimated undead and ferocious alien monsters. Scavenge as you go, crafting equipment to help you in your mission: escape Basingstoke!

games.title: Basketballverse
games.description: Basketballverse is a captivating fusion of hoop culture and immersive, high-energy multiplayer game. Serving as a true cultural hub, it provides an unparalleled experience and creates an atmosphere that truly celebrates the essence of basketball.

games.title: Bassmaster® Fishing
games.description: Bassmaster® Fishing, il videogioco ufficiale, è adesso disponibile, e porta l'emozione della pesca competitiva su PC. Tuffati nei contenuti della serie Bassmaster®, tutti su licenza, dagli eventi amatoriali a quelli élite.

games.title: Batbarian: Testament of the Primordials
games.description: Explore hundreds of secret-filled rooms, fight big bosses, gather companions and use the powers of Pip -your bat buddy- to solve puzzles and escape the eldritch abyss in this snarky action-adventure!

games.title: Batman Arkham Asylum Game of the Year Edition
games.description: Scopri cosa significa essere Batman e affronta i più grandi criminali di Gotham City. Esplora ogni angolo del manicomio di Arkham e aggirati liberamente per la malfamata isola.

games.title: Batman Arkham City Game of the Year Edition
games.description: Ottieni Batman: Arkham City e tutti i DLC a un prezzo bassissimo grazie alla GOTY Edition!

games.title: Batman Arkham Knight
games.description: Batman™: Arkham Knight conclude in maniera epica l'acclamata trilogia Arkham di Rocksteady Studios. Sviluppato esclusivamente per le piattaforme di nuova generazione, Batman: Arkham Knight introduce il design unico della batmobile nella versione di Rocksteady Studios.

games.title: Batora: Lost Haven
games.description: Batora: Lost Haven® is a choice-driven isometric action adventure with RPG elements and a unique duality system affecting combat, story, dialogues, puzzles, and endings, that will make you question the meaning of sacrifice.

games.title: BATTLE BEARS HEROES
games.description: Relive your childhood in this fast thrilling PvP brawler! Enjoy new modes like Mini MOBA, Battle Royale, and Deathmatch, Survive the classic BB-1 PvE campaign. Upgrade & customize all the bears from the award-wnning Battle Bears series. Winner of PocketGamer's Big Indie Pitch!

games.title: Battle Bits
games.description: Difendi il sistema in Battle Bits! In questo gioco 2D, sei una coraggiosa chiocciola (@) che combatte contro un virus informatico. Affronta nemici dalla A alla Z e boss da 0 a 9 usando segni come armi.

games.title: Battle Chasers: Nightwar
games.description: Battle Chasers: Nightwar è un GDR ispirato ai grandi classici su console, con una profonda esplorazione di dungeon, combattimenti a turni nel classico stile dei GDR giapponesi e una storia avvincente da scoprire esplorando il mondo.

games.title: Battle Chess
games.description: It took 2000 years for someone to make chess better!

games.title: Battle Chess 4000
games.description: Welcome to the Chess Game of Tomorrow!

games.title: Battle Chess II: Chinese Chess
games.description: Battle Chess II brings new life into Chinese Chess. A game of strategy with animated battles to bring the game to life!

games.title: Battle for Ercaton: Robot Uprising
games.description: Battle For Ercaton: Robot Uprising is a story-driven first-person shooter that throws you into a world of ruthless machines and hidden secrets on the planet Ercaton.

games.title: Battle Nations
games.description: Build your empire and lead your armies to victory in Battle Nations!

games.title: Battle Of Europe
games.description: You must prove that the RAF is a force to be reckoned with!

games.title: Battle Tanks
games.description: An exciting tank game with a huge world awaits you! Get to know the battle tanks!

games.title: Battle Train
games.description: Outthink, outbuild, outblast! Battle Train combines deck-building and tactical rail combat. Upgrade your train, lay tracks, and destroy your rivals with devastating locomotives. The rails are your battlefield—will you be the last train standing?

games.title: Battle with monsters game 3D
games.description: Battle with monsters game 3D is a role-playing game developed by me. In this game, you will play as a 3D hero character. You will move around the map to fight monsters. Battle various types of monsters throughout the game

games.title: BattleCore Arena
games.description: BattleCore Arena

games.title: Battlefield 4™ Premium Edition
games.description: Scopri una distruzione senza pari in Battlefield 4™. Combatti nel glorioso caos della guerra totale, dove troverai ad attenderti avvincenti sfide tattiche in scenari di gioco interattivi.

games.title: Battlefield V Edizione Definitiva
games.description: L'esperienza definitiva di Battlefield V. Partecipa al più grande conflitto della storia con l'arsenale di armi, veicoli e gadget al completo, più i migliori contenuti di personalizzazione degli anni 1 e 2.

games.title: Battlefield™ 1 Revolution
games.description: Battlefield™ 1 ti porta nella Grande Guerra, quando le nuove tecnologie ed un conflitto globale cambiarono per sempre il volto della guerra.

games.title: Battlefield™ 2042
games.description: Battlefield™ 2042 segna il ritorno dell'iconica guerra totale della serie. Forma una squadra e porta con te un arsenale all'avanguardia in campi di battaglia su vasta scala, in un mondo trasformato dal caos nel prossimo futuro.

games.title: Battlefield™ 6
games.description: Lo sparatutto più venduto del 2025

games.title: Battlefield™ Hardline Ultimate Edition
games.description: Strategia. Velocità. Storia. Questi sono i pilastri principali di Battlefield™ Hardline: poliziotti contro criminali in un'esperienza del tutto nuova.

games.description: BattleJuice Alchemist è un gioco di ruolo che aggiunge un sistema di abilità basato sull'equipaggiamento alla formula classica. Concentrati sul combattimento isometrico o opta per il combattimento uno contro uno in stile JRPG. Esplora la zona e studia la magia rituale.

games.title: Battleships Combat: Evolved
games.description: A remake of the classical sea battle-type game, where players take turns to guess enemy ship position. In our game players fight on a customizable battlefield and enjoy a great roster of ships from the 20th century with interesting damage patterns.

games.description: Bavovna included! - a satirical, casual indie game - manifesto in the Shoot 'em up genre with pixel graphics about russian troops in Ukraine. Memes and Easter eggs are included in the price!

games.title: BC Kings
games.description: BC Kings features several new elements not commonly found in strategy games. In addition to gathering resources, training an army and defeating the enemy, you will have to solve adventure and role-playing elements as well.

games.title: Be The Master of Yihongyuan
games.description: The story continues to develop, and due to hard work day and night, the protagonist suddenly dies at the hands of his boss. The soul returns to ancient times and becomes the owner of the bankrupt Yihong Courtyard

games.title: Beach Invasion 1944
games.description: Beach Invasion 1944 is a WWII FPS game where you defend the fortified beach against invading forces who will attack you with troops, tanks, planes and more! Use the iconic WWII weapons such as MG42, Flak88 and Panzers, prepare your defenses with mines, explosives and bonuses!

games.title: Beach Invasion 1945 - Pacific
games.description: Beach Invasion 1945-Pacific is a WWII FPS game where you defend the fortified Pacific island beaches against invading forces who will attack you with troops, tanks, planes and more! Use a variety of iconic and authentic WWII U.S. and Imperial Japanese weapons and defenses.

games.title: BeachHead Meta
games.description: Beachhead Meta is not just a game but an experience unlike any other. Its an entertainment product integrating gaming and a virtual world where you can play, interact with others, compete, and prosper.

games.title: BeachHead Rogue
games.description: BH Rogue is the next exciting iteration of the BeachHead brand. It blends the action FPS of the original BeachHead game with new Rogue-lite elements.

games.title: Beacon of Neyda
games.description: In a world where a robot revolution failed, the last humans search for a way to survive and escape. Beacon of Neyda is a side-scroller strategy game where you have to survive waves of enemies while creating and upgrading your base. Build where you want - Defend what you can.

games.title: Beacon Pines

games.description: Un RPG d'azione cooperativo online per un massimo di 8 giocatori. Affronta bestie gigantesche con una fisica realistica, sali su di loro per schiacciarne la testa e vivi intense battaglie d'azione di nuova generazione con il tuo gruppo, tutte guidate da una fisica avanzata.

games.title: Beasts of Maravilla Island
games.description: Beasts of Maravilla Island è un'avventura 3D in cui vestirai i panni di una giovane fotografa naturalista che percorrerà i magici ecosistemi di Maravilla Island per scoprire fantastiche creature, impararne i comportamenti e, soprattutto, fotografarle in tutta la loro maestà.

games.title: Beat of Rebellion
games.description: Be the voice out of the choir! Beat of Rebellion is an isometric rhythm-based Hack & Slash. Follow the Beat, create your own Melodies and unleash devastating combos to fight against a totalitarian regime in a cyberpunk city.

games.title: Beatbuddy: On Tour
games.description:
Experience a fast paced action game set in the Beatbuddy universe! 
Help Beatbuddy to play awesome concerts all over Symphonia and master 36 funky levels in this SPIN-OFF from the awarded STEAM game Beatbuddy: Tale of the Guardians.

games.title: Beatbuddy: Tale of the Guardians
games.description: Beatbuddy is an award-winning music-action adventure that combines puzzle solving and exploration with a dynamic soundtrack. The game features beautifully hand-drawn worlds, each with their own amazing sound composed by industry legends such as Austin Wintory.

games.title: Beaten Path
games.description: Beaten Path is a turn-based tactical RPG set in a world ruled by fallen gods and ancient machines. Take command of Panna and her companions as they unravel the secrets of time, confronting lost memories, mythic powers, and a looping fate.

games.title: Beautiful Indie Worlds Bundle
games.description: The Beautiful Indie Worlds Bundle enchants with two games whose dreamlike worlds couldn't be more different. Find your true destiny in Scarf and learn more about the afterlife in De-Exit!

games.title: Beautiful Light
games.description: Beautiful Light, a PvPvPvE tactical first-person extraction shooter where operators are tasked with entering, securing, and extracting an artifact in a horrific environment. Face other operators and player-controlled anomalies, but beware: mistakes can risk your life and gear.

games.title: Bee Simulator
games.description: Vivi la vita di un'ape! Esplora un mondo pieno di vita in cui raccoglierai polline, sfiderai le vespe pericolose e salverai il tuo alveare. Gioca insieme agli altri in tre modalità, tra cui cooperativa e PvP su schermo condiviso.

games.title: Bee Simulator: The Hive
games.description: Vivi l'epica avventura di una piccola ape in un mondo enorme! Raccogli polline, sfreccia tra le correnti d’aria e difendi il tuo alveare dalle vespe. Ora ancora più grande con l’espansione The Hive—raccogli risorse, costruisci e personalizza il tuo alveare!

games.title: BeetleQuest 2023
games.description: BeetleQuest is an adventure game about three beetlefriends who go on a great adventure together. Visit sunny forests, mysterious swamps, dark caves, and even a land underwater! All beautifully hand-drawn and animated, and filled with point and click goodness!

games.title: Before The World Died
games.description:
Before The World Died is a short game poem and interactive fiction about The End.
You play the very last flower left on Earth, bringing peace to long dead soil.
Explore brutalist ruins to collect memories of a dead world.
Maybe your presence can heal what is left.

games.title: Before We Leave
games.description: Before We Leave è un city builder non violento ambientato in un accogliente angolo dell'universo. Prenditi cura dei tuoi abitanti e dell'ambiente circostante, mentre ricostruisci e riscopri la civiltà. Insediati in nuovi territori e pianeti, cercando di non finire nelle fauci ...

games.title: Before Your Eyes
games.description: Intraprendi una commovente avventura narrativa in prima persona nella quale controlli la storia (e ne influenzi gli esiti) attraverso il battito delle tue palpebre. Grazie a questa tecnica innovativa ti potrai immergere in un mondo di ricordi mentre la tua intera vita ti passa...

games.canonical_title: Behind the Frame: Il paesaggio più bello
games.title: Behind the Frame: Il paesaggio più bello
games.description: Guida le pennellate e risolvi i rompicapi per aiutare un'aspirante artista a completare il suo capolavoro. Mentre componi il dipinto, scopri un'emozionante storia di possibilità e talento, svelata in momenti slegati e tuttavia familiari.

games.title: Beholder
games.description: You’re a state-installed landlord in a totalitarian country. Place listening devices, steal and sneak into your tenants’ apartments. Use what you uncovered to report anyone capable of plotting against the state. You MUST! But WILL you?

games.title: Beholder 3
games.description: When a high-ranking security officer saves you from prison, you end up a pawn in her schemes. Now you must eliminate anyone standing in the way of her secret plans and try to get your life back while working two jobs. No tenant, employee or superior is safe from your spying.

games.title: Beholder: Conductor
games.description: A Beholder series spin-off. Become a conductor of the Determination Bringer train: monitor passengers, report incidents, and carry out important Ministry assignments — whose level of secrecy depends only on your loyalty. And remember: mission success is very important to you!

games.title: Beku
games.description: Captured by a plotting king of Beku and forced to embark on a challenging quest to finalise his plans, you'll master your devastating ethereal abilities in this 2D platformer to overcome increasing waves of formidable foes. What secrets will you find along the way?

games.title: Below the Stone
games.description: Below the Stone is a pixel-art roguelike about dwarves on a quest for the deepest depths. A place where every descent will lead to new adventures -- and where only the most determined dwarves with many lost lives will be rewarded by the hidden world lying below the stone.

games.title: Bendy and the Ink Machine
games.description: Bendy and the Ink Machine®, gioco horror in prima persona che combina azione e rompicapi, trasformerà i tuoi amati cartoni dell'infanzia in un incubo indimenticabile.

games.title: Beneath
games.description: Beneath è uno sparatutto in prima persona, ispirato al Lovecraft. Combatterai in solitaria per di 10 ore in una campagna, per fronteggiare nemici spietatii. Il gioco è pensato tanto per i giocatori con esperienza quanto per chi è in cerca di una nuova sfida in stile old school.

games.title: Berzerk Recharged
games.description: Blast your way through an endless maze inhabited by deadly robots and their invulnerable, menacing master Evil Otto. Tag in a friend in local co-op to help you survive this twin-stick revival of an arcade classic.

games.title: Besteam
games.description: Besteam Game is an innovative startup building a football metaverse using NFTs, blockchain, and IoT. Users become virtual footballers with customizable avatars, join teams, and compete in 11vs11 matches bringing real football into the virtual world.

games.title: Better Mart Simulator
games.description: Create and expand your dream supermarket. Manage your aisles, inventory, machines, cleaning, deliveries, and staff. Welcome your customers and decorate every corner. Play solo or with up to 6 players and transform a small shop into a retail empire!

games.title: BetterTogether
games.description:
Have fun with your friends.
Puzzle Parkour: Solve puzzles, cooperate with your friends or sabotage them!
Climb Up: Reach the top without falling, but be careful, difficult roads and sabotage await you.
Dead Hunt: Stand back to back and survive waves of deadly enemies!

games.title: Bewitched: Part 1
games.description: Bewitched è un romanzo visivo pieno di avventure e missioni nel mondo della magia, dove hai una possibilità incredibile di diventare apprendista di una delle streghe più strane e carismatiche。

games.title: Beyond Astra
games.description: Beyond Astra is a real-time 4X sci-fi grand strategy game. Expand your own civilization, explore captivating and mysterious planets and star clusters, interact with your citizens and other life forms and shape your destiny through nearly infinite possibilities.

games.title: Beyond Blue
games.description: Beyond Blue è un'avventura narrativa per giocatore singolo, che ti trascina nelle profondità del cuore blu pulsante del nostro pianeta.  Ambientato in un futuro prossimo, Beyond Blue esplora i misteri del nostro oceano attraverso gli occhi di Mirai, esploratrice e scienziata d...

games.title: Beyond Enemy Lines - Remastered Edition
games.description:
The world is near of nuclear apocalypse, a soviet seperatist group captured the control chip of a military satelite. It is your job to recover the chip!
Equipped with state of the art weapons and equipment, you operate in absolute secrecy as a lone wolf far beyond enemy lines.

games.title: Beyond Enemy Lines 2 Enhanced Edition
games.description: Take the role of a special agent deployed deep beyond enemy lines. You will seek, locate and destroy the enemy while causing havoc and confusion. Emerge a hardcore tactical experience in vast, nonlinear missions where skill and tactical decisions matter!

games.title: Beyond Galaxyland
games.description: Beyond Galaxyland è un'avventura GDR che racchiude esplorazione dello spazio, combattimenti strategici a turni ed epiche battaglie contro i boss in un immenso sistema solare. Unisciti a Doug e al suo porcellino d'India pistolero in un esilarante viaggio per salvare la Terra.

games.title: Beyond Good & Evil 20th Anniversary Edition
games.description: Beyond Good & Evil 20th Anniversary Edition

games.title: Beyond Limits: The Parkour Game
games.description:
Beyond Limits è un gioco di parkour in cui salti e ti arrampichi sugli oggetti.
Ma non dimenticare: se cadi, riparti dall'inizio!

games.title: Beyond The Board
games.description: A single-player puzzle game that transforms traditional chess into a minimal, immersive journey. Every move is a step deeper into the world Beyond the Board, where shifting tiles and puzzles reveal the hidden fractures within the game’s very foundations.

games.title: Beyond the Ice Palace 2
games.description: Risorgi dai morti nei panni del "Re maledetto" in un avvincente platform d'azione. Impugna le catene che un tempo ti imprigionavano per sconfiggere nemici e attraversare il tuo regno. Scopri aree nascoste, sali di livello e rivendica il trono scacciando boss colossali!

games.title: Beyond These Stars
games.description: Costruisci una città sul dorso di una balena spaziale e impara a coesistere con questa creatura mentre viaggi tra le stelle. Gestisci complesse catene di rifornimento e le esigenze del tuo popolo mentre costruisci avamposti, incontri alieni e scopri i misteri dell'universo.

games.title: Beyond Two Souls
games.description: Vivi la vita straordinaria di Jodie e la sua connessione con una potente entità sovrannaturale.

games.title: Bible Trivia
games.description:
How well do you know your Bible Trivia?

Bible Trivia has never been so much fun. Challenge yourself or have a Bible Trivia night with friends and family in Party Mode!

games.title: Bibots
games.description: Bibots è uno sparatutto dall'alto in stile rogue-lite ambientato in un mondo futuristico. Gioca nei panni di Tayar, un esploratore che controlla un robot, e libera stanze con mostri, poteri e segreti da svelare. Muori, prova e ripeti finché non affronterai la minaccia finale.

games.canonical_title: Big Adventure: Trip to Europe 2 Collector's Edition
games.title: Big Adventure: Trip to Europe 2 Collector's Edition
games.description: Explore Europe in the ultimate Hidden Object adventure, “Trip to Europe 2”! Visit  cities across  countries, from Paris to Lisbon. Discover treasures, play exciting mini-games, and experience iconic landmarks like the Pena Palace. Uncover  secrets in Europe’s top tourist spots!

games.canonical_title: Big Adventure: Trip to Europe 3 Collector's Edition
games.title: Big Adventure: Trip to Europe 3 Collector's Edition
games.description: Discover the charm of Europe in “Trip to Europe 3” – a hidden object adventure! Explore  tourist hotspots in countries, uncover unique items, and play exciting mini-games. From Venice to Monaco, dive into culture, landmarks, and fun. Start your hidden object journey now!

games.canonical_title: Big Adventure: Trip to Europe 4 Collector's Edition
games.title: Big Adventure: Trip to Europe 4 Collector's Edition
games.description: Embark on a Hidden Object adventure with “Trip to Europe 4”! Explore  stunning locations across  European countries. Discover treasures, play mini-games, and collect souvenirs as you visit iconic spots like Greek islands, Budapest, and Monaco. Uncover the secrets of Europe now!

games.title: Big Buck Hunter: Ultimate Trophy
games.description: Preparati per caricare l'arma, prendere la mira e dominare la natura selvaggia come mai prima d'ora con Big Buck Hunter: Ultimate Trophy!

games.title: Big Helmet Heroes
games.description:
Immergiti in un’epica avventura picchiaduro 3D con adorabili cavalieri, piena di mondi e situazioni sorprendenti.
Gioca in coppia in modalità cooperativa 2 giocatori per salvare la principessa; ma questo sarà solo l’inizio!

games.title: Big Mutha Truckers 2
games.description: Ma Jackson, Hick State County's most infamous trucker, has been incarcerated on charges of tax evasion, 7,973 parking tickets, and six counts of being a comedy stereotype! Imprisoned, Ma's only hope lies with her kids.

games.title: Big Pharma
games.description: E se potessi far sparire le malattie dal mondo, migliorare le vite di milioni di persone, alleviare le sofferenze e curare i malati... il tutto mentre guadagni un bel gruzzoletto? (Non necessariamente in questo ordine...) Ti diamo il benvenuto nel mondo di Big Pharma!

games.title: Big Time
games.description: Big Time is a thrilling multiplayer action RPG that blends fast-paced combat with an epic journey through time and space.

games.title: Bigfoot Life
games.description: Live as Bigfoot in a peaceful forest-life simulator. Fish, forage, build, and protect wildlife as the guardian of the woods. Create your own Bigfoot and live your best Bigfoot Life.

games.title: Bikini Boxing
games.description:
Bikini Boxing is a live-action video interactive game. 
The game takes you into the world of the main character, where you boxing with 10 bikini beauties, and the game does not contain romance elements and a gripping plot.

games.title: Bilge Junction
games.description: Welcome to Bilge Junction, population 8: a dying town on the arctic highway. With the promise of a cheap roof over your head, you ran from your problems and wound up here. But winter's setting in, and the fire keeps burning. A storm is on its way.

games.title: Binary Smoke
games.description: È il futuro. L'oscurità digitale ha divorato il mondo. Ma la speranza sopravvive sotto forma di Binary Smoke. Guida un'insurrezione contro la classe dirigente e ispira una rivoluzione che rinnoverà la fiducia nel futuro.

games.title: Bio Prototipo
games.description: Un'ondata di sperimentazioni irrazionali si precipita verso di te. Sbrigati e muta! Evoluzione! Diventa mostri più spaventosi di loro! Usa carne e sangue per sbocciare un modo di sopravvivenza!

games.title: BIOMORPH
games.description: BIOMORPH is a dark metroidvania where you become the creatures that you kill! Solve ingenious puzzles and navigate a stunning hand-drawn world. Meet quirky characters, rebuild a city, and uncover the secrets of a sprawling, fallen civilization… and of your own mysterious origins.

games.title: BIOMUTANT
games.description: BIOMUTANT® è un gioco di ruolo post-apocalittico favolistico, con un mondo di gioco aperto e un sistema di combattimento originale in grado di unire combattimenti corpo a corpo, armi da fuoco e abilità mutanti.

games.title: Bion Clash
games.description: Dive into a chaotic, free-to-play party royale set in a hilarious dystopian future! Compete in absurd minigames, explore a vibrant sci-fi world, and outsmart your friends in this ever-evolving social adventure.

games.title: Bionics - We Will Evolve
games.description: Take the role of Jonas Schmidt, a private investigator trapped in a deranged house. Uncover the grim secrets of human experiments and grotesque machinery, all while solving puzzles and avoiding monstrous creations. Can you escape before you become the next test subject?

games.title: BioShock 2 Remastered
games.description: Osserva Rapture attraverso gli occhi del Soggetto Delta, un terrificante prototipo di Big Daddy, in una missione in cui rischierai la tua vita per salvare la tua Sorellina dispersa. Sono inclusi Minerva's Den e Prove protettore.

games.title: BioShock Infinite: The Complete Edition
games.description: Dopo essersi indebitato con le persone sbagliate, l'investigatore Booker DeWitt deve affrontare un'impresa impossibile: raggiungere una città tra le nuvole, Columbia, e salvare una misteriosa ragazza di nome Elizabeth. Sono inclusi gli episodi 1 e 2 di Burial at Sea e Clash in the Clouds.

games.title: BioShock Remastered
games.description: Esplora la città sottomarina di Rapture, un rifugio per le menti più brillanti della società che si è trasformato in un incubo distopico a causa della supponenza di una singola persona. Sono inclusi Museo delle idee orfane, Stanze della sfida (Challenge Rooms) e Commento del regista: Immaginare BioShock (Director's Commentary: Imagining BioShock).

games.title: BioShock: The Collection
games.description: Divertiti con la pluripremiata serie BioShock. Avventurati nelle città di Rapture e Columbia con BioShock Remastered, BioShock 2 Remastered e BioShock Infinite: The Complete Edition, incluso ogni contenuto dell'add-on per giocatore singolo.

games.title: Bioweaver
games.description: Bioweaver is an RPG game with the main content of treasure hunting and character building. You can use basic programming logic to deeply customize your skill sets, and you can also create organs with different attributes and functions with the special crafting system.

games.title: Biped
games.description: Due piccoli robot bipedi, Aku e Sila, cammineranno fianco a fianco e intraprenderanno un viaggio divertente e coinvolgente. Goditi questa avventura da solo o divertiti in modalità co-op con un amico o un parente.  Colleziona tesori e acquista cappelli carini!

games.title: Biped 2
games.description: I robottini sono tornati in azione! Esplora un pianeta misterioso in un gioco d'azione e avventura. Prova le nostre meccaniche innovative in solitaria o in cooperativa con un massimo di 4 giocatori!

games.title: Biped 2 DEMO
games.description: I robottini sono tornati in azione! Esplora un pianeta misterioso in un gioco d'azione e avventura. Prova le nostre meccaniche innovative in solitaria o in cooperativa con un massimo di 4 giocatori!

games.title: Birch Simulator
games.description: I personaggi principali dei giochi moderni possono essere molto diversi tra loro. Cavalieri coraggiosi, scienziati brillanti o supereroi che salvano mondi interi. Questo gioco vi offre un'esperienza più insolita. Qui potrete diventare una Betulla.

games.title: Bite the Bullet
games.description: Bite The Bullet è il primo Corri & Spara & Mangia al mondo. In questo roguelie RPG shooter devi mangiare i nemici, le pallottole e ancor di più per potenziare il tuo personaggio, le tue armi e le tue abilità. Spara zombie, robot e boss giganti mutanti con'esplosione di proiettili

games.title: Black Academy
games.description: 'School life like hell... Actually, it’s a school run by the devil?!’ Black Academy combines Side-scrolling shooting and Rogue-lite with a storyline of students transforming into magical girls to confront demons after finding out the real identity of the Academy.

games.title: Black Book
games.description: Black Book è un avventura GDR dai toni oscuri basata sulla mitologia slava in cui vestirai i panni di una giovane maga. Combatti le tenebre con un sistema di combattimento basato sulle carte ed esplora un mondo in cui gli umani vivono insieme a creature mitologiche.

games.canonical_title: Black Hair Girl is Best Girl
games.title: Black Hair Girl is Best Girl
games.description:
This visual novel is a 2-in-1 combo featuring two stories where both heroines have black hair.
The first story is an exploration of the philosophy of free will in an infinite loop.
The second story is a mystery VN about memory loss and its relation to love.

games.title: Black Myth: Wukong
games.description: Black Myth: Wukong è un RPG d'azione che attinge dalla mitologia cinese. Vestendo i panni del Predestinato, partirai per un viaggio ricco di sfide e portenti per scoprire la verità che si cela dietro al velo di un'insigne leggenda del passato.

games.title: Black Skylands
games.description: Mettiti al comando della tua aeronave per esplorare il mondo dei cieli, raccogli risorse per fabbricare armi potentissime, svela segreti arcani e combatti all'ombra delle vele della tua nave.

games.title: Black State
games.description: Black State opens a new door in the single-player, story-driven, action-adventure TPS genre, offering a photo-realistic action experience with countless elements of surprise that gamers have been demanding for so long.

games.title: Black Widow: Recharged
games.description: Difendi la tua ragnatela dall'assalto furibondo degli insetti in questo frenetico revival dello sparatutto cult a doppia levetta, al ritmo della contagiosa colonna sonora di Megan McDuffee. Gioca in modalità singola o cooperativa locale con un amico affrontando 30 sfide o nella modalità arcade.

games.title: BLACKHAT espionage
games.description: A newly hired cybersecurity specialist gets pulled in over his head as he unravels mysterious code hidden by an ancient prophet. You must use the clues to find and recover the missing hard drive and any evidence.

games.title: Blackjack 21: Blackjackist
games.description: Il Blackjack è un gioco avvincente che piace a tutti. Fai una puntata, ottieni più punti del banco e vinci delle chip. Senti il richiamo del rischio immergendoti nell'atmosfera da casinò e non farti sfuggire la fortuna.

games.title: Blacksad - Under the Skin
games.description: Un misterioso scandalo di corruzione nel cuore della malavita di New York per il carismatico detective John Blacksad

games.title: BLACKSHARD
games.description: BLACKSHARD is a first-person exploration game. Wander through a strange megastructure, the Labyrinth, to unravel its mysteries... Your behavior within the Labyrinth will define the outcome of your journey. What path will you choose to take?

games.title: Blacksmith Master
games.description: Gestisci la tua fucina medievale in Blacksmith Master ed estrai minerali e gemme per creare e vendere dei prodotti finiti. Forgia armi, armature, strumenti, utensili da cucina e molto altro per sostenere la tua attività e diventare specialista della forgiatura.

games.title: Blacksmith of the Sand Kingdom
games.description: Diventa il fabbro avventuriero della corte nel Regno di Sabbia!

games.title: BLACKTAIL
games.description: Forge the legend of Baba Yaga, a girl accused of witchcraft and expelled from her home. Live out the origins of the Slavic myth in this one-of-a-kind blend of intense archery combat and dark storytelling set in a vibrant fairy tale world.

games.title: Blade Ball Arena
games.description:
Blade Ball Arena is a fast-paced, easy-to-pick-up PVP game for you and your friends.
No tricky rules. No tutorial. Just you, a blade, and a heat-seeking dodgeball. Got what it takes to come out on top in the Blade Ball Arena? Jump in for a game or two!

games.title: Blade of God X: Orisols
games.description: "Blade of God X: Orisols" mira a portarvi in un viaggio incentrato sul tema del sacrificio e della redenzione, dove potrete trovare le vostre risposte.

games.title: Blade Prince Academy
games.description: Blade Prince Academy is a new take on tactical RPGs, where you lead your squad of Blade Princes to defend the city of Abjectalia with real-time with pause combat. Use your team's power to devastate threats, but be vigilant—there’s always a price to pay for a pact with darkness!

games.title: Blade Strangers
games.description: Blade Strangers

games.title: Blades of Fire
games.description: Un'avventura dark fantasy in cui forgiare l'acciaio modella i combattimenti, la progressione e il destino.

games.title: Bladesong
games.description: The ultimate swordmaking game. Forge unique weapons with freeform blade shaping and modular hilts, perfectly balanced to your customers’ needs. Master the art of smithing and uncover the secrets of Eren Keep, a last haven of a dying world – or so they say.

games.title: Blair Witch
games.description: Ispirato al mondo cinematografico di Blair Witch, vivi un nuovo horror psicologico narrativo che studia le tue reazioni alla paura e alla tensione.

games.title: Blanc
games.description: Blanc è un gioco d'avventura cooperativo artistico che racconta l'avventura di un lupetto e un cerbiatto bloccati in una vasta terra selvaggia innevata. Questo improbabile duo dovrà unire le forze per ritrovare le proprie rispettive famiglie.

games.title: Blankos Block Party
games.description: A vibrant open-world multiplayer game styled like a giant block party, with a focus on custom art and design, level building, exploration, and curating your collection of unique and rare Blankos!!

games.title: Blasphemous
games.description: Blasphemous è un brutale gioco d'azione platform con combattimenti in stile picchiaduro, ambientato nel mondo da incubo di Cvstodia. Esplora, potenzia le tue abilità e annienta senza pietà le orde di nemici che ostacolano la tua missione.

games.title: Blasphemous 2
games.description: Il Penitente si risveglia mentre Blasphemous 2 lo segue ancora una volta in una lotta senza fine contro il Miracolo. Immergiti in un mondo pericoloso, pieno di misteri e segreti.

games.canonical_title: Blast Brigade vs. the Evil Legion of Dr. Cread
games.title: Blast Brigade vs. the Evil Legion of Dr. Cread
games.description: Blast Brigade è un'avventura metroidvania in 2D ricca di emozione platform, esplorazione profonda e azione esplosiva. Assembla una squadra di eroi specialisti per farti strada in un'isola paradisiaca a suon di esplosioni per salvare il mondo!

games.title: Blaster Master Zero 3
games.description: The Pinnacle of Mutant Blasting Action Is Here! — Blaster Master Zero 3's hybrid of sidescrolling and top-down action is back for its 3rd chapter, and more intense than ever before!

games.title: BlazeRush
games.description: BlazeRush is a dynamic arcade racing survival game with no health, no levelling and no brakes! You can assemble a team of friends to play in local or online multiplayer, choose a car to your taste and chase, blow up and cut off! Adapt your style and tactics to new enemies.

games.title: Blazing Beaks
games.description: Roguelite - where too much greediness can be fatal. A colorful world with armed birds blazing their way through piles of mutants, monsters and creepy creatures. Lots of mysteries to unravel, secrets to discover and levels to explore.

games.title: Blazing Sails
games.description: Combatti per sopravvivere in Blazing Sails, un frenetico gioco PVP sui pirati! Crea il tuo pirata e la tua nave. Unisciti ad altri giocatori e mettiti al timone del tuo potente vascello! Scopri differenti modalità di gioco, mappe, armi, tipi di nave e molto altro ancora mentre...

games.title: Blazing Strike
games.description: Blazing Strike is a fast-paced 2D fighting game where retro arcade style meets modern innovation, delivering intense battles, unique fighters, and flawless online play.

games.title: Bleak Sword DX
games.description: Scopri e distruggi creature sempre più terrorizzanti in un opprimente mondo lo-fi. Brandisci armi e magie potenti in questo action-adventure in formato tascabile.

games.title: BLEED RUNNER
games.description: BLEED RUNNER is a 2.5D cyberpunk beat-em-up in which a lone knight fights an encroaching plague! Suddenly stricken with the disease, seek the cure on the mysterious spaceship and survive by grabbing, throwing, and pummeling enemies for blood.

games.title: Blind Descent
games.description: Immerse yourself in a new Martian underground adventure with Blind Descent, an open-world survival craft game that unveils the mysteries of the Martian depths. Play solo or with friends as you search for the missing team. Adapt and mutate to survive in this bizarre alien world.

games.title: Blind Fate: Edo no Yami
games.description: Dive into a world that mixes Sci-Fi and ancient tradition. Slash through robots with a trusty katana, use hi-tech implants to navigate the surroundings, dodge enemy attacks, and land devastating finishers. Reclaim the past following the way of the Japanese samurai in the fantasti

games.title: Blindfire
