games.description: Blindfire is an online multiplayer first-person shooter that takes place in the dark. Brave the arena alone or team up in matches of up to 8 players.

games.title: Blob's Adventure
games.description: Guide your bouncy hero, Blob, through a series of challenging levels!. Navigate carefully to avoid dangerous spikes and other traps as you aim to reach the flag and complete each stage.

games.title: Block Buster Billy
games.description: An alien family had a picnic on Billy's island. They had to leave in a hurry, causing Junior to forget his cubes. Can you help Billy figure out the mind-boggling alien puzzles?

games.title: Block Master 3D Puzzle
games.description: Test your mental skills with Block Master 3D Puzzle! Master this classic block puzzle game with realistic 3D graphics, strategic game modes and addictive gameplay. Race for the record without wasting time!

games.title: BLOCKLORDS
games.description: BLOCKLORDS è un gioco di strategia guidato dai giocatori sviluppato da MetaKing Studios. Governa, conquista e cresci con il tuo eroe medievale.

games.title: Blood and Zombies
games.description: Sangue, carne e budella. L'umanità dichiara guerra contro l'apocalisse zombi. Guida uno dei 4 superstiti più letali contro l'orda in questo sparatutto di difesa dalle ondate in prima persona. Ricarica armi, installa torrette, affina le abilità e forse sopravviverai alla notte.

games.title: Blood Bar Tycoon
games.description: Blood Bar Tycoon è un gioco di gestione di bar per vampiri. Crea bar e fabbriche, attira gli umani e servi il loro sangue ai tuoi clienti. Ricerca stravaganti macchinari e affronta i cacciatori di vampiri! Espandi la tua attività a Crimson City e diventa un Grande Maestro!

games.title: Blood Bowl 3
games.description: Brutale, folle, tattico... questo è BLOOD BOWL! Il famoso sport mortale torna con il nuovo videogioco di football fantasy che usa fedelmente le ultime regole del gioco da tavolo e nuovi contenuti. Raggiungi la vetta schiacciando gli avversari e lasciali al cimitero!

games.title: Blood Hunting
games.description: Blood Hunting è un videogioco survival horror in prima persona di Holcomb Entertainment LLC. Una vera esperienza survival horror che racconta di quanto possa essere pericolosa la vendetta... se riuscirai a sopravviverle.

games.title: Blood Money: Lethal Eden
games.description: Lured by an online lover, you're trapped in a scam compound—a true hell where compassion kills and greed consumes. Will you burn this abyss down or be its guiding light? Rule with beauty or betray for life? Your choices decide all: between life and death, heaven and hell.

games.title: Blood of Mehran
games.description:
Blood of Mehran ti porta alla scoperta di vaste dune di sabbia, vivaci bazar e tentacolari palazzi, con nemici da fronteggiare corpo a corpo, colpendoli da lontano con le frecce o rimanendo nell’ombra come un fantasma.
 
 Sali di livello per espandere la tua leggenda.

games.title: Blood of Steel
games.description: BOS is a MOBA game featuring legendary generals and their armies in world history. As the field commander, you will lead them into epic battles, taste the true medieval combat as a brave knight; to fight in ranked match, ride forth into World of Mercenaries and conquer the Steel

games.title: Blood of Titans
games.description: Diventa membro di un nuovo avvincente CCG, combatti e diventa il vincitore!

games.title: Blood on the Thames
games.description: A murder mystery puzzle game with visual novel elements in a Gothic, Lovecraftian world. Collect clues, solve puzzles, interrogate suspects, and uncover the mystery surrounding the death of Mini’s husband.

games.title: Blood West
games.description: Weird west legends meet eldritch horror in BLOOD WEST, an immersive stealth FPS. Become the Undead Gunslinger, doomed to roam the barren lands until he manages to purge their curse, freeing his soul. 3 varied scenarios, perk-based progression, and 20+ hours of gameplay await you!

games.title: Blood: Refreshed Supply
games.description: Things are about to get… bloody! Soak up 42 pulse-pounding levels dripping with Lovecraftian atmosphere as you battle your way through armies of sycophantic cultists, zombies, gargoyles, hell hounds, and other insatiable horrors, in your quest to defeat the loathsome Tchernobog.
games.publisher: Warner Bros. Games, Atari, Nightdive Studios

games.title: Bloodhound
games.description: 🔥 Bloodhound è un FPS frenetico ispirato ai giochi retrò 🎯. Immergiti in regni infernali 🌋, combatti 16 nemici unici 👹, affronta 5 boss 🐉 e scatena la distruzione con 10 armi letali 🔫. Preparati per un viaggio ricco di azione e incubi! 😈

games.title: Bloodlines Of The Eternal
games.description: 🩸 In a world torn by endless wars between vampires, werewolves, occultists, and the forsaken, you are the anomaly. Forge your own path, wield forbidden powers, and decide the fate of realms. Will you rise as savior, predator, or abomination?

games.title: BloodLoop
games.description: Scopri BloodLoop: un frenetico hero shooter 5 contro 5 che unisce capacità strategiche, crafting ed economia reale.

games.title: Bloodroots
games.description: In Bloodroots, il mondo è la tua arma: improvvisa e adattati a questo mondo di ultraviolenza in continua evoluzione, in una sanguinosa ricerca di vendetta attraverso il Weird West.

games.title: Bloodshed
games.description: Bloodshed is a Roguelite Survivors FPS; an exhilarating fusion of Roguelite elements merged with retro-styled visuals and first-person “Survivors-like” frenetic combat action!

games.title: Bloodshore
games.description: Bloodshore è un film d’azione interattivo incentrato su una battle royale televisiva fra streamer di alto profilo, intrattenitori e condannati a morte.

games.title: Bloodstained: Ritual of the Night
games.description:
Igavania ritorna!

Vesti i panni di Miriam, un'orfana segnata dalla maledizione di un alchimista che lentamente cristallizza il suo corpo. Per salvare l'umanità e se stessa, deve combattere nel castello e sconfiggere l'evocatore, Gebel.

games.title: Bloodstained: The Scarlet Engagement
games.description: Scopri gli oscuri segreti dell'universo di Bloodstained ed esplora un'affascinante Inghilterra del XVI secolo avvolta in un'atmosfera gotica in 2.5D. Difenditi in battaglie dense di strategia, esplora e crea oggetti, in questa vasta terra maledetta.

games.title: Bloody Hell Hotel
games.description: Renovate, upgrade and expand a hotel! Oh, by the way, you're a vampire, so hospitality isn't your strong suit.

games.title: Bloompunk
games.description: Bloompunk is an immersive, rogue-like, first-person shooter set in a vibrant world of nature. Players must grow and evolve their living arsenal of abilities to fight back against an invasive technological corruption before it consumes the forest.

games.title: Bloons TD 6
games.description: I bloon sono tornati e più minacciosi che mai! Vivi la miglior esperienza videoludica strategica attualmente disponibile grazie a questo favoloso gioco in stile tower defense con grafica 3D.

games.canonical_title: Blossom  Tales  II  The  Minotaur  Prince
games.title: Blossom  Tales  II  The  Minotaur  Prince
games.description: The Minotaur King has returned...and it's all your fault! Lily's back for a new "classic" action-adventure set hundreds of years after The Sleeping King!

games.title: Blossom Voyage
games.description: Beneath the falling cherry blossoms on the streets of Japan, your overseas romantic adventure is about to begin!

games.title: Blue Fire
games.description: Embark on an extraordinary adventure through the perished world of Penumbra to explore unique temples filled with increasingly difficult 3D platforming challenges, diverse enemies, quests, collectibles, and more.

games.title: Blue Protocol: Star Resonance
games.description:
Blue Protocol: Star Resonance × FAIRY TAIL
Limited time collaboration is available now!

Join Natsu and Lucy and take on new challenges, dress your hero, deck out your house with Fairy Tail collectibles!

games.title: BlueSuburbia
games.description: BlueSuburbia is a haunted world where you explore poems through immersive environments. Seek out dark secrets, confront your demons, and delve deeper into a dream that dances between beauty and horror. Explore forgotten dreamscapes and open worlds on your quest to find hope.

games.title: Bluey's Happy Snaps
games.description: Esplora il mondo di Bluey come mai prima d'ora!

games.canonical_title: Bluey's Quest For The Gold Pen
games.title: Bluey's Quest For The Gold Pen
games.description: Join Bluey on a fun-filled quest for the Gold Pen in an original story by Bluey creator, Joe Brumm. A joyful experience for the whole family.

games.title: Bmx Bastards
games.description:
Customize your BMX and dive into a giant open world wich include Bike Parks from all around the world waiting for you.
Can't find your favorite spot? Create it by yourself in our park editor.
Don't wait any longer and come to prove you're a true Rider!

games.canonical_title: Bob A thousand lives - Enhanced Edition
games.title: Bob A thousand lives - Enhanced Edition
games.description: Bob's life is already over, but now he gets another chance at survival – though not every life is a new beginning. A brutal platformer where every death pushes Bob to face new challenges, and the line between failure and victory gets thinner with each attempt.

games.title: Bob BOBBED Bob...
games.description: Famous podcaster, Bob's missing. Sheriff Bob (you) can scour the Old Bobalachins to crack the case w/ “Sheriff-Sense” to uncover clues like an easter egg hunt. Based on a Markiplier, Wade & Bob Distractible ep. Firewatch-like mystery in Skyrimish mountains, under an hour to many.
games.developer: Adam and Simmons (Isaac Ward & Julian Ward)
games.publisher: Adam and Simmons (Julian Ward & Isaac Ward)

games.title: Bodycamera Chase
games.description: Find a way out and don't let dangerous entities catch you.

games.title: BodyCamera Shooter
games.description: Uno sparatutto in prima persona realistico in cui vedi tutto dal punto di vista della telecamera fissa sul tuo combattente.

games.title: Bohnice - Within the Mind
games.description: Explore the dark secrets of a closed psychiatric hospital in Prague, Bohnice, as a determined journalist. Uncover chilling experiments, gruesome tortures, and paranormal encounters. Collect clues and photographs to reveal the horrifying truth hidden for 40 years.

games.title: Boing!
games.description: A deceivingly challenging platformer. Master physics-tight jumps across randomly generated worlds—each level unique and with its own twist. Beat the game and unlock sandbox mode where you can challenge yourself through unlimited levels of your own creation.

games.title: Bolmn
games.description: Bolmn has been sucked into a magic mirror. Help him escape his twisted reflections in this 3d platform adventure

games.title: BoltBreak
games.description: A Boltbreak, combatterai i nemici che possiedono poteri simili ai tuoi e dovrai impiegare le tue capacità in modo creativo per emergere come l'ultimo eroe in piedi. Hai quello che serve per sopravvivere nella Super Arena?

games.title: BoltBreak 2
games.description: BoltBreak 2 is an online multiplayer open-world superhero game inspired by comics like Invincible, The Boys, and DC. Join up to 5 other players in a shared world as you help save the multiverse or plunge it into chaos.

games.title: Bonfire Peaks
games.description:
Dai fuoco alle tue cose su una bellissima isola rompicapo in grafica voxel.

Vai in avanti, vai verso l'alto e non lasciarti niente alle spalle.
Bonfire Peaks è un rompicapo che mette la parola fine.

games.title: Book of Yog Idle RPG
games.description: The Book of Yog is a 3D idle RPG game. You can rally heroes, develop the kingdom and explore the secrets of a lost world. Dozens of heroes, hundreds of skills, thousands of loot for you to combine freely. Come to embark on a journey to build the strongest team!

games.title: Bookbound
games.description:
When worlds collapse into darkness…
When no one remains to save them…
Only the power of imagination can restore the light.

games.title: Boomerang X
games.description: Sfrutta la forza di un boomerang mistico per gettarti in aria. Taglia, vola e fatti strada in arene brulicanti di creature malvagie. Muoviti agilmente o incontra il tuo destino.

games.title: Boopoly
games.description: This board game is a thrilling survival challenge! Players must explore the map to collect classroom keys and tasks. The ultimate test happens at the penalty point, where you must finalize all tasks while evading a monster by strategically hiding inside the classrooms.

games.title: BOOST VECTOR EX
games.description: RUN FAST. Faster than any other. Take control of a Vector Master and sprint in uncompromising pure parkour racing. Hone your style with responsive flowing controls and break limits in the Premier Vector World Cup. The race beckons your arrival... Did I mention it was fast?

games.title: Booze & Ooze
games.description: Proudly be a nobody among mighty heroes, and carve out a fortune (or more likely, die trying) in this deck-building and tavern simulato r, enriched with RPG and roguelite elements. Playing a hero is simple; embracing the underdog is the real challenge. Do you have what it takes?

games.title: Booze Masters: Freezing Moonshine
games.description: Freezing Moonshine è un'inquietante avventura in prima persona con elementi di coltivazione, enigmi e molti liquori. Per sopravvivere, dovrete raccogliere i raccolti, scattare foto e produrre ogni sorta di liquore.

games.title: Borderlands 2
games.description: È arrivato il momento di far fuori Jack il Bello.  Chiama i tuoi amici a raccolta mentre ti sposti da un posto all'altro nel mondo raccogliendo miliardi di bottini e armi nel tentativo di salvare Pandora dalle malvagie grinfie dell'Hyperion Corporation.

games.title: Borderlands 3
games.description: Il leggendario sparatutto è tornato, con goziliardi di armi e un'avventura oltre i confini del caos! Esplora nuovi mondi, sconfiggi mostri pazzeschi e salva il tuo pianeta dalla setta più spietata della galassia.

games.title: Borderlands: The Handsome Collection
games.description: The Handsome Collection

games.title: Borderlands: The Pre-Sequel
games.description: LANCIATI NEL MONDO DI BORDERLANDS SPARANDO E SACCHEGGIANDO A TUTTO SPIANO IN UN'AVVENTURA NUOVISSIMA CHE TI PROIETTERÀ SULLA LUNA DI PANDORA IN BORDERLANDS: THE PRE-SEQUEL!

games.title: Borderlands®4
games.description: Borderlands 4 è uno spara e saccheggia dove regna il caos e che ti offre una vagonata di armi e avversari letali con le emozioni della modalità co-op. Sfuggi da un pericoloso pianeta nei panni di uno dei quattro Cacciatori della Cripta.

games.title: BORIS RUSSIAN BEAR
games.description: This beautiful brown bear is called Boris. He has an AK-47 and he really doesn't like it when someone with bad intentions comes to his forest.

games.title: Born of Bread
games.description:
Born of Bread è un’avventura GdR spensierata e stravagante che propone una rivisitazione dei classici giochi a turni.
Nei panni di Loaf, un pupazzo di farina, partirai insieme ai tuoi vivaci amici alla scoperta di un mondo incantevole e intriso di umorismo.

games.title: Bosorka
games.description: Bosorka is an exciting action roguelike where a young witch saves the world from insidious and cruel demons. Combine runes, master a variety of brooms, and try all possible and impossible spells until you gain enough power to fight evil.

games.title: BOSS FIGHTERS
games.description: BOSS FIGHTERS is a co-op arcade shooter where strategy and creativity meet wild fun. Battle as the towering Boss or team up as agile Fighters in fast-paced arena combat. Will you dunk your enemies in toxic lava or knock them out with a giant rubber duck?

games.title: Botanicula
games.description: Cinque amici - piccole creature arboree - intraprendono un viaggio per salvare l'ultimo seme del loro albero madre, che è infestato da un malefico parassita.

games.title: Botany Manor
games.description: Nei panni di Arabella Greene, una botanica in pensione, dovrai esplorare Botany Manor, la tua dimora signorile dell'Inghilterra del XIX secolo. Indagare in ogni angolo, trova l'habitat ideale per tanti esemplari di flora.

games.title: Boti - Byteland Overclocked
games.description: Salta, scatta, scivola! Tuffati in una classica esperienza platform 3D con Boti: Byteland Overclocked. Esplora gli interni straordinariamente stilizzati di un computer con Boti e salva Byteland da una minaccia inquietante.

games.title: Botlings
games.description: Control a swarm of mindless robots to build and automate a factory. Turn these workers into buildings, use them to carry resources, manufacture products and research new technologies. Manage your systems so your machines don't start to think on their own and escape your factory.

games.title: Bottle: Pilgrim Redux
games.description: Bottle: Pilgrim is a story of loss, regret and redemption, which reminds us that while we cannot change the things we have done, we can always learn from our mistakes.

games.title: Bounty Star
games.description: Combattimenti frenetici tra mech e costruzione di basi nella Red Expanse.

games.title: Bowling Over It
games.description: Bowling Over It is an unsettling platforming game about climbing to the top of the world, hitting the most pins as possible, in the shorter time you can, throwing a bowling ball. Inspirated in the works Getting Over It with Bennett Foddy and Golfing Over It with Alva Majo.

games.title: Boxes: Lost Fragments
games.description: Escape a lavish mansion full of mysterious puzzle boxes!

games.title: Boxville
games.description: Boxville è un puzzle game d'avventura sulle lattine senza parole che vivono nella città delle scatole e disegnano scarabocchi sui cartoni per raccontare le storie.

games.title: Boxville 2
games.description: Boxville 2 di Triomatica Games è la parte successiva di un gioco di avventura sulle lattine che vivono in una città scatola.

games.title: Boyfriend Dungeon
games.description: Frequenta le tue armi! Cattura i cuori di sette armi diverse per farle salire di livello in questa avventura dungeon crawler shack-and-slash. Occhi aperti alle sfide ricche d'azione nel dunj.

games.title: Bracer
games.description: Grab a buddy and brace for chaos in this 3D Fantasy Shoot ‘Em Up (SHMUP). Face off against a twisted necromancer fueled by a cursed bracer and a bloodlust for destruction. Blast enemies, dodge projectiles, unlock upgrades, and customize your hero.

games.title: Brain Show: Party Quiz
games.description: Compete with your friends in brand new quiz game (online multiplayer). Take part in crazy TV Show. Dynamite explosions, sobbing mates, ruined friendships! Sounds like fun? It will be – with Brain Show - quiz game!

games.title: Brainrot Kart
games.description: Brainrot Kart è un gioco di corse con kart per 8 giocatori. Gareggia con i tuoi amici su mappe caotiche come “Gooning Gateway” e “The Backrooms”, e lancia Hawk Tuahs contro i tuoi rivali per mandarli fuori pista. Preparati a un brainrot continuo che ti terrà in tensione.

games.title: Bramble The Mountain King
games.description: Bramble The Mountain King is a grim adventure set in a world inspired by dark, Nordic fables. Explore the beautiful yet dangerous and twisted land of Bramble, traverse a wondrous landscape and survive deadly encounters with Bramble's many hideous creatures.

games.title: Bratz™: Mostra il tuo stile
games.description: Mostra a tutti la tua passione per la moda in questa avventura bratzosa intorno al mondo!

games.title: Brave Escape
games.description: Parti per un'emozionante avventura in co-op con Brave Escape, un platform impegnativo che richiede lavoro di squadra per superare trappole insidiose e terreni pericolosi.

games.title: Brawl Arena Shooter
games.description: A fast-paced top-down arena shooter where cute animal heroes clash in chaotic online battles. Dash through bushes, grab power-ups, outplay rivals, and climb the global leaderboard in nonstop action.

games.title: Brawlers
games.description: An innovative twist on head to head card battler, developed by Tyranno Studios! A rowdy collision of strategy and suplexes, designed by the Magic: The Gathering mastermind.

games.title: Brawlhalla
games.description: Un gioco di combattimento platform epico per un massimo di 8 giocatori online o locali. Prova gli scontri casuali tutti contro tutti, le partite con classifica o invita gli amici in una stanza privata. Ed è gratis! Gioca in modalità multipiattaforma con milioni di giocatori su PlayStation, Xbox, Nintendo Switch, iOS, Android e Steam! Aggiornamenti frequenti. Oltre cinquanta leggende.

games.title: Breach - 83
games.description:
Watch the feeds. Spot the intrusions. Hold the line.

It’s your job to safeguard reality by watching the camera feeds and identifying changes in various key locations. But be careful, too many BREACHES seep in unnoticed and it will be GAME OVER

games.title: Breachway
games.description: Esplora la galassia in questo roguelike sci-fi di deckbuilding. I potenziamenti della nave e la gestione dell'equipaggio sono cruciali per la tua sopravvivenza: ottimizza la creazione di risorse, vivi battaglie a turni e affronta temibili minacce mentre vai in cerca del Segnale.

games.title: Bread and Fred
games.description: Grab your best bud for help in this new co-op challenge to help two adorable penguins, Bread and Fred, reach the top of the snowy summit. Time your jumps, cling to walls and swing across gaps to see how far you can make it before you tumble all the way back down the mountain.

games.title: Breakfall: Nuclear Winter
games.description: Un gioco strategico di sopravvivenza in cui impersonate un gruppo di sopravvissuti che lottano per rimanere in vita all'indomani di un disastro nucleare. Espandete il vostro rifugio durante il giorno e cercate di trovare le provviste di notte per assicurarvi la sopravvivenza.

games.title: Breaking Point: Operation Exodus
games.description: Un emozionante sparatutto in prima persona in cui guidi una squadra d'élite contro un'invasione aliena. Difendi città iconiche, infiltra basi segrete e scopri segreti nascosti. Combatti per la sopravvivenza dell'umanità in un gioco con grafica mozzafiato e meccaniche avvincenti.

games.title: Breakout Beyond
games.description: Description Breakout is back! In this neon-drenched take on the classic, you’ll need to literally break through each puzzle by clearing bricks to breach the final goal. Rack up a combo and create spectacular light shows alone or with a friend.is not set

games.title: Breakout: Recharged
games.description: The original brick breaker returns with its toughest challenge yet. Survive as long as you can in arcade or take on one of 50 challenges picking up game-changing power-ups along the way.

games.title: Breathedge
games.description: Sopravvivi nello spazio! Assieme al tuo pollo immortale, scopri la verità che si nasconde dietro all'improvviso incidente dell'astronave. Crea strumenti, pilota veicoli e controlla le stazioni spaziali per sopravvivere ed esplorare il relitto.

games.title: Brew
games.description: Face the challenges of The Tower as you enroll into the Alchemy Academy in this action-packed, third-person, roguelite. Brew potions to boost yourself in the heat of battle and use multiple weapons to defeat dangerous foes and pass your exams!

games.title: Brick Breaker Premium
games.description: Il classico rompi mattoni è tornato! 35 livelli da completare. Un filone narrativo eroico, dove tutto ha avuto inizio. Supporto per gamepad. Potenziamenti classici. Sequenze animate a fine partita. E tanto divertimento da non poterne più farne a meno! Buona fortuna!

games.title: Brick Breaker Premium 2
games.description: Un arcade vecchia scuola, il seguito del classico rompi mattoni. Sei "Blippy", la racchetta che dovrà salvare la Terra da una nuova minaccia. Oltre 40 nuovi livelli da completare. E se arrivi fino in fondo, non perderti le sequenze animate a fine partita!

games.title: Brick Breaker Premium 3
games.description: È arrivato l'ultimo Brick Breaker della trilogia! È il classico gioco rompi-mattoncini. Ben 50 nuovi livelli difficili da completare! Supporto per il gamepad. Potenziamenti classici. Nuova racchetta laser a colpo multiplo. Guarda i filmati finali di questa trilogia classica!

games.title: Brick Busters
games.description: Top-down tank roguelike with  upgrades, bosses, and local co-op. Every run is different. Every death teaches you something — usually that you should have dodged.

games.title: Bridge Constructor
games.description: Become an appraised bridge engineer and architect in Bridge Constructor. Create and design your own constructions and watch the cars and trucks pass over them - or see them fall and crash while your inferior creations collapse due to weight and the laws of physics!

games.title: Bridge Constructor Bundle
games.description: Ottieni Bridge Constructor: The Walking Dead e tutti i titoli Bridge Constructor classici in questo ricchissimo bundle. Affronta orde di vaganti, erigi ponti semplici dotandoli di rampe e anelli oppure immergiti nell'epoca medievale!

games.title: Bridge Constructor Medieval
games.description: Bridge Constructor Medieval turns back the clock a few centuries to the time of knights and castles.

games.title: Bridge Constructor Playground
games.description: Bridge Constructor Playground offers people of all ages an introduction to the topic of “bridge building”. This game gives you the freedom to let your creative side run riot – nothing is impossible.

games.title: Bridge Constructor Studio
games.description: Bridge Constructor Studio is the latest in the best-selling series. Test your engineering skills in this physics-based puzzle game, combining the best of previous titles with a modern, charming visual style—the ultimate experience for creative builders!

games.title: Bridge Constructor Stunts
games.description: Build imposing ramps and loops to reach your goal in the diverse stages. But building structures alone isn't enough this time: you sit behind the wheel of the vehicles yourself and have to maneuver them skillfully to the goal.

games.title: Bridge Constructor: The Walking Dead
games.description: Preparati al mashup definitivo! Bridge Constructor: The Walking Dead unisce il gameplay leggendario e avvincente di Bridge Constructor™ con l'universo post-apocalittico di The Walking Dead, la serie tv AMC.

games.title: Brie Parmesan Mysteries
games.description: Brie Parmesan is a stealthy rat navigating the criminal underworld of Chicatgo in search of cheese and collecting evidence to solve cases and bring the Cat Meowfia to justice.  The first case "Crimes of Chicatgo" is included

games.title: Brigand: Gold
games.description:
Brigand is a highly difficult post-apocalyptic RPG/FPS set in Mexico. Emphasis is on challenge, a branching story with multiple endings, and total freedom of action (kill friendly characters, rob stores, jump across roofs, etc.).

Gold Edition includes all 4 DLCs.

games.title: Brigands
games.description: Brigands is a “top-down hack and slash / beat 'em up adventure” game set in a medieval fantasy world. A local co-op game for casual gamers who like high intensity challenges for short periods of time. You can play from 1 to 4 players on a single computer.

games.title: Bright Paw - Definitive Edition
games.description: Murder, mystery, puzzles, and cats.

games.title: BrightGunner
games.description: BrightGunner è un innovativo e frenetico gioco sparatutto in prima persona.gameplay diversificato, lieve meccanismo Rogue, nessuno stile di design dell'interfaccia.

games.title: Bring Them Home
games.description: Salva astronauti in 50 rompicapi spaziali. Pilota il tuo drone, domina i teletrasporti e sentiti un genio quando tutto funziona!

games.title: BROK the InvestiGator
games.description:
Un'epica e innovativa avventura che spazia tra vari generi.
Che tipo di detective sarai?

games.title: BROK: The Brawl Bar
games.description: Affronta sfide folli, combatti fino alla cima di un bar sotterraneo e fai amicizia con persone inaspettate lungo il percorso. BROK: The Brawl Bar è un selvaggio party beat ’em up!

games.title: Broken Lore : FOLLOW
games.description: BrokenLore: FOLLOW is a psychological first-person horror game that immerses players in the haunting narrative of Anne, as she grapples with issues of self-acceptance, bullying, and worthlessness while encountering surreal creatures that heighten the terror of her journey.

games.title: Broken Pieces
games.description: Broken Pieces è un thriller psicologico ambientato in una località costiera francese, fuori dal normale flusso temporale. Svela i misteri rimettendo insieme i pezzi della storia e risolvendo gli enigmi che si celano dietro questo luogo mistico.
games.developer: Elseware Experience, Benoit Dereau and Mael Vignau

games.title: Broken Roads
games.description: Broken Roads è un GDR incentrato sulla narrativa che porta l'esplorazione, i combattimenti strategici a turni e delle importanti scelte filosofiche in una nuova ambientazione australiana post-apocalittica.

games.canonical_title: Broken Sword - Il Segreto dei Templari: Reforged
games.title: Broken Sword - Il Segreto dei Templari: Reforged
games.description: La pluripremiata avventura grafica torna con una splendida veste grafica in 4K e con audio rimasterizzato, per narrare le vicende dell'intrepido George Stobbart e della coraggiosa Nico Collard in un viaggio pieno di avventure e antiche cospirazioni.

games.canonical_title: Broken Sword - La Profezia dei Maya: Reforged
games.title: Broken Sword - La Profezia dei Maya: Reforged
games.description: Il classico pluripremiato ritorno con una splendida grafica 4K e un iconico audio rimasterizzato. Una misteriosa avventura tra intrighi e inganni, in cui la giornalista Nico Collard e il suo compagno di avventure George Stobbart devono superare forze potentissime.

games.title: BrokenLore: ASCEND
games.description: BrokenLore: ASCEND is a first-person psychological horror with climbing and stealth mechanics. Follow Ren and Yui, two rooftop climbers facing a cursed tower and the terrifying Rokurokubi. The higher they climb, the closer they get to madness—and to the truth about themselves.

games.title: BrokenLore: DON'T LIE
games.description: BrokenLore: DON’T LIE is a first-person psychological horror. Play as Junko, trapped in her apartment as loneliness, lies, and visions twist reality into disturbing liminal spaces. Not all you see is real. Not all you hear is true. Above all - DON’T LIE.

games.title: BrokenLore: DON'T PLAY
games.description: A first-person psychological horror game where a mysterious experimental video game invades reality. Face five increasingly disturbing levels and survive their consequences as Hideo slips toward identity loss.

games.title: BrokenLore: DON'T WATCH
games.description: In BrokenLore: DON'T WATCH, immerse yourself in the haunting world of Shinji, a young hikikomori trapped in his Tokyo apartment. As his mind unravels, confront a malevolent entity lurking in the shadows. Will you uncover the truth before it's too late?

games.title: BrokenLore: LOW
games.description: A psychological horror game set in a mist-covered, beautiful Japanese village, blending hyper-realistic graphics with low-poly elements. The main enemy is the Gashadokuro, a yokai from Japanese folklore.

games.title: BrokenLore: UNFOLLOW
games.description: BrokenLore: UNFOLLOW is a first-person psychological horror game that explores the impact social media has on mental health.

games.title: Brotato
games.description: Brotato è un arena shooter in stile roguelite in cui vesti i panni di una patata. Impugna fino a 6 armi per sconfiggere le orde aliene. Scegli gli attributi e gli oggetti che preferisci per creare combinazioni uniche e sopravvivere fino all'arrivo dei rinforzi.

games.canonical_title: Brothers - A Tale of Two Sons
games.title: Brothers - A Tale of Two Sons
games.description: Guida due fratelli in questo viaggio da fiaba creato dal visionario regista svedese Josef Fares e dalla rinomata casa di sviluppo Starbreeze Studios. Preparati a questo viaggio indimenticabile.

games.canonical_title: Brothers: A Tale of Two Sons Remake
games.title: Brothers: A Tale of Two Sons Remake
games.description:
Guida due fratelli in un viaggio epico ricco di scoperte, perdite, avventura e mistero ricreato con grafica, prestazioni e gameplay di nuova generazione. 

Gioca in modalità giocatore singolo o cooperativa locale con un amico.

Sarà un viaggio indimenticabile.

games.title: Brutal Orchestra
games.description: Brutal Orchestra is a Turn-Based Roguelike Strategy Game. You died, someone killed you. You are now in Purgatory and you will never escape. Make a deal with a "Demon" and set off into this vile world finding ​all manner of demented friends and foes on your quest to get revenge.

games.title: Bryo
games.description: Meet Bryo, a little hero made of stones with a metaphorically big heart. In this 2D puzzle-platformer, use Bryo's power to manifest stone structures to tackle tricky platforming and boulder puzzles on a quest for a shining diamond. Can you help him reach his goal unscathed?

games.title: Bubble Hook Mania
games.description: A retro arcade bubble-shooter where shots split bouncing bubbles until they vanish. Clear 40 handcrafted levels before the timer runs out or push your limits in Survival.

games.title: Bubble Rage
games.description: Bubble Rage is the platformer you’ll love to hate. Brutal traps, endless fails, and pure rage fuel. Whether you're playing or watching someone lose their mind, the real fun is in the suffering.

games.title: Bubsy 4D
games.description: The wise-cracking bobcat has returned to 3D in a new platforming adventure. Bubsy is back with new challenges, new moves, and even more personality. Run, jump, glide, and roll across alien planets, battle robotic sheep, and collect tons of yarn. What could possibly go wrong?

games.canonical_title: Bud Spencer and Terence Hill - Slaps and Beans
games.title: Bud Spencer and Terence Hill - Slaps and Beans
games.description: Bud Spencer e Terence Hill nella loro prima avventura virtuale. Slaps And Beans è un picchiaduro a scorrimento cooperativo o per giocatore singolo con l'aggiunta di elementi platform e mini-giochi in cui interpreterete i personaggi di Bud Spencer e Terence Hill

games.canonical_title: Bud Spencer and Terence Hill - Slaps and Beans 2
games.title: Bud Spencer and Terence Hill - Slaps and Beans 2
games.description: Naufragati in Africa, Bud e Terence si trovano a salvare un villaggio dalla presenza di malviventi, sfruttando una chiatta per il trasporto di banane per fare ritorno a casa. Tuttavia, come sempre accade nelle loro avventure, le cose non andranno esattamente come pianificato.

games.title: Buddy and Friends in Halloween
games.description: Halloween è arrivato, Buddy il gatto e gli amici sono pronti per 'dolcetto o scherzetto'. Ma mentre si avventurano nell'ignoto, la compassione trionferà sulla paura? Unisciti a questi gattini in un racconto di Halloween commovente in questo gioco di puzzle illustrato.

games.title: Buddy Simulator 1984
games.description: Buddy Simulator 1984 simula l'esperienza di trascorrere del tempo con un migliore amico! Imparerà a conoscerti, si adatterà costantemente alla tua personalità e ai tuoi interessi, ma soprattutto, giocherà con te!

games.title: Bug Fables -The Everlasting Sapling-
games.description: Follow Vi, Kabbu, and Leif as they uncover the secrets of the Land of Bugaria! Explore a lush world and combine your team's abilities to solve puzzles, defeat powerful enemies, and discover ancient treasures!

games.title: Bugby
games.description: Bugby is a team sport, set in a magical forest, full of hijinks, mayhem and fun. Try to score the most points by carrying the ball into one of the nearby goals around the arena. Use the bouncy mushrooms to traverse across the arena, but don’t fall into the giant pit!

games.title: Bugsnax
games.description: Siamo ciò che mangiamo. Bugsnax ti condurrà in un'avventura stravagante su Snaktooth Island, patria delle leggendarie creature mezzo-insetto mezzo-snack, i Bugsnax.

games.title: Build a Bridge!
games.description: Bridge building puzzle game that will test your wits and ingenuity across multiple levels in four varied locations! Complete mind-bending levels in realistic graphics!

games.title: Build From Block
games.description: Build From Block è un gioco incentrato su un mondo cubico in cui puoi costruire quello che vuoi!

games.title: Bulbs and Switches
games.description: This is a Realistic Electricity Game where you build circuits to solve puzzles. There are many different challenges, ranging from real life logic gates, to getting certain readings on a Voltmeter. You decide which bulbs turn on and which don't.

games.title: BULLET YEETERS
games.description: Bullet Yeeters - jetpack chaos in your own home! A third-person shooter where tiny agents with big guns battle it out in giant household arenas. Fly with a jetpack, fight crazy bosses, customize your hero, and unleash explosive mayhem in kitchens, garages, and living rooms!

games.title: Bulletrooms
games.description: Si tratta sempre delle stesse stanze gialle, ma ora siete voi il cacciatore invece della preda.

games.title: Bult: Hunting Simulator
games.description: Realistic waterfowl hunting simulator. Calls, decoys, a boat, and your hunting skills — everything you need to track down your prey in open hunting grounds. Feel the thrill of real hunting without leaving your home.

games.title: Bulwark Evolution: Falconeer Chronicles
games.description: Bulwark: Evolution è un gioco di strategia dinamico in cui si costruisce, si espande e si difende una grande civiltà, con modalità che vanno dalla creatività pacifica alla guerra intensa, modellate dal feedback dei giocatori e dall'evoluzione del gameplay.

games.title: Bum Ball Bears
games.description:
You control a team of two and attempt to get the ball past your opponents.

If the ball gets past the opposing team to the other side of the pitch, you score a point.

The team with the highest score wins.

games.title: Bumble Brawlers
games.description: Bumble Brawlers è uno sparatutto top-down ricco di azione. Personalizza i personaggi, combatti onde infinite, sopravvivi ai raid nei dungeon e sblocca compagni, armi e armature. Lotta per conquistare mappe e metti alla prova le tue abilità in modalità blitz e arene a ondate!

games.title: Bundle Ghostrunner
games.description: Vivi un'elettrizzante esperienza cibernetica con il Bundle Ghostrunner, che include l'adrenalinico Ghostrunner originale e il suo attesissimo seguito, Ghostrunner 2.

games.title: BUNKERZONE
games.description: Survive the judgement

games.title: Bunnerly
games.description: Step into the dark, dystopian world of Bunnerly. Save trapped rabbits and face exciting challenges. Navigate the darkest alleys with only your light to guide you. Beware—this city is full of dangers. Can your light save your friends?

games.title: Bunny Guys!
games.description: Climb, fall, curse… uh, respawn, pretend it was intentional. Bunny Guys is pure parkour chaos where one wins and everyone else fails spectacularly. Perfect for players who treat suffering, respawning, and “I can do better” as a hobby.

games.title: Bunny Hopper
games.description: Bunny Hopper è un frenetico platform 3D in cui controlli un agile robot da combattimento. Salta, corri sui muri, scatta e distruggi i bersagli mentre superi livelli impegnativi in ​​arene eleganti.

games.title: Bunny Park
games.description: Manage your own bunny park! Give snacks and toys to your bunnies. Improve and decorate your park to increase its popularity and collect all the bunnies!

games.title: Burnout™ Paradise Remastered
games.description: Burnout Paradise Remastered offre a te e ai tuoi amici il parco giochi automobilistico definitivo in cui divertirsi online.

games.title: Bus Bound
games.description: Step into the driver’s seat in Bus Bound, the latest title from the creators of Bus Simulator 21. Explore a vibrant city behind the wheel of officially licensed buses, and help transform it into a pedestrian-friendly paradise—one stop at a time.

games.title: Bus Driver Simulator
games.description: Try on the role of a driver of a passenger bus. Take a ride in a real city, strictly following the schedule.

games.title: Bus Simulator 21 Next Stop
games.description: Arriva alla tua fermata: Bus Simulator 21 Next Stop è arrivato! In questo aggiornamento completo troverai tanti miglioramenti e una nuova modalità di gioco.

games.title: Bus Simulator 27
games.description: Preparati a divertirti con Bus Simulator 27. È in arrivo la migliore flotta di autobus nella storia della serie, con nuovi marchi e modelli su licenza ufficiale e autobus iconici già presenti nei titoli precedenti.

games.title: Bus Simulator Car Driving
games.description: You have to be a great public bus driver in this bus game simulator.

games.title: Bus Stop Rush
games.description: Bus Stop Rush is a fast, addictive match-3 puzzle game where you organize queues, load buses, and solve clever challenges. Match characters, use powerful boosts, and progress through colorful levels packed with satisfying strategy and fun.

games.title: Bus World
games.description: Bus World è un gioco sul trasporto di passeggeri in varie condizioni, a partire dai giorni normali di un autista di autobus fino ad arrivare al salvataggio di persone che hanno vissuto disastri.

games.title: Bushido Kensei The Last Warrior
games.description: Busido Kensei The Last Warrior is a Rogue-Like action RPG with a twist. With Melee Combat you try and survive the demon hordes trying to take over the world. As the last warrior left it is up to you to protect the last remaining bastion of hope! Are you up to the challenge?

games.canonical_title: Business Tour - Board Game with Online Multiplayer
games.title: Business Tour - Board Game with Online Multiplayer
games.description: "Business Tour" è un gioco da tavolo multigiocatore gratuito. Costruisci il tuo monopolio con gli amici. Completa le missioni giornaliere, gareggia contro gli altri giocatori e ricevi ricompense!

games.title: Busway Islands - Puzzle
games.description: Busway Islands is a puzzle game about organizing roads and rails across a large archipelago. Your goal is to create a safe and efficient route between bus stations, ensuring that all passengers are picked up along the way.

games.title: Bylina
games.description: Challenge Koschei the Deathless himself! Journey to the Far Far Kingdom, save your immortal soul and become a true hero in Bylina, an Action RPG with a heavy focus on skill-based combat and a deep narrative rooted in Slavic folklore and legends.

games.title: Bypass
games.description: For all videogame fans, who have been looking for a multiplayer horror game with realistic graphics, Bypass is game which combines horror and action genre and compared to it's rivals, Bypass is free to play.

games.title: C-Beams
games.description: Affronta battaglie avanzate in un sistema di buchi neri letale, trasporta elementi rari e potenzia il tuo mezzo per sopravvivere. Svela i segreti oscuri dell'abisso in questo GdR d'azione spaziale con grafica straordinaria, trama profonda e progressione gratificante.

games.title: C64 & AMIGA Classix Remakes Sixpack
games.description: Enjoy the touch of nostalgic retro feel and play 6 classic game Remakes of the C64 and AMIGA era.

games.canonical_title: C64 and AMIGA Classix Remakes Sixpack 2
games.title: C64 and AMIGA Classix Remakes Sixpack 2
games.description: Get some of the classic games from the 80s and 90s back on your home PC - as a remake.

games.canonical_title: C64 and AMIGA Classix Remakes Sixpack 3
games.title: C64 and AMIGA Classix Remakes Sixpack 3
games.description: Get some of the classic games from the 80s and 90s back on your home PC - as a remake.

games.canonical_title: C64 and AMIGA Classix Remakes Sixpack 4
games.title: C64 and AMIGA Classix Remakes Sixpack 4
games.description: Bring some classics from the 80s and 90s back to your home PC—as remakes.

games.title: Cabernet
games.description: Change is brewing, threatening the established ways of alluring supernatural aristocrats. Sustain your facade as one of the living and struggle with your morality as a young vampire. Will you retain your humanity or descend further into the horror you have become?

games.title: Cafe Maid - Cute Anime Girls
games.description: 🔥 Start your very own idle maid cafe, filling your staff with cute anime girls. Flirt with the girls, win their hearts, dress them up in the cutest outfits... Once set in motion, your business grows even while you are away. 🔥

games.title: Cafe Owner Simulator
games.description: Open your dream restaurant at FPP. Create a unique exterior and interior, hire the best workers and chefs, create a place where people will love to eat, spend time and spend their money. Simulation of the restaurant business.

games.title: Cairn
games.description: Raggiungi una vetta inesplorata in questo gioco di arrampicata survival. Arrampicati dove vuoi e pianifica il percorso con chiodi e risorse varie per sopravvivere allo spietato Monte Kami. Scopri cos'è disposta a sacrificare Aava per completare la scalata della vita.

games.title: Calamity
games.description: An Action RPG with engaging classic gameplay you love. Conquer dungeons, challenge players, and gear up with epic loot in a world with a player-driven economy.

games.title: Calico
games.description: Calico è un gioco di simulazione di vita casuale di una comunità in cui ti viene affidato un compito importante: ricostruire il caffè dei gatti della città e riempirlo di creature coccolose! Costruisci il tuo bar riempiendolo con mobili carini, decorazioni simpatiche, delizios...

games.title: Call of Cthulhu
games.description: 1924. L'investigatore privato Pierce deve indagare la tragica morte della famiglia Hawkins sulla remota Darkwater Island. Immergiti in un mondo di follia inquietante popolato dai Grandi Antichi del leggendario universo di Lovecraft.

games.title: Call of Dragons
games.description: An MMO Fantasy Conquest Game by the RoK Team! Capture behemoths to fight. Use hero skills with allies. Deploy flying units over 3D terrain. Huge wars. Huge choices. Your journey starts here!

games.title: Call of Heroes: Tower Defense
games.description: Imbarcati in un'avventura magica ed emozionante per proteggere il regno delle fate in questo epico gioco di TD. Recluta eroi unici dotati di potenti magie. Crea armi esclusive per ogni eroe. Difendi il regno delle fate!

games.title: Call of the Sea
games.description: Call of the Sea is an otherworldly tale of mystery and love set in the 1930s South Pacific. Explore a lush island paradise, solve puzzles and unlock secrets in the hunt for your husband’s missing expedition.

games.canonical_title: Call of the Wild: The Angler™
games.title: Call of the Wild: The Angler™
games.description: Prova il brivido di affrontare le specie Leggendarie in ambientazioni mozzafiato. Gioca in solitaria o con gli amici per diventare un asso della pesca.

games.title: Calvin Carter: The Golden Guardian
games.description: Play as Calvin Carter(The Golden Guardian) drive vehicles, fight enemies and bosses, complete quests or free roam. Use your abilities to crawl or run on buildings, attach to buildings with your goo or use it to fight.

games.title: CALX
games.description: Sorvola le rovine del pianeta Syro, corrotto dal WARP. Padroneggia i movimenti nelle vesti del Seeker. Salta, scatta, levita e volteggia attraverso rovine cariche di atmosfera. Alterna calma e frenesia mentre esplori l'ambiente, risolvi puzzle e combatti.

games.title: Camp Canyonwood
games.description: Description is not setBuild and manage a summer camp in this cozy outdoor life sim where nothing strange ever happens. Lead troops of campers to earn badges, collect resources, decorate the vast campgrounds, and investigate the camp's many mysteries.

games.title: Camp Sunshine
games.description: Dropped off at Summer Camp, Jaz awakes in the middle of the night to discover blood everywhere...

games.title: CAMPIONI DI SUDOKU
games.description:
Il Sudoku è un gioco di enigmi numerici semplice e chiaro.
L’obiettivo è facile da capire: riempi la griglia in modo che ogni riga, colonna e riquadro 3×3 contenga i numeri da 1 a 9 senza ripetizioni. Nessuna matematica, solo logica.

games.title: Can You Escape: The Collection
games.description: A collection of 23 classic escape games featuring puzzles and hidden objects across various locations. Perfect for fans revisiting these old favorites.

games.title: Candle Knight
games.description: Never let your light go out. Wield a powerful flame, overcome menacing creatures and explore the shadows of a ruined castle in this compelling 2.5D action adventure platformer which features a unique dynamic difficulty system.

games.title: cant be touched: Algeria War
games.description: Ghaith, from Ghardaia, discovers a hidden cellar in an old library. Inside, a book titled 'The Time' transports him to Algeria's 1954 revolution. Immersed in the struggle against French colonialism, he becomes a brave revolutionary, shaping history.

games.title: Cap 'n Barr's Adventure
games.description: A retro 2D platformer with fun gameplay, cute characters, and 8-bit visuals! Play as a capybara, cross forests and seas, stomp enemies, toss crates, and save animal friends. Go solo or co-op, find hidden levels, and stop an evil villain!

games.title: Capes
games.description: Un gioco di strategia a turni basato su scontri tra supereroi. Recluta, addestra e schiera la tua squadra per liberare la città dai cattivi che la tengono in ostaggio.

games.title: Capital Cities Trivia
games.description: Can you name the capital city of every country in the world? Choose from the most popular geographical categories including Europe, North America, The 50 States, and World Capitals.

games.title: Capital Command
games.description: Prendi il timone di una nave da guerra all'avanguardia e combatti epiche battaglie spaziali in una campagna sandbox. Migliora e personalizza la tua nave, padroneggia l'arte del pilotaggio, e combina abilità tattiche e potenza di fuoco per superare minacce letali.

games.title: Capri Care
games.description: Capri Care lets you care for and interact with adorable Capri creatures. Compete in fun minigames, breed new colors and traits, and explore a vibrant island. Feed, train, and bond with your Capri to unlock new adventures and surprises in this magical world!

games.title: Captain Blood
games.description: Captain Blood è un action game a tema piratesco in cui giochi nei panni di un terribile pirata alla ricerca di oro e gloria. Affronta le avventure mozzafiato con cannoni, pistole, combattimenti con le spade e tanti altri tipi di altre bricconate piratesche.

games.title: Captain Bones
games.description: Captain Bones è un gioco di azione e avventura ambientato in un mondo di pirati aperto. Devi avere abilità di sopravvivenza per fare battaglie navali e cacce al tesoro con il tuo equipaggio.

games.title: Car Driving School Simulator
games.description: Car Driving School Simulator is one of the most realistic car games available! In this feature-packed game you will test your skills driving awesome cars and learn useful traffic rules along the way!

games.title: Car Mechanic - City Driving
games.description: Personalizzate la vostra auto e fate un giro sereno per le strade della città!

games.title: Car Mechanic Simulator 2018
games.description: Build and expand your repair service empire in this incredibly detailed and highly realistic simulation game, where attention to car detail is astonishing. Find classic, unique cars in the new Barn Find module and Junkyard module.

games.title: Car Parking Real Driving Sim
games.description: Build the vehicle of your dreams in this parking game full of realistic details and challenging missions! Complete missions now, earn rewards and get your dream vehicle.

games.title: Car Tuning Simulator
games.description: In Car Tuning Simulator, you can create, modify and paint your own luxury car, and then go to the atmospheric night city highway to test it in action!

games.title: Caravan SandWitch
games.description: Intraprendi un viaggio attraverso immensi paesaggi in Caravan SandWitch, un’entusiasmante avventura esplorativa incentrata sulla trama.

games.title: Carcassonne
games.description: L'adattamento ufficiale del famoso gioco da tavolo: Carcassonne! Carcassonne è un classico gioco contemporaneo incentrato sul posizionamento di tessere e basato sul pluripremiato gioco in cui i giocatori disegnano e posizionano una tessera con sopra disegnato un paesaggio dell...

games.title: Card Shark
games.description: Card Shark è un gioco di avventura pieno di astuzie, intrighi e squisiti inganni. Entra in un mondo in cui dovrai giocare il tuo avversario meglio delle tue carte.

games.title: Cardinal Fall
games.description: Cardinal Fall is a nonprofit, community-developed, story-driven, 3d side-view, survival-horror game set within an original far-future dystopian sci-fi universe where you play as a clone—known as an Echo, located in a research facility where catastrophic events are unfolding.

games.title: Cardpocalypse: Standard Edition
games.description: La decenne Jess fa proibire, senza volerlo, il gioco di carte collezionabili preferito dai suoi compagni nella scuola elementare Dudsdale... proprio il primo giorno! Ma quando la situazione si complica e i mutanti del gioco prendono vita, toccherà proprio a Jess e ai suoi amic...

games.canonical_title: Cards of Eternity: The Wheel of Time
games.title: Cards of Eternity: The Wheel of Time
games.description: Cards of Eternity: The Wheel of Time is a strategic card game where players harness iconic characters, creatures, and the mystical forces of the One Power from the legendary fantasy world. Build decks, master unique abilities, and outplay opponents in dynamic, lore-rich battles.
games.developer: Aether Games Inc, Red Rift Inc.

games.title: Cargo Truck Simulator 2023
games.description: Become a master truck driver by performing cargo missions in this truck game.

games.title: CarGo!
games.description: CarGo! is a chaotic couch co-op for up to four players. Working as a team of couriers try to collect and deliver as many goods as possible while keeping an eye out for time, traffic and roadworks!

games.title: Carmageddon: Rogue Shift
games.description: Carmageddon e i suoi brutali e caotici combattimenti roguelite tra veicoli sono tornati! Adattati, migliora il tuo mezzo e scatena la distruzione sulle orde di zombi post-apocalittiche. La tradizione continua, rinnovata e implacabile.

games.title: Carmen Sandiego
games.description: Carmen Sandiego, la superladra scarlatta, è tornata! Indossa il cappello rosso di Carmen e gioca nei panni della famosa vigilante. Tuffati nel mondo dello spionaggio, usa gadget tecnologici e sventa i piani della VILE.

games.title: Carnage Battle Arena
games.description: Unleash chaos in Carnage Battle Arena! Smash, race, and survive in blocky, retro-styled mayhem. 82 cars, dozens of maps, epic destruction, and game-changing power-ups await. Master multiple modes like Death Match, Survival, and Racing. Get ready for nonstop adrenaline! 🚗🔥

games.title: Carnage Chase
games.description: Welcome to Carnage Chase, where racing meets intense shooting! Navigate dynamic tracks, unleash firepower, and outmaneuver rivals in ever-changing challenges. Adapt, race and dominate amidst the chaos. Ready for the ultimate challenge?

games.title: Carnival Games
games.description: Carnival Games offre divertimento assicurato per tutti, che sia in modalità individuale o con un massimo di altre tre persone. Sfida i tuoi amici più e più volte nei 20 mini-giochi disponibili.

games.title: Carpathian Survival
games.description: Experience the untamed beauty of the Carpathian wilderness. Gather resources, chop trees, mine for materials, craft tools, and build shelter to withstand the harsh environment. Hunt wildlife and master essential survival skills as you navigate the untamed mountains.

games.canonical_title: Carpool: Attack of the Disco Mob
games.title: Carpool: Attack of the Disco Mob
games.description: Disco-ver an alien mothership from the disco era! Drive your carpool past cops, blast through barriers, and save Earth from evil dancing invaders!

games.title: CARRION
games.description: CARRION è un gioco horror al contrario nel quale impersonerai una creatura amorfa dalle origini sconosciute che dà la caccia e consuma chiunque la imprigioni.  CACCIA. CONSUMA. CRESCI. EVOLVITI.

games.title: Carsick Carventure
games.description: Carsic Carventure is a simple hyper-casual game where you drive your 2D car as far as possible. Discover new places, set new records, and beat your friends! Enjoy infinite levels and different game modes!

games.title: Cartel Tycoon
games.description: Cartel Tycoon è un gioco gestionale di sopravvivenza ispirato al narcotraffico degli anni '80. Espanditi e conquista, difenditi dai cartelli rivali ed eludi le autorità. Ottieni la lealtà dei cittadini e cerca a tutti i costi di scongiurare il fatale destino che attende tutti ...

games.title: Carto
games.description: Carto è un affascinante gioco di avventura costruito attorno a una speciale meccanica di puzzle in grado di alterare il mondo circostante. Utilizza questa capacità per esplorare terre misteriose, aiutare un bizzarro gruppo di personaggi e riportare Carto dalla sua famiglia.

games.title: CarX Drift Racing Online
games.description: CarX Drift Racing Online is your chance to immerse yourself in the real world of drifting. Get together with friends, tune your car and burn some tires!

games.title: Casa del Golf 2
games.description: Imbarcati in un'avventura golfistica indimenticabile con House of Golf 2 - non solo un gioco, ma un invito a creare ricordi indelebili con famiglia e amici. Che tu sia un professionista esperto o un novellino sui green virtuali, tuffati in un mondo ricco di sfide ed eccitazione.

games.title: CASE 2: Animatronics Survival
games.description:
Two years before the attack on the police station, there was a terrible tragedy in the city, which led to the closure of the amusement park.
Some believe it was an accident—others, that it was a well-planned act of intimidation.

games.title: CASE: Animatronics
games.description: CASE: Animatronics is a truly scary and challenging first-person stealth horror on PC. Control of the police department is in the hands of anonymous hacker. All exits are locked. Electricity is off. Metallic thumps are getting closer. Will you survive, Detective Bishop?

games.title: Cassette Beasts
games.description: Colleziona fantastici mostri da usare in battaglie a turni in questo GdR open-world, ora con multigiocatore online. Combina due forme di mostro qualsiasi usando il Sistema di fusione di Cassette Beasts per crearne di nuove, uniche e potenti!

games.title: Cassiodora
games.description: Cassiodora è un gioco fantasy medievale ispirato agli sparatutto classici, che offre meccaniche uniche e battaglie epiche contro i boss. Salva la principessa Cassiodora da solo o con un massimo di due amici nello stesso schermo.

games.title: CASTILLO: The Nine Circles
games.description: CASTILLO: The Nine Circles is an FPS Collectathon. Collect power shards in each circle of hell to unlock new areas and progress on your quest through 9 diverse worlds. Embark on a journey through the circles of Hell, using unique abilities and weapons.

games.title: Castles
games.description: Design and Build Authentic Medieval Castles!

games.title: Castles II - Siege and Conquest
games.description: Immerse yourself in all of the glory and honor of being a medieval Baron struggling for the throne!

games.title: CastleStorm 2
games.description: CastleStorm 2

games.title: Castlevania Anniversary Collection
games.description: Konami Castlevania Anniversary Collection riscopre le origini dello storico franchise dedicato ai vampiri.

games.title: Cat Cafe Manager
games.description: Mettiti in viaggio verso il sonnecchiante villaggio di Caterwaul Way e ricostruisci il caffè con i gatti di tua nonna. Rinnova il tuo ristorante, stringi amicizie durature con i gatti e i cittadini del posto, scopri misteri felini e crea una casa per tantissimi gatti unici!

games.title: Cat Karting
games.description: Now you are a catloaf and you are racing along the track.

games.title: Cat Named Mojave
games.description: Stranded in the desert, your only hope of escaping rests in a strange Catman. His one request: hunt down surreal creatures, skin them, and chop them up so he can keep them as trophies.

games.title: Cat Quest
games.description: Il pluripremiato GDR d'azione. La ricca gattavventura di Cat Quest è tanto splendida da vedere quanto emozionante da giocare. Adorata dai critici di tutto il mondo: farai le fusa dalla gioia!

games.title: Cat Quest II
games.description: GDR d'azione open world in un regno fantasy popolato da cani e gatti. In Cat Quest II potrai giocare in singolo o con un amico, sia come gatto che come cane! Esplora un mondo di magie, sconfiggi mostri e raccogli bottino in una gattavventura mai vista prima!

games.title: Cat Slide Tiles
games.description: Move the sliding tiles to unblock a path for the kitten to walk to the exit.

games.title: Cat's Wars
games.description: Cat's Wars is a turn-based, third-person co-op strategy game. Choose a side: the Catounter or the CaTerror, assemble a squad of 5 unique furry fighters and unleash pure feline chaos. Hide in shelters, set ambushes and destroy your enemies in battle against a friend.

games.title: Cataclismo
games.description: Progetta e costruisci fortezze mattone su mattone, in modo che resistano a orde di Orrori: un gioco strategico in tempo reale con elementi di gestione risorse, difesa da assedio ed esplorazione. Impartisci ordini ai tuoi uomini e respingi le creature della Nebbia.

games.title: CATAIRE
games.description: Cat + Solitaire = CATAIRE is a unique game that combines two passions - a love for cats and a fascination with solitaire gameplay. It's a real treat for cat enthusiasts and card game fans alike. Every detail beautifully crafted, and gameplay that is equally engaging and relaxing.

games.title: Catch the Icons II
games.description:
Catch the Icons II is a Christian Edutainment game that allows the player to watch Christian Icons and "catch" the ones with the right theme. Faith-inspired and family-friendly.

Learn Iconography. Study Themes. Catch the Icons.

games.title: Catizens
games.description: Catizens is a colony management simulation game where you watch over unique cats with quirky personalities, as you help them build and grow their settlement while exploring new lands, facing off against wildlife and overcoming the challenges of each environment.

games.title: Catniss around the world
games.description: Jump into a beautifully crafted adventure starring Catniss! Experience smooth, traditional 2D animation brought to life inside immersive 3D environments. Run, leap, and explore vibrant side-scrolling worlds full of charm and challenge.

games.title: Catoise
games.description: Make portals and levitate objects to solve puzzles - help Catoise get back home after a shopping trip in space ends in a crash landing. Collect parts of the damaged ship scattered across this strange planet. Meet friendly and unfriendly animal characters along the way.

games.title: Cats Hidden Around the World
games.description: Trova 4000 gatti nascosti in 40 location iconiche in tutto il mondo in questo rilassante gioco di oggetti nascosti, dal creatore dell’originale gioco virale dei gatti nascosti! Riuscirai a trovarli tutti?

games.title: Cats Hidden in Italy
games.description: Find 100 cats hiding in Italy in this cute hand-drawn hidden object game

games.title: Cats on Duty
games.description: Cats on Duty è una miscela perfetta di strategia in tempo reale e meccaniche tower defense e match-3. Gestite due campi di battaglia contemporaneamente e armate e potenziate le vostre torri per sconfiggere orde di formidabili nemici. Godetevi questa miao-gnifica battaglia!

games.title: Cats Ritual
games.description: Explore a decaying city in "Cats Ritual," an indie adventure where you must find 30 cats to complete a mysterious ritual and save an eccentric NPC from ancient cat spirits. Uncover secrets, solve puzzles.

games.title: Causal Loop
games.description: CAUSAL LOOP is a narrative puzzler that blends mind-bending mechanics with a rich sci-fi story about time, consequence, and survival. Solve intricate puzzles by using the unique “echo” mechanic to record, replay, and interact with up to three versions of your past self.

games.title: Cave Story+
games.description: Probabilmente il gioco indie più conosciuto di tutti i tempi, Cave Story+ offre una storia originale ricca di personalità, mistero e divertimento frenetico. Corri, salta, spara, vola ed esplora in questa enorme avventura che ricorda i classici a 8 e 16 bit!

games.title: Cavern of Dreams
games.description: Imbarcati in una magica avventura nei panni del drago Fynn per salvare i tuoi fratelli non ancora nati dalla misteriosa Caverna dei Sogni in questo platform 3D in stile N64.

games.title: Caverns of Mars Recharged
games.description: Race through caverns while blasting away enemies and terrain to reach the depths of Mars in this reimagining of the 1981 classic.

games.title: Celeste
games.description: Aiuta Madeline ad affrontare i suoi demoni in un viaggio verso la cima del Monte Celeste in un avvincente platformer dai creatori del classico multigiocatore TowerFall. Fronteggia centinaia di sfide disegnate a mano, scopri impalpabili segreti e ricostruisci il mistero della m...

games.title: Cellveillance
games.description: "Cellveillance" is a detective drama entertainment product, you will visit the apartment every day, and the entire apartment is responsible for everything that happens in the apartment, a mysterious organization asks you to return the information of the residents.

games.title: Centipede: Recharged
games.description: Blast bugs and chase high scores in this glorious revival of an old-school classic, all while jamming to a heart-pounding original score by Megan McDuffee. Play solo or tag in a friend for local co-op across 30 unique challenges or the endless arcade mode.

games.title: Century: Age of Ashes
games.description: Century: Age of Ashes è un gioco multigiocatore free-to-play di battaglie con i draghi. Padroneggia una gamma di classi e draghi in continua espansione, partecipa a intense battaglie in arena e domina i cieli in frenetici scontri aerei.

games.title: Cepheus Protocol
games.description: An unimaginable plague has been released in San Francisco, turning the population into mutated creatures hellbent on spreading the Pangu Virus. Inspired by classic RTS series Company of Heroes and World in Conflict, it is up to you to win back the city.

games.title: CET
games.description:
First part of Episode 1 called "Cursed Staff" from Mini Stories of Terror.
Javier will discover his past while trying to rid himself of the demon KOMA and his own fears in Lord Atrick's mansion

games.title: Chain Crisis
games.description: Chain Crisis is a single-player cyberpunk action RPG set in the ruins of Warpgate City. Build your combat style with modular abilities, explore Nullium-scarred districts, and rise as a Runner guided by Jack as the city fractures around you.

games.title: Chains of Freedom
games.description: Embark on a thrilling journey in a high-stakes, turn-based tactics game. Lead an elite squad in a fictional, dystopian Eastern European country as you unravel a conspiracy threatening the state. Navigate intense strategic battles and adapt to ever-evolving challenges to prevail.

games.title: Chains of Fury
games.description: Welcome to high adrenaline, fast-paced Metroidvania Boomer Shooter where you have only one goal: spread furious mayhem among the scumbags keeping you locked up. Stuck looking for an exit? Just punch through walls and then shoot the suckers behind them.

games.title: Chains of War
games.description: Step into Chains of War© and experience FREL, the groundbreaking Fantasy RPG Extraction Looter. Engage in the struggle between Orcs, Elves, and Humans. Will you strive for liberation or conquest? Your decisions mold the fate of this immersive saga.

games.title: ChanceLot TD: Merge Wars
games.description: Un gioco di difesa cooperativa con un tocco di fortuna. Evoca, unisci, gira la ruota e affronta ondate infinite con i tuoi amici. Scegli la difficoltà e dimostra che la tua squadra può superare qualsiasi sfida.

games.title: Chants of Sennaar
games.description: La leggenda narra che un giorno un viandante riunirà le genti della Torre, che non sono più in grado di comunicare tra loro. Osserva, ascolta e decifra le lingue antiche in un universo affascinante ispirato al mito di Babele.

games.title: Chaos on Wheels
games.description: Take a wheel of a heavily armored car, and drive yourself to victory while shooting and destroying enemy cars, turrets, and hazards in this chaotic vehicular combat experience. Choose a driver, customize your cars, upgrade armor, buy new weapons, and leave nothing but chaos!

games.title: Charm And Clue 2 Collector's Edition
games.description: Charm & Clue 2 - a hidden object detective game: explore locations, find clues, and solve mysteries where logic and magic intertwine.

games.title: Charm and Clue Collector's Edition
games.description: Charm & Clue - an exciting detective adventure with mysteries, puzzles and secrets in the atmospheric world of the 50s-60s

games.title: Charon's Staircase
games.description: In questa misteriosa avventura horror in prima persona, dovrai venire a capo dell’orribile passato di un governo tirannico. Recupera e distruggi i documenti che sveleranno i segreti che nasconde la tenebrosa Oack Grove.

games.title: Chased by Darkness
games.description: Sopravvivi all'oscurità. Affronta entità soprannaturali in solitaria o con gli amici in questo horror cooperativo per 1-4 giocatori. Scaccia gli spiriti, sblocca nuovi personaggi ed esplora diverse mappe. Riuscirai a sfuggire a un incubo che diventa sempre più minaccioso?
games.developer: ISAAC SANTOS MORENO DESENVOLVIMENTO DE SOFTWARE LTDA
games.publisher: ISAAC SANTOS MORENO DESENVOLVIMENTO DE SOFTWARE LTDA

games.title: Check Inn
games.description: Check Inn is an addictive game about building a hotel chain and checking in guests!

games.title: Chef Life - A Restaurant Simulator
games.description:
Crea e gestisci il ristorante dei tuoi sogni! 
Menu, acquisti, decorazioni, personale, attrezzature, clienti... senza dimenticare la cucina in sé! Vivi la quotidianità di un ristoratore e guadagna i premi della Guida Michelin.

games.title: Chemists Area of infection
games.description: A year after the global catastrophe, you woke up in a hospital and don't remember anything. You have to not only find out what happened, but also try to survive in this harsh dangerous world.

games.title: Chernobylite
games.description: Chernobylite è un GDR di sopravvivenza horror fantascientifico con combattimenti complessi e una meccanica di creazione unica. Il gioco è ambientato nella iper-realistica scansione in 3D delle terre desolate della zona d'esclusione di Chernobyl. Esplora una narrativa non linea...

games.title: Chess Club Valley
games.description: Chess Club Valley è un GDR a mondo aperto in 2D. Vivi per la prima volta un'epica avventura scacchistica ambientata in un mondo pieno di personaggi unici, mostri, segreti e super boss, mentre giochi a scacchi per aumentare i tuoi PE. Un totale di oltre 20 ore di gioco!

games.title: Chess Infinity
games.description: Riscopri l'arte della strategia senza tempo in Chess Infinity, ideale sia per esperti che per principianti. Immergiti in ambienti sereni, migliora grazie all'IA adattiva e interagisci con giocatori di tutto il mondo. Intraprendi il tuo viaggio e padroneggia la tua prossima mossa.

games.title: Chess Knights: Shinobi
games.description: Chess Knights: Shinobi is an original turn-based puzzle game inspired by Chess. Become a Ninja in feudal Japan and prove your skills in the art of infiltration, sabotage and assassination.

games.title: Chess Knights: Viking Lands
games.description: Help the Knights to rescue their Kings and Queens in the beautiful and dangerous Vikings Lands. An innovative game concept inspired by chess: Infiltrate mindfully, rescue quickly and get out alive if you can.

games.title: Chess Ultra
games.description: Siamo lieti di presentarvi Chess Ultra, il gioco di scacchi più entusiasmante mai visto. Splendide immagini in 4K, sessioni multigiocatore online senza interruzioni, IA approvata dai grandi maestri e compatibilità totale con i dispositivi di realtà virtuale.

games.title: Chessarama
games.description: Chessarama è una raccolta di giochi di puzzle e strategia ispirati agli scacchi.

games.title: Chicken Assassin Reloaded
games.description: Fight your way as Mean Mcallister, the baddest chicken in town, through multiple hordes of enemies to save your girlfriend in this hilarious, strategic button-mashing, action-RPG.

games.title: Chicken Chicken
games.description: Enter the brutal pecking order of the wasteland! Chicken Chicken is a party game for 2-6 players. Survive mad mini-games, form temporary alliances, and claw your way to the top. Total feathery anarchy!

games.title: Chicken Fries
games.description: Chicken Fries is a first-person restaurant simulator where you run a fast-food kitchen: prepare meals by hand, manage fryers and inventory, serve customers, and survive the daily chaos of a busy restaurant, one chicken at a time.

games.title: Chicken Journey
games.description: Play as an adorable chicken in this relaxing platformer. Jump, climb and solve puzzles to find the answer to the ULTIMATE question a chicken can ask: "What came first: the Chicken or the Egg?"

games.title: Chicken Police - Paint it Red!
games.description: Una selvaggia storia di amore, morte, polli e redenzione! Chicken Police è un'avventura poliziesca noir ambientata in un mondo di gioco creato con la massima attenzione al dettaglio, una storia cruda e ruvida e un senso dello humour surreale. Il gioco mescola elementi propri d...

games.title: Child of Light: Ultimate Edition
games.description: Nel 1895, Aurora, una bambina austriaca, si sveglia in un mondo fatato chiamato Lemuria. Per tornare a casa dovrà combattere le creature oscure della Regina della Notte, che ha rubato il sole, la luna e le stelle.

games.title: Children of Silentown
games.description: Children of Silentown è un cupo gioco di avventura che narra la storia di Lucy, ragazza cresciuta in un villaggio nel cuore di una foresta piena di mostri. Qui non è insolito che le persone scompaiano, ma adesso Lucy è abbastanza grande per indagare da sola. O almeno così crede.

games.title: Chip 'N Clawz vs The Brainioids
games.description: Download Friend’s Pass to Chip ‘n Clawz online co-op and PvP multiplayer with a friend for free on any platform! If a friend owns the full game, you can join them for free, or vice-versa.

games.title: Chiral
games.description: In Chiral, assumerai il ruolo di un cervello disincarnato in un barattolo, affiancato da un compagno digitale AI. Insieme, navigherete in un labirinto di enigmi a specchi, laser e gravità.

games.title: Chivalry 2
games.description: Chivalry 2 è uno slasher multigiocatore in prima persona ispirato alle battaglie medievali cinematografiche. I giocatori si tufferanno nell'azione di tutti i momenti più iconici dell'epoca: dal fragore delle spade alla pioggia di frecce incendiate, fino agli assedi ai castelli...

games.canonical_title: Choice Clash: What Would you Rather?
games.title: Choice Clash: What Would you Rather?
games.description: Experience a world of choices in this ultimate decision-making game with 300 mind-bending dilemmas. Your path, your destiny awaits! And You What Would You Rather? Be invisible for a day or Be able to fly for a day? Your Choice matter!

games.title: Chorus
games.description: Era la guerriera più letale della Cerchia. Oggi è la fuggitiva più ricercata. Nei panni di Nara e della sua astronave Forsaken, dovrai attraversare la galassia per unire le forze della resistenza contro la Cerchia e liberare l'universo dall'oppressione.

games.title: Christmas Mahjong
games.description:
Mahjong magic - collect numerous gifts on Christmas night! 
Complete over 100 unique levels in 6 locations. 
Earn points and trophies!

games.title: Christmas Mahjong 2
games.description: A Christmas atmosphere on every level! Are you ready to dive into a winter fairytale? Complete 120 unique levels of Mahjong!

games.title: Christmas Wonderland 10 Collectors Edition
games.description: A family friendly festive hidden object game

games.title: Christmas Wonderland 11 Collectors Edition
games.description: A family friendly festive hidden object game

games.title: Christmas Wonderland 12 Collectors Edition
games.description: A family friendly festive Hidden Object Game

games.title: Christmas Wonderland 13 Collectors Edition
games.description: A family friendly festive hidden object game.

games.title: Christmas Wonderland 16: Collector's Edition
games.description: A family friendly festive Hidden Object Game

games.title: Christmas Wonderland Collectors Edition
games.description: A relaxing hidden object game for the festive season.

games.title: ChromaGun
games.description: Salve! Ti abbiamo convocato qui per farti provare la nostra tecnologia all'avanguardia nel campo del colore a uso militare: la ChromaGun! Usala per provare a risolvere le nostre camere di test realizzate nei minimi dettagli colorando le pareti e i droidi. Ti ricordi quelle divertentissime lezioni all'asilo in cui dovevi mescolare i colori? Se la risposta è sì, ti trovi nel posto giusto!

games.title: ChromaGun 2: Dye Hard
games.description: Shoot paint, mix colors, and solve puzzles in this adventure about friendship and redemption. Just don't enter that portal to another universe, and ᴇᴠᴇʀʏTʜɪɴɢ will 𝐛𝐞 ᴘEʀ𝐅𝓔ᴄᴛʟʏ 𝒇 𝔦 𝓃 ҽ .  •   °

games.title: Chronicles of 2 Heroes: Amaterasu's Wrath
games.description: Amaterasu and her yokai army rule over feudal Japan. All hopes rest on two siblings, each one with unique skills. Switch in real time between Kensei and Ayame to defeat the goddess in this intense, 16-bit action platformer with Metroidvania elements and gorgeous pixel art.

games.title: Chronicles of Taldun - The Remainder
games.description: A dark-fantasy tale where death isn't the end but the path to the truth. Two magi trapped in a collapsing tower must unravel a deadly mystery. Each death reveals another piece of the puzzle of their shared past. For fans of House in Fata Morgana and literary dark fantasy.

games.title: Chrono
games.description: Chrono is a puzzle/platformer game where you control how time affects objects in the world. By freezing time, fast-forwarding, or rewinding objects, you can crack a wide variety of puzzles. The goal is to escape the facility where you are trapped, before time runs out.

games.title: Chrono CCG
games.description: The Future of Digital Card Games, built for Competition and Community.

games.title: Chrono Odyssey
