games.description: Chrono Odyssey - A Next-Generation Action MMORPG. Game features include awe-inspiring visuals powered by Unreal Engine 5, a vast and intricately designed seamless open world, dynamic action-based combat mechanics based on time manipulation and extensive customization.

games.title: Chrono Stranded
games.description: Chrono Stranded is an adventure action game where you battle through a shattered world where past, present, and future collide. Survive encounters against humans, aliens, beasts, and robots as you uncover the truth behind a cataclysmic temporal collapse.

games.title: ChronoForge
games.description: Part game, part massive social experiment - ChronoForge is a radical multiplayer RPG in which the combined decisions of players make or break the world!

games.title: Chronos Affinity
games.description: Chronos Affinity is a narrative‑driven extraction shooter built on perspective, consequence, and the desperate search for truth in a collapsing world. Every raid, every alliance, and every loss pushes you closer to uncovering what happened—and what it cost you.

games.title: Chronos Trap In Time
games.description: Harness the power of Greek Gods in this intense vertical rogue-like shooter. Command divine Mechas, brew sacred potions, and unlock permanent upgrades at Hephaestos’ Forge. Battle mythical hordes and challenge the Titans in a fast-paced quest for eternal glory!

games.title: Chronos: Before the Ashes
games.description: Chronos: Before the Ashes è un gioco di ruolo immersivo nel quale seguirai la vita di un eroe che si batte per proteggere la propria terra dal male. Diventa più forte, saggio e potente esplorando le profondità del misterioso labirinto.

games.title: ChronosWorlds
games.description: A fresh take on action platformers, set in a post-apocalyptic world, featuring +100 multiplayer game modes, co-op dungeons, boss raids, and intense PvP battles. Start your adventure through time.

games.title: CHUCHEL
games.description: CHUCHEL è un gioco di avventure comiche dai creatori di Machinarium, Botanicula e Samorost. Unisciti al peloso eroe Chuchel e al suo rivale Kekel nella ricerca della preziosissima ciliegia e affronta numerosi enigmi e sfide complicate!

games.title: Ciclo Infinito:Stanze Segrete
games.description: Questo è un gioco sparatutto roguelike dall’alto verso il basso con esplorazione, enigmi e un pizzico di horror, in cui puoi personalizzare le armi e fuggire dai backrooms attraverso migliaia di stanze!

games.title: Cicoria: una storia pittoresca
games.description: Un gioco d'avventura top-down in un mondo ambientato in un libro da colorare, pieno di personaggi vivaci. Usa i tuoi poteri pittorici per esplorare, risolvere rompicapi, conoscere nuovi amici e disegnare su qualsiasi cosa! Dal creatore di Wandersong e dai designer che hanno la...

games.title: Cinema Theater Tycoon
games.description: Gioco gestionale in cui dirigi il tuo cinema attraverso oltre 100 anni di storia. Costruisci e personalizza il tuo impero cinematografico senza farti travolgere dall'evoluzione della settima arte.

games.title: Cions of Vega
games.description: Your daughter Leila ran away from home, so you're going after her to find where she's hiding. Your brother, Logan, accompanies you throughout your journey.

games.title: Circus Electrique
games.description: Circus Electrique è in parte un GDR dalla spiccata componente narrativa, in parte un gioco tattico e di gestione dei circhi, ma è in tutto e per tutto coinvolgente. Quando i londinesi si trasformano misteriosamente in spietati assassini, solo gli artisti di maggior talento dello show possono salvare la città.

games.title: Cities: Skylines
games.description: Cities: Skylines è un approccio moderno alla classica simulazione di città. Espande i concetti di base dell'esperienza di costruzione di una città e offre nuovi elementi che creeranno sia l'emozione che le difficoltà del realizzare e gestire una vera città.

games.title: Citizen Conflict
games.description: Team-based hero shooter Citizen Conflict merges fast-paced gameplay with esports intensity for ultimate competitive action.

games.title: Citizen Sleeper
games.description: Roleplaying in the ruins of interplanetary capitalism. Live the life of an escaped worker, washed-up on a lawless station at the edge of an interstellar society. Inspired by the flexibility and freedom of TTRPGs, choose your friends, escape your past and change your future.

games.title: Citizen Sleeper 2: Starward Vector
games.description: A dice-driven RPG, in a human and heartfelt sci-fi world. You are an escaped android, with a malfunctioning body, a price on your head and no memory of your past. Get a ship, find a crew, and take on contracts while you navigate across the Starward Belt.

games.title: City 20
games.description: Survive in a living post-apocalyptic city. Build trust or spark conflict with NPCs and factions, uncover mysteries, and watch the world change with your every choice.

games.title: City Ambulance Car Driving
games.description: Take ill people to emergency hospital in this ambulance game. If you like to play simulation games, this ambulance game is for you.

games.title: City Car Parking Simulator
games.description: Enjoy city driving in the City Car Parking Simulator, full of realistic driving experiences and challenging parking missions. Customize your vehicle and test your skills in this simulation game that offers a unique atmosphere with its graphics.

games.title: City Gridlock
games.description: This is a city traffic simulation game. You will have to solve various traffic problems to achieve good traffic efficiency. You will have to place road signs and traffic lights. Decide how to handle each traffic problem. Divert cars to different routes.

games.title: City of Beats
games.description: Esplora l'orizzonte di una città in continuo cambiamento dettato dalla 🎵 musica 🎵 in questo ritmico sparatutto rogue-lite. Entra in stato zen durante il combattimento, dove ogni azione è sincronizzata con la musica. Spara, segui il ritmo, raccogli bottini, potenzia e ripeti.

games.title: City of Brass
games.description: Diventa un audace ladro in City of Brass, un gioco di avventura in prima persona creato dagli esperti sviluppatori di BioShock.  Armato di scimitarra e di una versatile frusta, dovrai farti strada con fendenti e sferzate, tra esche e trappole, verso il cuore di una sfarzosa me...

games.title: City of Gangsters
games.description: In questo gioco gestionale di un impero criminale dovrai iniziare embrionali attività illecite e farle diventare macchine sforna-soldi! Costruisci locali clandestini e distillerie illecite. Sfrutta privilegi, insegui debitori e corrompi la polizia per farle chiudere un occhio.

games.title: City of Riches
games.description: Live the character and lead yourself to victory in this adventure. innovative gameplay movement, stunning visuals, and climb the leaderboard. City of Riches offers immersive single-player fun with rifles, nature guns, instruments, and more. Don't miss the experience.

games.title: City of Springs
games.description: Design and build drones to take down a corrupt regime and their army of clockwork robots! Sneak and fight your way through the city of Riveton to inspire the people to rise up for their freedom in this steampunk action adventure.

games.title: City Transport Simulator: Tram
games.description: Torna in cabina per l'esperienza di guida definitiva a bordo di un tram.

games.title: Civil Engine
games.description:
Civil Engine is powerful 3D visualization software designed for transportation and civil engineering projects. Build immersive visualizations with ease using industry-ready tools—no external 3D expertise required.
Note: This is not a video game

games.title: Civil War Gettysburg
games.description: The Battle of Gettysburg was fought from 1st to 3rd July 1863, in Pennsylvania. The battle resulted the largest number of casualties in any battle of the entire war, and was the turning point of the American Civil War.

games.title: Civil War: 1862
games.description: Relive iconic battles of the American Civil War. Take command of both the Union and Confederate forces in this exciting turn-based strategy game.

games.title: CIVITAS
games.description: Build, trade, and strategize in Civitas, a multiplayer city-building game where every decision matters. Form alliances, expand your influence, and shape a thriving world that lives and breathes with you. The future of your city is in your hands: are you ready to lead?

games.canonical_title: Clad In Iron War of The Pacific 1879
games.title: Clad In Iron War of The Pacific 1879
games.description: Manage your fleet and army, hunt the enemy's fleet, hide your weak squadrons in protected ports until reinforcements arrive, blockade enemy trade routes, amphibious assaults, struggle for dominance over the seas.

games.title: Clair Obscur: Expedition 33
games.description: Guida la Spedizione 33 in una missione per distruggere la Pittrice e impedirle di dipingere la morte. Esplora un mondo di meraviglie ispirate alla Francia della Belle Époque e affronta nemici incredibili in un GDR a turni con meccaniche in tempo reale.

games.title: Claire de Lune
games.description: Claire de Lune è un avventuroso gioco di rompicapi dalla trama intensa e ambientato in un universo fantascientifico. Vesti i panni di John e punta su astuzia, agilità e sulla tua affidabile Nanogun per esplorare l'infida superficie del pianeta e il misterioso centro ricerche c...

games.title: Clash - Artifacts of Chaos
games.description: Braccato dai mercenari di un nemico dal potere incommensurabile, il combattente Pseudo e la creatura sotto la sua protezione iniziano una pericolosa missione ai confini di terre sconosciute.

games.title: Clash Heroes of Feralia Terra
games.description: An intense hybrid of hack-and-slash melee and ranged weaponry, enhanced with feral abilities tied to your hero's animal lineage. Unleash your feral instincts in visceral combat, scavenge, craft, explore corrupted landscapes, and destroy the cosmic horrors threatening all life.

games.title: Class of '09
games.description: This is the anti-visual novel. Instead of playing as some guy magically able to score with beautiful anime girls, YOU play the anime girl and create mass chaos in the lives of your potential "suitors". Earnest comedy, social accuracy, and late 2000's aesthetic await you!

games.title: Classic Car Simulator Car Driving
games.description: An immersive car game awaits you with a classic car driving simulator.

games.title: Classic racing manager
games.description: Amministra il tuo team corse, pilota e macchina, prepara setup e strategia per ogni gara, analizza la telemetria di gara e diventa parte di una grande comunità di motorsport.

games.title: Classified: France '44
games.description: Classified: France '44 è un nuovo gioco strategico a turni ambientato durante la Seconda guerra mondiale, in particolare nei mesi disperati che hanno preceduto l'invasione della Francia da parte degli Alleati nel giugno del 1944.

games.title: CLAWPUNK
games.description: Gioca nei panni di intrepidi eroi felini e affronta gang malvagie per riconquistare Felinity in questa caotica avventura arcade. Sfodera gli artigli e scatena la tua furia mentre l'adrenalina ti trascina attraverso ambienti interattivi.

games.title: Clawsome
games.description: Help Clawby find unique friends in this wholesome adventure! Collect cute figurines with the help of Clawby to create colorful dioramas in this cozy claw machine game.

games.title: Cleaner Company
games.description: Star Wipers, ready your mops! In an online co-op expedition for up to 4 players, use an arsenal of tools to clean up abandoned space stations, unexplored planets, and ruined restaurants across the cosmos. Start by tidying away the corpses of your predecessors.

games.title: Cleaning Queens 2: Sparkling Palace
games.description: Get swept away in the sparkling love story of "Cleaning Queens 2: Sparkling Palace" as Beth and Ross navigate hidden object levels, mini-games, and a world of cleaning slang in their quest for a spotless future. Join them in over 100 levels of cleaning mayhem.

games.title: Cleaning Queens: Crystal Clean Home
games.description: House cleaning has never been more fun - grab your mouse, sit back, relax, and clean up numerous rooms in this satisfying point-and-click game!

games.title: CLeM
games.description: A puzzle adventure game with a dark twist. Wake up in a world where puzzles intertwine with exploration, weaving a unique narrative rooted in alchemy. A voice awakens you. It gives you purpose. To guide you, you find a notebook with mysterious entries and a house to explore.

games.title: Clicker Kingdom
games.description: In Clicker Kingdom, manage and expand your kingdom by collecting resources with every click. Unlock upgrades, build structures, and recruit allies to automate tasks and enhance your realm. Aim to create the most powerful kingdom in this fun and engaging incremental adventure!

games.title: Clid The Snail
games.description: In questo stravagante sparatutto dall'alto vestirai i panni di Clid, una scontrosa chiocciola antropomorfa armata fino alla radula! Vivi un'oscura favola fantasy ed esplora uno spietato mondo in miniatura per mettere fine all'infestazione di lumache con armi incredibile e un esclusivo set di abilità... viscide.

games.title: Clockwork Sword
games.description: Slash, stab, and shoot your way through a multi-tiered museum filled with corrupted automata, customizing your weapon with the scraps of the fallen. Clockwork Sword is a thrilling isometric hack and slash, in which you'll use combinations of weapons & elements to conquer all foes

games.canonical_title: Clone Drone in the Danger Zone
games.title: Clone Drone in the Danger Zone
games.description: Clone Drone in the Danger Zone è un gioco di combattimento con spada in terza persona in cui qualsiasi parte del corpo può essere mozzata. La tua mente è stata scaricata in un gladiatore robot e devi sopravvivere alle insidie dell'arena.

games.title: Close To The Sun
games.description: La Helios di Tesla è alla deriva in acque internazionali. Una sorta di utopia senza limiti per la ricerca scientifica: Rose Archer sale a bordo per cercare sua sorella, scoprendo presto che non tutto è come sembra. E all’ingresso vi è solo una scritta... QUARANTENA!!

games.title: Cloud Cutter
games.description: Classic arcade shoot ‘em up gameplay in top notch graphics. Enjoy intense fast-paced explosive action full of epic destruction, arcade style power-ups, lasers and of course huge multi-stage boss fights.

games.title: Cloudheim
games.description: Master chaotic physics-based combat inspired by Zelda and Devil May Cry. Explore islands and dungeons, smash monsters, loot and craft powerful gear, and grow your home in the sky. Play solo or online co-op with up to 4 players.

games.title: CloudMountainFarm
games.description: Cloud Mountain Farm is a farm simulation game where players can plant crops, chop trees, and mine stones.

games.title: Clouzy!
games.description: Le nuvole in genere svolazzano nel cielo, ma queste adorabili e soffici nubi devono essere accudite nel centro per nuvole! Esplora il mondo, raccogli frutti deliziosi e cucina piatti gustosi in questo graziosissimo gioco di allevamento.

games.title: CLOWN
games.description: You're trapped inside a series of mazes with a killer clown. Find the 8 playing cards to banish him before he finds you. Can you escape?

games.title: Clown Eyes: Dead Park
games.description: Gioco di nascondino in prima persona molto suggestivo. Riesci a raccogliere tutte le immagini e a scappare dal clown?

games.title: CLUTCH
games.description: CLUTCH is a cinematic open-world action-driving game where the worlds of professional and underground street racing collide across the French Riviera.

games.canonical_title: Cobra Kai - The Karate Kid Saga Continues
games.title: Cobra Kai - The Karate Kid Saga Continues
games.description: Scegli da che parte stare, padroneggia le tue mosse e affronta il tuo destino in un'epica avventura del genere picchiaduro ispirata alla famosa serie.

games.title: COCOON
games.description: Da Jeppe Carlsen, il progettista principale del gameplay di LIMBO e INSIDE, COCOON ti porta in un'avventura attraverso mondi dentro mondi. Padroneggia meccanismi che fanno saltare il mondo e risolvi intricati enigmi per svelare un mistero cosmico.

games.title: Code Alkonost
games.description: Code Alkonost is a first-person, atmospheric adventure where Slavic legends come to life. Travel through a dark fantasy world and encounter the possessive spirits of the underworld. Experience authentic art styles and stories that have never been seen in adventure games before.

games.title: CODE EXIT
games.description: Enter Pantheon, a futuristic city swallowed by darkness and ruled by a rogue AI. Team up with up to 4 players and survive an adaptive pursuer that learns from every mistake. Complete the mission, uncover Minerva’s secrets, and find a way out before the city consumes you.

games.title: Code Name: Boogeyman
games.description: Code Name: Boogeyman is a single-player action-fighting game inspired by iconic movies and video games.

games.title: Codename Medusa
games.description: Build a country, become a billionaire, or dive into our sprawling open-world to learn lore. Dictate the focus of your nation! Be wicked and have fun tormenting struggling citizens for profit or nice by completing town projects to clean the corrupted area for deported monsters.

games.title: Coin Push RPG
games.description: Coin Push RPG is a unique blend of Semi-Idle RPG and coin-pusher gameplay! Recruit legendary heroes, equip them with powerful gear, upgrade your town, construct buildings, and unlock stunning backgrounds as you expand your influence.

games.title: Cold Paws
games.description: A stray cat standing with a puppy against all odds in a vast cosmic drama based on our private novel COLD PAWS. Players play as Chitti (Cat) and Mounti (Puppy), and also as Humans and Elves. Join Chitti and Mounti to experience a rollercoaster of emotions.

games.title: Cole Hunter: Payback
games.description: Un roguelite bullet hell 2D in stile retrò, dove piloti una nave personalizzabile, raccogli nuclei nemici per potenziare l’arsenale e insegui taglie in un’odissea spaziale ad alto rischio.

games.title: Collector's Cove
games.description: Set sail on a cozy farming adventure aboard your boat in Collector's Cove. Explore diverse climate zones with your animal companion and discover rare crops and fish. Enjoy cozy solitude while completing your Collector's compendium and rise to the rank of a Named Collector.

games.title: Collezione Alto
games.description: Ti attendono due viaggi alla volta di infiniti deserti e sconfinati paesaggi alpini. Scegli il tuo percorso e parti all'avventura con il tuo snowboard o la tua sandboard in compagnia di Alto e i suoi amici.

games.title: Colonies of the Remnant
games.description: In a post-apocalyptic world, found and develop your own colony under the threat of the undead. Be cautious against enemy colonies or form alliances. Engage in action-fueled battles against the undead and other humans using FPS or TPS game modes.

games.title: Colonize
games.description: Colonize is a relaxing 17th-century city-builder. Establish a settlement in the New World, manage resources, and ensure your people thrive across three unique levels. No combat, just pure strategy and management in a peaceful isometric world. Build your legacy at your own pace!

games.canonical_title: Colony : Part I The Moon Castle
games.title: Colony : Part I The Moon Castle
games.description: Humanity has experienced many technological revolutions in 200 years. Thanks to these revolutions, it can be expanded into space. They established colonies on Mars and the Moon. However, with the surprise attacks on the Moon colony, the youth began to experience difficult times..

games.title: Colony Break
games.description: Your people are the power, and the problem. Land on an unknown planet and build a thriving colony in this sci-fi sim. Humanity’s last hope, rests in a pristine, yet perilous world. Will your COLONY survive, or will their conflicts BREAK it apart?

games.title: Colony Defense - Tower Defense
games.description: Protect your space colonies in COLONY DEFENSE! Experience challenging tower defense with minimalist graphics, engaging voice acting, and high replay value. Start defending now!

games.title: Color Fear
games.description: Today on The Color Fun Coloring Show they want Viewers to help them find out Who is Breaking into their House!

games.title: Colorbound
games.description: In Colorbound, color is more than just hue. As Anku, an Aymara boy with a unique gift, you’ll harness the power of color to shape the environment itself, uncovering hidden paths to navigate challenging and complex puzzles.

games.title: Colorgrid
games.description: Colorgrid is a puzzle game about mixing colors in a Lab. Find the correct positions for your lasers and mirrors to get the right mix of colors in each material.

games.title: Colt Canyon
games.description: Fatti strada sparando in un canyon pieno di tesori nascosti, armi, ostacoli e farabutti sanguinari di ogni sorta! Un elegante sparatutto in pixel art con elementi roguelike e combattimento in tempo reale per salvare il tuo partner da banditi senza scrupoli.

games.title: Comanche
games.description: Comanche è un moderno sparatutto di scontri tra elicotteri ambientato in un futuro alternativo. Calati in una campagna per giocatore singolo in evoluzione, metti alla prova le tue capacità nelle missioni Conflitti o competi con altri giocatori nelle esplosive modalità multigio...

games.title: Combat Arena
games.description: Combat Arena is a combat simulator where AI vs AI duels happen in real time. Every move, decision, and reaction is controlled entirely by the AI. Experience the adrenaline of taking part in high-stakes duels!

games.title: Come on Fantasy baby!
games.description: Once a failure, fired and in debt, you ordered girls from another world through a vending machine. They bring joy and challenges as you confront your past and thwart villains, but is it all as it seems?

games.title: Come to my Party!
games.description:
"Become class president, and I'll throw you a birthday party." 
Trusting her mother's promise, Jimin throws herself into the campaign—but the closer she grows to her friends, the more hidden stories come to light.

games.title: Command & Conquer™ Remastered Collection
games.description: 25 anni fa, Command & Conquer e Red Alert hanno ridefinito il genere dei giochi strategici in tempo reale e oggi sono stati entrambi rimasterizzati in 4K da ex membri di Westwood Studios, ora a Petroglyph Games.

games.title: Commando:  Heart Of Terror
games.description:
Action shooter inspired by 1980s movies.


June 1985, you have been dropped into the African jungle to kill an emerging demonic menace.  Jake Walker and Reginald Washington are on a death mission to cleanse this evil that has risen to possess and kill humanity.

games.title: Commando:  Hell's Target 3D
games.description: Action shooter inspired by 1980s movies and games.  Eliminate demons deep into the African jungle in what can be described as a shock induced madness episodes or something all too real.

games.title: Commandos 3 - HD Remaster
games.description: Fall in, soldier! Commandos 3 - HD Remaster sends you to the relentless and unforgiving battlefields of Europe.

games.title: Commandos: Origins
games.description: ALLARME! Sei stato scelto per una missione che deciderà il destino del mondo intero. Assisti agli esordi della leggendaria forza d'élite della seconda guerra mondiale in Commandos: Origins.

games.title: Compadrone: Land Wars
games.description: In this fast-paced roguelite arena shooter with tower-defense twists, control a drone capable of wielding multiple weapons and fight hordes of alien warbots. Collect resources and XP to unlock new weapons, towers, abilities, and drones.

games.title: Company of Crime
games.description: Company of Crime places you in the heart of 1960s London. Will you build a criminal empire, or head up an elite Scotland Yard task force and crack down on the rising tide of corruption? Case out targets, then dive into the melee with your team of gangsters or detectives.

games.title: Compass of Destiny: Istanbul
games.description: Discover the 17th-century Ottoman Empire, its mysteries, and real historical events! Draw the path of your destiny with the guidance of the compass that will open the way of Fitra!

games.title: ComputerKeyboard
games.description: Master touch typing with ComputerKeyboard — a fast, intuitive way to train all ten fingers. Practice on global keyboard layouts, improve speed and accuracy, and build muscle memory without typing a single word. Just keys, reflexes, and results.

games.title: Conan Exiles
games.description: Un survival multigiocatore online, ora con la magia, ambientato nelle terre di Conan il Barbaro. Sopravvivi in un enorme mondo sandbox, crea un regno partendo da una semplice casa e annienta i nemici in modalità giocatore singolo o multigiocatore.

games.title: Conarium
games.description: Conarium, un gioco raggelante dalle atmosfere lovecraftiane, segue l'appassionante storia di quattro scienziati che tentano di sfidare quelli che tutti considerano i normali limiti della natura.

games.title: Concubine
games.description: A sensual, dark fantasy hack & slash ARPG. Fully customize an concubine and up to three female companions with deep cosmetic details. Be the private assassin of the Sultan and earn sexy outfits, powerful weapons & mystic skills. Design & customize your Harem base at the Palace

games.title: Conglomerate 451
games.description: Conglomerate 451 is a grid-based, dungeon crawling first-person RPG with roguelike elements set in a cyberpunk world.

games.title: Conjury Revell
games.description: Conjury Revell is a first-person action game from the students at SMU Guildhall. Use your magical spells and abilities to eliminate waves of faceless oppressors as they attempt to keep you from rebelling against the system.

games.title: Conkis
games.description: In Conkis, players command a medieval-like armies in a turn-based tactical battle to achieve victory through capturing flags or annihilating enemy forces. The game takes inspiration from both Chess and the Age of Empires series.

games.title: Conquest of the New World
games.description: Exploration, Deception, Conquest & Victory. Do you have what it takes to build the ultimate nation?

games.title: Conquistador Rex
games.description:
3 Spaniard conquistadors lost in a fantasy ​​America full of jurassic creatures and other enemies. 

Conquistador Rex is a 2D tactical platform game to play alone or in local co-op with.

You will have to combine the different skills of 3 characters to advance.

games.title: Conrad Stevenson's Paranormal P.I.
games.description: I made this first-person single player ghost hunting simulation game, trying to take an authentic approach at investigating ghosts. Use essential paranormal tools to help your community alleviate their concerns and put their minds at ease.

games.title: CONSCRIPT
games.description: Un eroico soldato francese deve avventurarsi da solo in un labirinto di trincee, accaparrandosi i rifornimenti necessari e risolvendo enigmi complessi: il tutto lottando per sopravvivere durante il più brutale conflitto che l’umanità abbia mai visto.

games.title: Containment Sector
games.description: Play VR PvE missions, secure strategic positions, retrive data and equipments in restricted zones in a futuristic cyberpunk world. Play the game in single player or team up in co-op missions.

games.title: Continente della Pietra di Entropia
games.description: Continente della Pietra di Entropia è un gioco di strategia che unisce combattimento tattico a turni e sviluppo del personaggio. Sei un principe sopravvissuto a una cospirazione di corte, ora esiliato in un mondo fantastico plasmato dalle Pietre di Entropia.

games.title: Contingent®️
games.description: A gritty melee RTS game set after the fall of the Roman Empire in Britain

games.title: Contractor: The Clean Up
games.description: Take control of a powerful loader and clear construction sites filled with rubble, broken concrete, and debris. Collect, transport, and clean up every corner to restore order and complete challenging recovery jobs.

games.title: Contraption Maker
games.description:
From the creators of The Incredible Machine comes Contraption Maker bringing all the Rube Goldberg craziness up to the modern age.

Comes with improved physics, new parts, ridiculous chain reactions, over 200 official puzzles, and Wonderstructs and Battling Cards Puzzle Packs.

games.title: Control
games.description: L'invasione di un'agenzia segreta di New York da parte di una minaccia ultraterrena ti porta a diventare la nuova direttrice: dovrai lottare per riconquistare Control.

games.title: CONTROL Resonant
games.description: Esplora una Manhattan distorta sull'orlo dell'annientamento paranaturale in questo elettrizzante GDR di azione-avventura. Scatena i grandi poteri di Dylan Faden mentre lotta per la sua umanità e la nostra sopravvivenza contro una minaccia cosmica che piega la realtà.

games.canonical_title: CONV/RGENCE: A League of Legends Story™
games.title: CONV/RGENCE: A League of Legends Story™
games.description: Riavvolgi il passato, controlla il futuro - Esplora lo spettacolare mondo di Zaun nei panni di Ekko, un giovane inventore che possiede un dispositivo per manipolare il tempo, in un platform narrativo.

games.title: Cook Serve Forever
games.description: Fatti strada con coltelli, mestoli e padelle in questa nuova e immensa avventura realizzata dai creatori della serie di successo "Cook, Serve, Delicious!".

games.title: Cook, Serve, Delicious! 2!!
games.description: Apparentemente facile da imparare ma incredibilmente difficile da padroneggiare, Cook, Serve, Delicious! 2!! è un viaggio che ti permetterà di diventare uno dei migliori chef al mondo nel tuo piccolo e umile ristorante al 50° piano della Teragon Supertower.

games.title: Cook, Serve, Delicious! 3?!
games.description: Cucina, servi e gestisci il tuo chiosco ambulante mentre prepari centinaia di piatti diversi in un'America devastata dalla guerra in questo incredibile seguito della serie che ha venduto milioni di copie!

games.title: Cooking Simulator
games.description: Un simulatore di cucina realistico con ingredienti basati sulla fisica. Impara oltre 80 ricette nella modalità Carriera o libera la fantasia nella modalità Sandbox tra esperimenti, prove e caos culinario totale in una cucina completamente interattiva.

games.title: Cooking Trip Collectors Edition
games.description: Cooking Trip – walk the path to perfection. Fulfill your dream and become a great chef!

games.canonical_title: Cooking Trip New Challenge. Collector's Edition
games.title: Cooking Trip New Challenge. Collector's Edition
games.description: Cooking trip is an exciting game about dishes and restaurant business!

games.title: CoopValor Ukraine
games.description: TOTAL RE-LAUNCH (V2.0). Visceral Helmet Cam FPS by a Solo Dev. Pilot Gen-3 Tanks, use FPV Drones, and survive FRACTURE mode. Earn ammo via objectives and face lethal Tactical AI. Join the Vanguard and support a unique humanitarian cause.

games.canonical_title: CoopValor WW2 Battle of the Bulge
games.title: CoopValor WW2 Battle of the Bulge
games.description: First and third person shooter set in World War II. Single player and multiplayer. He fights in the Ardennes against the SS and the fearsome Tiger 2

games.title: Copa City
games.description: Organize a high-stakes football event in first football tycoon! Get the urban space and the stadium ready, ensure safety, and provide fans with an amazing football fiesta! Your decisions influence not only the city but also the emotional rollercoaster for football fans!

games.title: Core
games.description: Core is a multiverse of free games to play and worlds to explore designed by a global community of developers. Play thousands of Unreal-powered games from every genre, or create and earn from your own! Download now to get a limited-time free reward bundle.

games.title: Core Keeper
games.description: Explore an endless cavern of creatures, relics and resources in a mining sandbox adventure for 1-8 players. Mine, build, fight, craft and farm to unravel the mystery of the ancient Core.

games.title: Coreborn
games.description:
A fun survival game set in the world of Ultracore. 
Build, grow, and defend your town from attacking enemies. Go on adventures to loot, gather resources, discover a beautiful fantasy map, unlock Skills, build bases, find mounts, and shape the world alone or with friends.

games.title: Cornucopia®
games.description: Cornucopia is an enchanting 2.5D pixel art farm sim RPG. Transform your farm with the innovative NPK soil system, nurture delightful animals, and enjoy captivating gameplay. Befriend vibrant villagers, uncover mysteries, and shape your adventure. Start your magical journey now!

games.title: Coromon
games.description: Coromon è una versione moderna del classico gioco di addomesticamento di mostri. Addomestica i Coromon ed esplora un vasto mondo ricco di battaglie a turni, enigmi cervellotici e una misteriosa minaccia da sconfiggere. Essere un ricercatore combattente non è semplice!

games.title: Corporeal
games.description: Amateur ghost hunters seeking a cheap thrill becomes a nightmare. Investigate haunted places, but beware—the more you uncover, the more hostile the spirits become.

games.title: CORPSE CARNIVAL
games.description: "CORPSE CARNIVAL" is a top-down action-adventure game where you will play as Li Xiaomeng, a first-year student at the "Linge" Military Academy, and escape from this city filled with zombies and monsters with your good friends.

games.title: Corpse Keeper
games.description: Corpse Keeper è un complesso dungeon crawler d'azione e di strategia. Guida una squadra composta da tre cadaveri nell'esplorazione a tempo di un sinistro mondo medievale. Metti su un esercito di morti viventi ed elimina il demone nascosto nelle profondità della cattedrale.

games.title: Corrigendum
games.description: An eerie puzzle game that will test your memory and hand-eye coordination as you are stuck in a mad man's gauntlet to see if you are worthy to be in their "new world."

games.title: Corrupt - Political Simulator
games.description:
Have you ever wanted to be in charge as either the President or the Underworld Boss of your country?
Why not both?

Corrupt - Political Simulator is the answer you’ve been waiting for!

games.title: CORRUPTION 2029
games.description: Ambientato in un'America distopica in un futuro non troppo lontano. CORRUPTION è un gioco che unisce in maniera del tutto inedita strategia e tattica. Sviluppato da The Bearded Ladies, creatori di Mutant Year Zero: Road to Eden.

games.title: Corsair Cove
games.description: Costruisci un porto pirata e una flotta pronta a salpare per affrontare la Corona ed evitare che l'era dei pirati tramonti per sempre! Dalle provviste alle armi, gestisci complesse catene di produzione e mettiti a capo di un equipaggio turbolento per dominare i mari!

games.title: Corsairs - Battle of the Caribbean
games.description:
Preparatevi a solcare il Mar dei Caraibi in cerca di gloria e tesori!
Un gioco di strategia immersivo ambientato nel mondo dei bucanieri. Naviga mari tempestosi e gestisci un equipaggio variegato per stabilire il dominio marittimo e garantire il futuro della tua flotta.

games.title: Cosmic Coop
games.description: Grow, collect, and decorate your dream farm! Meet adorable Critterlings, harvest crops, craft decorations, and design a cozy paradise full of life. A colorful and relaxing creature-collecting farming game full of charm and creativity.

games.title: Cosmic Express
games.description: Cosmic Express è un gioco rompicapo in cui hai il compito di pianificare il percorso ferroviario della colonia spaziale più stravagante di sempre; dagli stessi creatori di A Good Snowman Is Hard To Build e con la partecipazione artistica di Tyu del gruppo Klondike.

games.title: Cosmicrafts
games.description: Cosmicrafts is an epic space strategy game where you command fleets. Engage in tactical battles, discover alien civilizations, and shape your galaxy’s fate. Will you conquer the stars or be lost in the void? The universe is yours to command!

games.title: Costume Quest
games.description: Costume Quest è un'avventura di Halloween realizzata da Double Fine Productions di Tim Schafer. In questo affascinante gioco di ruolo, dovrai scegliere il tuo eroe e fare dolcetto o scherzetto in tre splendidi ambienti caratterizzati dallo stile e dall'umorismo tipici di Doubl...

games.title: Costume Quest 2
games.description: Esplora spettrali paesaggi senza tempo, indossa adorabili nuovi costumi in grado di trasformarti in un potente guerriero di Halloween, raccogli figurine di dolcetti da brivido e usale per combattere contro una legione di cattivi ossessionati dall'igiene.

games.title: Couch Planes
games.description: Couch Planes è un adrenalinico party game in cui vince il pilota più abile. Schiva missili, recupera potenziamenti e sfreccia attraverso mappe costellate di pericoli tra varie modalità che spaziano dal caos locale alle partite online. Facile da imparare, sempre uno spasso. 🛩️✨

games.title: CounterAttack: Uprising
games.description: Description is CounterAttack: Uprising is a side scrolling space shooter (SHMUP). Team up or fight solo, 1 - 4 player local or up to 8 players online coop, unlock upgrades, use powerful ultimate abilities, enhance your ship the way you want, and save the Earth from annihilation.

games.title: Countless Army
games.description: Diventa il cattivo in un Tower Defense inverso: evoca truppe, abbatte difese nemiche e potenziale per conquistare il mondo intero!

games.title: Countrytale 2010
games.description: A realistic farming simulation where you buy land, plant crops, use fertilizers, and sell your harvest to earn profits and expand your farm.

games.title: County Hospital
games.description: County Hospital is a singleplayer offline psychological horror inmersive game with jumpscares and high quality assets. Paranormal activity is happening, gather as much evidence as you can and try to escape from the building without getting caught. Are you brave enough?

games.title: County Hospital Outbreak
games.description: 4-player cooperative horror game featuring flamethrowers, grenades, and nasty unknown organisms. Complete a multi-stage mission to eradicate a biological outbreak: explore 3 maps find keycards, disks, and batteries to launch the emergency protocol and destroy the mother organism

games.title: Couple-Cultivation Saves the World
games.description: This is a live-action interactive game. As the hero, you find out you become the best cultivation power bank in Jiuqiu by chance. Are you willing to Couple-Cultivate with the girls from another world, save the Earth, and maintain peace in Jiuqiu?

games.title: Courier of the Dead
games.description: A slow-burn psychological horror experience. As the courier, you deliver messages of the dead to help them rest, while avoiding the cursed entities that roam. Solve riddles from the letters, and uncover the story behind the cursed village of Evershade.

games.title: Covid Carl
games.description: The story follows the player as they attempt to stop a super soldier from a government project to vaccinate everyone. In typical fashion the government project goes awry and he starts mutating people instead. That's where you come in to shoot or burn almost everything that moves.

games.title: Cozy Grove
games.description: Ti diamo il benvenuto a Cozy Grove, un gioco di simulazione di campeggio che si svolge su un'isola infestata da fantasmi e in continua evoluzione. Sei uno Spettro Scout e dovrai esplorare ogni giorno la foresta dell'isola per cercare nuovi segreti e per aiutare i fantasmi del ...

games.title: Cralon
games.description:
Cralon is an oldschool indie immersive sim dungeon crawler with RPG and adventure elements, inspired by the ultimate dungeon classics.
Hunting a demon, you fell into the abyss of an old mine. Equip yourself, solve quests, uncover secrets and find a way out.

games.title: Cramped Room of Death
games.description: A puzzle adventure with a claustrophobic twist! Use your spear to defeat enemies and collect treasure, but plan your moves carefully—each room has tight turns, deadly traps and no margin for error.

games.title: Crash Drive 3
games.description: Sali a bordo di monster truck, carri armati e altri veicoli incredibili in uno sconfinato mondo aperto in questo gioco cross-platform multigiocatore a esplorazione libera! Sali di livello, partecipa a eventi, guadagna soldi, sblocca nuove auto e scopri segreti....

games.title: Crashlands
games.description: Rivista TIME I 10 giochi migliori del 2016 Crea, combatti e completa le missioni di Crashlands, un ARPG Crafting story-driven ultrasfacciato!

games.title: Crazy Bus
games.description: Single-Player Metropolitan Bus and Attendant Simulator

games.title: Crazy Mosquito Simulator
games.description: Have you ever been driven mad by a mosquito? Trade places with him and make human go crazy. Use your annoying bzzz sound, make pranks on him, destroy his items, make his life a living hell.

games.title: Creaks
games.description: La terra trema, le lampadine vanno in frantumi... E qualcosa di strano sta succedendo dietro alle pareti della tua stanza. Armato solo di acume e coraggio, ti inoltrerai in un mondo abitato da uomini-uccello e mostruosi pezzi di mobilio.

games.title: CREAMARE - The Game
games.description: In CREAMARE: The Game, players take on the role of divers to explore 9 real underwater cultural sites in the Mediterranean Sea. They must defeat a monster from the future by solving ecological challenges and puzzles related to the history of these sites.

games.title: Creatura
games.description: Seed, Breed, Create. From single-cell organisms to complex ecosystems. Evolve every part of your own unique aquarium/terrarium by applying scientifically accurate principles of natural and artificial selection, in Creatura - the ultimate Virtual Evolution Vivarium Simulator.

games.title: Creature in the Well
games.description: Nei panni dell'ultima unità BOT-C dovrai avventurarti nelle profondità di una montagna per riattivare un'antica struttura, dimora di una disperata creatura. Scopri e migliora potente equipaggiamento per liberare la città di Mirage dalla letale tempesta di sabbia che l'affligge.

games.title: Creature Keeper
games.description: Creature Keeper is an action-adventure RPG where you Befriend Creatures and fight alongside them in real time. Explore a mysterious world and uncover the truth behind a strange sickness spreading across the land. Power up your team and embark on your journey of destiny!

games.title: Creatures of Ava
games.description: Let your empathy guide you as you play an exciting action-adventure, creature-saver game. Understand and tame the creatures of Ava and let them lead you through a variety of ecosystems – all in the hopes of saving the planet from a life-consuming infection.

games.title: Creepy Scary
games.description: Play solo or in local co-op, choose your character, and race against time in a haunted cemetery. Find three magical items, hide from monsters, solve puzzles, and use special abilities to survive.

games.title: Cricket: Jae's Really Peculiar Game
games.description: Cricket: Jae's Really Peculiar Game is a hand animated JRPG adventure that draws from genre classics. Join Jae as he goes on a journey with his best friends to try and fix the past in a story full of laughs, tears, and Elemelons.

games.title: Crime 1997
games.description: Newport, 1997: Waterside gang member, Henry Gallagher, is thrust into danger following a failed deal, tangling with the police and the Sorvino Mafia. A riveting drug sweeps the city, igniting hidden conflicts.

games.title: Crime Boss: Rockay City
games.description: Crime Boss: Rockay City is a 1-4 player co-op FPS heist game with enjoyable stealth and epic killing spree combat. Featuring a solo roguelike campaign that combines FPS and strategy elements with the most hilariously cheesy voice acting that make you laugh.

games.title: CrimeBot 2: Unsolved Cold Case
games.description: Become a detective in CrimeBot 2 and travel the world solving criminal cases. You'll have only your logic and intuition to analyze dossiers filled with clues, suspect profiles, and photographs. Can you catch the culprit?

games.title: Crimson Dawn
games.description: Description is not set

games.title: Crimson Desert
games.description: Un gioco action-adventure open world ambientato nella terra di Pywel. Unisciti a Kliff nel suo viaggio per ricostruire i Mantogrigio e salvare il continente da una minaccia imminente. Da vaste terre selvagge fino al misterioso Abisso, esplora queste terre e forgia il tuo cammino.

games.title: Crimson Moon
games.description: Un GDR d'azione e avventura gotico con angeli violenti e divinità defunte.

games.title: Crimson Oath
games.description: Preparati a soffrire! Un'avventura di combattimento nello stile Souls in un mondo unico. Impara a combattere... poi combatte per realizzare la tua fede. Un guerriero cresce gradualmente e scopre la verità ultima del cambiamento del mondo.

games.title: Crimson Spires
games.description: This otome-style visual novel blends eeriness and romance into a compelling drama. A ring of deadly towers traps you in the small mining town of Bataille, Missouri with extreme conspiracy theorists, a serial killer, and wealthy vampires. Choose your partner wisely.

games.title: Crimsonland
games.description: Migliaia di alieni, lucertole mutanti e tanto altro ancora. Riuscirai a fronteggiare l’attacco? Sessanta missioni, decine di armi e accessori da sbloccare, cinque modalità di sopravvivenza in un coinvolgente sparatutto a doppia levetta.

games.title: Cris Tales
games.description: Vivi contemporaneamente il passato, il presente e il futuro in questa splendida lettera d'amore indie ai classici GDR giapponesi

games.title: CRISIS Command
games.description: The peaceful island of Yukrea has been invaded by the evil Dread Corps! It's time to blast your way through 6 stages of mayhem to rescue civilians and push those robots out. Use their own powers against them and help reclaim peace to the island.

games.title: CrisisX
games.description: Enter a brutal, boundless open world. Carve your survival from the ruins of the dead. Outlast the infected, rival survivors, and a merciless wilderness. Fight or ally. Claim your turf. Build your stronghold. Forge a post-apocalyptic world that answers to YOU alone.

games.title: Critadel
games.description: Critadel is a futuristic platform/shooter/roguelike with three playable characters, hundreds of branching paths and over 100,000 unique weapon configurations!

games.title: Critter Cove
games.description: A deep, open world life sim and town building game set in a cozy post-apocalyptic paradise. Restore an old town, sail across a mysterious archipelago. Hunt for relics and farm, fish & craft everything you need.

games.title: Critter Crops
games.description: Sylvie è una giovane strega, esiliata a causa della sua magia. Una lettera misteriosa la porta a Mur Mur Town, un luogo abbandonato dove l'attende una bella vita! Raccogli colture magiche, svela i misteri di Mutter Island e costruisci una casa per la strega e i suoi amici!

games.title: Croakwood
games.description: Croakwood is a creative, relaxed town building simulation game about frogs and nature! Design and create structures, plan and decorate towns, and explore an ancient forest to guide the growth of your community of tiny amphibians as they settle into a new life in the lush woods.

games.title: Cronos: The New Dawn
games.description: Cronos: The New Dawn è un brutale horror di sopravvivenza in terza persona in cui è necessario salvare il passato per lottare per un futuro migliore. Brucia i mostri prima che si uniscano. Estrai le anime dei vivi. Adattati... o soccombi.

games.title: Cross Tails
games.description: Un RPG tattico giocabile da due punti di vista!

games.title: Cross The Ages: BLAST
games.description: Face your opponents in 5-minute strategic duels! Collect over 800 unique cards, master 7 elements and their synergies, and dominate the board in this free-to-play tactical card game. PC and Mobile - Cross-play enabled!

games.title: Crossfire
games.description: Layla e Cross sono agenti agli antipodi, divisi ideologicamente ma uniti in una fragile alleanza contro una minaccia alla quale, da soli, non sopravviverebbero. Libertà tattica e combattimenti realistici si fondono in un'avventura d'azione narrativa e cinematografica.

games.title: Crosshair V2
games.description: Scegli tra una varietà di dimensioni, forme e colori neon per trovare il mirino che ti dà il massimo vantaggio nel tuo gioco preferito.

games.title: Crosshair X
games.description: Sovrapponi mirini personalizzati su ogni gioco che giochi. Scegli tra migliaia di mirini unici creati dalla comunità di Crosshair X o progetta il tuo usando il designer.

games.title: Crowded Mysteries
games.description:
Explore Mystery City! Be a detective, find clues and suspects, and solve crimes in the ultimate crime - solving adventure game! In Crowded Mysteries, you're a detective in Mystery City, investigating crimes and interrogating
suspects.

games.canonical_title: Crown of Ruin: The Parkour Game
games.title: Crown of Ruin: The Parkour Game
games.description: Navigate a misty, abandoned ruin with fluid parkour mechanics; climb walls, cross gaps, and master the environment. Every step demands reflex, every move rhythm. Explore, experiment, fall, and rise again. Here, your skill defines your path.

games.canonical_title: Crown of Ruin: The Parkour Game Part II
games.title: Crown of Ruin: The Parkour Game Part II
games.description: Navigate a misty, abandoned ruin with fluid parkour mechanics; climb walls, cross gaps, and master the environment. Every step demands reflex, every move rhythm. Explore, experiment, fall, and rise again. Here, your skill defines your path.

games.canonical_title: Crown of the Empire 2: Around the World Collectors Edition
games.title: Crown of the Empire 2: Around the World Collectors Edition
games.description: Crown of the Empire: fun adventures await! The queen needs your help!

games.canonical_title: Crown of the Empire 3: Timeloop Collector's Edition
games.title: Crown of the Empire 3: Timeloop Collector's Edition
games.description: Crown of the Empire: fun adventures await! The queen needs your help!

games.canonical_title: Crown of the Empire 4 Collector's Edtition
games.title: Crown of the Empire 4 Collector's Edtition
games.description: Crown of the Empire - Elena hopes for your help!

games.canonical_title: Crown Of The Empire Collectors Edition
games.title: Crown Of The Empire Collectors Edition
games.description: Crown of the Empire: fun adventures await! The queen needs your help!

games.title: Crown Trick
games.description: Entra in un labirinto che seguirà i tuoi spostamenti e padroneggia gli elementi per sconfiggere i nemici e scoprire i misteri di questo mondo sotterraneo. Lasciati guidare dal potere della corona!

games.canonical_title: Crowns and Pawns: Kingdom of Deceit
games.title: Crowns and Pawns: Kingdom of Deceit
games.description: Le leggende del passato tornano in vita in questa affascinante avventura punta e clicca. Prepara le valigie e parti all'avventura con Crowns and Pawns: Kingdom of Deceit attraverso un'Europa dei giorni nostri per scoprire i segreti del re che non fu mai incoronato.

games.title: Cruel Bands Career
games.description: La Glass Heart Band deve superare una serie di sfide in un mondo crudele! Per portare a termine la loro missione segreta, dovranno affrontare svariati spettatori e boss.

games.title: CRUELTY
games.description:
"CRUELTY" is a Japanese-made splatter horror.
You were in an accident and lost consciousness. The moment you wake up, you find yourself in a nightmare world, one that is not of this Earth. In an abattoir ruled by madness, horrific scenes unfold, and inescapable terror awaits you.

games.title: Crying Suns
games.description: Crying Suns è un rogue-lite tattico nel quale vestirai i panni di un comandante di una flotta spaziale all'esplorazione di un impero misteriosamente caduto. In questa ricca esperienza narrativa, ogni partita che porterai a buon fine, ti condurrà a scoprire la verità sull'imper...

games.title: CryoFall
games.description: CryoFall è un gioco di sopravvivenza e di simulazione di una colonia fantascientifica che è ambientato su un pianeta dimenticato in un futuro lontano. Padroneggia la tecnologia, l'agricoltura, il commercio, l'industria, la cibernetica, l'esplorazione e tanto altro!

games.title: Cryptic Tales - Crossroads
games.description: Jon’s dreams were filled with music and a love life he once had. Now they’ve curdled into nightmares, weaving between memories and unknown realms. Set in the '90s, this immersive first-person psychological walking simulator follows Jon as he realizes… something is stalking him.

games.title: Cryptmaster
games.description: SAY ANYTHING in this bizarre dungeon adventure where words control everything. Fill in the blanks with text or voice to uncover lost abilities, solve strange quests, and play unexpected mini-games. Use your words to conquer the crypt and unleash a whole new kind of spell casting.
games.developer: Paul Hart, Lee Williams, Akupara Games

games.title: CryptoGearz
games.description: Crypto Gearz is an SF strategy game where players pilot powerful Mechs to dominate lands and traverse future battlefields.

games.title: Crysis 2 Remastered
games.description: Rivivi la leggendaria campagna per giocatore singolo di Crysis 2, il classico sparatutto in prima persona, ora ottimizzato per l'hardware più recente in Crysis 2 Remastered.

games.title: Crysis 3 Remastered
games.description: Prova l'esperienza in modalità giocatore singolo di Crysis 3, l'iconico sparatutto in prima persona, ora ottimizzato per sfruttare al massimo l'hardware più recente in Crysis 3 Remastered.

games.title: Crysis Remastered
games.description: Il classico sparatutto in prima persona di Crytek è tornato con un gameplay pieno di azione, un mondo sandbox e le epiche battaglie che hai amato fin da subito, adesso con una grafica rimasterizzata e ottimizzata per la nuova generazione di hardware.

games.title: Crysis Remastered Trilogy
games.description: Crysis Remastered Trilogy comprende ciascuna delle campagne per giocatore singolo dei leggendari sparatutto in prima persona Crysis, Crysis 2 e Crysis 3, ottimizzati per l'hardware più recente.   Rivivi le avventure di grande valore grazie a questo conveniente bundle tutto in uno.

games.title: Crystal Ball Critters
games.description: Crystal Ball Critters is a multiplayer ball-racing game, in which you race your friends through our antagonist's carefully thought out multiverse of adventures! Play by yourself or against up to 4 of your friends to find out who can beat each stage first.

games.title: Crystal Crisis
games.description: Un cast stellare di eroi si metterà alla prova in questo gioco di combattimenti online tenero e caotico dove si abbinano i colori! In Crystal Crisis i giocatori attaccano sistemando dei cristalli in caduta e rimuovendoli dallo schermo. È la competizione a enigmi online definit...

games.title: Crystal of Atlan
games.description: Crystal of Atlan is a Magicpunk MMO Action RPG where you can immerse yourself in a Magicpunk world. Build your skills, fight and uncover the secrets of this world with your allies! Time to embark on a wondrous journey of Magic and Machinery!

games.title: Crystale
games.description: Unravel your tale and obtain Crystals, fostering spirits of ancient warriors, ancient art and the secrets of Crystale. The Crystals will be yours to behold as you piece together the Tales of the Realm.

games.title: Crystalfall
games.description: Crystalfall is a free online Action RPG where your ground loot matters and your skills offer endless procedural customization. Survive in a world destroyed by a mysterious asteroid and grow more powerful with steampunk weapons and lootable skills in an infinite endgame.

games.title: Cthulhu: Books of Ancients
games.description: Cthulhu: Books of Ancients è un gioco horror in prima persona in cui vestiamo i panni di un detective alla ricerca di sei bambini scomparsi. Un biglietto misterioso lanciato da un informatore sconosciuto alla porta lo condusse alla biblioteca dell'Università di Miskatonic.

games.title: Cuban Missile Crisis
games.description: Cuban Missile Crisis is a real-time strategy game combined with a global turn-based tactical mode, thrusting gamers into a world ravaged by the military-political confrontation between the USA and USSR in 1962.

games.title: Cuban Missile Crisis: Ice Crusade
games.description: Ice Crusade is a stand-alone expansion for post-apocalyptic real time strategy Cuban Missile Crisis. Ice Crusade continues the original story and adds new campaigns, battlegrounds and units.

games.title: Cubic Oddyssey
games.description: Intraprendi un viaggio galattico in Cubic Odyssey, un'avventura a mondo aperto in cui esplorerai pianeti variopinti, produrrai attrezzi, costruirai veicoli e combatterai la Tenebra rossa. Scopri antichi misteri e crea un universo pieno di vita, pericoli e possibilità infinite!

games.title: Cubin
games.description: Cubin è un puzzle game in prima persona che vi immerge nell'esperienza dell'LGA. Completate tutti i 60 esperimenti per scoprire finalmente la verità su questa simulazione.

games.title: Cubin II
games.description: Cubin II è un gioco platform puzzle in prima persona che ti riporta nell'esperienza LGA. Completa la storia risolvendo questi 50 nuovi esperimenti per fuggire finalmente da questo luogo terribile.

games.title: Cubzh
games.description: Play an infinite number of games, create your own items and worlds, and share them with friends. Hang out, compete, and chat in a virtual space where creativity knows no limits.

games.title: Culpa Innata
games.description: The World Union is labeled the 'perfect society'. Prosperity is a science, disease and wars have vanished, sex is entertainment, and the future has never looked brighter.

games.title: Cult Vacui
games.description: Cult Vacui is a horror point-and-click adventure with survival and time management elements where your choices could keep you alive... or not.

games.title: Cultivation Magic World
games.description: A cultivation treasure-hunting game with AFK mode. Pick from Sword Cultivator, Spiritual Sorcerer, or Beast Tamer. Unlock the Ancient Holy Body. Advance from Body Tempering to Mahayana, up to Immortal Realm. Capture spirit beasts as allies.

games.title: Curious Expedition
games.description: Curious Expedition è un simulatore di spedizioni roguelike ambientato nel 19esimo secolo. Insieme a personalità famose della storie ti addentrerai in spedizioni senza precedenti, in regioni inesplorate per fama, scienza e tesori.

games.title: Curious Expedition 2
games.description: Curious Expedition 2 è un gioco roguelike a turni narrativo ambientato in una versione reinterpretata del tardo XIX secolo che utilizza un sistema di gioco procedurale ed elementi della storia per creare avventure epiche e incredibilmente uniche ogni volta che giochi.

games.title: Curse of the Dead Gods
games.description: In cerca di inimmaginabili ricchezze, vita eterna e poteri divini, giungi presso questo tempio maledetto: un infinito labirinto di trappole mortali, mostri e fosse senza fondo.

games.title: Cursed Castilla (Maldita Castilla EX)
games.description: An arcade action platformer full of creatures from medieval myths from Spain and the rest of Europe, as well as from chivalric romances. This game is an extended and improved version of the renowned classic arcade Maldita Castilla, originally created by the indie Locomalito.

games.title: Cursed Ghost
games.description:
Cursed Ghost is a challenging 2.5D puzzle-platformer where survival depends on timing, awareness, and careful movement.

Once a ghost, now trapped in flesh.

games.title: Cursed to Golf
games.description: Cursed to Golf è un'avventura in stile golf dove ogni tiro è importante. I giocatori devono scappare dal purgatorio del golf (Golf Purgatory) e diventare una leggenda del golf (Golfing Legend).

games.title: Cursed Treasure 2 Ultimate Edition
games.description: Why be good when you can be... bad? Cursed Treasure 2 is a classic tower-defense game, remastered and carefully re-balanced. Build towers of powerful orcs, demons, and undead, and master powerful spells, to protect your precious hoard from all manner of no-good do-gooders.

games.title: Cyanide & Happiness - Freakpocalypse (Episode 1)
games.description: Ambientato nell'universo di Cyanide & Happiness, giochi nei panni di uno strano e impopolare orfano dai capelli rossi. Il tuo obiettivo è salvare il mondo guardando, toccando e parlando con ogni cosa.

games.title: Cyber Avenger
games.description: Cyber Avenger è un gioco d'azione con visuale dall'alto in cui si assume il ruolo di un agente segreto altamente qualificato. Dovrete attraversare cinque mappe, affrontando una varietà di nemici, tra cui tiratori, cecchini, kamikaze e altri ancora.

games.title: Cyber Clutch: Hot Import Nights
games.description: Cyber Clutch: Hot Import Nights è un arcade racer frenetico con combattimenti. Gareggia online, usa abilità tattiche e domina circuiti futuristici pieni di velocità e caos. Personalizza il tuo veicolo e scala la classifica.

games.title: Cyber Drift
games.description: Choose a track and start drifting, 1-3 minutes of drifting experience, repeatedly challenge your own fastest record.

games.title: Cyber Hook
games.description: Speed through a gorgeous retrowave world using parkour skills and a grappling hook to scale and ride walls in this fast-paced, 3D platformer. Blast enemies, manipulate time and abuse physics to avoid falling to your death.

games.title: CyberCorp
games.description: Brand new solo and co-op top-down looter shooter in a cyberpunk world! You are a corporate Agent fighting against street crime in the year 2084. Upgrade weapons, unlock abilities, and take down bosses. But what if you find out what's hiding under a faceless corporation?

games.title: Cyberia
games.description: Take control of outlaw computer hacker Zak as you infiltrate a secret terrorist base to steal the ultimate doomsday device

games.title: Cyberia 2 - Resurrection
games.description: Zak's back, resurrected from a living death to put his cyberhero skills to the ultimate test.

games.title: Cybernetic Fault
games.description: Dimostra la tua capacità di leggere i nomi accanto ai grandi pulsanti rossi! Dimostrate la vostra capacità di combattere per la vita in un centro scientifico che sta cadendo a pezzi a causa delle conseguenze di un folle esperimento scientifico!

games.title: Cyberpunk 2077
games.description: Cyberpunk 2077 è un GDR d'azione a mondo aperto ambientato nell'oscuro futuro di Night City, una pericolosa megalopoli ossessionata dal potere, dalla moda e dalle incessanti modifiche cibernetiche.

games.title: Cyberpunk City
games.description: One of the first functioning metaverses built on Unreal Engine 5, offering immersive & unique gaming experiences as well as socializing & holding events.

games.title: Cyberpunk Hacker
games.description: You are a rogue hacker, armed with advanced cybernetic enhancements and a hacker's toolkit, tasked with infiltrating the fortresses of the world's most powerful corporations.

games.title: Cyberpunk SFX
games.description: Cosa c'è di più spettacolare di una ragazza armata di razzi e senso dell'umorismo? Sì, sta per iniziare a risolvere i problemi del XXI secolo. E se volete assicurarvi che non ne crei di nuovi, dovrete mostrarle la strada.

games.title: CyberTD
games.description: Help protect the core of cyberspace from mutant viruses in this innovative tower defense game packed with roguelite elements! Will you be able to build the ultimate line of defense?

games.title: Cycles
games.description: Cycles is a procedural music composition about appreciating a forest through all parts of its life cycle. Experience billions of unique generations of the piece.

games.title: CYGNI: All Guns Blazing
games.description: Un assalto implacabile di immagini strabilianti, paesaggi sonori esplosivi e azione sconvolgente rendono CYGNI l'avanguardia per la prossima generazione di sparatutto. A corto di munizioni e alleati, tuffati in un cielo infernale e lotta fino alla fine per la sopravvivenza.

games.title: Cynosure
games.description: Fight a rogue AI in a world full of secrets with 6 captivating arenas

games.title: D Drift
games.description: D-DRIFT is a high-speed racing game focused on drift mastery and precise driving. Play intense modes like D-Point Collection and Pursuit Races, where control and strategy decide victory. Push your limits and dominate every corner.

games.title: D-topia
games.description: Risolvi i rompicapi per portare felicità ai residenti di D-topia e far funzionare il distretto in questa rilassante avventura rompicapo.

games.title: Daahrien's Active and Operational
games.description: Un survival horror su un’astronave abbandonata di Intellicialis. Un’IA è fuori controllo. Ti trovi di fronte a una figura oscura, mostri intelligenti e più domande che risposte. Esplora, raccogli, crea, risolvi enigmi, nasconditi, corri… e prega.

games.title: Daedalic Real Time Tactics Bundle
games.description: Quattro giochi tattici in un solo bundle! Tensione, pianificazione ed esecuzione perfetta in quattro diversi giochi: Shadow Tactics: Blades of the Shogun, Shadow Tactics: Aiko's Choice, Partisans 1941 Extended Edition e Iron Danger.
games.developer: Mimimi Games, Action Squad Studios, Alter Games

games.title: DAEMON X MACHINA
games.description: Pilota il tuo mech Arsenal completamente personalizzabile e collabora con altri mercenari per difendere l'umanità da macchine corrotte e robot giganti in questo gioco d'azione post-apocalittico!

games.title: Dahlia View
games.description: Quando Charlotte May, 8 anni, viene denunciata come scomparsa da Dahlia View, il detective in pensione Robert Conway avvia le sue indagini sulla sua scomparsa. Guida le indagini e scopri oscuri segreti in un thriller osservativo basato sulla trama.

games.title: Dakar Desert Rally
games.description: Dakar Desert Rally is the biggest off-road rally racing adventure ever developed. Experience the speed and excitement of the largest rally race on the planet, featuring a wide variety of licensed vehicles from motorcycles, cars, trucks, quads and SSVs.

games.title: Dandara: Trials of Fear Edition
games.description: In uno strano universo in cui gli oppressi sono sull'orlo dell'oblio, Dandara si è risvegliata per cambiare il mondo. Benvenuti in un esclusivo platform 2D in stile metroidvania pieno di creature mistiche e con possibilità di esplorazione illimitate.

games.title: Danger Scavenger
games.description: Danger Scavenger is fast-paced action, cyberpunk-themed, roguelite skyline crawler. Blow up, cut, shoot enemy robots on the roofs of skyscrapers. Choose your way to higher levels, loot, buy stuff, upgrade yourself, fight against greedy corporations, be a rebel!

games.title: Dangerous Driving
games.description: Dai talenti creativi della serie innovativa Burnout, Dangerous Driving riporta l'aggressività nei simulatori di guida, ricatturando lo spirito del passato portandolo a un livello superiore. Dangerous Driving è un gioco di guida reale. Il tipo di guida che vorresti mettere in p...

games.title: Dangerous Waters
games.description: S.C.S. - Dangerous Waters allows you total control over multiple air, surface, and submarine platforms in a modern-day naval environment. Take direct control of individual crew stations and also plan and execute combined arms naval strategies.

games.title: Daniel Hertz C Wave
games.description: Daniel Hertz patented C Wave technology eliminates the human stress response to digital (PCM) audio. A unique 4-band EQ gives more punch and clarity to headphones or speakers for gaming and all media. More natural sound and less fatigue boost your performance.

games.title: Dark Deception
games.description: Dark Deception è uno gioco d'avventura horror in un labirinto spaventoso. Sopravvivi a dedali da incubo mentre corri nel disperato tentativo di cambiare le tue sorti. Fuggi o muori. A te la scelta. Dark Deception si compone di 5 capitoli. L'ultimo non è ancora disponibile e sarà aggiunto successivamente.

games.title: Dark Deception - Monsters & Mortals
games.description: Dark Deception: Monsters & Mortals è un multigiocatore horror che offre svariate modalità in cui i giocatori vestono i panni di mostri o mortali dell'universo di Dark Deception (e di altri universi) e combattono per accaparrarsi frammenti d'anima in labirinti da incubo!

games.title: Dark Deity
games.description: Command legendary heroes to reshape a land fractured by broken oaths, reckless wars, and secret arcane powers. Claim ancient artifacts and powerful weapons to empower your cast of 30 voiced, playable characters as they form bonds and battle their way to become legends.

games.title: Dark Envoy
games.description: Guida una squadra di cacciatori di reliquie in un'epica avventura GDR per computer ambientata in un mondo devastato dalla guerra, tra armi e magia. Sperimenta con il rallentatore tattico e il moderno sistema di combattimento!

games.title: Dark Fairy Tale: Dreamland Survivors
games.description: Un roguelike con visuale dall’alto e tiro automatico giocabile con una sola mano! Vesti i panni di Pinocchio in un incubo, raccogli Uova del Sogno proibite e affronta mostri fiabeschi deformi!

games.title: Dark Fantasy 2: Jigsaw Puzzle
games.description: The next of the most atmospheric jigsaw puzzle game with lots of dark ladies to unify.

games.title: Dark Fantasy Jigsaw Puzzle
games.description: I puzzle non sono mai stati così suggestivi! Dark Fantasy ti porterà in un viaggio attraverso ritratti cupi.

games.title: Dark Farts: Parody Smell Edition
games.description: EMOTIONAL DAMAGE INCOMING! The most ridiculously epic Souls-like parody ever created meets outrageous humor in this absolutely insane action-RPG! You're no chosen one – just a blacksmith with questionable bean-eating habits who accidentally gained ancient dragon powers.

games.title: Dark Future: Blood Red States
games.description: Entra nello straordinario e distopico mondo di Dark Future, ricco di pericoli, caos e azione! Un gioco d'azione e strategia come non ne hai mai visti, con una modalità di comando unica che dilata il tempo per aiutarti a prendere decisioni tattiche sulle autostrade violente.

games.title: Dark Hours
games.description: Dark Hour è un gioco horror di sopravvivenza co-op per 1-4 giocatori. La tua rapina viene messa a repentaglio da un evento sovrannaturale e la tua squadra è ora nelle grinfie di un'entità malvagia. Esplora e collabora per trovare una via d'uscita.
games.publisher: Piece of Cake studios, Kepler Ghost

games.title: Dark Life Excalibur
games.description: Dark Life: Excalibur is a fantasy action adventure that tells the story of Aron, a human linked to the most famous and legendary sword of all time: Excalibur.

games.title: Dark Light
games.description: A Sci-fi 2D action-platformer, metroidvania, souls-like game. Explore the apocalypse cyberpunk world full of supernatural beings, some of them are only visible in the light source of your drones. Kill, gain, upgrade, get stronger in the dark world!

games.title: Dark Lord
games.description: Scatena il tuo potere in Dark Lord, un GdR roguelike ricco di strategia, avventura e sarcasmo. Governa il tuo regno in crescita con pugno di ferro nella modalità Storia, immergiti nelle leggende di altri giocatori o crea le tue storie nel modo Storie della community!

games.title: Dark Matter
games.description: Dark Matter is a retro 2D shoot ‘em up inspired by the 1980’s arcade classic, Asteroids. The action will get frantic as you battle waves of enemy alien ships and deadly asteroids. When ready, take the space carnage to Challenge Mode and rack up your score!

games.title: Dark Mystery
games.description: Dark Mystery è un gioco platform enigmatico in cui il giocatore affronta diversi tipi di difficoltà per trovare il suo vero amore. Questo gioco è basato sul vero amore tra Furry (giocatore) e la sua regina, che si è perso nel mondo oscuro.
games.developer: Yash Future Tech Solutions Pvt Ltd
games.publisher: Yash Future Tech Solutions Pvt Ltd

games.title: Dark Odyssey
games.description: Experience the Magic World

games.title: Dark Rally
games.description: Face extreme terrains and unpredictable challenges in the ultimate off-road experience. Ride bikes, quads, cars, SxS, and trucks across intense rally stages where skill, courage, and precision define the true champion.

games.title: Dark Table CCG
games.description: Enter a dark Lovecraftian world where four supreme beings called Keymasters play a sinister card game over the control of worlds. The 4-player gameplay and fresh unique mechanics ensure there is no real meta, so you can enjoy endless deck combinations.

games.title: Darkblade Ascent
games.description: Darkblade Ascent is a fast paced First-Person Melee Roguelike RPG with randomly generated weapons and upgrades, unlockable new classes and persistent leveling. Hack and slash your way through atmospheric dark fantasy locations, unique monsters and bosses.

games.title: Darke - Haunting Hours
games.description: Johnny Darke couldn’t imagine what awaited him when he arrived at The Requiem Sanatorium. On his first day, as night falls and the haunting hours begin, everything changes. The walls, the furniture, and the entire environment became sinister and haunted.

games.title: Darkest Dungeon II
games.description: L'attesissimo seguito del GDR horror gotico di grande successo di Red Hook!  DDII metterà alla prova il tuo coraggio e ti porterà sull'orlo della follia. Armati al meglio e prepara il tuo gruppo per il viaggio che verrà. Sarà dura.

games.title: Darkest Dungeon®
games.description: Darkest Dungeon® è un coinvolgente RPG roguelike a turni gotico, incentrato sullo stress da avventura. Recluta, allena e guida un gruppo di eroi disturbati attraverso orrori inimmaginabili.

games.title: Darkestville Castle
games.description: Da buon demone, Cid passa le notti progettando cattive azioni ai danni della pacifica gente di Darkestville.  Non immagina neppure che il suo arcinemico è sul punto di cambiare la sua vita per sempre.

games.title: DarkManor
games.description:
Dark Manor is a solo horror game.
You will need to find mystic amulets to unlock a gate and escape from this haunted house.
But be careful, monsters lurk in the shadows.

games.title: Darksiders Genesis
games.description: DARKSIDERS GENESIS offre ai giocatori un primo sguardo sul mondo di DARKSIDERS prima degli eventi del gioco originale. E presenta inoltre l'ultimo Cavaliere, CONFLITTO, insieme alla modalità Co-op, finora inedita per la serie.

games.title: Darksiders II Deathinitive Edition
games.description: L'esperienza definitiva di DARKSIDERS II! Risoluzione nativa di 1080p. Distribuzione del bottino e bilanciamento del gioco rielaborati e ottimizzati. Motore di rendering grafico migliorato per una qualità visiva, dell'illuminazione e delle ombre ancora più elevata. Grafica di ...
games.developer: Gunfire Games, Vigil Games, THQ Nordic

games.title: Darksiders III
games.description: Fai ritorno su un pianeta Terra post apocalittico in Darksiders III, un'avventura hack-n-slash ricca di azione, in cui i giocatori vestiranno i panni di FURIA, intenzionata a dare la caccia e ad annientare i sette peccati capitali.  La più imprevedibile ed enigmatica dei quatt...

games.title: Darksiders Warmastered Edition
games.description: Dopo essere stato spinto con l'inganno dalle forze del male a dare prematuramente vita all'Apocalisse, Guerra, il primo dei Quattro Cavalieri, venne accusato di avere infranto la legge divina incitando una guerra tra Paradiso e Inferno.

games.title: DarkSwitch
games.description: DarkSwitch is a vertical city builder with a survival focus. You’ll build a city in and around a great tree and defend it against the Fog. Face the challenges of limited real estate, scarce resources, and tough moral choices as you seek to uncover the mystery of the Veil.

games.title: Darkwood
games.description: Darkwood: una nuova visione del survival horror. Esplora e sfrutta un mondo aperto, ricco e in continua evoluzione di giorno, poi rintanati nel tuo nascondiglio e prega che arrivi l'alba.

games.canonical_title: Darkwood Tales - Beast in the Shadows
games.title: Darkwood Tales - Beast in the Shadows
games.description: Find out the truth about the mysterious legend and the monster in this exciting hidden object adventure! Solve tricky puzzles and play many relaxing mini-games!

games.title: DARQ: Complete Edition
games.description: DARQ tells the story of Lloyd, a boy who finds himself in the middle of a lucid nightmare. Unable to wake up, Lloyd has to face his fears and decipher the meaning of the dream.

games.title: Darwin's Paradox!
games.description: Tuffati in un'avventura indimenticabile con Darwin il polpo!

games.title: DATA2073
games.description: Step into DATA2073, a thrilling NFT-powered universe teeming with high-tech combat robots known as DATA Automatons. Take on the mantle of 'The Architects' and engage in epic battles for control over crucial energy sources, shaping the destiny of post-apocalyptic realms.

games.title: Dataflux Overdrive
games.description: Dataflux Overdrive is a neon‑fueled endless runner pushing reflexes, speed, and endurance. Blaze through escalating modes from Noob to Unplayable, snag chips to unlock outfits and customization, and chase achievements as relentless momentum drives you to see how far you can go.

games.title: DATE TEACHER
games.description: "Play as Arthur in a dating sim where honesty is optional, but consequences are real. Partners detect lies and confront you instantly. Lose trust, and the date ends with a harsh evaluation. 15 partners. Infinite tension. Watch your words."

games.title: Dating Killmulator
games.description: Dating Killmulator is an award-winning romantic comedy game that joins romance with murder, memes and divorce papers.

games.title: DAVE THE DIVER
games.description: DAVE THE DIVER è un gioco di ruolo e avventura casual per giocatore singolo che permette di esplorare gli abissi marini di giorno e gestire un sushi bar di notte. Unisciti a Dave e ai suoi stravaganti amici nel tentativo di svelare i segreti del misterioso Profondo blu.

games.title: Dawn Apart
games.description: Dawn Apart è un simulatore di colonia e fabbrica spaziale con ambienti completamente distruttibili. Estrai risorse, mantieni un insediamento in crescita di cacciatori di fortuna e difendilo dalla feroce popolazione nativa.

games.title: Dawn of Anarchy
