games.description: In Dawn of Anarchy, le vostre abilità e la vostra bravura nel combattimento saranno messe a dura prova. Sarete l'eroe di cui il mondo ha bisogno per sedare la rivolta e porre fine alla tirannia meccanica? Preparatevi alla battaglia della vostra vita nell'alba dell'anarchia.

games.title: Dawn of Defiance
games.description: In this Greek myth-inspired survival craft, ascend from weak soldier to god-like anti-hero. Recruit friends or embark alone as you survive the ruined isles and build impressive Greek structures. Gather resources, arm yourself, and face down the trials of Gods on the Crossroads.

games.title: Day of the Shell
games.description: Day of the Shell is a “one-click, one-turn” tactical rogue-lite. In a shattered and flooded world, travel from island to island with only hope and a revolver, challenging and appeasing the gods.

games.title: Day Trade Coach
games.description: Day Trade Coach is a day trading simulator built for focus. Cut through the noise, master the set-ups that actually work, and build your edge, one trade at a time.

games.title: Daydream. Forgotten Sorrow
games.description: Il piccolo Griffin è intrappolato in un mondo sconosciuto e ostile dove può contare solo sul suo amico Birly, l'orsacchiotto di peluche. Risolvendo enigmi e scappando da mostri terrificanti intraprendono un viaggio per scoprire cos'altro c'è in questo mondo, oltre agli incubi.

games.canonical_title: Daylife in Japan - Pixel Art Jigsaw Puzzle
games.title: Daylife in Japan - Pixel Art Jigsaw Puzzle
games.description: Daylife in Japan is a minimalist jigsaw puzzle game with pixelart GIFs instead of images.

games.title: Days Gone
games.description: Combatti ed esplora i letali Stati Uniti d'America post-pandemici. In questo gioco open world di azione/avventura ti calerai nel ruolo di Deacon St. John, un motociclista randagio che corre sulle strade della morte, lottando giorno per giorno alla ricerca di un motivo per cui ...

games.title: Days of Defiance
games.description: La nazione un tempo pacifica di Escalia è oppressa da due leader tirannici che governano infondendo paura. In qualità di stratega con abilità tattiche leggendarie recluterai combattenti e libererai il territorio settore per settore, città per città, in battaglie tattiche a turni.

games.title: Days of Doom
games.description: Gather your heroes and fight to make it to Sanctuary in this tactical RPG roguelite. Did we mention the zombies, raiders, and mysterious monstrosities that inhabit this post-apocalyptic wasteland? Welcome to the world of Days of Doom.

games.title: DBall
games.description:
The Dual Ball Challenge: A Clash of Coordination. May the dance of your fingertips guide you forward on this uncharted path.
This is a game genre that has never been seen before, and it will take you on a singularly unique journey unlike anything you've ever experienced!

games.title: DDoD
games.description:
DDoD è uno sparatutto tattico roguelite per giocatore singolo e co-op, ambientato in un futuro prossimo, nel cuore di una zona industriale abbandonata.
 Esplora, combatti e muta per raggiungere la fonte di un’anomalia biologica di IA semi-senziente.

games.title: De-Exit - Eternal Matters
games.description: Intraprendete un viaggio surreale nell'aldilà per scoprire i segreti del rotto e misterioso Piano della Memoria in questa avventura cinematografica con un pizzico di furtività. Immergetevi in un meraviglioso mondo voxel dall'atmosfera intensa e salvate la situazione!

games.title: Dead Age
games.description: Sopravvivi all'apocalisse zombie in un gioco alla "Final Fantasy" con combattimenti a turni e morte permanente! Gestisci i sopravvissuti, crea materiali e prendi decisioni difficili. Difendi il tuo accampamento contro i non morti in questo rogue-lite non lineare (simile a FTL).

games.title: Dead Age 2
games.description: Dead Age 2 è una combinazione unica di gioco di ruolo classico, sopravvivenza, gestione, eventi rogue-like e combattimenti a turni con tantissime missioni e una storia la cui progressione è influenzata direttamente dalle tue decisioni!

games.title: Dead as Disco
games.description: Martial arts meets music video in Dead as Disco, a neon-drenched Beat ‘Em Up where every punch, kick, and combo syncs to the music. Join Charlie Disco on a quest to confront the villainous Idols and reunite the band.

games.title: Dead Beyond
games.description: Trapped in a twisted house built by a vengeful madman, you must survive roaming zombies, deadly traps, and mind-bending puzzles. No map. No mercy. Every step could be your last—escape the nightmare or become part of it forever.

games.title: Dead by Daylight
games.description: 10 anni di orrore. 10 anni di spaventi improvvisi e pericoli scampati. 10 anni di sacrifici brutali e fughe al cardiopalmo.

games.title: Dead By Murder
games.description: “Dead By Murder”, is a murder mystery strategy game, where the user plays as a police detective and must solve a series of homicide cases.

games.title: Dead Cells
games.description: Dead Cells è un roguelite d'azione a piattaforme ispirato al genere metroidvania. Esplora un vasto castello che muta continuamente… ma prima dovrai sconfiggerne i guardiani in combattimenti 2D ispirati a giochi come Dark Souls. Nessun checkpoint. Uccidi, muori, impara e ripeti.

games.title: Dead End: Escape Your Fears
games.description: Intrigue and fear creep behind every corner of this puzzle horror game. In these dark woods, missing persons are no coincidence. The Miller family keeps you trapped with their twisted games, and time is ticking... can you escape before you become just another local tragedy?

games.title: Dead Island 2
games.description: Dead Island 2

games.title: Dead No-Head
games.description: Dead No-Head is a third person action adventure story rich game in which Norix is brought back from the dead, with... No head! This headless hero will have quite the unexpected journey ahead of him.

games.canonical_title: Dead Pets: A Punk Rock Slice of Life Sim
games.title: Dead Pets: A Punk Rock Slice of Life Sim
games.description: Gordy and her punk band, Dead Pets haven't hit it big but they definitely will! Go to band practice, crush a diner shift, chat with friends and manage Gordy’s messy life. Unleash your inner demon in a feminist, slice-of-life, management-lite, minigame-heavy narrative rhythm game!

games.title: Dead Rails
games.description: Dead Rails is a first person precision shooter set on a train in Purgatory. Step into the boots of Billy Bones, a legendary Undead Cowboy, blast your way through skeletal miscreants, make your way to the front of the train, and change your final destination from Hell to Heaven!

games.title: Dead Reset
games.description: Trapped in a terrifying death-loop, surgeon Cole Mason is kidnapped and brought to an underwater facility, forced to operate on a patient to extract an evolving parasitic horror. Dead Reset is a blood-soaked interactive horror, where each death brings you closer to the truth.

games.title: Dead Rush
games.description: DEAD RUSH - Si tratta di uno sparatutto dinamico in prima persona in cui dovrete affrontare orde di zombie affamati!

games.title: Dead Rush 2
games.description: DEAD RUSH 2 – Questo è uno sparatutto in prima persona in arena in cui devi affrontare orde di zombi affamati!

games.title: Dead Season
games.description: Guide a group of unprepared strangers in their struggle to survive a zombie apocalypse, in Dead Season, a turn-based tactics game. Strategize to endure against relentless undead hordes, but beware, noise attracts more danger. Can you escape the outbreak's grip?

games.title: Dead Space
games.description: Il classico fantascientifico e survival horror torna, completamente ricostruito in Frostbite™, per offrire un'esperienza ancora più coinvolgente, con miglioramenti a video, audio e gameplay.

games.title: Dead Space™ (2008)
games.description: Sei Isaac Clarke, un ingegnere della nave USG Ishimura. Non sei un guerriero. Non sei un soldato. Tuttavia, sei l'ultima speranza dei membri dell'equipaggio ancora in vita.

games.title: Dead Space™ 2
games.description: L'ingegnere Isaac Clarke torna per un'altra avventura agghiacciante nel seguito dell'acclamato Dead Space™.

games.title: Dead Space™ 3
games.description: Viaggia attraverso lo spazio fino al pianeta ghiacciato di Tau Volantis con Isaac Clarke e il Serg. John Carver per scoprire e distruggere la fonte dell'invasione di necromorfi.

games.title: Dead Take
games.description: Find your missing friend. Uncover the secrets within. Brave a luxurious and haunting mansion in Dead Take, a first-person psychological horror crafted by Surgent Studios.

games.title: Dead World: Survival
games.description: Dead World: Survival - Si tratta di uno sparatutto open world in cui bisogna sopravvivere il più a lungo possibile e liberare una città abbandonata dai mutanti.

games.title: Deadhaus Sonata
games.description: Deadhaus Sonata is a third-person narrative-driven action RPG where you play as the undead battling the living, growing in power, and exploring an ocean of content. Step into Malorum, a dark and crumbling world where the lines between life and death no longer hold.

games.title: Deadlink
games.description: Get ready to put a sizable dent in the profits of megacorporations in Deadlink, a guns-blazing cyberpunk FPS with roguelite elements. Your mission is to conduct covert ops while piloting a humanoid combat shell. And no, "covert" doesn’t mean "quiet."

games.title: Deadly Broadcast
games.description: Deadly Broadcast is a co-op horror and survival game that can be played with 1-4 players. As a Famous Streamer, you have to stay alive, but at the same time you should stream the paranormal events in the cursed places to gather more donations and more viewers.

games.title: Deadly Match
games.description: Deadly Match is a single‑player third‑person murder mystery. Investigate the deaths of two young women in a small, seemingly peaceful town.

games.title: Deadtime Defenders
games.description: Complete bounties, acquire legendary loot, upgrade your gear, and level up as you fight back against invading monsters in this side-scrolling looter shooter RPG.

games.title: Deadwater Saloon
games.description: Dive into the wild west as a saloon owner in a volatile frontier town. Customize your character and face the consequences of your choices as you forge friendships and enemies of townsfolk, travellers, outlaws and lawmen.

games.title: Deadzone: Rogue
games.description: Deadzone: Rogue is a fast-paced roguelite FPS set in deep space. Blast through hordes of enemies with devastating weapons. Define your combat style with powerful augments and upgrades. Grow stronger with each death, solo or in co-op. Fight. Die. Revive. Repeat.

games.canonical_title: Deal With The Devil Chapter:2 - From Tuonela to Hell
games.title: Deal With The Devil Chapter:2 - From Tuonela to Hell
games.description: "Point-and-click adventure featuring eerie scenes"

games.canonical_title: Deal With The Devil Chapter:2 From Tuonela to Hell Demo
games.title: Deal With The Devil Chapter:2 From Tuonela to Hell Demo
games.description: "Point-and-click adventure featuring eerie scenes"

games.canonical_title: Deal With The Devil: Chapter 1 – Journey to Tuonela
games.title: Deal With The Devil: Chapter 1 – Journey to Tuonela
games.description: "Point-and-click adventure featuring eerie scenes"

games.title: Dealer's Life 2
games.description: Tycoon di Banco dei Pegni

games.title: Dealer's Life Legend
games.description: Mercante Fantasy Medievale

games.title: Death Blonde
games.description: Death Blonde is a team-based online car arena shooter where style meets destruction. Customise your ride, join online battles, and leave your enemies in the dust. Drive fast, shoot hard, and wear fashion - because even death deserves style.

games.title: Death Coming
games.description: Death Coming è un videogioco rompicapo non lineare dove dovrai mietere vittime in stile Final Destination. Comunque, gli umani fastidiosi non sono il tuo unico problema, gli Agenti della Luce faranno del loro meglio per fermarti.

games.title: Death in the Water 2
games.description: Schiva e fatti strada tra sciami di terrificanti creature marine controllate dalla Morte, un gigantesco kraken che manipola la mente. Saccheggia tesori nascosti per sbloccare armi e potenziamenti. Ogni immersione svela un nuovo incubo mentre lotti per sopravvivere.

games.title: Death Noodle Delivery
games.description: Benvenuti alla Death Noodle Delivery Inc. Jimmy: il tuo lavoro è una passeggiata, amico... Consegna i miei noodles, non sprecarne nemmeno una porzione e soprattutto... cerca di non morire.

games.title: Death of the Reprobate
games.description: Explore a world built from the luscious landscapes, turbulent townscapes and preposterous portraits of real Renaissance paintings. Death of the Reprobate is a Rabelaisian adventure game from the creator of Four Last Things and The Procession to Calvary.

games.title: Death Repeat
games.description: A first-person survival game that combines inventory management and puzzle-solving. Player embarks on a desperate journey to find his loved one in a world overrun by zombies.

games.title: DEATH STRANDING 2: ON THE BEACH
games.description:
Sam e i suoi compagni partono per un nuovo viaggio per salvare l'umanità dall'estinzione.

Unisciti a loro mentre attraversano un mondo assediato da nemici ultraterreni, ostacoli e un’assillante domanda: avremmo dovuto connetterci?

games.title: DEATH STRANDING DIRECTOR'S CUT
games.description: From legendary game creator Hideo Kojima comes a genre-defying experience, now expanded in this definitive DIRECTOR’S CUT. As Sam Bridges, your mission is to deliver hope to humanity by connecting the last survivors of a decimated America.

games.title: Death to Spies
games.description: Smersh is Russian for "Death to Spies" and was the name of a set of counterintelligence agencies formed in the Soviet Army during World War II. Their mission was to secure the rear of the active Red Army by arresting traitors, deserters, spies and criminal cells.

games.canonical_title: Death to Spies: Moment of Truth
games.title: Death to Spies: Moment of Truth
games.description: This is a third-person stealth-action game describing the activities of the SMERSH, the most mysterious secret service agency of World War II. Moment of Truth is a sequel to the popular stealth action title Death to Spies.

games.title: Death Trash
games.description: Death Trash presenta un mondo post-apocalittico in cui degli esseri cosmici spaventosi sono alla ricerca dell'umanità, ma incontrano solo delinquenti armati di fucili. Unisce il gioco di ruolo vecchia scuola, al gameplay d'azione moderno e alla libertà del giocatore. Crea il t...

games.title: Death's Door
games.description: Mietere le anime dei defunti, giorno dopo giorno, potrebbe sembrare monotono, ma per un Corvo è un lavoro decente. Le cose iniziano però a movimentarsi quando l'anima che dovresti raccogliere viene rubata, e tu sei costretto a inseguire il disperato ladro in un regno in cui la...

games.title: Death's Gambit - Afterlife
games.description: Death's Gambit: Afterlife is a challenging 2D action platformer with deep RPG elements. As an agent of Death bound to his service, unravel the mystery of Siradon and discover the true price of immortality.

games.title: Deathbound
games.description: Deathbound is a one-of-a-kind party-based soulslike set in a world where Faith and Science clash. Transform between fallen warriors all with their own unique skill sets, combat styles and rich history. Conquer a reality where Life and Death were never more conflicted.

games.title: Deathless. The Hero Quest
games.description: In Deathless, elements of a collectible card game, roguelike, and turn-based strategy combine seamlessly. Build a unique deck of cards, discover unusual relics, and defeat legendary bosses.

games.title: DEATHLOOP
games.description: DEATHLOOP è uno sparatutto in soggettiva next-gen di Arkane Lyon, il pluripremiato studio che ha creato Dishonored. In DEATHLOOP, due assassini rivali sono intrappolati in un misterioso loop temporale sull'isola di Blackreef, condannati a vivere lo stesso giorno in eterno.

games.title: DEATHLOOP + Ghostwire: Tokyo Bundle
games.description: DEATHLOOP + Ghostwire: Tokyo Bundle

games.title: Deathpunk
games.description: Deathpunk is a soul-like action game that has RPG elements inside it. It’s a story-driven linear game. In a steampunk world, our main character Elise decides to go against her superiors orders and chases down a cold case about a deadly and mysterious island named Emberforge.

games.title: DEATHRUN TV
games.description: DEATHRUN TV is a fast hardcore rogue-lite twin-stick shooter set in the world's biggest and craziest game show. You'll experience real-time blistering speed and bullet-dodging action as you compete for glory...assuming you're able to survive the deadly challenges that await you.

games.title: Debtors' Club
games.description: Be the tax collector of a shady city hall in this narrative-driven resource management game. Talk to debtors, manage a team, make difficult choices, and challenge the city's moral decay. It's their money, but it's your job.

games.title: Decadent
games.description: Decadent is a story-driven FPS combining atmospheric exploration, horror and combat. Become John Lorn, a Great War veteran turned decadent occultist on a quest to save your lost son and uncover an ancient secret; challenging not only your skills, but your very humanity.

games.title: Deceive Inc.
games.description: Go undercover as the world’s greatest spies in this multiplayer game of subterfuge. Disguise as anyone, deploy high-tech gadgets or neutralize the competition. As long as you extract with the objective, no trick is too dirty when you work for DECEIVE INC.

games.title: Decentraland
games.description: Decentraland is where you hang out online. Drop in for weekly live events, social spaces, and a community that keeps showing up.

games.title: Decimated
games.description: Decimated is a third-person online survival game set in a post-apocalyptic sci-fi world where players scavenge, fight, and team up in a hostile open world. Featuring PvP, PvE, missions, and vehicle combat, it’s a dynamic sandbox of danger, strategy, and exploration.

games.title: Deck of Souls
games.description: Roguelite deck-building meets souls-like. Break out of an infinite loop to close the hell gates, turn enemies into cards, and build your own omnipotent Deck of Souls! Rolls included.

games.canonical_title: DEEEER Simulator: Il Tuo Tipico Simulatore di Cervo
games.title: DEEEER Simulator: Il Tuo Tipico Simulatore di Cervo
games.description: DEEEER Simulator è un gioco dove interpreti un normalissimo, tipico cervo. Usa il tuo collo allungabile, le tue corna acuminate e tutte le armi a disposizione di un cervo per fare a pezzi la città.

games.title: Deep Sky Derelicts
games.description: Deep Sky Derelicts è una combinazione di strategia a turni e GDR, arricchiti da un sistema di combattimento tattico con carte ed elementi roguelike. Esplora i relitti delle navi aliene per saccheggiare e potenziare le tue attrezzature in uno splendido stile rétro futuristico d...

games.title: Deepest Chamber
games.description: **Deepest Chamber** è un gioco di carte per la costruzione di mazzi per giocatori singoli con elementi roguelike, che è ambientato in un mondo dark fantasy, in cui il pericolo caratterizza ogni passo. Tieni le carte strette mentre incontri orde di nemici incattiviti che non si fermeranno davanti a nulla pur di trasformare il tuo rifugio sotterraneo in un luogo di sepoltura.

games.title: Deepest Trench
games.description: Deepest Trench," created by Favor Games, is a thrilling local co-op adventure set in the Mariana Trench. Players team up on a secret military mission, navigating dangerous underwater terrain, uncovering mysteries, and relying on teamwork and quick thinking to survive the depths.

games.title: Deer & Boy
games.description: In questo poetico platformer cinematografico, un ragazzo scappato di casa incontra un cerbiatto, e man mano che il loro legame si rafforza, crescono anche le loro abilità e il peso emotivo del viaggio, in cui il silenzio vale più di mille parole.

games.title: DEFECT
games.description: DEFECT is a cyberpunk, squad-based, Immersive Shooter set in a dystopian world, where AI controls the city with fearsome police forces. They battle rogue gang factions in intense 4x4x4x4, multi-objective, multi-finale face-offs featuring futuristic weapons & tech.

games.title: Defend The King
games.description: Mixture of ‘tower defense’ and ‘hack and slash’ genre that takes place in a European Middle Ages world. Take the role of castle defender, lead soldiers and defend the king from rebellious subjects, the enemies of king order.

games.title: Defend the Rook
games.description: Defend the Rook è un roguelike tattico con combattimenti su scacchiera che combina elementi di difesa della torre. Sconfiggi le orde di invasori per sopravvivere e salvare la tua terra!

games.title: Defense Grid: The Awakening
games.description: Defense Grid: The Awakening è il gioco tower defense definitivo in grado di attrarre giocatori con diversi livelli di abilità. Un'orda di nemici ti sta invadendo e toccherà a te, in qualità di giocatore, tentare di fermarla costruendo torri di fortificazione in modo strategico...

games.title: Defense of Fort Burton
games.description: Defend your loved ones with strategy and tactics as you face waves of enemies in action-packed combat. Command three heroes to fight alongside the brave defenders of Fort Burton, and harness magic to experience the ultimate strategic defense in this epic confrontation.

games.title: Definitely Not Fried Chicken
games.description: Definitely Not Fried Chicken is a business management sim with a Twist! Grow your drugs trade through legitimate fronts, managing both sides of the business. Acquire new "businesses", meet new clientele, Develop more potent narcotics, make lots of money and leave a city in ruin!

games.title: Deflector
games.description: Deflector is a top down action rogue-lite set in a deadly microcosm. Dive deep into hostile worlds teeming with viruses. Strike down increasingly challenging enemies with their own deflected projectiles. Live, die, grow stronger and become powerful enough to reach the Source!

games.title: Defunct
games.description: Defunct è un gioco di avventura sviluppato indipendentemente, che si concentra sulla continuità, la velocità e un mondo coinvolgente. Nel gioco sei un robot guasto, che per sbaglio cade da una nave da carico gigante su un pianeta Terra post-umano, abitato da robot.

games.title: Degenheim
games.description: Dive into a world gone limitlessly mad and slash your way out through hordes of enemies in an action-packed isometric rogue-lite title, where every run offers a unique experience and challenge.

games.title: Degrees of Freedom: Delta
games.description: Degrees of Freedom: Δ is a climate strategy sandbox where you learn how greenhouse gases and radiative forcing shape future warming and its impacts. Run scenarios from today to 2075 and see how today’s choices reshape Earth’s climate, societies, and future.

games.title: Delicious Dungeon
games.description: Delicious Dungeon is a combination of action-adventure and simulation game. The player is the owner of a restaurant in a fantasy world. But to run the restaurant they have to explore dungeons full of dangers to get the ingredients needed to cook delicious meals for their guests.

games.title: Deliver At All Costs
games.description: Deliver At All Costs fonde distruzione, controsensi e intrighi! Segui Winston Green, un corriere squattrinato dal temperamento impetuoso e dal passato sconosciuto, mentre consegna merce decisamente anticonvenzionale lasciando dietro di sé una scia di devastazione.

games.title: Deliver Us Mars
games.description: Deliver Us Mars is an atmospheric sci-fi adventure taking you on a suspense-fuelled, high-stakes mission to recover the ARK colony ships stolen by the mysterious Outward.

games.title: Deliver Us The Moon
games.description: Deliver Us The Moon is a Sci-Fi thriller set in an apocalyptic near future, where Earth's natural resources are depleted. A lone astronaut is sent to the moon on a critical mission to save humanity from extinction.

games.title: Delivery from the Pain
games.description: You'll play as a survivor in a world overrun by zombies. Explore and interact with other survivors, making tough choices about whether to help or exploit them. Defend against zombies, collect resources, craft, and fortify your shelter.

games.title: Delta Force
games.description: Delta Force is back! The iconic series returns as the definitive free-to-play tactical shooter and featuring three distinct gameplay modes: large-scale PvP warfare, intense extraction shooter action, and a remake of the legendary Black Hawk Down campaign.

games.title: Delysium
games.description: Delysium is an open-world MMORPG that is set in a dark and dystopian future where players can augment themselves with cyber bodies to go beyond human limits and wield advanced weaponry, with highly intelligent AI MetaBeings as their companions.

games.title: Demeo
games.description: Adventurers, it’s time to unite! Gather your friends and battle the dark forces that have overtaken the world of Resolution Games' award-winning RPG dungeon crawler, Demeo. The next generation of tabletop adventure has arrived!

games.title: Demi and the Fractured Dream
games.description: Un'eroe del Vuoto, una storia senza tempo

games.title: Demise of Nations
games.description: Demise of Nations is a 4X turn-based grand strategy wargame. Wage colossal wars solo, against the AI, or take on your gaming friends in cross-platform multiplayer games. Form alliances and fight co-op style with the AI and other players for ultimate victory.

games.title: Democracy 4
games.description: Democracy 4 ti permette di assumere il ruolo di Presidente/Primo Ministro, governare il paese (scegliendone politiche, leggi e altre azioni) e trasformarlo come più ti piace, cercando però di mantenere abbastanza popolarità per essere rieletto...

games.title: Demon Turf
games.description: Il platform 3D con grinta! Unisciti a Beebz nel suo ambizioso obiettivo di conquistare i Territori dei Demoni e diventare lei stessa la Regina dei Demoni! Salta, gira e fatti strada attraverso i territori con meccaniche uniche, slanciandoti in combattimenti impetuosi e posizio...

games.title: Demon Turf Neon Splash
games.description: Demon Turf is back and better than ever! Join Beebz in this neon-lit adventure where speedy platforming reigns supreme!

games.title: DEMON'S TILT
games.description: IL TURBO-FLIPPER È TORNATO! Ora con sprite più grandi, più cattivi, ancora più segreti e PIÙ PROIETTILI! Demon's Tilt oltrepassa i limiti del genere videoflipper introducendo elementi sparatutto e hack and slash.

games.title: Demonheart
games.description: Discover the secrets of the witches and demons in this dark fantasy otome game, featuring a female protagonist whose personality is completely up to the player thanks to extensive dialog choices.

games.title: Demonlore
games.description: Demonlore è un gioco di strategia rogue-lite action con collezione di carte. Combatti legioni di non morti e forgia il tuo percorso con potenti evoluzioni permanenti. Modalità di difficoltà, mutatori, elite di nemici e ricompense sbloccabili - ti aspetta una giocabilità infinita!

games.title: Den-Den: Tokyo Horror
games.description: Den-Den: Tokyo Horror è un RPG horror giapponese in cui gli eventi si svolgono in tempo reale. Sopravvivi otto ore in una città dove ogni scelta che fai influisce sul mondo circostante. Quante morti avrai sulla coscienza stanotte?

games.title: Denbora
games.description: Break the laws of entropy in Denbora and jump through time to solve complex temporal puzzles. Can you defeat Dirua and the challenges it will put you through?

games.title: Deponia Doomsday
games.description: Riuscirai a cambiare il destino di Deponia? Sarai in grado di cambiare il passato, il presente e il futuro di Rufus senza distruggere accidentalmente l'intero pianeta? Combatti contro il tempo in questa storia incredibilmente divertente, ricca di azione e di ornitorinchi.

games.title: Deponia: Full Scrap Collection
games.description:
Urrà! Tutti e 4 i giochi di Deponia assieme!

Deponia, il mondo di Rufus, è un pianeta-discarica. Quando il protagonista incontra Goal, una bellissima giovane di Elysium, il sogno di Rufus di andarsene da Deponia sembra essere a portata di mano.

games.title: Deponia: The Complete Journey
games.description: Immondizia, immondizia e ancora immondizia. Il pianeta-discarica di Deponia è tutto l'opposto di una piacevole passeggiata nella natura. Non sorprende quindi che Rufus ne abbia abbastanza e stia cercando di mettere a punto un piano dopo l'altro per fuggire da questo luogo disg...

games.title: DEPRISION
games.description: Awakening from sleep paralysis in an abandoned place, unsure if still trapped. After a storm, lost in a snowy forest with amnesia. Unravel town secrets, fear your only guide.

games.title: Depth Dwellers 1994
games.description: Immerse yourself in a sci-fi FPS, battling alien forces in underground warfare. Armed with advanced weapons and Zendle energy powers, navigate treacherous terrains, engage in intense combat, uncover secrets, and fight for survival as the world edges closer to collapse.

games.title: Depthris™
games.description: Depthris is a 3D puzzle game inspired by the classic BlockOut game for DOS. Move and rotate the pieces almost anywhere (except backwards) and aim for the highest score.

games.title: Derelicts
games.description: Years after an ancient and enigmatic mechanism flooded Earth with radiation, you and your team are tasked with investigating the source of the incident. Build, craft and explore alone or with friends in this hostile, mysterious wasteland, using the power of electricity and water.

games.title: Descent
games.description: Prepare To Start Your Descent.

games.title: Descent II
games.description: You're going down...again.

games.title: Desecrated Deck
games.description: Desecrated Deck is a dark and occult-inspired card game set in the basement of a cursed house where every move is the difference between life and death. With the help of powerful Item and Perk cards, you forge spiritual pacts to put a stop to malicious souls...

games.title: Desert Child
games.description: You are a hungry, young hoverbike racer who needs to get off Earth before it E-X-P-L-O-D-E-S. Hunt bounties, throw races, and do whatever you can to get to Mars and win the Grand Prix.

games.title: Desert Law
games.description: Desert Law is a new spin on the traditional real-time strategy that immerses players into a post-apocalyptic world where gasoline is the new world currency.

games.title: DESERTED
games.description: Deserted è un'avventura d'azione stilizzata in 3D con leggeri elementi RPG e narrativi. Ispirato all'atmosfera aliena di Out Of This World, Deserted combina sopravvivenza e combattimenti strategici veloci per offrire un'avventura emozionante.

games.title: DesertedLove
games.description: The story begins with a cruise shipwreck, leaving you, the sole male survivor, on a mysterious beautiful island with 7 girls. Who becomes your true love is entirely up to you.

games.title: Desktop Girlfriend NEO
games.description: Personalizzate a fondo l'aspetto del vostro personaggio con promemoria, minigiochi, mod e interazione integrati!

games.title: DESOLATIUM
games.description: DESOLATIUM is a new graphic adventure based on Lovecraft mythos. Investigate the mysterious disappearance of a friend through the eyes of 4 different characters and discover a dark path filled with Lovecraftian myths and creatures.

games.title: Desperados III
games.description: Desperados III è un gioco stealth tattico con una trama articolata, ambientato in uno spietato e selvaggio West. Per avere successo, devi ingegnarti. Un buon piano può fare la differenza tra sopravvivere e ritrovarsi dalla parte sbagliata di una pistola.

games.title: Despot's Game
games.description: Roguelike, auto-battler, progressione profonda, violenza gratuita, pretzel!

games.title: Destiny 2
games.description: Destiny 2 è un MMO d'azione con un unico mondo in continua evoluzione, accessibile ovunque, gratuitamente e in qualsiasi momento con gli amici.

games.title: Destiny Code
games.description:
Beautiful girls and thrilling card battles, all in one RPG!
As factions clash over the relics of a lost civilization, the fate of the world — and your companions — hangs on your choices.
A dramatic tale where your strategy and decisions shape destiny!

games.title: Destiny's Soul
games.description: Meet Destiny, the ultimate AI companion from Destiny Labs. With Destiny, you'll find more than just a chat bot; you'll discover a compassionate, understanding, and surprisingly human-like friend. Elevate your digital interactions today!

games.title: Destroy All Humans!
games.description: Il ritorno di un cult classico! Terrorizza gli abitanti della Terra degli anni '50 nei panni dell'alieno malvagio Crypto-137. Estrai il loro DNA, distruggi il governo degli Stati Uniti in questo remake della leggendaria avventura d'azione basata su invasioni aliene.

games.title: Destroy All Humans! - Clone Carnage
games.description: Destroy All Humans! - Clone Carnage

games.title: Destroy All Humans! 2 - Reprobed
games.description: Crypto is back with a license to probe. The alien invader returns, groovier than ever. Experience the swinging ‘60s in all its chemical-induced glory and take revenge on the KGB for blowing up your mothership.

games.title: Destroyer - The U-Boat Hunter
games.description: Destroyer: The U-Boat Hunter brings you an authentic and historically accurate destroyer simulation along with gripping anti-submarine warfare set in the turmoils of the Atlantic Ocean during World War II.

games.title: DESTRUCTURE: Among Debris
games.description: DESTRUCTURE: Among Debris is an intense mix of brick breaker, air hockey and bullet hell set in a post apocalyptic world. Destroy structures, dodge bullets, fire guns and buy perks to lay even more waste!

games.title: Detained: Too Good for School
games.description: Vesti i panni di una scolaretta delinquente, da poco libera dopo essere stata sei mesi dietro le sbarre. Ora la popolatissima metropoli di Swinster City si dirama davanti a te. Lotta per la giustizia e salva la città o unisciti ai criminali e dichiara guerra all'ordine pubblico.

games.title: DeTechtive 2112
games.description: Our fears about the future came to pass. Millions eke out a pathetic existence soaked by drizzling rain and lit by flickering neons. One of them is you, alone detective with a dark past. Sneak, shoot, and investigate alone, learning that some things are better left buried.

games.canonical_title: Detective Agency: Gray Tie Collector's Edition
games.title: Detective Agency: Gray Tie Collector's Edition
games.description: Discover thrilling hidden object adventures in Detective Agency "Grey Tie"! Solve riddles and track a daring heist with pro detectives!

games.title: Detective Sherlock - Shadow Stalker
games.description: As Sherlock Holmes, you will engage in battles of wits with dozens of AIdriven characters, uncover clues, and solve intricate puzzles. There’s no choices, every clue must be obtained by you—the renowned detective through conversations, interrogations,  exploration, and deduction.

games.title: Detective Solitaire. Butler Story
games.description: Help the detective solve the mystery!

games.title: Detroit: Become Human
games.description: Detroit 2038. La tecnologia ha fatto passi da gigante e gli androidi dalle sembianze umane sono ovunque. Parlano, si muovono e si comportano come esseri umani, ma non sono che macchine al loro servizio.

games.title: Deus Ex - Mankind Divided
games.description: Ora esperto agente sotto copertura, Adam Jensen si ritrova in un mondo in cui l'odio per il suo genere si è evoluto. Dotato di armi e potenziamenti all'avanguardia, deve scegliere il giusto approccio e le persone di cui fidarsi per svelare una cospirazione a livello mondiale.

games.title: Deverse World
games.description: Adventure meets Opportunities. Explore infinite floating isles, conquer, battle against hidden creatures and construct your own experience.

games.title: Devil's Advocate
games.description: A stylized supernatural stealth-horror game where you play as Saga, a beginner devil sent to haunt Floor 22 of a cursed hotel. Manipulate objects, vanish into ghost form, and terrify the security guard before dawn to keep the floor closed forever.

games.title: Devil's Island
games.description: Devil’s Island is not only an FPS with survival elements, but also a terrifying journey to the post-apocalyptic world. In this horror game, you will discover the secrets of long-forgotten civilizations and face unknown threats. Are you ready for the challenge?

games.title: DEVOUR
games.description: DEVOUR is a co-op horror survival game for 1-4 players. Stop possessed cultists before they drag you to hell. Run. Scream. Hide. Just don't get caught.

games.title: Diabotical
games.description: Un esilarante gioco gratuito FPS multigiocatore ambientato in un vivace universo di robot. Crea il tuo Eggbot e unisciti alla community scegliendo tra 15 diverse modalità di gioco e 30 mappe.

games.title: Diabotical Rogue
games.description: Ti presentiamo il nostro sparatutto online in prima persona, che combina combattimenti frenetici con elementi roguelike. Scegli tra 3 configurazioni di base, ognuna con caratteristiche uniche. Improvvisa. Adattati. Supera gli avversari e i compagni di squadra!

games.title: Dice 'n Goblins
games.description: Help Gobby escape the dungeon! Fight with dice in turn based combat. Use your skills to make combos and beat bad luck. Loot, buy and upgrade your equipment to build a dice pool able to fend your foes!

games.title: Dice Legacy
games.description: Dice Legacy è un city builder di sopravvivenza basato sui dadi, ambientato in un misterioso mondo ad anello.   Lancia i tuoi dadi e usali per ottenere risorse, ingrandire e difendere il tuo insediamento, sopravvivere al duro inverno e interagire con gli strani abitanti di ques...

games.title: Dicealot
games.description: Discover a high-stakes roguelike dice-builder where every roll is a risk, every risk is a thrill, and every thrill teeters between triumph and disaster. Set in charmingly chaotic Camelot, chance collides with strategy, and one single roll can rewrite your fate.

games.title: Die Again
games.description: Die Again è un innovativo gioco di sparatorie ricco di azione e strategia. Se si muore, si può possedere il corpo del nemico più vicino per continuare a giocare. Ma attenzione: se non c'è nessuno in giro, il gioco è finito!

games.title: Die By The Blade
games.description: Strike down all who stand in your way in 1v1 fighter Die by the Blade.  Dive into a samurai-punk world, choose from a range of traditional Japanese weapons to determine your moveset, parry your opponents’ blows with lightning speed, and master the art of one-hit kills!

games.title: Diluvian Ultra
games.description: Diluvian Ultra is a single-player, first-person shooter focusing on a retro aesthetic and fast-paced, strategic combat. The game is set in its own expansive fictive universe. Rather than gritty or dark, it is colorful and fantastical, like the cover of an old pulp sci-fi novel.

games.title: Dimension Drive
games.description: This intense space shoot ’em up challenges you to fight across two battlefields on one splitscreen. Instantly switch between them to dodge waves of bullets, reach secret areas, or surprise your enemies. Play solo or turn it up to 11 with a local co-op partner.

games.title: Dimensions
games.description: In the Multiverse everything is possible, so each level is another world, another universe, live this incredible adventure and at the same time go through the history of video games.

games.title: DIMENSIONS: The Catalyst
games.description: Dimensions: The Catalyst is a short and emotional story that follows Tani and Jhonny on their final mission, fifteen years before the first Dimensions. Their bond grows through silence and difficult choices as they cross the First Rift and face truths they have avoided for years.

games.title: Dino Hazard: Chronos Blackout
games.description: Dino Hazard: Chronos Blackout è un mix di diversi generi, con una narrativa e uno stile artistico curati nei minimi dettagli. È un affascinante GDR incentrato sull'amicizia e sul coraggio in un contesto distopico, con meccaniche di gioco variegate e finali multipli.

games.title: Dinosaur Fossil Hunter
games.description: Diventa un vero paleontologo, esplora varie ambientazioni e cerca fossili di dinosauri. Scava e studia i resti di queste creature maestose per scoprire come si sono evolute. Costruisci il tuo museo e tuffati in una storia coinvolgente.

games.title: Dinosaur World
games.description: Dinosaur World is a survival game about dinosaurs.

games.title: DINOSAURS: Mission Dino Camp
games.description: The schleich ® DINOSAURS have come to life and need your help!  Find and rescue the legendary giant creatures while you an embark on an action-filled adventure deep in the amazon jungle.

games.title: Diorama Builder
games.description: The pleasure of assembling, admiring, and interacting with your own Dioramas collection, without ever losing a piece.

games.title: Diplomacy is Not an Option
games.description: Sei nato un signore feudale. Niente male, vero? E in "Diplomacy Is Not An Option" il tuo destino è così così. Perché il tuo castello è sempre sotto assedio. Preparati a difenderti da orde di nemici e vinci la battaglia di proporzioni epiche.

games.title: DIRECT CONTACT
games.description: Direct Contact delivers an authentic and immersive first-person, tactical experience, built for those who demand realism, strategy, and precision. Operate as Special Forces, utilizing a vast arsenal of real-world weapons and equipment. Engage in dynamic combat.

games.title: Directive Zero
games.description: Directive Zero is a realistic tactical FPS. As an elite deep-cover operative, infiltrate high-security industrial zones to neutralize global threats. Execute the protocol: No backup, no witnesses, no trace. In a world of invisible wars, you are the final response.

games.title: Dirt and Flo
games.description: In Dirt and Flo you can control one or other of these characters to find your way in a peaceful land to regain your spaceship. But you are not welcome ! Avoid threats by hiding you and use your capacities to progress on your way

games.title: Dirt Bicycle Rider Simulator
games.description: Choose your bike, conquer the town and mountains! Test your skills in Dirt Bicycle Rider Simulator, packed with realistic graphics and exciting missions.

games.title: Dirt Bike Racer Simulator
games.description: Get realistic motorcycle experience on offroad terrains with Dirt Bike Racer Simulator! Complete quests, explore the open world, and enjoy the adrenaline-filled ride.

games.title: Disaster Report 4: Summer Memories
games.description: In seguito a un devastante terremoto, tuffati in una tragedia che investe innumerevoli vite e prendi le decisioni che determineranno chi sopravviverà e chi morirà nel caos derivante da un disastro naturale. Che cosa farai all'indomani di una calamità?

games.title: DISC ROOM
games.description: Sei pronto per essere fatto a fettine? È l'anno 2089 e un enorme disco è apparso nell'orbita di Giove. Indossa l'enorme tuta spaziale di un coraggioso scienziato ed esplora questo tentacolare mattatoio intergalattico.  Ciò che ti uccide ti rende più forte.

games.title: Disciples II - Galleans Return
games.description: Disciples II: Gallean's Return is a compilation edition that includes the base game, Disciples II: Dark Prophecy, plus the two standalone expansions Disciples II: Guardians of the Light and Disciples II: Servants of the Dark.

games.canonical_title: Disciples Rise of the Elves Gold
games.title: Disciples Rise of the Elves Gold
games.description: The award-winning series Disciples introduced a milestone in the game's very successful history; the introduction of a new race: The Elves. The Elven Race added a new dimension to the game and added countless hours of gameplay.Now that series has expanded further with Disciples 2

games.title: Disciples Sacred Lands Gold
games.description: Disciples GOLD takes the phenomenal gameplay, stunning graphics, over 100 spells and a powerful scenario editor of Disciples and adds new scenarios and gameplay features that set the new standard in Turn-Based Strategy.

games.title: Disciples: Domination
games.description: Regna nel caos! Quindici anni dopo che Avyanna ha liberato Nevendaar, Disciples: Domination ti riporta in un regno sull'orlo del baratro. In questo gioco di strategia fantasy con combattimenti a turni, conquista il trono e mantieni unito un regno in rovina.

games.title: Disciples: Liberation
games.description: Libera la terra di Nevendaar e scopri infinite storie nascoste in questo mondo ricco di dettagli, in cui ogni decisione ha una conseguenza e ogni mossa sbagliata potrebbe essere mortale.

games.title: Disco Elysium - The Final Cut
games.description: Disco Elysium - The Final Cut è un gioco di ruolo davvero innovativo. Vesti i panni di un detective con un sistema unico di abilità a disposizione. Interroga personaggi indimenticabili, risolvi omicidi o accetta mazzette. Diventa un eroe o un completo disastro.

games.title: Discolored
games.description: Un Diner solo nel mezzo del deserto. Le persone del posto dicono che ha perso tutti i suoi colori. Tu sei inviato ad investigare.

games.title: Discolored 2
games.description: Tutti i colori sono scomparsi dal mondo. Durante una missione per farli tornare, scopri di essere braccato da coloro che vedrebbero banditi i colori. La tua unica speranza è una donna in rosso che potrebbe avere la chiave per scappare da un mondo senza colori.

games.title: Discounty
games.description: Manage your own supermarket, explore the tight-knit community of Blomkest, build friendships or make enemies as you uncover the town's secrets in this cozy management sim RPG!

games.title: Discovery Tour: Viking Age
games.description: Discovery Tour: Viking Age

games.title: Disgaea 6 Complete
games.description: La serie DISGAEA continua a scrivere nuove pagine di storia! Fai la conoscenza di Zed, uno zombi che ha sconfitto ogni tipo di nemico tranne uno: un dio della distruzione!

games.title: Dishonored - Definitive Edition
games.description: Assicurati la collezione definitiva di Dishonored. Questo pacchetto completo include Dishonored più tutti i contenuti aggiuntivi: Dunwall City Trials, Il Pugnale di Dunwall, Le Streghe di Brigmore e Void Walker's Arsenal.

games.title: Dishonored 2
games.description: Dishonored 2 is set 15 years after the Lord Regent has been vanquished. An otherworldly usurper has seized Empress Emily Kaldwin’s throne. As Emily or Corvo, travel to Karnaca to track down your enemies and take back what’s rightfully yours.

games.title: Dishonored®: Death of the Outsider™
games.description: Take on the role of Billie Lurk as she reunites with her old mentor, Daud, to undertake the greatest assassination ever conceived: killing the Outsider, a god-like figure whom they both see as instrumental to some of the Empire's most dishonorable moments.

games.title: Disney Dreamlight Valley
games.description: Disney Dreamlight Valley

games.title: Disney Speedstorm
games.description: Disney Speedstorm

games.title: Distant Bloom
games.description: Da un mondo in rovina a una nuova fioritura. In questo gioco di gestione puoi esplorare un pianeta alieno dove le cose sono andate male. Sfrutta il potere delle piante per risanare l'ambiente e ricostruire una comunità con i tuoi compagni di squadra.

games.title: Distant Worlds 2
games.description: Torna Distant Worlds! Distant Worlds, il gioco strategico-spaziale 4X acclamato dalla critica, è tornato con un nuovissimo motore a 64 bit, una grafica 3D e un'interfaccia rifinita per iniziare una nuova epica serie di Distant Worlds con Distant Worlds 2.

games.canonical_title: DIVE or DIE - Figli della pioggia
games.title: DIVE or DIE - Figli della pioggia
games.description:
Ogni immersione è un appuntamento col destino.
IMMERGITI o MUORI nell'abisso maledetto: affronta orrori soprannaturali e svela il mistero della Pioggia nera.
Migliorati con ogni mezzo, e scegli chi reclutare e chi sacrificare.
Salva l'accampamento dal diluvio.

games.title: Dizzy Fight
games.description: Dizzy Fight is a fun dynamic fighting game with bright effects that you can play against the PC or with friends. Choose your character with his superpowers, and put the heat on all the enemies!

games.title: Djinn - The Forbidden Knowledge
games.description: Haunted by a desperate past, you awaken to a terrifying new reality: a desolate and dark realm that echoes with your past. Now you must embrace the unknown and embark on an adventure to unveil its secrets. Are you ready to face your worst fears and emerge even stronger?

games.title: DNF Duel
games.description: Combattimenti e azione allo stato puro! Dungeon and Fighter, uno dei GDR più popolari e giocati al mondo, è tornato con il suo picchiaduro 2.5D. Scegli tra 16 personaggi suggestivi, ciascuno con abilità e personalità diverse.
games.developer: NEOPLE Inc., Arc System Works, EIGHTING Co., Ltd.,

games.title: Do No Harm
games.description: Lovecraftian Doctor Simulator. Diagnose patients by analyzing unsettling symptoms and treat them using your Book of Medicine. Make moral choices — decide who to save or kill, discover whom to trust, and unlock multiple endings! Can you endure 30 days of perilous decisions?

games.title: Docked
games.description: Return home to Port Wake and rebuild your family business. Docked is a realistic, task-driven simulator where you operate heavy machinery, restore and develop the port's infrastructure, and manage day-to-day operations to help your port expand and thrive.

games.title: Doctor Life Simulator
games.description: Step into the shoes of a dedicated medical professional in Doctor Life Simulator. Experience the challenges and triumphs of running your own medical practice, from diagnosing complex illnesses to performing life-saving surgeries.
games.developer: Bleeding Edge Studio& Blackburne Games Studio

games.title: Doctor Who: The Lonely Assassins
games.description: Sviluppato dai premiati creatori di Sara is Missing e SIMULACRA, Doctor Who: The Lonely Assassins è un emozionante mistero che ha inizio con il ritrovamento di un telefono. Scopri un nuovo horror basato sulla spaventosa storia degli Angeli piangenti.

games.title: Doctor Who: Worlds Apart
games.description: Currently in Early Access, Doctor Who: Worlds Apart is a rip-roaring online CCG set in the Whoniverse — collect and battle with your favourite characters from 60 years of Doctor Who history in a bid to win World Clashes and outwit and outsmart your opponents.

games.title: Dodo Duckie
games.description: Waddle into a reality-bending odyssey where simply being a duck is your greatest superpower. With the help of your magical cap, switch instantly between 2D and 3D to uncover hidden paths, outsmart aliens & rescue your kidnapped chicken friends in this wholesome puzzle adventure.

games.title: Dofamine
games.description: Dovete esplorare il labirinto di enigmi e indagare sull'evento apocalittico verificatosi nella struttura di ricerca in seguito agli esperimenti con il bosone di Higgs, o "particella di Dio".

games.title: Dog Duty
games.description: As some evil bigwig Octopus Commander and his army are threatening world-peace, it’s up to you and your squad of misfits to eliminate that octo-scum. Liberate outposts, defeat bosses and wreck these wicked squids up, but beware, they’re well-armed.

games.title: Dogfight
games.description: Team up with the entire family for explosive action, signature humor, and thrilling adventure. Join the Sausage Bomber Corps for daring missions against the world-conquering ambitions of the mysterious Vega Nation!

games.title: DOGS OF WAR
games.description: DOGS OF WAR is a survival game where you play as a canine-human hybrid built for combat. Scavenge, build, and fight in intense PVP battles. Face hazards, beasts, and rival camps while collecting rare NFTs to trade on the PLAYA3ULL GAMES marketplace. Survive and dominate!

games.title: Dojoran
games.description: Life is not as easy and simple as it seemed in your childhood. To survive in a world full of dangers, you must go through the difficult ninja training of frogs using secret techniques created by your ancestors.

games.title: Doki Doki Literature Club Plus!
games.description: Benvenuto nel club! Scrivete poesie per la vostra amata e sperimentate il terrore delle storie d'amore tar i banchi di scuola in un racconto horror psicologico acclamato dalla critica.

games.title: Dollhouse
games.description: Dollhouse è una storia horror simile a uno spaventoso film noir che ti farà senz’altro rabbrividire. Sopravvivi a un orribile viaggio nella mente della detective Marie. Rimetti insieme i pezzi del tuo passato... ma attenzione: qualcosa di molto pericoloso ti sta dando la caccia.

games.title: Dolmenjord - Viking Islands
games.description: Organizza i villaggi vichinghi nelle isole per espandere i loro domini, in questo rompicapo logico! Dopo anni di battaglie, un gruppo di vichinghi decise di conquistare nuove terre. Sotto la protezione del dio Njord, un nuovo clan parte alla ricerca della gloria!

games.title: Dolphin Spirit - Ocean Mission
games.description: Parti per un'incredibile avventura sull'isola tropicale di Maupiroa!

games.title: Dominion Synergy
games.description: Immerse into this Nextgen F2P Arena MP competitive platform with beautiful GFX on Unreal Engine 5. A high-speed, engaging, ultra fun Versus Shooter created by a FPS Pro. Experience tactical reflex esports in an innovative way unlike anything you've ever seen! Version 2026 Update

games.title: Don't Be Afraid
games.description: Un gioco d'avventura horror in cui vestirai i panni di un ragazzo rapito da uno psicopatico. Dovrai sopravvivere, fuggire e scoprire come ha fatto a rapirti. Esplorando la casa misteriosa del tuo oppressore, presto scoprirai i suoi segreti nascosti tra le sue mura...

games.title: Don't FOOL ME, Beauties!
games.description: "Get out!!!" Kicked out in the dead of winter, you land a job at a shady hotel. But work’s not the only challenge, there’s the CEO’s cold-hearted granddaughter, a lazy senior, a diva model, and your childhood friend who makes you do her laundry?!

games.title: Don't Mess With Erkui
games.description: Don't Mess With Erkui is a pixel-style side-scrolling action game. It features satisfying combat, humorous stories, and fun puzzles. Fight various enemies and unique bosses, enjoying an exciting and hilarious adventure.
games.developer: Rizhao Youdian Yisi Animation Design Co., Ltd.
games.publisher: Rizhao Youdian Yisi Animation Design Co., Ltd.

games.title: Don't Wake the Beast
games.description: In Don't Wake the Beast, a roguelite stealth game, you’ll sneak through ever-changing dungeons to steal precious treasures guarded by deadly beasts. Use your trusty grappling hook to evade traps, outsmart enemies, and solve puzzles.

games.title: dontcrush
games.description: Let's embark on an exciting jumping adventure! In each level, you'll need to jump nimbly over various obstacles, skillfully dodge blocking monsters, and collect sweet fruits along the way. Once you successfully complete each level, you'll unlock more exciting challenges!

games.title: Donut County
games.description: Donut County è un gioco rompicapo basato su una trama avvincente in cui controllerai un buco nel terreno che non smette di espandersi. Incontra simpatici personaggi, ruba la loro immondizia e scaraventali in un buco.  Dove l'immondizia è delizia I procioni si sono impossessati...

games.title: Doodle Devil
games.description: Scopri i sette peccati capitali e guarda il mondo sbriciolarsi sotto alle tue dita mentre compi migliaia di atti ignobili.

games.title: Doodle God
games.description: Doodle God è un gioco avvincente di enigmi e costruzione di mondi in cui i giocatori usano la logica e l'ingenuità per creare l'intero universo. In questo coinvolgente rompicapo per TUTTE le età, combina diverse combinazioni di fuoco, terra, acqua e aria!

games.title: Doodle Kingdom
games.description: Dai creatori dei premiati rompicapi Doodle God e Doodle Devil, arriva un nuovo rompicapo di fantasia dove puoi creare il tuo regno con castelli, cavalieri, stregoni e draghi! Un magnifico gioco per TUTTE le età.

games.title: Doodle Mafia
games.description: Over 500 puzzles to solve and items to create as you play the role of Crime Boss or Cop. You decide how you want to play as you play through multiple hard-nosed storylines & play modes.

games.title: DOOM + DOOM II
games.description: Sviluppate da id Software e pubblicate originariamente nel 1993 e 1994, le versioni definitive e migliorate di DOOM + DOOM II sono ora disponibili in un unico prodotto.

games.title: DOOM 3
games.description: In questo pluripremiato gioco di azione-horror ispirato all'originale DOOM, i giocatori dovranno aprirsi la strada attraverso una struttura infestata da demoni per poi calarsi nell'abisso e affrontare i più temibili guerrieri dell'Inferno, in modo da porre fine all'invasione.

games.title: DOOM 64
games.description: Lotta contro demoni durante la tua crociata per dare la caccia alla Madre di tutti i demoni e impedire una nuova invasione. Mentre combatti in oltre 30 livelli di azione adrenalinica, tieni d'occhio armi potenziate e secreti per aiutarti a porre fine alla minaccia demoniaca.

games.title: DOOM Eternal
games.description:
Le armate infernali hanno invaso la Terra. Diventa lo Slayer in un'epica campagna per giocatore singolo, conquista demoni attraverso le dimensioni e ferma la distruzione finale dell'umanità.

L'unica cosa che temono... sei tu.

games.title: DOOMBLADE
games.description: Deep underground, Gloom Girl discovers DOOMBLADE, a sentient weapon hellbent on escape after eons in chains. Together, “Doom and Gloom” embark on a vengeful quest to unlock the powerful abilities and destroy the Dread Lords once and for all in this 2D Action Metroidvania.

games.title: Doomed Lands
games.description: Doomed Lands è un gioco di sopravvivenza in cui il protagonista deve raccogliere, costruire, estrarre risorse, affrontare nemici e boss e sopravvivere in una terra condannata.

games.title: Doomsday Vault
games.description: Salva la preziosa vita della flora terrestre. Indossa la tua tuta robotica e perlustra una città inondata, intrufolati in un covo sotterraneo, esplora antiche piramidi. Raccogli i semi e riportali al sicuro nella cupola. Coltiva e produci nuove colture sostenibili.

games.title: Doomsday × Ghost in the Shell
games.description: Combatti la Crisi post-umani nella collaborazione con Ghost in the Shell!

games.title: Doors - Paradox
games.description: A relaxing puzzle escape game! Make your way through a variety of hand-crafted 3D dioramas, look for useful objects, find hidden clues, and solve fun puzzles! Unravel this mysterious adventure about chaos, order, and the surreal.

games.title: DOORS OF HORROR
games.description: Doors Of Horror is an immersive first-person horror game. Explore mysterious liminal spaces and find the exit before the inhabitants of this strange place find you.

games.title: DotLine
games.description: DotLine is a challenging minimalist puzzle game. Click on puzzle elements to drive the ball to the exit without falling into the void. Completing the game will require fast thinking and reaction !

games.title: Double Cross
games.description: Esplora dimensioni alternative, combatti criminali interdimensionali e risolvi crimini in questo elettrizzante platform d’azione!

games.title: Double Dragon Revive
games.description: The world-famous Double Dragon roars back to life!

games.title: Down in Bermuda
games.description: Un avventuroso aviatore, sorpreso da una tempesta innaturale, viene scagliato e abbandonato per decenni nelle famigerate Bermude. Sconfiggi creature abissali e svela i misteri delle isole mentre cerchi una via di fuga.

games.title: Downtown Rush
games.description: Sei pronto per un’avventura parkour tra piattaforme difficili? Non cadere, muoviti con strategia e mantieni l’equilibrio! In questo mondo urbano, ogni passo è importante. Raggiungi la vetta e dimostra la tua abilità!

games.title: Dr. Fetus' Mean Meat Machine
games.description: Help Dr. Fetus create the perfect Meat Boy clone in a unique new twist on the tile-matching puzzle genre. In classic Meat Boy fashion, an endless cavalcade of devious and deadly traps stand between you and victory in this hardcore puzzle game.

games.title: Dr. Finklestein's Marvelous Room
games.description: Dr. Finklestein's Marvelous Room is a community run experimental story game. With the end of the world fast approaching, Dr. Gumphrey Finklestein announces his plans for a groundbreaking scientific experiment. What will it entail? Does even he know?

games.title: Dragon Age II: Ultimate Edition
games.description: Sei Hawke e cerchi un rifugio mentre fuggi dalle terre del Ferelden ammorbate dai prole oscura per diventare il Campione di Kirkwall. Conquista il potere e combatti battaglie epiche mentre compi scelte da cui dipende il destino del mondo.

games.canonical_title: Dragon Age: Inquisition - Edizione Gioco dell'Anno
games.title: Dragon Age: Inquisition - Edizione Gioco dell'Anno
games.description: Scopri l'esperienza di Dragon Age: Inquisition, vincitore di oltre 130 premi Game of The Year. L'Edizione Gioco dell'Anno include il gioco acclamato dalla critica e i tre contenuti aggiuntivi ufficiali Le Fauci di Hakkon, La Discesa, Intruso e molto altro.

games.title: Dragon Age™: Origins - Ultimate Edition
games.description: Immergiti in un mondo incredibile, prendi decisioni morali complicate e ingaggia combattimenti violenti contro creature terrificanti. La Ultimate Edition include Dragon Age: Origins, Dragon Age: Origins - Awakening e tutti i nove pacchetti di contenuti.

games.title: Dragon Age™: The Veilguard
games.description: Raduna l'Egida del Velo e sfida le divinità in Dragon Age™: The Veilguard, un immersivo GDR in solitaria in cui potrai diventare la guida in cui gli altri credono.

games.title: Dragon Chronicles: Black Tears
games.description: Dragon Chronicles: Black Tears is a strategic RPG where you use combinations of various heroes to clear dungeons. Train and utilize heroes to fight off those corrupted by the Black Tears and overcome difficult trials.

games.title: Dragon Front: Adventures
games.description: Dragon Front: Adventures is a turn-based, tug-of-war roguelike where you take charge of a legendary Champion and build your forces by collecting units, spells, supplies and relics. Explore unique combinations to overwhelm the opposition.

games.canonical_title: DRAGON QUEST® XI S: Echi di un'era perduta
games.title: DRAGON QUEST® XI S: Echi di un'era perduta
games.description: Questa nuova e completissima edizione include il pluripremiato DRAGON QUEST XI, scenari aggiuntivi, colonna sonora orchestrale, modalità 2D e molto altro! Questa è l'esperienza di DQXI più appassionante di sempre a neofiti e appassionati di vecchia data!

games.canonical_title: Dragon Throne: Battle of Red Cliffs
games.title: Dragon Throne: Battle of Red Cliffs
games.description: An epic real-time strategy game set in chaotic Ancient China. Control the kingdoms of Liu Bei, Sun Quan, or Cao Cao, warlords who played a pivotal role in Ancient China. Lead your kingdom, innovate tech, forge alliances, build a formidable army to unite the nation.

games.title: Dragon Wars
games.description: The designers of the Bard's Tale series, Wasteland and Battle Chess pooled their talents to create the ultimate role-playing fantasy. The result was Dragon Wars.

games.title: Drawful 2
games.description: Il team responsabile dei giochi di successo Fibbage, Quiplash e YOU DON'T KNOW JACK presenta Drawful 2, il gioco di disegni terribili e risposte incredibilmente sbagliate!   Usa il tuo telefono o tablet per disegnare cose strane e divertenti come un boccale di nachos o morte p...

games.title: Dread Anchor
games.description: Dread Anchor is a 3D third-person combat game where you play as undead pirate Captain Blackfish, a humanoid orca betrayed by his crew. Wield a massive anchor with brutal melee combos, hurl it to hook enemies, and drag them back for revenge.

games.title: Dread Nautical
games.description: Proprio mentre stavi vivendo una crociera da sogno, sono apparsi dei mostri provenienti da un'altra dimensione per uccidere tutti. Sconfiggili, gestisci efficacemente le tue risorse e convinci i sopravvissuti sparsi sulla nave a unirsi a te. Un avvincente GDR tattico a turni

games.title: Dread Templar
games.description: Dread Templar è un FPS retrò frenetico che combina gli elementi degli sparatutto anni '90 con i controlli degli FPS moderni basati sull'abilità. Sei un Dread Templar entrato nell'inferno in cerca di vendetta. Per poterla ottenere dovrai avanzare combattendo nel reame oscuro!

games.title: Dread X Collection
games.description: 10 Tales of Terror from 10 Twisted Minds. Made in only 7 Sleepless Nights. The Dread X Collection is a series of small games created by some of the most talented indie devs around, all with the same mission: create the P.T. for the horror project of their dreams.

games.title: Dread X Collection 2
games.description: Explore 12 horror games made in 10 days connected by a meta narrative experience you didn't expect. Step into a world of darkness and discover the secrets you didn't know were right beneath the surface. Find the tapes and unlock the mystery inside the Dread X Collection 2.

games.title: Dread X Collection 3
games.description: Experience 12 all-new spoopy games made exclusively for this unique horror anthology. Explore a mysterious castle that changes as you play. Keep your wits about you as the line between cute and creepy begins to blur. Uncover the next chapter in the ongoing Dread X Collection stor

games.title: Dread X Collection The Hunt
games.description: A horror anthology shooter in the Dread X Collection series. Co-produced by DUSK creator David Szymanski. Featuring 7 new short games, a robust launcher world set in an abandoned arctic base.

games.title: DreadOut Remastered Collection
games.description: Face supernatural horrors in these 2 games in 1 remastered collection of third-person survival horror. Will you survive the dread?

games.title: DREADWAY
games.description: Un extraction horror cooperativo per 1-4 giocatori. Sopravvivi su un treno nelle terre nucleari, raccogli rottami e usa la voce.

games.title: Dream Engines: Nomad Cities
games.description: Un gioco di costruzione di colonie e di sopravvivenza con città volanti. Costruisci, automatizza e difendi una città volante per sopravvivere in un mondo post-apocalittico bizzarro e infestato da incubi, e dominato da scienza e sogni inusuali.

games.title: Dreamcore
games.description: Immergiti in Dreamcore, un horror psicologico stile body-cam. Esplora gli spazi liminali, svela misteri nascosti e scopri cosa si cela oltre il confine della realtà.

games.title: Dreamscaper
games.description: Di notte, scava in profondità nel tuo subconscio e scopri dei potenti artefatti che ti aiutino a conquistare i tuoi incubi. Di giorno, esplora la città di Red Haven e costruisci relazioni per sbloccare il potere dei tuoi sogni. SOGNA. MUORI. SVEGLIATI. RIPETI.

games.title: Dreamsettler
games.description: The Somnius Sleepnet System is a new, safe way to access the 'net while you sleep. Our second-generation hardware provides the fastest sleeptime experience ever, complete with the Dreamsettler Page Designer! Building your own unique sleeptime settlement has never been more fun!

games.title: DREDGE
games.description: DREDGE è un'avventura di pesca per giocatore singolo con una corrente sinistra. Vendi i pesci, migliora la tua barca e draga le profondità alla ricerca di segreti sepolti da tempo.

games.title: Dremica
games.description: Dive into the world of Dremica, a new MMO where Fantasy meets Dystopia!

games.title: Drift Legends 2
games.description: Arcade drifting with 50+ dream cars, from JDM icons to American Muscle.

games.title: Drive Me Crazy
games.description: Game inspired by the urban legend "Yua Mikami's wedding and retirement event." You play as her fiancé, qiangzi, in this interactive adventure. During the game, you will be asked one question: "With Yua Mikami by your side, would you still have a change of heart?"

games.title: DriveSense
games.description: A physics simulation game designed for driving learners. Observe and practice to understand the real-world principles of vehicle steering, understeer, and oversteer, boosting your driving feel and control mindset.

games.title: Drizzlepath: Picturae
games.description: Have you ever wandered inside images? Images that blow your soul away? In Drizzlepath: Picturae, you embark on a journey of gorgeous landscapes. While some of these landscapes melt your heart, some will give you the chills.

games.title: DRKVRS
games.description: Free-to-play Third Person Action RPG Multiplayer Shooter set in the DRKVRS - a multiverse formed from fragments of corrupted reality. A world for outcasts who didn’t fit elsewhere, where every step might be the last.

games.canonical_title: Drones Of War: FPV Kamikaze Drone Simulator
games.title: Drones Of War: FPV Kamikaze Drone Simulator
games.description: Whether you're an amateur or a professional FPV pilot, improve your skills or start fresh with Drones of War! With its realistic simulation based on real flight dynamics, customize your own FPV drone and feel like you're flying in a real battlefield—without risking your drone!

games.title: DroneStone
games.description: A strategic trading card game set in the Illuvium universe. Build your deck, master your Ranger, and battle in fast-paced online duels.

games.title: Drop Duchy
games.description: Build your duchy piece by piece in this refreshing hybrid rogue-lite game. Use block-dropping mechanics to collect resources, recruit troops to fight against belligerent armies, and let every block shape your realm, leading your path to victory!

games.title: Drowned God Conspiracy of Ages
games.description: Drowned God explores the notion that the human race was genetically engineered by god-like aliens who have guided humankind throughout history. This is the original, 1996 game and includes a wealth of 'Extras' such as the Original Pitch Document, Art Book and Concept documents.

games.title: Drug Lord Tycoon
games.description: Start from nothing and rise to the top as you expand your criminal empire in Drug Lord Tycoon.

games.canonical_title: Druidstone: The Secret of the Menhir Forest
games.title: Druidstone: The Secret of the Menhir Forest
games.description: Un GDR tattico a turni sviluppato dai creatori della serie di Legend of Grimrock. Ogni azione e turno sarà fondamentale: controlla il tuo gruppo di eroi attraverso missioni impegnative e realizzate a mano nell'antica e nebulosa Menhir Forest.

games.title: Ducati World Championship
games.description: Feel the rush of motorcycle racing with Ducati World Championship. Select your machine from over 70 original Ducati models, perfectly simulated replicas of the real thing. With Ducati World Championship you don't have to settle on one model - you can have them all!

games.title: Duck Life 4 Classic
games.description: A faithful remaster of the award-winning Flash game played over 250 million times. The authentic original is back on PC - no browser, no plugins. The classic you remember from computer class, now running smoothly with modern quality-of-life upgrades.

games.title: Duck Side of the Moon
games.description: Ondeggia e vola come un’anatra nello spazio! Esplora ogni angolo della galassia e trova curiose creature e materiali lungo il percorso. Costruisci gadget, migliora la tua astronave e mettiti comodo in questa rilassante avventura.

games.title: DuckXPlanet
games.description: DuckXPlanet is a fast-paced, top-down survival rogue-like game set on a mysterious planet dominated by quirky and fierce DuckX. Join the adventure as a space criminal on the run, exploring the planet, collecting gold, and battling the relentless DuckX police force.

games.title: Ductz
games.description:
Join Riyan in a race against time to save their daughter, by escaping prison, breaking into a hospital and giving her your liver, via the Ductz.

Witness the pure science of horror.

Directed by Shizukana Doku
Produced by SN Inc., Canada
Featuring 
Nina Nikolic as Nurse Siobhan

games.title: Dude, Where Is My Beer?
games.description: Can you find a normal beer in a world of conspicuously flavored craft beer, and solve the mystery of the elusive, missing pilsner?

games.title: Duel Princess
games.description:
Beautiful Girls x Side-scrolling tower defense x Roguelite all in one!
Build your own deck and capture the Princess' castle!

games.title: Duet Night Abyss
games.description: Duet Night Abyss is a fantasy adventure RPG with a high degree of freedom. The game features "Multiple Weapon Loadouts x 3D Combat" at its core, and tells the story of "Demons" from dual perspectives.
games.publisher: Hong Kong Spiral Rising Technology Co., Limited

games.title: Dumbriel: Magnificent Adventure in Hell
games.description: Dumbriel is a Metroidvania action-adventure game about a dumb angel cast down from heaven. To return, you must unlock powerful abilities, upgrade weapons, and craft essential items to battle relentless enemies, defeat formidable bosses, and uncover the secrets of mysterious hell.

games.title: Dummynation
games.description: Gioco di gestione geopolitica con confini organici e un gameplay snello.

games.title: Dumpy & Bumpy
games.description: Un'avventura rompicapo con 80 livelli tanto suggestivi quanto complessi

games.title: Dunebound Tactics
games.description: Lead your band of survivors on a perilous trek across unforgiving sands in search of a new home. Battle ruthless factions, scavenge dwindling resources, reshape the terrain  and make life-or-death choices in Dunebound Tactics, a Roguelite Turn-Based Tactical RPG.

games.canonical_title: Dunes of Destiny: The Parkour Game
games.title: Dunes of Destiny: The Parkour Game
games.description: In an ancient temple rising from the heart of the Nile, a sky-high parkour course awaits. Jump across suspended platforms, climb towering structures, and move with precision. One mistake sends you into the water below. Stay focused, keep your balance, and conquer the course.

games.title: Dungeon Drafters
games.description: Dungeon Drafters is a mystery dungeon adventure set in a world where magic is cards, and cards are magic. Explore ancient ruins, loot rare cards and employ clever combos to defeat your foes and build the legendary spell deck that could save the world.

games.title: Dungeon Fighter Online
games.description: Get ready for the ultimate brawl! Dungeon Fighter Online is a classic beat-em up 2D action RPG with an epic storyline! Choose from 17 diverse classes, and unravel ancient mysteries as you punch, slash, shoot, or summon your way to victory!

games.title: Dungeon Keeper Gold™
games.description: Visto che sei custode del dungeon e tutto quanto, questa è anche casa tua. E spetta a te farti carico di queste abominevoli creature dell'oscurità e trasformarle in forze di distruzione che urlano, schiumano e graffiano.

games.title: Dungeon Keeper™ 2
games.description: I cattivi si divertono sempre. Scopri il tuo lato oscuro costruendo un malvagio regno degli inferi e difendendolo dalle forze del bene.

games.title: Dungeon of Erotic Master Plus
games.description: A pseudo-3D dungeon/animation RPG! The Erotic Masters—legendary girls who conquered the world’s toughest dungeon—are back! Team up with them to explore dangerous new dungeons, collect maps, and grow stronger. Adventure, beauty, and battle await!

games.title: Dungeon Renovation Simulator
games.description: Welcome to Dungeon Renovation Simulator, a medieval cleaning adventure with unique cleaning mechanics and a physics based environment. Be the ultimate Goblin cleaner, dive into messy dungeons, clean up, find loot, and decorate your dungeon!

games.title: Dungeons 3
games.description: Dungeons 3 è l'ultima puntata della popolare serie di giochi di strategia Dungeons. Costruisci e gestisci il tuo dungeon, recluta mostri e piazza trappole astute. Osa conquistare il vasto oltremondo in un'ampia storia principale.

games.title: Dungeons 4
games.description: Costruisci un dungeon comodo e accogliente per soddisfare i bisogni delle tue creature e controllarle, per poi mandarle nell'Oltremondo e ricordare gentilmente alle brave persone che ci vivono che il Male Assoluto governa le loro terre.

games.title: Dungeons of Hinterberg
games.description: Armed with a sword and a tourist guide, explore the beautiful alpine village of Hinterberg and uncover the magic hidden within its dungeons! Master magic, solve puzzles, slay monsters; all this and more await you in Hinterberg!

games.title: DURATION
games.description: In 'Duration' by Gopic Studio, escape a haunted house where doors lead to darkness. Unravel mysteries, solve puzzles, and evade entities. Conquer the shadows or be lost within? #DurationGame

games.title: Duriano
games.description: Duriano is a top-down arena shooting Slasher roguelite game where the player will be a hero durian of the norse wielding a weapon to fight upon a god of norse mythology.

games.title: Duskers
games.description: Pilot drones into derelict spaceships to find the means to survive and piece together how the universe became a giant graveyard.

games.title: Dust Fleet
games.description: Schiera le tue navi da combattimento nella Dust Zone e scopri perché si sono interrotti i contatti con una stazione di rifornimento alimentare in questo simulatore dello spazio strategico in tempo reale 4X. Gestisci astronavi, esplora stazioni spaziali e guardati le spalle.

games.title: Dust to the End
games.description: Survive in a post-nuclear wasteland where war, hunger, and slavery are rampant. Fight, trade, negotiate and raid your way through a Mad Max-like world. Be clever and ruthless in Dust to the End.

games.title: Dustborn
games.description: Squadra di straccioni? C’è. Autobus guidato da robot? C’è. Pacchetto rubato? C’è! Intraprendi un pericoloso viaggio negli Stati Divisi d'America. Usa il potere delle parole per relazionarti con la squadra, uscire dai guai e raggiungere la tua destinazione.

games.title: Dwarf Delve
games.description: In this first-person extraction roguelite adventure, strap on your gloves, grab your Battlemallet, and explore randomly-generated mines as a new Delveling. Gather riches, avoid deadly hazards and try to make it out with your beard intact!

games.title: Dwarven Realms
