games.description: Face massive hordes of mobs and unleash chaotic abilities that paint the screen with mayhem. Dive into the largest mob density of any 3D ARPG and slay them all. Wield epic powers, create your build, and shape a world of endless possibilities in the action-packed ARPG experience.

games.canonical_title: Dying Light 2 Stay Human - Reloaded Edition
games.title: Dying Light 2 Stay Human - Reloaded Edition
games.description: Now with guns! With the Reloaded Edition, the arsenal at your disposal has grown massively. Be creative with your combat or outrun your foes as you enjoy the perks of more than 10 post-launch updates. Good luck out there, and stay human!

games.title: Dying Light Collection
games.description:
La Dying Light Collection contiene:
Dying Light Essentials Edition
Dying Light 2: Stay Human Digital Extras Edition

Scopri il franchise di zombi definitivo con la Dying Light Collection! Esplora vasti mondi aperti, affronta combattimenti creativi e sperimenta l'alternarsi del giorno e della notte.

games.title: Dying Light: Essentials Edition
games.description: Inizia la tua avventura in Dying Light con l'Essentials Edition, che contiene il gioco base, i DLC Bozak Horde, Cuisine e Cargo, oltre ad altri 8 DLC contenenti oggetti estetici e progetti di armi.

games.title: Dying Light: The Beast
games.description: Crane è tornato! Prosegui la sua storia in questa nuova avventura a sé stante

games.title: Dynasty Legends 2
games.description: Next-Gen ARPG is coming! One vs thousands, battlefield is waiting!

games.title: Dynopunk
games.description: An ironic adventure with cyberpunk aesthetics set in a world where humans have been replaced by dinosaurs. Become a top-notch repair shop mechanic: fix gadgets, have heart-to-heart talks, and offer drinks to your customers — everything to fulfill your ultimate dream.

games.title: DYSMANTLE
games.description: Ascend from your shelter. Ruin everything. Escape the wretched island. Explore. Fight. Level up. Survive. Gather. Craft. Harvest. Hunt. Build. Farm. Solve puzzles. Fish. Cook. Live. Enjoy the bittersweet post-apocalypse.

games.title: E30 Drift Car Simulator
games.description: E30 car modification options and a funny drift game are waiting for you.

games.title: EA SPORTS FC™ 25 Standard Edition
games.description: EA SPORTS FC™ 25 offre nuovi modi di vincere per il club. Fai squadra con gli amici nelle tue modalità preferite con l'inedita Rush 5 vs 5 e porta il club alla vittoria con un controllo tattico più avanzato che mai grazie a FC IQ.

games.title: EA SPORTS FC™ 26 Standard Edition
games.description: Il Club è tuo in EA SPORTS FC™ 26. Gioca a modo tuo con un'esperienza di gioco rivoluzionata dai feedback della community, con le Sfide tecnico Live che regalano nuove trame alla stagione e con gli Archetipi ispirati ai grandi del calcio.

games.title: EA SPORTS™ College Football 27
games.description: Entra nella nuova era del football universitario, dove l'ambizione personale incontra l'orgoglio del programma.

games.title: EA SPORTS™ Madden NFL 25
games.description: Colpisci duro con FieldSENSE™ e BOOM Tech. Il nuovo sistema di contrasto dinamico basato sulla fisica consente collisioni realistiche e nuove animazioni di gioco in attacco e in difesa.

games.title: EA SPORTS™ Madden NFL 26
games.description: Domenica dopo domenica, i dati reali della NFL danno vita al Madden più realistico di sempre.

games.title: EA SPORTS™ Madden NFL 27 Standard Edition
games.description: Gestisci la lega una decisione alla volta. EA SPORTS™ Madden NFL 27, potenziato dal nuovissimo Persona Engine.

games.title: EA SPORTS™ PGA TOUR™
games.description: Unica casa dei Major, EA SPORTS™ PGA TOUR™ presenta Pure Strike, che garantisce un'esperienza di gameplay di golf superiore grazie a ShotLink®, e l'accesso senza precedenti ai più esclusivi campi da golf.

games.title: EA SPORTS™ WRC
games.description: Costruisci l'auto dei tuoi sogni nel nostro più grande gioco di rally di sempre, EA SPORTS™ WRC, il nuovissimo videogioco ufficiale del FIA World Rally Championship, il primo sviluppato dal team pluripremiato della serie DiRT Rally.

games.title: EA SPORTS™ WRC 24
games.description: Prova il brivido della stagione 2024 di rally con nuove località, momenti, tappe, vetture ad alte prestazioni, livree e tanto altro. Preparati a intraprendere il tuo viaggio senza sosta nel rally!

games.title: EA STAR WARS™ TRIPLE BUNDLE
games.description: EA STAR WARS™ TRIPLE BUNDLE

games.title: Earniverse
games.description: A unique VR Metaverse made of a 1080km2 Open-World Map accessible as Free to Play where players can own and build their land in a true AAA graphics environment.

games.title: EARTH DEFENSE FORCE ６
games.description:
Live the future of despair.
The year is 2024 AD. The survivors fought against the remaining threats while trying their best to continue their recovery.Three years passed in the year 2027. In a new world without hope, the time has come to once again resist the fate of the Earth.

games.title: EARTH DEFENSE FORCE: WORLD BROTHERS 2
games.description: The Earth is in pieces...again! We've gotta do more to save the planet!!

games.title: Earth Fire And Wind
games.description: An open world martial-arts elemental magic ARPG.

games.title: EARTHLOCK
games.description: 귀여운 만화 스타일에 속지 마십시오. 이 게임은 도전적입니다. JRPG 장르의 진정한 팬들은 이를 사랑할 것이지만 가벼운 플레이어들은 다른 곳을 찾을 수도 있습니다. 시간을 투자하면 EARTHLOCK이 최고의 전략가조차 시험할 수 있는 깊은 게임플레이로 보답해줄 것입니다.

games.title: Earthworm Jim
games.description: EAT DIRT!

games.title: Earthworm Jim 2
games.description: Two times the fun! Two times the excitement!

games.title: Easter Egg Hunt
games.description: Easter Egg Hunt is a fun scavenger-style game where you roam around your house searching for the hidden Easter Eggs. Once you have collected every Easter Egg in the house you unlock the hidden area to feast on free food to gain boosts to complete the rest of the Easter Egg Hunt!

games.title: Eastern Exorcist
games.description: Gioca a un abile esorcista per combattere contro il male caotico

games.title: Ebenezer and the Invisible World
games.description: Embark on a story-rich 2D Metroidvania adventure, playing as miser-turned-hero Ebenezer Scrooge in a reimagined Victorian-fantasy based on Charles Dickens’ classic novel, A Christmas Carol. Enlist the help of ghosts to save the people of London before it’s too late.

games.title: EBOLA 2
games.description: EBOLA 2 è stato creato nello spirito dei grandi classici dei survival horror. In questo gioco controllerai il personaggio principale con una telecamera in prima persona che ti farà sentire come se fossi in un vero film dell'orrore.

games.title: EBOLA 3
games.description: EBOLA 3 - è stato creato nello spirito dei grandi classici dei survival horror. In questo gioco controllerai il personaggio principale con una telecamera in prima persona che ti farà sentire come se fossi in un vero film dell'orrore.

games.title: EBOLA VILLAGE
games.description: EBOLA VILLAGE - this is a classic survival horror game from the 90s with a focus on atmosphere and player immersion. Solve puzzles, follow the story carefully and use various weapons in a brutal fight for survival. Danger lurks at every turn.

games.title: Echo Flare
games.description: Echo Flare is a full-motion video interactive narrative set in a modern city with secrets and choices. Drawn into a urban adventure, you control the story. Navigate the city, meet diverse characters, and shape branching paths through dialogue, exploration, and quick actions.

games.title: Echo Storm
games.description: Echo Storm is a 2D action with roguelite elements. Survive enemies attack as long as possible. Death resets the progress, but the longer you survive, the more abilities your character gets. Onslaught of enemies is growing too, so - find best abilities combination and destroy 'em!

games.title: Echo Weaver
games.description: A time loop metroidbrainia where time is your best resource and secrets are your only upgrades. You're the last of the Weavers, a remnant of a ruined society trapped in a glitching time loop. Explore what remains. Uncover the mystery. Perfect the loop.

games.title: Echo's of the Dark
games.description: Single Player and Story based Game. Try to find the Truth behind the Missing Friend, and uncover the truth behind the Mental Asylum. This is a Horror and Scientific Based game.

games.title: Echoes of Plum Grove
games.description: A new life awaits you in Honeywood! Build a thriving farming community that will last generations in this cozy farm simulator. Farm, socialize, make friends, cook, craft, forage & uncover the secrets of the island! Someone doesn’t want to be friends? There are always other means.

games.title: Echoes of the Hollow
games.description: Echoes of the Hollow is a psychological first-person horror game set in an abandoned forest village consumed by darkness and secrets. Explore, survive, and uncover the truth before the Hollow consumes you.

games.title: Echoes Within
games.description: Echoes Within is a story-driven, third-person action adventure set in 1930s Cyprus. Blending horror, parkour, and shooter elements, it follows Ann, a silent witness to echoes that claw through sanity and drag her toward a nightmare long forgotten.

games.title: Ecosystem
games.description: Grow and modify an ecosystem, with simulated evolution by natural selection creating the lifeforms that inhabit it. All the creatures in the trailer evolved on their own in the game. None were hand-edited!

games.canonical_title: Ed & Edda: GRAND PRIX – Racing Champions
games.title: Ed & Edda: GRAND PRIX – Racing Champions
games.description: Ed & Edda: GRAND PRIX – Racing Champions is a fun racing game for the whole family that brings the famous mascots of the Europa-Park to life. Players can – either alone or with their friends – race through several European landmarks to find out who is the fastest!
games.developer: Tivola Games GmbH, Funatics Software GmbH

games.title: Eden Island
games.description: Eden Island is a beautiful survival game. As a survivor, you will explore and survive on a realistic tropical island, craft weapons against beasts, farm and hunt, build your own home.

games.title: Eden's Lair
games.description: Fight your way out of purgatory in a series of intense combat arenas.

games.title: Edge of Destruction
games.description: A surreal First-Person Shooter where you destroy the haunting world you created to escape your guilt. Featuring almost full environment destruction.

games.title: Edge Of Eternity
games.description: Combatti epiche battaglie a turni mentre segui Daryon e Selene nella loro ricerca per trovare una cura alla spietata malattia Corrosion, in questa grande storia di speranza e sacrificio.

games.title: Edge of Sanity
games.description: Set in the unforgiving lands of Alaska, Edge of Sanity is a Cthulhu-inspired, 2D survival horror game. Uncover a disturbing story while madness claws at your mind. Lead a group of survivors and explore, scavenge and survive together - against untold eldritch horrors.

games.title: Educational Family Games
games.description: Divertimento educativo pluripremiato! Gioca a 80 giochi rapidi in un gioco per famiglie senza violenza per 1-4 giocatori, doppiato in 19 lingue.

games.title: Effie
games.description: Effie è un gioco di azione e avventura in 3D che combina gli elementi classici del genere, come il combattimento, la piattaforma e i puzzle, con l'esplorazione di un vasto mondo. Sperimenta un'avventura fantasy unica e rivivi le sensazioni dei videogiochi classici!

games.title: Egging On
games.description: Face the challenge of being a real, fragile egg. Climb out of the hen house and survive in a shop, a kitchen, and other dangerous areas. Roll, jump, and use the environment to reach new heights. Don't break your eggshell, and do your best not to fall!

games.title: Egregore
games.description: Embark on a first-person adventure to a mysterious café in Cairo. Adopt a new perspective and shape reality to your will as you unravel an occult conspiracy hidden in plain sight.

games.title: Eigengrau
games.description: A twist at every turn! Explore a colorful shoot 'em up with varied and diverse gameplay beyond the familiar shooting and dodging. Every situation, every enemy, and every boss offers a different handcrafted experience.

games.title: Eiyuden Chronicle: Hundred Heroes
games.description: Eiyuden Chronicle: Hundred Heroes è stato creato per portare ai giocatori una rivisitazione moderna della classica esperienza JRPG. Preparati a condurre più di 100 personaggi giocabili attraverso un mondo dilaniato dalla guerra che solo tu puoi salvare.

games.title: Eiyuden Chronicle: Rising
games.description: Eiyuden Chronicle: Rising è un GDR d'azione ambientato nello stesso mondo di Eiyuden Chronicle: Hundred Heroes. Offre meccaniche di costruzione della città, combattimenti veloci e dei retroscena importanti per molti dei personaggi di Eiyuden Chronicle: Hundred Heroes.

games.canonical_title: Ekikoi: The Young Miss Falls for the Station Attendant - VAM
games.title: Ekikoi: The Young Miss Falls for the Station Attendant - VAM
games.description: A "Video Audio Manga" game of the romance series "Ekikoi: The Young Miss Falls for the Station Attendant".

games.canonical_title: El Hijo – A Wild West Tale
games.title: El Hijo – A Wild West Tale
games.description: "El Hijo - A Wild West Tale" è un eccitante videogioco stealth spaghetti-western, dove guidi un bambino di 6 anni nella missione per trovare la sua madre.

games.title: Elden Gunfire
games.description: Elden Gunfire è un gioco sparatutto in terza persona multigiocatore online PvP e giocatore contro bot con una simpatica grafica 3D a fumetti e un gameplay accattivante.

games.title: Elderand
games.description: Solo i più forti trionferanno in questo cruento platform d'azione con elementi GdR. Smembra creature demoniache e spaventosi boss brandendo letali armi in un intenso scontro di abilità. Uccidi o soccombi cercando di accumulare gloria e tesori in questo mondo in 2D da incubo.

games.title: Eldest Souls
games.description: Dal ritmo serrato e brutalmente impegnativo, Eldest Souls è un'esperienza soulslike unica. In un ultimo atto di vendetta, gli Antichi Dèi scatenarono la Desolazione in tutto il mondo. L'unica speranza per l'umanità è un guerriero solitario… e il suo spadone di pura ossidiana.

games.title: ELDRADOR CREATURES: SHADOWFALL
games.description: Description is not set

games.title: Eldrem
games.description:
Tame. Breed. Train. Conquer. 
In Eldrem, dragons and fantasy creatures are more than just companions, they’re your path to glory. Explore floating islands, hatch and raise beasts, build kingdoms, defend your lands and lead epic battles across the skies in this fantasy ARPG

games.title: Eleanor Is Out of Time
games.description: Jump through time in an instant with an unprecedented level of freedom in an open world. After crash landing in the distant past Eleanor must use her time travelling powers to piece together her broken ship, rescue her crew and navigate through alternate futures full of dangers.

games.title: Electrician Simulator
games.description: Take on the electrician role and learn the profession's basics! Install sockets, repair worn-out equipment, assemble broken appliances, replace light bulbs, and lay wires at your customers' homes. Be sure to check everything twice, with electricity there are no jokes!

games.title: ElectriX
games.description: ElectriX è un gioco di simulazione di riparazione di apparecchiature elettroniche con un tocco oscuro di cospirazione. Nel gioco potremo riparare dispositivi elettronici moderni e retrò come: console, computer, telefoni cellulari e altre apparecchiature elettroniche.

games.title: Electro Magnate
games.description: Energy business clicker: buy power generators, batteries and equip a sales office.

games.title: ElectroFix Simulator
games.description: Own an electronics repair shop! Fix phones, solder circuits & replace components in this co-op store management sim. Build your workshop, earn big!

games.title: ELEGIES Aya
games.description: After losing his parents and barely escaping his burning home, Zach wakes up in the hospital where he meets Aya, the ghost of a girl. Who is she, and why can only Zach see her? Together they try to investigate Aya's past, which quickly awakens new dangers.

games.title: Elemental Exiles
games.description: Elemental Exiles è un deckbuilder GdR in stile rogue. Impersona uno dei 12 eroi, ciascuno con la propria missione personale e con carte iniziali e luogo di partenza specifici. Supera battaglie impegnative e affronta incontri inaspettati mentre esplori e migliori il tuo mazzo.

games.title: Elemental War 2
games.description: Elemental War 2 ti offre la popolare sensazione dei tower defense combinata con meccaniche di gioco innovative - il mix definitivo per molte ore di divertimento!

games.title: Elemental Wizards TCG
games.description: Elemental Wizards is a card strategy game where mages challenge each other in mystical duels to bring honor and glory to their clan. Each mage counts with a vast spell knowledge, henchmen, and allies who assist them in their fight to subject the enemy forces.

games.title: Eleven
games.description: Eleven is a competitive space arena shooter where players lock on and battle in fast-paced, skill-based matches. Customize your ship’s look and outfly opponents in zero-gravity arenas. No power-ups—just pure precision, reflexes, and strategy.

games.title: ELEX
games.description: ELEX è un GDR d'azione disegnato a mano, sviluppato dai pluripremiati creatori della serie Gothic e ambientato in un nuovo universo fantascientifico post-apocalittico.

games.title: ELEX II
games.description: In this sequel to the vintage Open World RPG ELEX, Jax must once again unite the free people of the Science-Fantasy world of Magalan against a new threat - the Skyands, who want to change the face of the planet forever.

games.title: Elflock
games.description: Immerse yourself in a fairy tale, where your actions shape the story! Become a princess, navigate the murky political landscape, forge an alliance with the Fae, or turn your back on them. Make decisions that could save your kingdom or destroy it if you misjudge the circumstances.

games.title: Elite Dangerous
games.description: Controlla la tua navicella in una galassia spietata. Elite Dangerous è il multigiocatore massivo spaziale definitivo, che offre un'originale avventura open world alla generazione moderna, con una storia in costante evoluzione e la Via Lattea in tutta la sua completezza.

games.title: Elite Strike Team
games.description: Elite Strike Team is a fast-paced multiplayer FPS that combines tactical teamwork, strategy, and intense firefights. Players form elite squads empowered by mythical ancient forces and battle across varied maps and game modes. The game is currently in early development!

games.title: Elven Rivers 2 New Horizons
games.description: Help fantastical beastlands and protect them from the orc threat. Find new friends when you least expect it!

games.title: Elven Rivers 4: Raging Waves
games.description: Fight the tides, stop the flood, and find an ally where you least expect it in this thrilling fantasy adventure story!

games.title: Elven Rivers 5: Under Sea
games.description: Explore the boundless ocean, uncover hidden treasures, and befriend two powerful princes of the underwater kingdom!

games.canonical_title: Elven Rivers 6: Guardians of Hope Collector's Edition
games.title: Elven Rivers 6: Guardians of Hope Collector's Edition
games.description: New lands awaits! Fight, explore and befriend a grumpy yet charismatic dwarf in most exciting and dangerous journey of your life!

games.canonical_title: Elven Rivers 7: The Crimson Tide Collector's Edition
games.title: Elven Rivers 7: The Crimson Tide Collector's Edition
games.description: Harsh cold lands awaits! Fight, explore and befriend a young kind-hearted mermaid in most thrilling and perilous adventure of your life!

games.canonical_title: Elven Rivers. The Forgotten Lands Collector's Edition
games.title: Elven Rivers. The Forgotten Lands Collector's Edition
games.description: In this game in the genre of time management you need for a limited time to manage to collect and properly distribute the resources that you collect on the level.

games.title: Elypse
games.description: Scopri il mondo devastato di Elypse sulle note di un racconto struggente. Affronta il tuo destino in un platformer con meccaniche in stile metroidvania, all’interno di un ambiente misterioso e suggestivo.

games.title: Ember and Blade
games.description:
Become the immortal hunter and stand against the archdemon Asmodeus. Cut through bullet-hell swarms, clash with Souls-like bosses, and harness celestial blessings that reshape your powers each run. 
The demons are rising—raise your sword.

games.title: Emergency Crew 2 Global Warming
games.description: Hurricanes are raging in Sunland! Once again, Stephen Shepard leads an Emergency Crew to help people in their hour of need and get to the bottom of what's going on.

games.canonical_title: Emergency Crew 4: Call of the Ancestors Collector's Edition
games.title: Emergency Crew 4: Call of the Ancestors Collector's Edition
games.description: Emergency Crew 4 - an exciting strategy of selfless heroes in the time of a disaster!

games.canonical_title: Emergency Crew 5: Blazing Vacation Collector's Edition
games.title: Emergency Crew 5: Blazing Vacation Collector's Edition
games.description: New Challenge: The rescue team battles chaos even on vacation!

games.title: Empire of Ember
games.description: Empire of Ember è un GDR d'azione epico-fantasy in prima persona con strategia in tempo reale ed elementi gestionali ambientato nel mondo di fantasia del suo predecessore spirituale, Ember.

games.title: Empire of the Ants
games.description: Conquista i nidi dei nemici e guida la tua colonia tra i pericoli della foresta in questo innovativo videogioco strategico in tempo reale.

games.title: Empire of the Gods
games.description: Ancient Egypt cards. Master power, wealth, faith and life. Work your way up from a small tribe to a flourishing Empire. Win the Gods' favor and become the mightiest Pharaoh.

games.title: Empires of the Undergrowth
games.description: Guida sciami di insetti in una scala bellica senza precedenti in questo mix di RTS e costruzione di basi. Conduci colonie di formiche contro le minacce del mondo degli insetti: crea formicai intricati, sviluppa tattiche basate sui feromoni ed evolvi per affrontare i pericoli.

games.title: Empyreal
games.description:
Empyreal è un RPG d'azione complesso, impegnativo e sfaccettato.

In un angolo remoto della galassia una spedizione giunge fino a un pianeta inesplorato, dove scopre un colossale Monolite costruito da un'antica civiltà perduta.

games.title: Empyrion - Galactic Survival
games.description: Build and explore in a true space sandbox survival adventure. Construct mighty capital vessels, sprawling planetary settlements, and vast space stations in your galactic journey to discover the mysteries of Empyrion

games.title: Encased
games.description: GDR tattico a sfondo fantascientifico ambientato in una versione alternativa degli anni '70, in cui un gigantesco manufatto sconosciuto chiamato "Dome" (la cupola) viene scoperto in un lontano deserto. Combatti, esplora strane lande desolate, fai salire di livello il tuo personaggio e unisciti a una delle forze che operano in questo mondo in rovina.

games.title: Enchanted Portals
games.description: Battaglie estreme contro boss folli in questo intenso platform 2D

games.title: End of Abyss
games.description: Gioca nei panni della giovane ingegnera militare Cel, scopri i segreti celati nelle aree abbandonate della struttura e affronta le creature mostruose che le abitano.

games.title: End The World
games.description: Bring the End of the World in this story-driven retro title about love and hate, light and dark, and all the ways everything could end in a snap. Play as multiple characters as you traverse the kingdom of Ionis trying to put an end to tyranny by any means possible.

games.canonical_title: ENDER LILIES: Quietus of the Knights
games.title: ENDER LILIES: Quietus of the Knights
games.description: La storia di Lily e del cavaliere imperituro inizia a Finis, un regno caduto in rovina a causa della necropioggia. Un RPG a scorrimento orizzontale ambientato in un mondo tragico e bellissimo, in cui un istante d'esitazione può essere fatale.

games.title: EndGame
games.description: The ultimate action sci-fi RPG adventure, travel across time and explore places humans cannot go. Powerful monsters blocking your path and dangerous dungeons await you.

games.title: Endix
games.description: Explore unique & immersive booths from your favorite games. Watch exclusive trailers, compete in mini-games, and connect with players, creators & developers from around the world. All inside a living, free multiplayer experience.

games.title: ENDLESS™ Dungeon - Definitive Edition
games.description: ENDLESS™ Dungeon - Definitive Edition

games.title: ENDLESS™ Legend 2
games.description: Guida il tuo popolo alla vittoria in un mondo in continua evoluzione in questo gioco strategico con fazioni asimmetriche guidate da potenti eroi. Costruisci il tuo impero, esercita la tua influenza politica e combatti per scoprire oscuri segreti sepolti nel pianeta.

games.title: Endling - Extinction is Forever
games.description: Come l'ultima mamma volpe, i tuoi cuccioli hanno bisogno di te per sopravvivere in un mondo che si distrugge. Aiutali, istruiscili e salvali. Ricorda: l'estinzione è per sempre – nel mondo reale e in questa esperienza vincitrice del BAFTA 2023.

games.title: Enemania
games.description: Brace for enemies, prepare for mania. Hordes monstrous enemies are after your treasure! The only thing that keeps them away is your arsenal of weaponry: cannons, catapults and bombs. Arrange your weapons carefully and defeat the enemies before they reach your treasure.

games.title: Engines of Fury
games.description: Engines of Fury is a top-down extraction shooter. Fight thrilling battles against human survivors and alien mutants. Scavenge for valuable resources and upgrade your hideout to survive in a post-apocalyptic wasteland.

games.title: Enigma's Edge
games.description: Enigma's Edge™ is a roguelike science-fantasy RPG where you lead a party of three adventurers through a vast, darkly beautiful world filled with monsters, hidden treasures, and intricate clockwork puzzles.

games.title: Enjoy the Diner
games.description: Why not enjoy the diner? The moon is as full as it'll ever be, and there's even a drink fountain.

games.title: Enki's Return
games.description:
Enkis Return is a fantasy adventure inspired by Sumerian mythology about the God Enki.

In this Saga, Enki and his wife Ninki must confront the corrupters, the destroyers, the zombies, the monsters and defeat them all.

games.title: Enotria: The Last Song
games.description: "Enotria: The Last Song" is a thrilling Soulsike set in a sun-lit land inspired by Italian folklore and filled with danger

games.title: Enter the Gungeon
games.description: Proiettili, armi e risate

games.title: Entomophobia
games.description: A top-down Roguelite Bullethell where you kill thousands of Bugs! Get up to 5 Automatic firing Weapons, and a Controllable Weapon too. Slay Bugs, Get Upgrades, and Kill More.  Pick from 3 Upgrade Cards on Level Up, choose correctly may your choice bring great damage and glory.

games.title: Enypnion Redreamed
games.description: Entra in un'avventura surreale che scava nel profondo della mente subconscia di un giovane ragazzo. Guidato da uno spirito del sogno, risolvi enigmi ed esplora un regno di inquietante meraviglia, mentre trovi la strada per tornare nel mondo della veglia.

games.title: EONA
games.description: Immergiti nel racconto oscuro e inquietante di **Eona**. Sopravvivi ai pericoli del **castello** della **malvagia fata Mélusine,** da troppo tempo in attesa di un'anima da tormentare. Fuggi da questo luogo maledetto con il tuo bottino, nella speranza di salvare tua madre.

games.title: Epic Cards Battle 3
games.description: Online strategy multiplayer CCG,TCG card battle game. Play tactic Auto Chess, PVP, PVE, RPG battles with players all over the world. Experience a fantasy world of marvel, magic, onmyoji and heros.

games.title: Epic Chef
games.description: Preparati a partire per questo viaggio culinario in cui impersonerai Zest: iniziando con poco, dovrai costruire una fattoria, coltivare ingredienti deliziosi, costruire macchinari e cucinare senza sosta fino a diventare lo chef più leggendario di Ambrosia!

games.title: Epic World - Hunt For Quest
games.description: Epic World è un gioco d'azione platform con elementi complicati, tesori nascosti e nemici pericolosi. Diventi un avventuriero che esplora livelli in continua evoluzione per riconquistare l'oro rubato al re degli orchi.
games.developer: Yash Future Tech Solutions Pvt Ltd
games.publisher: Yash Future Tech Solutions Pvt Ltd

games.title: epic zone battleroyal
games.description: Zone" is an engaging battle royale game that offers fast-paced action and strategic gameplay, set in a dynamic, immersive environment. Its smooth graphics, intuitive controls, and well-designed maps create an exciting experience for both newcomers and seasoned players.

games.title: Epidaurum Reborn
games.description: Adventure in medieval Mediterranean city.

games.title: Epistory - Typing Chronicles
games.description: Epistory immerses you in an atmospheric game where you play a girl riding a giant fox who fights an insectile corruption from an origami world. As you progress and explore this world, the story literally unfolds and the mysteries of the magic power of the words are revealed.

games.title: Epsylon
games.description: A private eye mystery game where you decide how to solve the case. Use your detective skills to solve the case or rely on the abilities of your little dragon partner to see things from a new angle.

games.title: ER-cade
games.description: A game for the medically curious! Explore the human heart inside and out, cause heart attacks and other diseases, and complete challenges to unlock abilities. Then use your newfound skills to play challenging arcade-style games and compete in online leaderboards!

games.title: Ergenekon
games.description: Ergenekon è un gioco single player in terza persona, basato sulla storia, cinematografico e lineare, sull'epopea turca Ergenekon. Sarai testimone della rinascita dei Turchi con Ergenekon.

games.title: Eriksholm: The Stolen Dream
games.description: Experience an isometric, narrative-driven stealth game and join Hanna’s adventure in the vibrant city of Eriksholm. The mysterious disappearance of her brother, Herman, ignites a chain of catastrophic events that will forever change their lives and the fate of the entire city.

games.title: Ertugrul of Ulukayin
games.description: Become a medieval warrior in this action-adventure game. Discover traditional myths and fight for your tribe. Mount your horse, sharpen your weapons and explore an ancient semi-open world.

games.title: Escape Academy
games.description: Welcome to Escape Academy. Train to become the ultimate Escapist. Solve Puzzles. Hack Servers. Meet the Faculty. Brew the perfect cup of tea. Escape Rooms in single player or co-op with a friend - local or online!

games.title: Escape Academy 2: Back 2 School
games.description: Class is (back) in session with Escape Academy 2: Back 2 School! Explore an all-new campus, escape life-threatening puzzle rooms,and unravel a conspiracy as old as the school itself, all before the bell rings. Play solo or grab a friend and start solving in online or local co-op.

games.title: Escape Camp Stranded
games.description: Escape Camp Stranded is a short, single player, horror game with some puzzle elements, set at night, in a campground. A recurring nightmare brings you back to a childhood memory you wished you'd forgotten. Now, you must finally escape the nightmare from within.

games.title: Escape First Alchemist
games.description: First-person escape game, play solo or with up to 4 people. Solve riddles of a reclusive alchemist that trapped you in his workshop. Brew potions and overcome challenges as he laughs at your failures and makes light of your successes...But what if things are not what they seem?

games.title: Escape from Blackwood
games.description: From wanting to go visit a castle to being trapped inside it. Solve the clues and discover how to escape from it.

games.title: Escape from Duckov
games.description: Escape from Duckov is a PVE top-down looter-shooter game—in a duck's world!. Scavenge for resources, build your hideout, and upgrade your gear in the world of Duckov. Start from nothing and rise to the top. Outwit hostile ducks, survive, or make it out alive.

games.title: Escape From Lavender Island
games.description: Explore a dream that refuses to end. As Zede Aksis, wander a surreal city that feels both alive and liminal, filled with digital citizens and absurd infrastructure. Can you find an escape? A way out of a world that remembers you better than you remember it?

games.title: Escape From Mystwood Mansion
games.description: In this first-person puzzle escape room game, you are trapped in the mysterious Mystwood mansion. Explore the mansion and find hidden compartments while solving puzzles and deciphering codes to find a way out. Will you escape or linger to uncover the mansion's final secret?

games.title: Escape from Tarkov: Arena
games.description: EfT: Arena è uno sparatutto con un alto livello di realismo, dove le proprie abilità e il gioco di squadra stanno alla base di tutto Non avrete meccaniche arcade: ma scontri PvP duri e dinamici, con meccanica delle armi e balistica dettagliate, richiederanno padronanza e maestria

games.title: Escape from Tung Tung Sahur
games.description:
You wake up trapped in a creepy, abandoned village — no lights, no friends, just you... and a whole lot of trouble.
You’ve got one job: save the poor, caged Brainrot animals that the terrifying Tung Tung Sahur has locked up... and get them out safely.

games.title: Escape the Charon
games.description: Escape the Charon è un'avventura di fantascienza. Un antico manufatto alieno è stato portato sulla stazione spaziale Caronte: subito dopo la Caronte si oscura. Cerca indizi e risolvi il mistero per scoprire cosa è andato storto.

games.title: Escape The Loop
games.description: Come reagiresti se ti dicessi che questa non è la prima volta che visiti questa pagina? Hai già letto queste parole, visto queste schermate di gioco e guardato questo trailer. Non una, bensì un centinaio di volte, e forse anche di più. E dopo cinque minuti non ti ricorderai più niente di quello che hai fatto: ripetendo così ogni tua azione.

games.title: Escape the Riddlerock Ruins
games.description: Esplora le antiche Riddlerock Ruin con il tuo fedele amico a quattro zampe in questa escape room videoludica in prima persona. Risolvi enigmi, decifra antiche iscrizioni, scopri passaggi nascosti e padroneggia meccanismi ancestrali lasciati da una civiltà perduta.

games.title: EscapeGameShow : THE TIMELINE
games.description: Sei stato sorteggiato per partecipare a The Escape Game Show e provare a vincere il jackpot.

games.title: Esophaguys
games.description: You are the Esophaguys, old folks with elongating necks. Stretch, bite, and swing together in co-op, compete in minigames for long-necked glory, and embark on a narrated story! Featuring the world's first soundscape composed of twanging tones and elderly grunts.

games.title: Espiocracy
games.description: Espiocracy è un gioco di strategia spionistico. Dirigi i servizi segreti di una delle 74 nazioni giocabili e riscrivi la storia dall'ombra influenzando ideologie, tramando colpi di stato e ordendo guerre per procura. Sarà il sotterfugio a dettare il nuovo ordine mondiale.

games.title: Esplosione artistica
games.description: Continua a raccogliere monete per sbloccare diverse forme e creare le tue opere!

games.title: Esse Proxy
games.description: Un abile, elegante e brutale sparatutto a doppia levetta con visuale dall'alto. Uccidi o muori è il mantra che ti servirà per svelare i segreti di Esse Proxy in questa storia ricca d'azione ambientata in una città cyberpunk distopica.

games.title: Eternal League
games.description: In Eternal League, you'll embark on an epic journey through a fast-paced roguelike RPG that combines customization, strategic combat, and a unique session-based progression system that rewards your skill and creativity.

games.title: Eternal Night - Spooky Solitaire
games.description: Play a game of “Eternal Night” solitaire, set in a spooky Halloween environment. Haunting backgrounds and matching card decks create a suspenseful atmosphere, accompanied by atmospheric music.

games.title: Eternal Rebirth -Curses of love-
games.description: Real Miss Maxims as Game Protagonists?! A Grand Interactive Game Featuring Top-Tier Miss Maxims! Can You Unravel the Secrets of Your Past Life and Find Happiness in the Present While Traveling Between Modern Times and Historical Eras?

games.title: Eternal Strands
games.description: Affronta epiche creature torreggianti, unendo le tua abilità magiche a un arsenale di armi potenti per impedire al mondo di andare in pezzi in questo gioco d'azione e avventura in terza persona.

games.title: Eternal Threads
games.description: Eternal Threads è un gioco di rompicapo single player in prima persona dove la manipolazione del tempo, le scelte e le relative conseguenze giocheranno un ruolo importantissimo.

games.title: Eternights
games.description: Eternights è un gioco d'azione/simulatore di appuntamenti dove cerchi di vivere al massimo durante l'apocalisse. Lunedì: seratina romantica. Martedì: razzia nel dungeon. Venerdì: crisi di nervi! Il tempo scorre!

games.title: Eternis: Death Match
games.description: Welcome to Eternis, a realm where history's greatest minds and warriors collide in a 23rd-century fighting arena

games.title: Eternity Convergence
games.description: Eternity Convergence is a Sci-fi RPG. The player begins their journey as a pilot in the human controlled galaxy of Ennae. After building up a crew and a small fleet of ships the player can explore hundreds of planets and a number of galaxies to uncover a hidden plot.

games.title: Eternity's Echo: Patient Zero
games.description: Witness anomalies at a gas station in Winona, Arizona. Experience the tense atmosphere of the gas station through the eyes of Rayne Williams, an experienced D.I.B Agent. Explore the story with your own playstyle.

games.title: Eternium
games.description: Hack & slash against the dark forces threatening your home-world. Experience intense tactical fights in this fast paced, old school action RPG.

games.title: Etherborn
games.description: Delve into an environmental puzzle platformer built on exploring and understanding gravity-shifting structures. You are a voiceless being that has just been born into a world where a bodiless voice awaits your arrival. Go forth and seek your purpose.

games.title: ETHERNITY
games.description:
Are you ready to play... for money?
Jump into the first AI-powered shooter, ETHERNITY! 
Play, fight, trade, and earn $ETNT tokens in thrilling game modes. 
Join ETHERNITY, where every shot counts!

games.title: Etherscape
games.description: Enter the Etherscape to battle for epic loot in a world where players drive the blockchain economy.

games.title: Etrange Overlord
games.description: Join Étrange on this musical odyssey as she seeks to conquer hell in the pursuit of living her best afterlife.

games.title: Euphoria: Supreme Mechanics
games.description: La capacità di discernere le connessioni nascoste è sia un dono che una maledizione. I meccanismi nascosti della realtà non si rivelano a tutti, e c'è un prezzo da pagare per questa conoscenza...

games.title: Europa Universalis IV
games.description: Rule your land and dominate the world with unparalleled freedom, depth and historical accuracy. Write a new history of the world and build an empire for the ages.

games.title: Evan's Remains
games.description: Anni dopo la scomparsa di Evan, un ragazzo prodigio, viene consegnata una bizzarra lettera. Evan vuole che una ragazza di nome Dysis lo cerchi. Nei panni di Dysis dovrai risolvere una serie intricata di rompicapi per svelare l'intero mistero e riportare Evan a casa.

games.title: EVE Online
games.description: EVE Online è un MMO spaziale free-to-play gestito dalla comunità, dove i giocatori possono scegliere il loro percorso tra innumerevoli opzioni. Vivi appieno l'esplorazione dello spazio, delle battaglie PvP e PvE su larga scala, l'estrazione di risorse, l'industria e la fiorent...

games.title: Everafter Falls
games.description: Rediscover the simple life. Farm, fish, forge and fight to restore the peace in an all-new farming adventure. Features split-screen coop, a helpful pet, automated drones, resourceful pixies, a card-eating progression system, and dangerous dungeons to delve into!

games.title: Everdream Valley
games.description: A farming adventure with a breath of magic. By day, restore your homestead - raise crops, care for animals and rebuild your farm. At night become the various farmland creatures through your dreams.
games.publisher: Untold Tales S.A. Varsav Game Studio

games.title: Evergreen Tavern
games.description: Run a cozy medieval tavern... staffed by monsters from your basement! Grow and cook delicious things and serve them to your customers. Decorate and customize your place. Explore dark places, befriend and hire monsters, and sell your loot for a good price!

games.title: Evergreen Valley: The Parkour Game
games.description: Evergreen Valley is a parkour adventure set in a stylized town. Jump, climb, and conquer every obstacle to reach the top! But beware! One fall, and it’s back to the very beginning!

games.title: Everholm
games.description: Lilly was spirited away to a mysterious island. As her memories fade, everyone seems to know about her quest for her missing sister. It’s time to establish a homestead, meet the islanders, learn their secrets and solve the mystery of Everholm in this open-ended minimalist RPG!

games.title: Everhood
games.description: Un GDR D'AVVENTURA NON CONVENZIONALE ambientato in un mondo ineffabile, colmo di incredibili battaglie musicali e incontri deliziosamente peculiari. Ne vedremo delle belle.

games.title: Everlasting Guilt
games.description: if you’re into Doom, Furi \ Titan Souls, this game will fulfill your needs with its FPS, fast-paced gameplay that heavily focuses on Boss fights, each with a unique approach that has its own mechanics, and a load of enemies to unleash your anger and test your arsenal upon.

games.title: EverRail
games.description: Move or freeze! EverRail is an open world survival craft odyssey set in a frozen wasteland. Ride the rails! Glide through the air! Brave the cold on foot!

games.title: Everreach: Project Eden
games.description: Take on the role of Nora Harwood, member of Everreach’s Security Division, on a mission to secure the colonization process of Eden and investigate mysterious incidents! Everreach: Project Eden is a fast-paced, story-driven action-RPG set on the visually stunning Planet Eden.

games.title: Evershire
games.description: Discover the ever-growing lands of Evershire. A cozy, minimalist strategy builder that encourages creativity and offers a challenge to those looking for one. Decide whether you want to create and decorate your own worlds in creative mode or try your hand at managing resources.

games.title: EverSiege: Untold Ages
games.description: Liberate Bastion, humanity’s last refuge. Defend against evil hordes, reclaim lost powers, rebuild ancient ruins, and adapt your tactics to break the everSiege. A top-down action-strategy rogue-lite where choices shape every run, playable solo or up to 3 players in co-op.

games.title: Everstorm
games.description: Slay hordes of monsters as you compete with other teams to defeat the final boss and escape alive. Each match you will choose a class, level up, buy gear, customize your abilities and choose game changing buffs. Unlock permanent upgrades in between matches and go back for more!

games.title: Every Day We Fight
games.description: Fermo in un loop temporale, il tuo gruppo di combattenti per la libertà è l'ultima speranza degli umani. Esplorazione in tempo reale unita a tattiche a turni e strategie rogue-lite: apprendi abilità, trova armi e usa nuove tecniche per fermare l'oscura minaccia aliena.

games.title: Everything
games.description: Sii l'universo!

games.title: Everything is Crab
games.description: Il roguelite sull'evoluzione degli animali. Caccia, scappa, cerca e prospera in un ecosistema vivo. Scegli tra più di 125 evoluzioni e specializzazioni per combinazioni di creature uniche a ogni sessione. Adattati per battere la carcinizzazione... o soccombi all'ordine naturale!

games.canonical_title: Everything is going to be OK
games.title: Everything is going to be OK
games.description: "Everything is going to be OK" is a desktop labyrinth of vignettes, poetry, strange fever dream games, and broken digital spaces. It is a collection of life experiences that are largely a commentary on struggle, survival, and coping with the aftermath of surviving bad things.

games.title: Evil Nun: The Broken Mask
games.description: Entra nell'incubo di Evil Nun.  In trappola in una scuola maledetta, devi scappare da Suor Madeline. Lei è astuta, esplora ogni angolo, ti attira e ti parla in base alle tue azioni. Risolvi rompicapi,  crea oggetti e svela il mistero in questo gioco horror con diverse vie di fuga

games.title: Evil Seal
games.description: Evil Seal: Un action horror ispirato all' Apocalisse di San Giovanni. Gioca nei panni dell' ex-marine Adam, salva sua moglie da forze demoniache. Risolvi puzzle e enigmi. Modalità storia e survivor ti attendono con oltre 10 ore. Prima/Terza persona

games.title: Evoland Legendary Edition
games.description: Evoland Legendary Edition ti farà vivere due fantastici GDR unici, con uno stile grafico e un sistema di gioco che evolvono mentre avanzi nella storia!

games.title: Evoluzione motore 2023
games.description: Il tuo MMO di corse preferito è tornato, questa volta con tracciati incredibili, una fisica più divertente e molto altro ancora! Godetevi le corse multigiocatore più intense che mai!

games.title: Evoluzione Sidecar 2024
games.description: È arrivato il primo vero gioco di corse di sidecar MMO! Gioca con un massimo di 39 amici!

games.title: Evolve
games.description: Evolve is a cutting-edge benchmarking suite designed to push the limits of modern hardware. Evolve is not just a benchmark; it's a comprehensive tool for understanding and optimizing your hardware's capabilities in the evolving landscape of computer graphics and performance.

games.title: Ex Natura Nature Corrupted
games.description: Ex Natura: Nature Corrupted is a souls-like game with Enrage mechanic which sets in a Nature themed dark fantasy world. Fight your way from the deepest dungeons to the top of the clouds and save the corrupted nature in this mysterious "pre-human" era-themed epic story.

games.title: Excavator Simulator - REMAKE
games.description: After mobile devices, Excavator Simulator REMAKE has finally arrived on the PC platform for you.

games.title: Exclusive memory
games.description: Exclusive memory "is a first person immersive suspense love full dynamic live action interactive video game. A sudden accident caused you to lose your memory. Can you retrieve your memories and everything that belongs to you in the turbulent undercurrents?

games.title: Eximius: Seize the Frontline
games.description: EXIMIUS è un gioco che si incentra sui combattimenti a squadre, unendo il genere dello sparatutto in prima persona e quello dello strategico in tempo reale. Con questo gioco potrai vivere un'intensa esperienza multigiocatore 5 contro 5 in cui ogni squadra sarà composta da 4 uf...

games.title: EXIT DATA
games.description: This simulation observes players heading toward exits and retreating when they sense something unusual. When the count reaches 9, the AI’s “learning” is complete. Note: The AI is a fictional element within the story, and no actual AI technology is used.

games.title: Exit: Left or Right
games.description: Puoi andare a destra o a sinistra, ma ricorda che un errore ti costerà la vita...

games.title: Exo Mayhem
games.description: Exo Mayhem è l'esperienza definitiva da supercattivo! Vola, spara, pugnala, esplodi ed esplora Paradise Mall, un mondo aperto lussureggiante con diversi biomi pronto per essere conquistato!

games.title: Exo One
games.description: Uno strano segnale… un'astronave aliena… Exo One è un viaggio interplanetario che sfida la gravità attraverso lo spazio e il tempo.  Padroneggia un sistema di traversata veramente diverso e spostati in paesaggi alieni enigmatici e desolati in modi che non hai mai sperimentato.

games.title: EXODUS
games.description: EXODUS™ è un GDR fantascientifico di azione e avventura dove, in qualità di Traveler, guiderai la lotta per la sopravvivenza umana contro i Celestial. Esplora mondi straordinari e sfida il tempo per plasmare il destino di intere generazioni, in un futuro distante 40.000 anni.

games.title: ExoGP
games.description: FLY, FIGHT, SURVIVE. A high-stakes racing experience set in a hostile universe, ExoGP merges the thrill of flight-based racing with the strategic depth of combat and customization. Race and battle ruthless competition to make a name for yourself as a legend of the skies.

games.title: Exographer
games.description: Exographer è un'avventura ispirata alla scienza. Diventa un esploratore, naufragato su un pianeta alieno, e scopri i segreti di una civiltà estinta. Acquisisci nuovi poteri per evitare pericoli e ostacoli nel tuo viaggio, e usa la tua fotocamera per rivelare particelle nascosti.

games.title: EXOMECHA
games.description: Sparatutto multigiocatore

games.title: Exotic Cars VI
games.description: Il gioco cerca di seguire gli eventi della vita reale, quindi quando un marchio lancia un nuovo prodotto questo si riflette nel gioco. Ciò consente al giocatore di integrarsi nel mondo in modo organico e semplice, il giocatore può mangiare, bere, guidare qualsiasi marca di auto, comprare vestiti, ecc.
games.publisher: Lany Games Inc S.A de C.V.

games.title: Expedition Zero
games.description: Expedition Zero, un survival horror ambientato in una zona anomala nel cuore della Siberia. Affronta gli inquietanti mostri della foresta e trova il modo di sconfiggerli. Scopri i segreti di una spedizione perduta e del tuo misterioso avversario.

games.title: Expedition: Crushing Depth
games.description:
Expedition: Crushing Depth is about controlling a submarine, with an atmospheric environment and slight horror elements.
Maintain and operate your submarine in order to reach the deepest point in the ocean, but watch out for dangers!

games.title: Expeditions: A MudRunner Game
games.description: Conduci le missioni di ricerca guidando una gran varietà di veicoli, utilizzando strumenti altamente tecnologici e gestendo il tuo accampamento e la tua squadra per assicurarti il successo.

games.title: Expeditions: Conquistador
games.description: Conquista il nuovo mondo: nel 16° secolo, gli esploratori e i soldati spagnoli hanno raggiunto le coste delle Americhe. In cerca di ricchezza, gloria e avventura, questi viaggiatori si sono addentrati in terre selvagge insidiose dove hanno dovuto fronteggiare fame, malattie e ...

games.title: Expeditions: Rome
games.description: Determine the destiny of Rome as you conquer foreign lands and navigate political intrigue in this turn-based RPG. Directly fight with your party of Praetorians, guide your legion to victory, and choose your own path in a story where every decision matters.

games.title: Expeditions: Viking
games.description: Ci troviamo all'incirca nel 790 d.C Un piccolo gruppo di guerrieri nordici arriva sulle coste dell'Inghilterra. I libri di storia avranno pure dimenticato come si chiamano, ma le loro gesta vivranno in eterno. Sarai il capotribù del tuo clan: lascia che sia l'ambizione a guida...

games.title: Extinct Forest
games.description: Fight for your life in a mysterious open world. In Extinct Forest, there are no crosshairs and no HUD — just you and your weapon against intelligent dinosaurs. Explore a forest, solve environmental puzzles, and master realistic combat mechanics in this immersive shooter.

games.title: Extreme Bike Racing
games.description: Extreme Bike Racing è l'ultimo gioco di corse in bici 3D per tutte le età. Ci sono 3 fasi con 3 sfide in ogni fase in cui il giocatore deve affrontare diversi ostacoli e difficoltà per completare quella sfida.
games.developer: Yash Future Tech Solutions Pvt Ltd
games.publisher: Yash Future Tech Solutions Pvt Ltd

games.title: Extreme Bus Driver 2024
games.description: Are you ready to become an experienced bus driver? Experience the thrill of transporting passengers in a realistic city with Extreme Bus Driver 2024! Get passengers to their destination on time and safely, earn rewards and customize your bus.

games.title: Extreme Car Drift Simulator

games.description: Fight For Your Resurrection is a fighting game with dynamic A.I., Anaglyph support, Gamepad support. When You loose a match the difficult level decrease! When You win consecutively two matches the difficult level increase! I dare You to finish the game never losing a match!

games.title: Fight Life: Vanguard
games.description: Lead a squad of brave adventurers through a war-torn world besieged by darkness.

games.title: Fighters Forge
games.description: A frantic 4 player arena fighting game featuring both versus & beat 'em up co-op adventure modes!

games.title: Fights in Tight Spaces
games.description: Fights in Tight Spaces combina la costruzione di mazzi, le tattiche a turni e coinvolgenti sequenze di combattimento animate che si svolgono in ambientazioni tipiche dei film d'azione. Impara a bilanciare le carte della tua mano, il ritmo dello scontro e le posizioni per ribal...

games.title: Figment
games.description: Figment è un gioco d'azione-avventura che ti invita a esplorare un universo unico e surreale pieno di musica, umorismo e narrativa su più livelli.

games.description: Figment 2: Creed Valley è un gioco d'azione-avventura ambientato nella mente umana. Gli incubi stanno seminando il caos e hanno invaso delle terre un tempo pacifiche. games.description: Risolvi enigmi complicati basati sui cavi e scopri cosa sia successo veramente all'equipaggio della Alabaster. Adesso offre un sistema di indizi (per gli enigmi particolarmente complessi).

games.title: File Destined
games.description: Can this last case of Oliver, all be just a small part of a bigger picture? Gather clues, unravel the mystery behind the case and uncover the truth.

games.title: Filthy Animals
games.description: Filthy Animals è un gioco multigiocatore per 1-4 giocatori dove si effettuano rapine. Vesti i panni di animali mutanti che seguono gli ordini di Tony, la mente dietro l'operazione. Pasticcia durante le rapine, usa i poteri mutanti e ciò che ti circonda per evitare la sicurezza…

games.title: Filthy Us Complete Edition
games.description: Filthy Us: Complete Edition is an original horror adventure game with a dark story and puzzle elements. The game not only contains a large number of Buddhist and oriental elements, but also the horrifying customs of the people who used to live in that world.

games.title: FINAL FANTASY VII REBIRTH
games.description:
Il viaggio verso l'ignoto continua...

Dopo essere fuggiti dalla città distopica di Midgar, Cloud e i suoi amici partono per un viaggio attraverso il pianeta. Nuove avventure ti attendono nel mondo vasto e dinamico di questa storia indipendente della trilogia remake di FFVII!

games.canonical_title: FINAL FANTASY VII REMAKE & REBIRTH Digital Deluxe Twin Pack
games.title: FINAL FANTASY VII REMAKE & REBIRTH Digital Deluxe Twin Pack
games.description: A bundle containing FINAL FANTASY VII REMAKE INTERGRADE and FINAL FANTASY VII REBIRTH Digital Deluxe Edition. This product contains the Digital Art Book, Digital Mini Soundtrack, and the digital content.

games.canonical_title: FINAL FANTASY VII REMAKE & REBIRTH Twin Pack
games.title: FINAL FANTASY VII REMAKE & REBIRTH Twin Pack
games.description:
The Unknown Journey Continues...

After escaping from the dystopian city of Midgar, Cloud and his friends set out on a journey across the planet. New adventures await in a vibrant and vast world in this standalone entry to the FFVII remake trilogy!

games.title: FINAL FANTASY VII REMAKE INTERGRADE
games.description: Cloud Strife, an ex SOLDIER operative, decends on the mako-powered city of Midgar. The world of the timeless classic FINAL FANTASY VII is reborn, using cutting-edge graphics technology, a new battle system and an additional adventure featuring Yuffie Kisaragi.

games.title: FINAL FANTASY XVI
games.description: Un dark fantasy in cui il destino è nelle mani degli Eikon e dei loro Dominanti. Questa è la storia di Clive Rosfield, un guerriero coinvolto in una tragedia che giura vendetta sull'Eikon Ifrit, un'entità che lascia dietro di sé grandi calamità.

games.title: Final Pillar
games.description: Free-to-play multiplayer progression sandbox blending deep itemization, skill grinding, idle automation, strategic combat, targeted looting, crafting systems, and extensive build customization in a player‑driven economy.

games.title: Find Me
games.description: Find Me is a psychological horror focused on sound, atmosphere, and emotion. Search for meaning in whispers of the trees and a hidden story. I seek her. I seek answers. And she calls. A short mini-game offering an intense 30–60 min experience.

games.title: Find the Oil Racing Edition
games.description: Get ready to embark on an action-packed adventure like no other!

games.title: Finding the Soul Orb
games.description: Finding the Soul Orb is a medieval fantasy game. In it, you use your crossbow both as a weapon against werewolves as well as a tool to solve puzzles.

games.title: FIRE
games.description: FIRE is a co-op Action PvE game for 1 to 4 players where you battle apocalyptic wildfires and supernatural creatures using mini-guns, rocket launchers, attack helicopters, teamwork and tactics.

games.title: FIRE AND ASHES
games.description: It's 1977. Henry Gray awakens in a psychiatric hospital, haunted by the ghosts of his past. Fire and Ashes await: An immersive survival horror where nothing is certain, insanity and reality mix, and voice recognition means every monster will hear you scream…

games.title: Fire Commander
games.description: Preparati a sfidare le fiamme. Controlla un'unità di vigili del fuoco in questo emozionante gioco tattico e strategico in tempo reale. Salva vite umane e proteggi la tua squadra in più di 30 missioni. Distinguiti compiendo azioni eroiche!

games.title: Fire Commander
games.description: Take command of a city’s emergency response system. Dispatch fire and EMS units in real time, manage coverage areas, and handle a full 24-hour shift with realistic call volumes and unit behavior.

games.canonical_title: Fire On Fight : Online Multiplayer Shooter
games.title: Fire On Fight : Online Multiplayer Shooter
games.description: "Fire On Fight: Sparatutto multigiocatore online" è un gioco sparatutto moderno in prima persona multigiocatore online PvP e Giocatore contro bot vecchia scuola con una straordinaria grafica 3D e un gameplay accattivante.

games.title: FIRE: The First Dreamer
games.description: Explore the ancient Preseli mountains of Wales in this open-world adventure inspired by a true story. Uncover forgotten secrets, awaken totemic powers, decode mysterious messages, and rediscover a world shaped by purpose, balance, and meaning.

games.title: Fire: Ungh's Quest
games.description: FIRE è un gioco d'avventura ed esplorazione basato su enigmi intuitivi. Racconta una storia selvaggiamente esilarante senza spendersi in molte parole. Avventurati nell'Età della pietra e affronta la sfida più difficile di questo periodo: la ricerca del fuoco!

games.title: Fireball Wizard
games.description: Explore Wizardonia, a magical world filled with danger and wonder in Fireball Wizard! As a powerful wizard, you'll explore a pixelated landscape filled with treacherous enemies and obstacles.

games.title: Fireburst
games.description: Blast opponents off the road with Fireburst, an explosively fun fast-paced arcade style racing game with fantastic graphics.

games.title: Firefighting Simulator: Ignite
games.description: Affronta pericoli imprevedibili, spegni incendi insieme alla tua squadra e salva vite in Firefighting Simulator: Ignite. Vesti i panni di un vigile del fuoco statunitense e gioca con un massimo di 3 amici o con compagni controllati dall'IA.

games.title: Firegirl: Hack 'n Splash Rescue DX
games.description: Take on the role of a young rescue officer starting her career. Armed with a trusty axe and high-pressure fire hose that also acts like a jetpack, Firegirl responds to emergency calls across the city. Can Firegirl save all the trapped civilians caught in each blaze?

games.title: Firelight Fantasy: Force Energy
games.description: Firelight Fantasy: Force Energy è uno spettacolare gioco di combattimento con la spada in terza persona basato sulla mitologia scandinava.

games.title: Firelight Fantasy: Phoenix Crew
games.description: Firelight Fantasy: Phoenix Crew è uno spettacolare gioco di combattimento con la spada in terza persona basato sulla mitologia scandinava

games.title: Firelight Fantasy: Resistance
games.description: Firelight Fantasy: Resistance è uno spettacolare gioco di combattimento con la spada in terza persona. Immergetevi nel ruolo di Hakon, uno spietato cacciatore di tesori. Scoprite antichi manufatti, schiacciate tutti i rivali e impadronitevi di ricchezze incalcolabili!

games.title: Firelight Fantasy: Vengeance
games.description: Firelight Fantasy: Vengeance - un gioco di spettacolari battaglie con la spada in terza persona. È un gioco d'azione basato sulla mitologia scandinava. Immergetevi nell'insolita storia della morte di Sigurd.

games.title: Fires At Midnight
games.description: In a world where making love without being in love makes you spontaneously combust, the person you adore most may be the one who burns you in Fires at Midnight – a cinematic and interactive visual novel about a couple who struggles to stay together.

games.title: Fireside
games.description: Fireside is an uplifting narrative experience about a journey, and the breaks that follow it. Make friends, trade and chat at the campfire, weave connections, and explore a serene magic-filled world.

games.title: Firestone Online Idle RPG
games.description: Firestone: Online Idle RPG is a multiplayer fantasy game with idle rpg mechanics. Collect heroes🧙‍♂️, upgrade their gear & skills, and sent them in AFK battles or go on an incremental clicker frenzy to beat monstrous bosses! Chat with guild friends or engage in PVP⚔️.

games.title: Firework
games.description: An accidental fire at a funeral forces the police to re-investigate a closed case of massacre. Lin Lixun participates the re-investigation by chances. As the investigation goes deeper, the past of the victims gradually emerges. However, the case becomes more bewildering.

games.title: First Class Trouble
games.description: First Class Trouble è un gioco in cui i giocatori collaborano e si ostacolano per sopravvivere a un disastro. Lo scopo è disattivare una I.A. letale. Alcuni sono impostori e giocheranno nei panni di robot assassini dall'aspetto umano con lo scopo di tradire gli altri giocatori.

games.title: First Dwarf
games.description: If there’s one thing dwarves are better at than grooming their beards, it's engineering. Jump into your mech, build a base and explore the crumbled fantasy world in this immersive action RPG.

games.title: Fish
games.description: Fish is a beautiful, bizarre and realistic experience that takes you on a planet 56. But note: this is not the 56th planet per se but this is planet 56 - fifty-six is its own name. Let's dive to Cosmos nad Universe!

games.title: Fishing - North Atlantic
games.description: Commercial fishing in North Atlantic! Discover majestic world of Canadian Nova Scotia while admiring the vast diversity of ocean life. Search for the ocean gold with upgradable fishing boats and various fishing gear as you progress in your fisherman career.

games.title: Fishing Planet
games.description:
Fishing Planet® è un simulatore di pesca multigiocatore online in prima persona estremamente realistico. Sviluppato da accaniti appassionati di pesca per offrirti il brivido della vera pesca con l'amo sul tuo schermo.

Free-to-Play e a portata di download!

games.title: Five Dates
games.description: Five Dates è una commedia romantica interattiva sul mondo imprevedibile degli appuntamenti digitali.

games.title: Five Hearts Under One Roof
games.description: Yuman’s, the player, once solitary home and routine are now invaded by five beautiful women! Each has her unique charm– the 'childhood friend of 20 years,' the 'first love and former idol,' the 'demanding boss,' the 'bold younger girl,' and the 'shy recluse.' Who will you choose?

games.canonical_title: Five Hearts Under One Roof season2
games.title: Five Hearts Under One Roof season2
games.description:
Boarding house owner Yuman is back!
Mal-sook, Gran, and Min-jung return—joined by three new residents: a wealthy heiress, a girl haunted by childhood scars, and a gentle nurse with a healing heart. who will steal your heart?

games.canonical_title: Five Nights at Freddy's: Into the Pit
games.title: Five Nights at Freddy's: Into the Pit
games.description: Survive five nights of terror in this chilling adventure game. Travel between time periods to solve puzzles, gather clues, and outrun the threat pursuing you. Move swiftly and stay hidden, and you may just survive. But be careful—it's not just your own life that’s on the line.

games.canonical_title: Five Nights at Freddy's: Secret of the Mimic
games.title: Five Nights at Freddy's: Secret of the Mimic
games.description: Five Nights at Freddy’s: Secret of the Mimic ti immerge in un mondo dove ogni angolo oscuro cela un segreto e ogni bagliore di luce ti avverte di un pericolo imminente.

games.canonical_title: Five Nights at Freddy's: Security Breach
games.title: Five Nights at Freddy's: Security Breach
games.description: In Five Nights at Freddy’s: Security Breach, vesti i panni di Gregory, un ragazzino intrappolato durante la notte nel Mega Pizzaplex di Freddy Fazbear. Con l'aiuto di Freddy in persona, Gregory deve svelare i segreti del Pizzaplex, scoprire la verità e sopravvivere fino all'alba.

games.title: Five Nights In Saransk
games.description: You wake up in the middle of the night in your cozy one-room apartment and notice something wandering around your five-story panel building. Your only task is to prevent these strange creatures from getting inside.

games.title: Five Nights In The Backrooms

games.description: Lock the doors, use the video surveillance system to keep an eye on them, and under no circumstances let them inside.

games.canonical_title: Fix Me Up Doc - Dark Humor

games.description: This is a parody game with dark humor, with such unbelievable graphics and so intense levels that you can even feel the smell.

games.title: FixForce
games.description: Leap, climb, and launch your friends in this chaotic co-op extraction platformer for up to 6 players! Use your drill-wrench to build your way across a vibrant post-apocalyptic world, find replacement parts, and fix broken machines.

A plot-oriented, full-motion live-action interactive video work, which is different from the traditional fantasy love interactive work.
The love, hate, affection, and hatred you gain all depend on your current choices.

games.title: Flame Keeper
games.description: Flame Keeper è un dinamico rogue-lite d'azione in cui dovrai ripristinare la Fiamma eterna, rubata da creature oscure. Affronta mostri tipici dei rogue in vari biomi con varie tecniche di lotta. Un gioco da ragazzi per un pezzo di carbone come te.

games.description: Un gioco tattico-rpg ambientato in un mondo di pirati con una narrazione forte e originale.

games.description: Da A44, lo studio che ha creato Ashen, ecco un esplosivo Souls-lite in cui armi e divinità si scontrano in una battaglia per il futuro dell'umanità.

games.title: FlipScapes Pinball
games.description: FlipScapes blends classic pinball with energetic arcade action, from pachinko and brick-breaking to whack-a-mole and beyond.

games.title: Flirty Landlord Gorgeous Tenants
games.description:
Flirty Landlord & Gorgeous Tenants
A live-action interactive movie game centered on romantic ambiguity.
Play as a landlord, making choices among unique female tenants.
Each decision shapes different romantic paths and endings.

games.title: Floppa: The Dark Forest
games.description: Trova 8 immagini di gatti e non farti prendere da Big Floppa!

games.description: Tactics fuse with card game mechanics as Phoebe and Carlton, a brilliant young inventor & her robot-arm bestie, square off in turn-based battles. Select your Knights, hone your deck, and execute your strategy for victory!

games.title: Flora Frontier
games.description:
Flora Frontier is a first person, action rogue-lite, dungeon crawler where you 
fight alien plants, explore vast cave systems, and win by defeating the mother plant.

games.title: Flourish Islands
games.description: Flourish Islands is a web3-powered city-building game where players buy items, harvest resources, and build thriving cities. Use blockchain-based assets to expand your land, gather materials like trees, and create a unique digital world.

games.title: Flower

games.description: Fluffy's Adventure is a delightful platformer where players control Fluffy, a charming and curious ball of fur, on a quest through a magical land filled with puzzles and obstacles. players helps Fluffy walk, jump, and change colors to navigate and overcome challenges.

games.title: Fly Corp
games.description: Sviluppa la tua rete di trasporto aereo in vari Paesi e città. Apri nuove rotte, acquista aerei e potenziane le caratteristiche.

games.title: Flying Islands
games.description: Flying Islands is a parkour game with a Stylized-Town theme. You jump and climb on objects. But don’t forget! If you fall, you start from the very beginning!

games.canonical_title: FOCUS INDIES BUNDLE: Curse of the Dead Gods + Shady Part of Me + Aeon Must Die!
games.title: FOCUS INDIES BUNDLE: Curse of the Dead Gods + Shady Part of Me + Aeon Must Die!
games.description: FOCUS INDIES BUNDLE: Curse of the Dead Gods + Shady Part of Me + Aeon Must Die!

games.title: Folly of the Wizards
games.description: Folly Of The Wizards is a comedic 2D roguelike action game that puts you in the shoes of a clumsy wizard apprentice. Join a wacky wizard cult and use unique spells to defeat enemies, explore procedurally generated dungeons, and save the world from chaos.

games.title: Food Truck Empire
games.description: Diventa il più grande magnate dei food truck. Crea la tua flotta, gestisci i menù, ottimizza le tue cucine mobili e conquista la strada. Da hamburger economici a opere d'arte culinaria. Trova i tuoi clienti, rimpinzali e costruisci il tuo Impero di Food Truck!

games.title: Football Club Inside
games.description: Lead a small football club through one unforgettable season. Make tough choices, face the media, manage morale and ambition — every decision shapes your story in this cinematic, story-driven football management drama.

games.title: Football Heroes League
games.description: Football Heroes League è un gioco di calcio multiplayer ad alto numero di ottani in cui abilità sovrumane incontrano controlli precisi.

games.title: Football Life Simulator
games.description: Live the life of a professional footballer both on and off the field. Train, play matches, manage your social life, climb the career ladder, and spend your earned money. Decorate your life with luxury while managing your relationships and finances.

games.title: Football Manager 26
games.description: Siediti in panchina e prova il futuro dei manageriali di calcio

games.title: Football Referee Simulator

games.title: For Honor Standard Edition
games.description: For Honor Standard Edition

games.title: For The King

games.title: For The Warp
games.description: A roguelike deckbuilding game in space! Explore randomly generated systems, enemies and strange encounters. Build your deck, survive and reach For The Warp gate!

games.title: For What Will Come: Reimagined
games.description: For What Will Come: Reimagined is a narrative-driven psychological mystery that takes you on an emotional journey through time, memory, and family. After years away, Abby Williams returns to her childhood home, only to find that it holds more than just memories.

games.title: Force of Warships
games.description: Join battleships with friends now and take part in the battle on modern ships! What are you waiting for, captain?

games.title: FORECLOSED
games.description: FORECLOSED è un gioco di azione-avventura a tema narrativo, ambientato in un mondo cyberpunk pieno di azione, suspense e potenziamenti sperimentali. Segui la storia di Evan Kapnos in questo gioco dallo stile fumettistico mentre cerca di svelare il complotto che si nasconde die...

games.title: Foregone
games.description: Foregone è un platform d'azione 2D rapido e fluido, ricco di bottini leggendari e con uno stile pixel art spettacolare. Raccogli un arsenale di armi potenti e scopri una storia avvincente di rimpianti e complotti facendoti strada tra orde di nemici per salvare Calagan.

games.title: Forest Grove
games.description: A Forest Grove è scomparsa un'ereditiera adolescente. Si sospetta un delitto. Indaga su un cast di personaggi, raccogli prove e scopri la verità in questo giallo futuristico!

games.title: Forest Offroad Driving Simulator
games.description: Discover the beauties of nature with the Forest Offroad Driving Simulator! Customize your vehicle, conquer challenging roads, and get ready for adventure.

games.title: Forest Ranger Simulator
games.description: Take care of forgotten nature's treasure. Build, craft, feed, clean and manage your forest in Forest Ranger Simulator. Ensure its long-lasting beauty and become a flawless Forest Ranger!

games.title: Foretales
games.description:
Decidi le sorti del mondo in questo ingegnoso gioco di carte.

Foretales propone un'angolatura unica sul genere dei giochi d'avventura, con una serie di stili di gioco e di linee narrative tramite cui salvare il mondo... o condurlo alla sua fine.

games.title: Forever Ago
games.description: Un triste tiro del destino porta Alfred a intraprendere un viaggio a nord in cerca di redenzione in quest'avventura per giocatore singolo.

games.title: Forgive Me Father
games.description: Forgive Me Father è uno sparatutto horror retrò in prima persona ambientato in un mondo da fumetto ispirato ai romanzi di H.P. Lovecraft. Nei panni dell'unica persona ancora consapevole di sé, partirai per un viaggio alla ricerca di risposte e sollievo. Quanto a lungo resisterai?

games.title: Forgive Me Father 2
games.description: Embark on a journey into the darkest nightmares to restore your sanity. Blast your way through hordes of possessed enemies, unlock an arsenal of deadly weapons and get ready to face even more Lovecraftian madness in this action-packed FPS sequel.

games.title: Forgotlings
games.description: A fully voice-acted cinematic adventure set in a hand-drawn world of living forgotten objects. Lead Fig and the crew of the Volare through a story of identity, unity, and survival—where diplomacy, difficult choices, and moments of action shape the fate of five divided tribes.

games.title: Forgotten Bunker 1939
games.description: step into the boots of Private Jacob, an American soldier caught in the fury of a World War II bombing raid. Desperately seeking refuge, Jacob stumbles upon a terrifying mysterious bunker, which turns out to be a demonic time portal.

games.title: Forgotten Fields
games.description: Sid, a struggling writer, travels back to his childhood home one last time before it's sold off. Visit old friends, relive memories, solve puzzles and play through sections of Sid's book in this warm game about nostalgia and the passage of time.

games.title: Forklift 2024 - The Simulation
games.description: Get ready to take on the ultimate forklift simulation experience with Forklift 2024 - The Simulation! Operate your very own forklift and complete randomly generated orders to earn money and expand your warehouse.

games.title: Forklift Extreme - Deluxe Edition
games.description: Preparati a far rombare i motori e a scalare la gloria nel simulatore Forklift Extreme Edizione Deluxe! Simulazione definitiva con DLC, modalità di gioco e ambienti magazzino iperrealistici.

games.description: Begin your career as a forklift operator and immerse yourself in the action from both first and third-person perspectives, delving into forklift operations.
