games.description:
Mystery of Volcano is the third edition in the adventures of KAO the Kangaroo.

Join the feisty marsupial as he bounces his way through challenging and interesting missions, whilst interacting with the inhabitants of this unique game world.

games.title: Kao the Kangaroo - Round 2
games.description: Fai un tuffo nei ricordi e divertirti di nuovo insieme al coraggioso e adorabile Kao il canguro. Immergiti in un classico gioco a piattaforme 3D ricco di avventura dove Kao corre, salta e lotta contro i nemici.

games.title: Kao the Kangaroo: La trilogia
games.description: Finalmente è arrivata la tanto attesa trilogia delle epiche avventure di Kao the Kangaroo!

games.title: kapih
games.description: Kapih is a classic run-n-gun shooter platformer, with action packed levels and boss battles. The visuals and music are inspired by the many lost in time art-styles of India. We follow the adventure of a Vaanar (monkey) in a colorfully imagined ancient India.

games.title: Kapital: Sparks of Revolution
games.description: Sandbox economic simulation game about class struggle. European country is in a deep political crisis. You are the mayor of the capital. Social unrest is inevitable. What price are you willing to pay to save your country from anarchy?

games.canonical_title: Kaptain Brawe - A Brawe New World
games.title: Kaptain Brawe - A Brawe New World
games.description: Kaptain Brawe (Remastered) is critically acclaimed old school point n' click adventure. In a alternate reality, humanity has already conquered space travel by the mid-19th century.

games.title: Karakage The Sky Shadow
games.description: Competitive Fast-Paced Anime Shooter With Unique Guns & Abilities. Play Various Game Modes Like 1v1 Battle/Domain Warp/Free For All/Team Deathmatch/Etc.Domain Warp Is Are Custom Gamemode Giving You The Ability To Teleport Between 2 Maps Mid Game.Tons Of Gun & Cool Features To Use

games.title: Karaoke Love Song
games.description: Share your best beautiful voice with a karaoke game themed around love songs.

games.title: Karate Master 2 Knock Down Blow
games.description: Karate Master 2 Knock Down Blow è un picchiaduro che fonde elementi di RPG, simulazione e arcade in una combinazione esplosiva che riporta in vita il genere Beat'em up!

games.title: Karate Survivor
games.description: Become a martial arts master in this survivor-like roguelite inspired by action movies of the ‘80s. Use your fists, feet, and the environment to fight off relentless thugs. Master powerful combos, enhance your skills, and remember: everything around you is a weapon!

games.title: Kardboard Kings
games.description: Open your own Card shop by the seaside! Buy, trade and sell Cards, OR keep them for your own collection! Earn reputation with customers, beat your shop goals, unlock new decorations, and host exciting events to bring everyone to the best Card shop in town!

games.canonical_title: KARDS - Il gioco di carte della seconda guerra mondiale
games.title: KARDS - Il gioco di carte della seconda guerra mondiale
games.description: KARDS, il gioco di carte della seconda guerra mondiale, combina il tradizionale stile dei giochi di carte collezionabili con delle meccaniche innovative ispirate ai classici strategici e alle tattiche dei veri campi di battaglia. Prendi il comando e sfida gli altri giocatori in scontri su ampia scala per terra, aria o mare.

games.title: Karma City Police
games.description: Be the new dispatcher at the Karma City Police Station in this narrative-driven pixel adventure. Talk to the victims to discover their needs and fight in a unique pinball-based battle system, as you follow a captivating story with lots of humor and a great soundtrack.

games.title: KARMA: The Dark World
games.description: Karma: The Dark World è un thriller psicologico cinematografico in prima persona ambientato in un mondo distopico in cui la Leviathan Corporation è onnipresente. È il 1984 e siamo nella Germania Est, ma le cose non sono esattamente come sembrano.

games.title: KarmaZoo
games.description: L'unione fa la forza! KarmaZoo è un divertente platform cooperativo in cui fino a 10 giocatori scelti a caso si alleano e devono combinare le abilità di 50 personaggi diversi per completare un Anello e raccogliere Karma!

games.title: Karos
games.description: Una misteriosa maga, un severo spadaccino o un allegro artigliere: quale percorso sceglierai nel mondo di Azmara? Unisciti alle migliaia di eroi che hanno già scoperto questo MMORPG facile da imparare e con hardware ridotto!

games.title: Karos Classic
games.description: La leggenda vivente ritorna nella sua forma originale! La versione Classica di Karos, incontaminata da anni e aggiornamenti.

games.title: Karthikeya : Wake Up To Reality
games.description: Karthikeya: Wake Up to Reality is a 3D narrative adventure where your choices shape the story and lead to multiple endings. Explore immersive environments and make meaningful decisions in a cinematic journey.

games.title: Katana Dragon
games.description: An action, adventure & dungeon exploration RPG, where you play as the ninjas Shin & Nobi in their quest to save the world of Sogen!

games.title: Kawaii Deathu Desu
games.description: In Kawaii Deathu Desu, supernatural beings find themselves incarnated as cute japanese idols! Pick a supernatural idol and beat the hell out of - no pun intended - as many overzealous fans as you can in this addictive beat'em up.

games.title: Kaya's Prophecy
games.description: Kaya’s Prophecy is a unique card based village builder! establish your village, gather resources, and craft tools and buildings in a vibrant world. Explore and combat various challenges and other groups in this colourful, deck-builder while appeasing your god to earn his favour.

games.title: Kaze and the Wild Masks
games.description: Parti all'avventura con Kaze, in questo platform ispirato ai classici degli anni '90. Quando le Crystal Islands vengono maledette, Kaze deve salvare il suo amico Hogo. Trova le Wild Masks, scatena i poteri dei leggendari guardiani e padroneggia terra, cielo e aria.

games.title: Keep in Mind Remastered
games.description: Keep in Mind follows Jonas, a tormented alcoholic whose life is falling apart. He awakens to a shadowy mirror world where beasts lurk and the stars don't shine. Jonas must face twisted beasts if he ever wishes to return home and learn the truth, about truth about his darkness.

games.title: KeepUp Survival
games.description: KeepUp Survival is an open base-building and exploration game set in a natural, abandoned world. Build, gather, survive, and unfold your own story on a mysterious island.

games.title: Kejora
games.description: When Kejora realizes that her peaceful village has been reliving the same day over and over, she and her friends seek out to try and uncover the origin of the mysterious time loop cursing her village

games.title: Kellan Graves: Fallen
games.description: A first-person sci-fi horror where Kellan Graves fights through the deadly caverns of Elior. Face relentless creatures and uncover the fate of lost Echo units in a tense, atmospheric, story-driven descent into darkness.

games.canonical_title: Ken Follett's The Pillars of the Earth
games.title: Ken Follett's The Pillars of the Earth
games.description: Inghilterra, XII secolo. In un'epoca di povertà e guerra, un piccolo villaggio comincia la costruzione di una cattedrale per chiedere protezione per le sue genti. Nella lotta per la sopravvivenza, i destini si intrecciano. Basato sul best seller mondiale di Ken Follett I pilas...

games.title: Kena: Bridge of Spirits
games.description: A story-driven, action adventure combining exploration with fast-paced combat. As Kena, players find and grow a team of charming spirit companions called the Rot, enhancing their abilities and creating new ways to manipulate the environment.

games.title: Kena: Scars of Kosmora
games.description: Alla ricerca di una cura per il proprio male, Kena raggiunge l'isola di Kosmora, colpita anch'essa da una misteriosa corruzione. Per proteggere Kosmora in questa avventura, dovrà imparare a controllare gli elementi grazie all'aiuto di spiriti alleati.

games.title: Kendo Warrior
games.description: Kendo Warrior is a realistic samurai sword fighting simulator. In the game, the player will take part in exciting duels in medieval Japan. Realistic animations of the most important moves of kendo warriors will introduce the player to the world of this martial art.

games.title: Kenshi
games.description: A free-roaming squad based RPG. Focusing on open-ended sandbox gameplay features rather than a linear story. Be a trader, a thief, a rebel, a warlord, an adventurer, a farmer, a slave, or just food for the cannibals. Train your men up from puny victims to master warriors.

games.title: Kerbal Space Program
games.description: In Kerbal Space Program, take charge of the space program for the alien race known as the Kerbals. You have access to an array of parts to assemble fully-functional spacecraft that flies (or doesn’t) based on realistic aerodynamic and orbital physics.

games.title: Kerbal Space Program 2
games.description: Kerbal Space Program 2, realizzato da Intercept Games e Private Division, è il sequel dell'acclamato simulatore di volo spaziale Kerbal Space Program. Entra nella nuova generazione dell'avventura spaziale con nuove ed elettrizzanti parti, una grafica favolosa, interfaccia utente e visuale della mappa completamente riviste, e nuovi e ricchi ambienti da esplorare.

games.title: Kernel Hearts
games.description: Gather your allies. Eliminate Angels. Transform into a Magical Girl. Slay god. Kernel Hearts is a Multiplayer Co-Op Roguelike Action RPG about four magical girls and their attempt to save a world that's drowning in ashes.

games.title: Keylocker | Turn Based Cyberpunk Action
games.description: Keylocker is a Cyberpunk turn-based rhythm JRPG. As the electric singer, B0B0, you’ll choose your class, master a challenging combat system, and shake the foundations of Saturnite society in rhythm-game style!

games.title: KeyWe
games.description: KeyWe è un adorabile gioco cooperativo di rompicapi postali che ha per protagonisti due piccoli uccellini kiwi impiegati in un bizzarro ufficio postale.

games.title: Kholat
games.description: The most terrifying journey of your life set in the beautiful winter scenery of the Ural Mountains. Uncover the horrific mystery behind the Dyatlov Pass Incident. Narrated by the famous Sean Bean.

games.title: KIBORG
games.description: KIBORG is a fast-paced, story-driven action game with rogue-lite encounters. Become an unstoppable war machine and face the consequences of your actions as you lead a resistance group on a faraway prison planet.

games.title: Kickback Clicker
games.description: Mutants are flooding the planets! Destroy them all! Improve your technology, upgrade weapons and turn dangerous worlds into safe havens. Every click is a step towards the future of mankind!

games.title: KID A MNESIA EXHIBITION
games.description: Un universo digitale/analogico sottosopra creato da materiali grafici e registrazioni originali per festeggiare i 21 anni di Kid A e Amnesiac dei Radiohead. In arrivo a novembre 2021. Aggiungilo subito alla Lista dei desideri.

games.title: Kids Learn
games.description: Kids Learn is amazing useful educational game for everyone. Get ready for educational tour.
games.developer: Yash Future Tech Solutions Pvt Ltd
games.publisher: Yash Future Tech Solutions Pvt Ltd

games.title: Kiki
games.description: A vibrant platformer with unique graphics and catchy chiptune soundtrack! Dodge treacherous traps and obstacles, overcome only by your agility and quick reflexes. Don’t miss the chance to test your abilities and become a true master of jumping! 🏃‍♀️

games.title: Kill It With Fire
games.description: Kill It With Fire è un gioco d'azione in prima persona sulla caccia ai ragni e il danno collaterale. Raduna il tuo arsenale e dai la caccia a questa minaccia a otto zampe in un viaggio attraverso le periferie.

games.title: KILL KNIGHT
games.description: KILL KNIGHT è uno sparatutto d'azione isometrico ad alta reattività ispirato ai classici del passato. Preparati a un'eternità di sofferenza! Annienta orde di creature ultraterrene usando un arsenale di armi devastanti.

games.title: Kill The Dead
games.description: Explore the area, find weapons, and don't let the horde of hungry zombies eat you!

games.title: Killer Frequency
games.description: Killer Frequency è un rompicapo horror in prima persona ambientato nel 1987, che ti fa vestire i panni di uno speaker radiofonico di programmi notturni in una piccola cittadina americana i cui ascoltatori vengono perseguitati da un assassino misterioso.

games.canonical_title: Killer Klowns From Outer Space: The Game
games.title: Killer Klowns From Outer Space: The Game
games.description: Pianificate la vostra invasione aliena e raccogliete gli umani nei panni degli iconici Killer Klown o riunite una squadra di sopravvissuti per sfuggire alla minaccia extraterrestre a Crescent Cove!

games.title: Killing Floor 2
games.description: In KILLING FLOOR 2 i giocatori si calano nell'Europa continentale, invasa da orrendi cloni assetati di sangue chiamati Zed, creati dai malvagi componenti della Horzine Corporation. Modalità cooperativa a 6 giocatori e modalità VS ammazza-Zed a 12 giocatori.

games.title: Killing Floor 3
games.description: Killing Floor 3 è il nuovo capitolo della leggendaria serie d'azione/horror. In questo sparatutto in prima persona sarai uno specialista di Nightfall e avrai fino a 5 compagni per combattere ondate di zed, guadagnare denaro, sbloccare abilità e comporre il tuo arsenale.

games.title: Kim il Scxxabile
games.description: In questo gioco di combattimento 2D dovrai salvare l'umanità da un dittatore crudele, spietato e sanguinario che aspira all'egemonia mondiale.

games.title: kinanh: Town of Darkness
games.description: Kinanh: Town of Darkness is indie horror game tells the tragic story of a family murdered because of a lie, whose restless spirits now seek revenge. Designed for a short, immersive experience, the game invites you to uncover dark secrets hiding in every shadow.

games.title: Kine
games.description: Un avvincente gioco di rompicapi in 3D su musica, macchine e sogni

games.title: King of Avalon
games.description: Summon your Dragon and be the King of Frost and Flame in Avalon!

games.title: King of Retail
games.description: The store is your kingdom! Expand your humble boutique into a thriving business: hire the right staff, decorate your displays, and lure in customers. Even your wildest ideas can turn a profit. Why not start a business that sells only white T-shirts and ketchup? PCs and beans? You

games.title: King of Retail 2
games.description: Ready to build another empire? You are once again back in the role as the manager, trying to make the best of a busy store. Find the right things to sell, get the right employees and turn every stone for a profit. Can you handle the pressure or will you buck under?

games.title: King of Seas
games.description: King of Seas è un gioco di ruolo d’azione ambientato in un mondo piratesco procedurale. Un universo ricco di personaggi strabilianti e missioni mozzafiato che ti terrà ancorato mentre lotti per diventare il re di tutti i pirati.

games.title: King's Bounty II
games.description: L'oscurità scende sul mondo di Nostria. Le cospirazioni, i sabotaggi e la necromanzia gettano ombra sul Paese. Ma forse è già arrivato un salvatore, l'ultima speranza del regno, in grado di ribellarsi e riportare finalmente la pace e l'ordine a Nostria!

games.title: King's Bounty: Armored Princess
games.description: King's Bounty: Armored Princess is a sequel to the critically acclaimed King’s Bounty: The Legend.

games.title: King's Bounty: Crossworlds
games.description: King’s Bounty: Crossworlds is the stand alone expansion for the famous King's Bounty: Armored Princess role-playing game that contains an improved version of it, two additional campaigns and world editor.

games.title: King's Bounty: Dark Side
games.description: Time has come to join the dark side. Take a trip to the other side of Teana, to the part of the world that has yet remained unseen to the royal bounty hunters.

games.title: King's Bounty: The Legend
games.description: King's Bounty: The Legend is an adventure game with tactical turn-based battles and role-playing elements.

games.canonical_title: King's Bounty: Warriors of the North
games.title: King's Bounty: Warriors of the North
games.description: King’s Bounty: Warriors of the North is the next chapter in the cult classic RPG/adventure saga, after King's Bounty: The Legend, King's Bounty: Amored Princess and King's Bounty: Crossworlds.

games.title: Kingdom - The Far Reaches
games.description: An Epic, Interactive Adventure The Whole Family Will Enjoy

games.title: Kingdom Come: Deliverance
games.description: Kingdom Come: Deliverance è un GDR open-world con un'avvincente componente narrativa che ti farà immergere in un'avventura epica ambientata nel Sacro Romano Impero. Vendica la morte dei tuoi genitori combattendo gli invasori, avventurati in missioni decisive e prendi decisioni...

games.title: Kingdom Come: Deliverance - Saga Bundle
games.description: Play through the entire Kingdom Come: Deliverance Saga in this bundle of epic proportions. Featuring both award-winning Action RPG’s and all post launch content.

games.title: Kingdom Come: Deliverance II
games.description: Kingdom Come: Deliverance II è un emozionante GdR d'azione ambientato nel caos della guerra civile boema del XV secolo.

games.title: KINGDOM HEARTS HD 1.5 + 2.5 ReMIX
games.description: KINGDOM HEARTS HD 1.5 + 2.5 ReMIX è una raccolta HD rimasterizzata di sei indimenticabili esperienze di KINGDOM HEARTS. KINGDOM HEARTS HD 1.5 + 2.5 ReMIX ti offre l'occasione perfetta per impugnare il tuo Keyblade e salvare i mondi Disney dalle tenebre.

games.canonical_title: KINGDOM HEARTS HD 2.8 Final Chapter Prologue
games.title: KINGDOM HEARTS HD 2.8 Final Chapter Prologue
games.description: KINGDOM HEARTS HD 2.8 Final Chapter Prologue offre 3 magiche esperienze che portano a KINGDOM HEARTS III: - KINGDOM HEARTS Dream Drop Distance HD - KINGDOM HEARTS χ Back Cover (film) - KINGDOM HEARTS 0.2 Birth by Sleep – A fragmentary passage –

games.title: KINGDOM HEARTS III + Re Mind (DLC)
games.description: KINGDOM HEARTS III + Re Mind (DLC) è una storia d'amicizia in cui Sora e i suoi amici partono per una pericolosa avventura. Ambientato in una serie di mondi Disney, KINGDOM HEARTS parla del viaggio di Sora, un giovane che scopre inaspettatamente di avere un potere spettacolare.

games.title: KINGDOM HEARTS Melody of Memory
games.description: Gustati le musiche di KINGDOM HEARTS come non le hai mai sentite prima! Melody of Memory è un gioco d'azione ritmico con oltre 20 personaggi, più di 140 brani musicali e una modalità multigiocatore online. Esplora le musiche e i ricordi della serie KINGDOM HEARTS.

games.title: Kingdom II: Shadoan
games.description: Travel across distant lands, encounter friends and strangers, and gather magical items to aid you in your battle against Torlok the Twisted to restore Freedom to the Five Kingdoms.

games.title: Kingdom New Lands
games.description: Quanto a lungo durerai?

games.title: Kingdoms of Amalur: Re-Reckoning
games.description: Ritorna un successo dei GDR! Rimasterizzato con una grafica incredibile e un gameplay aggiornato, Re-Reckoning offre intensi combattimenti GDR personalizzabili all'interno di uno sconfinato mondo di gioco.

games.title: Kingmakers
games.description: Go back in time to a war-torn medieval era with a vast arsenal of modern weapons, change the course of history in this epic action/strategy sandbox. Build your kingdom, grab a gun, and lead an army of thousands into massive, real-time simulated battles — solo or in co-op.

games.title: Kings Do Not Fall
games.description: When the kingdom needs a legend, you don’t fall... you rise. In a land torn apart, an entire army has fallen. Embark on a classic beat ’em up, just like we loved to play in the 90s.

games.title: Kingsgrave
games.description: Welcome to Kingsgrave, a dark fantasy adventure RPG. Gain more power and obtain new combat skills as you explore the fractured land, slay foes created by plague, solve puzzles and rebuild villages. Reclaim your realm!

games.title: KinnikuNeko: SUPER MUSCLE CAT
games.description: Insieme a KinnikuNeko, un gatto con il corpo di un culturista, in questo divertente platform 2D, affronta una invasione aliena. Una storia piena di umorismo demenziale, amicizia, dramma e azione. Una lettera d'amore agli anime anni '90 con una colonna sonora indimenticabile.

games.title: Kitaria Fables
games.description: Kitaria Fables è un affascinante GDR d'azione-avventura dove si coltiva e costruisce! Impugna tante armi e un libro di incantesimi per combattere una pericolosa oscurità in ascesa. Svela regioni, reliquie e risorse. Coltiva le provviste e completa le missioni in modalità solitaria o cooperativa!

games.title: Kiteboarding
games.description: The most realistic Kiteboarding simulator

games.title: KLETKA
games.description: KLETKA is a co-op (up to 6 players) horror game about going down in an elevator that is trying to eat you. Feed the elevator, explore deadly floors and descend deeper.

games.title: KLONOA Phantasy Reverie Series
games.description: KLONOA Phantasy Reverie Series

games.title: Kneedle Knight
games.description: Kneedle Knight is a 3rd-person puzzle platformer game. Sir Lukoss the Small wields his magic needle sword to solve puzzles, platform across magical objects, and defeat cursed candle minions to return to normal and defeat the Witch of Fabric!

games.title: Knight Squad 2
games.description: Knight Squad 2 è un caotico gioco arcade per un massimo di 8 giocatori. Scegli un eccentrico cavaliere e combatti per la gloria con armi strampalate. Straccia i tuoi amici in una quantità ridicola di modalità di gioco, sia offline che online.

games.title: Knight Swap
games.description: One chess piece, the mighty knight. One simple concept: exchange the knights from one colored square to another. One hundred hand-crafted levels in a beautiful minimalist set. Can you swap the knights?

games.canonical_title: Knight vs Giant: The Broken Excalibur
games.title: Knight vs Giant: The Broken Excalibur
games.description: Indossa l'armatura di Re Artù in questo roguelite fantasy d'azione e brandisci l'infranta Excalibur in una missione per salvare i cittadini dispersi di Camelot, sconfiggere il temibile Gigante del Vuoto e fuggire dalla Dimensione astrale una volta per tutte.

games.title: Knight's Retreat
games.description: A chess game without any chess. Rearrange your troops to bring your best Knights back to your Kingdom in an abstract medieval world.

games.title: Knightfall Requiem
games.description: Step into a fallen kingdom consumed by darkness. Master brutal hack & slash combat, wield forbidden magic, and carve through relentless enemies. In Knightfall Requiem, every strike matters. Will you rise as the last hope, or become part of the eternal requiem?

games.title: Knights of Cathena
games.description: Enter the world of Knights of Cathena, a thrilling RPG-driven turn-based tactics PvP game. Outsmart opponents, equip a powerful collection of items, and earn Cathena Gold. Unleash your strategic wits, conquer the battlefield, climb the ranks, and dominate the realm!

games.title: Knights of Honor II: Sovereign
games.description: Become the king and fight over Europe in this fresh take on medieval real-time grand strategy. Manage provinces, gather armies, initiate diplomacy, and dabble in espionage. The path is open: become the true Sovereign of your people and bring them to glory.

games.title: Knock on the Coffin lid
games.description: Investigate your own death, find ways to break free from a time loop, choose a hero who will ascend to the throne and rule the Northern gate! The fates of whole nations of the land of Midian depend on your choices.

games.title: Kode Zero
games.description: Welcome to Kode Zero, the ultimate free-to-play multiplayer shooter that thrusts you into a cyberpunk world like no other. Are you ready to dominate the neon-soaked chaos and emerge as the legendary champion?

games.title: KOKODI
games.description:
This is a MVP (Minimum Viable Product).

MVP is not a final product and will not show 
the quality of the final product.

If you will like what you see: 
Please support us on social media and join to discord!

games.title: Kombinara
games.description: Control multiple colored balls simultaneously in this brain-bending puzzle platformer. It's up to you to combine every ball and complete each perilous level. Can you solve them all? Can you save King Kombine from the Kave of Kaos?

games.title: KOMMUNALKA
games.description: Post-Soviet liminal space.

games.title: KOMPETE
games.description: KOMPETE è un gioco multiplayer tutto in uno. Le modalità di gioco attuali includono Blitz Royale e Kart Race, con altre in arrivo! Ora in accesso anticipato.

games.title: Konfronto
games.description: Build a powerful intergalactic starship by interlocking different technologies, then battle through a galaxy populated with other players' creations.

games.title: Kong: Survivor Instinct
games.description: When monsters fight, no one’s safe. Embark on a thrilling quest of survival in a city that’s become a battleground for Titans. Use the lethal strength of Kong and other monsters to your own advantage in this Monsterverse game set shortly after the events of Godzilla vs. Kong.

games.title: KOOO TO JUMP!
games.description: A voice-controlled precision platformer where you crow to jump! Sustain a continuous 'KOOO' to scale a brutal, foddian-style map. Scale 60 camera zones, conquer a massive world, and lose your dignity in this unrelenting rage game. Includes controller support and Practice Mode.

games.title: Kopi
games.description:
A lively, family-friendly cooking game where you brew, cook, fry, clean, and serve quirky customers. Earn coins, unlock levels, and experience a
playful visual style that transforms each scene into a charming miniature world. Ensure every customer leaves with a smile!

games.title: KORAL
games.description: Koral, una lettera d'amore all'oceano. Immergiti in un bellissimo mondo sottomarino nei panni di una corrente marina. Risolvi enigmi per riportare in vita le barriere coralline e diffondere la bellezza degli oceani nei diversi ecosistemi marini.

games.canonical_title: Koropokkur in Love ~A Little Fairy’s Tale~
games.title: Koropokkur in Love ~A Little Fairy’s Tale~
games.description: Koropokkur in Love is a tale of a young woman who, after venturing out of her isolated village, experiences love and a vast, brand-new world for the very first time.

games.title: KorrPadel
games.description: A modern padel simulation where positioning and timing make the difference. Pick your side, choose your partner, and challenge opponents in local or online matches. Real padel, friendly spirit.

games.title: Kosmokrats
games.description: Kosmokrats è il gioco d'avventura e commedia dark a gravità zero del popolo! Pilota il tuo drone. Fai nuove amicizie, incluso Bill Nighy. Costruisci stazioni spaziali. Assembla una possente flotta spaziale. Guadagna patate. Crea la tua avventura. Il destino dell'umanità dipend...

games.title: Kraken Academy!!
games.description: Fai nuove amicizie, libera gli spiriti e assicurati che il mondo non finisca! Ti diamo il benvenuto a Kraken Academy, un delirio allucinante in technicolor che per questioni legali definiremo come "una scuola, insomma". Salva il mondo con l'aiuto di un kraken, tuo magico alleato.

games.title: Kristala
games.description: Kristala is a dark fantasy ARPG featuring challenging combat, fluid parkour, and deep exploration. Master the ancient magic of the Sacred Six Kristals and uncover the source of a mysterious curse in a thrilling, story-driven adventure.

games.title: Krogger Skull Killer
games.description: Krogger has been called to banish evil from the depths of the jungle in present times to mysterious and malevolent dimensions in various eras in time and space. You are Krogger and you have come to banish the bearers of cruelty and destruction.

games.title: Kubikon 3D
games.description: Cubes, cubes, cubes... Cubes everywhere. Whether you're in the mood to challenge your brain or just relax, Kubikon is here for you!

games.title: Kugle
games.description: Play with your friends in a galaxy in which you collect, breed and trade Kugles.

games.title: Kujlevka
games.description: A flying saucer crash-lands in a distant Russian village, turning a rundown kolkhoz into the first, thin bridge between civilizations. As the first point of contact, you must dictate how this encounter unfolds and ultimately determine history’s outcome.

games.title: Kumitantei: Old-School Slaughter
games.description: Uccidetevi a vicenda… per la scienza! La classe dell'89 è intrappolata in un gioco letale in una scuola d'élite. Indaga e smaschera i tuoi compagni di classe in Kumitantei™: Old-School Slaughter, un giallo episodico d'avventura di battaglie con carte ispirato agli anime rétro.

games.title: Kun'tewiktuk: A Mi'kmaw Adventure
games.description: A fantasy adventure game inspired by Mi’kmaw legend and folklore. It chronicles the adventures of two young siblings Wasuek ("Flower") and her brother U'n ("Fog"). The siblings get separated one summer morning and they go on an adventure through the spirit world to reunite.

games.title: KURT ´99 - THE FOOTBALL MANAGER
games.description: KURT - THE FOOTBALL MANAGER: The perfect soccer manager for young and old. Game depth and fun guaranteed. KURT puts football back in the spotlight.

games.title: KurtzPel
games.description: KurtzPel è un gioco di combattimento d'azione in stile anime, con una prospettiva in terza persona.

games.title: L'Ascesa dei Pinguini GB
games.description: "L'Ascesa dei Pinguini" è un action-platformer 2D a scorrimento laterale per Gameboy. Il gioco è semplice e lineare ma con nemici impegnativi. Ispirato a Ghost n Goblins e Mega Man.

games.title: L3E7
games.description:
L3E7 is a next-gen location-based open-world RPG where the real world becomes your battlefield.
Explore a mirrored version of Earth powered by real-world maps. Walk, explore, and interact with your surroundings to unlock missions, claim landmarks, and engage in tactical battles.

games.title: La lira cremisi
games.description:
La lira cremisi
è un'immersiva avventura RPG in prima persona in una pericolosa terra fantastica. Costruisci il tuo personaggio, risolvi i problemi a modo tuo e recupera... La lira cremisi!

games.title: La mia amica Peppa Pig
games.description: Inizia un'avventura divertentissima con Peppa Pig. Crea il tuo stile, incontra i tuoi personaggi preferiti e gioca nel mondo di Peppa, proprio come nel cartone!

games.title: La Pasion XR
games.description: “La Pasión XR" takes guests on an ephemeral, audio-reactive journey through the Gateway Chamber Orchestra’s Spring 2023 performance of Osvaldo Golijov's La Pasion según San Marcos.
games.publisher: Agile Lens, LLC., Gateway Chamber Orchestra

games.title: La vendetta del pianeta selvaggio
games.description: Revenge of the Savage Planet è un'azione d'avventura sci-fi satirica e divertente. Saltate, sparate e raccogliete il vostro cammino attraverso vivaci mondi alieni, scoprendo nuovi equipaggiamenti e potenziamenti e vari segreti nascosti.

games.title: Lab Rat
games.description: Un'IA ossessionata dalle metriche ti osserverà, ti traccerà un profilo e ti intratterrà mentre avanzerai attraverso centinaia di enigmi di genere diverso.

games.title: Labyban
games.description:
LABYBAN modernizza l'esperienza dei giochi di puzzle proponendo un approccio accessibile, intuitivo e stimolante, adatto a tutti i pubblici.
Attraverso 157 livelli, teletrasportatori, tappeti rotanti e molte altre meccaniche vi aspettano!

games.title: Labyrinth Destroyer 1
games.description: Game

games.title: Labyrinth of Whiskers
games.description: Play through multiple mazes with 3 possible ending areas as a rodent collecting cheese to unlock new levels.

games.title: Ladies Dont Tempt My Immortality
games.description: Seven beautiful calamities are all that stand between you and godhood. Train, flirt, and survive divine tribulations in this live-action romantic fantasy where every choice tests your heart and your immortality.

games.title: Laika: Aged Through Blood
games.description: Laika: Aged Through Blood is a western-inspired motorvania set in a post-apocalyptic wasteland. It is the story about a tribe oppressed by occupant forces, and the personal story of a mother coyote warrior on an endless path of vengeance to take back what her people lost.

games.title: Lake
games.description: È il 1986. Meredith Weiss decide di prendersi una pausa dal lavoro nella metropoli per fare la postina nella sua città natale. Come passerà queste due settimane nella ridente Providence Oaks, una cittadina sulle sponde del suo famoso lago in cui risiedono degli abitanti piutto...

games.title: LakeSide
games.description:
LakeSide is a cozy city builder in side-scroll perspective.
Build and manage a quiet town by the lake or expand it into a picturesque city state. Construct marvelous buildings, epic wonders and become the envy of the known world!

games.title: Lakeside Bar
games.description: A cozy management sim where the jazz is smooth, the cocktails are cooler than the evening breeze, and the lake reflects your perfect escape.

games.title: Lamentum
games.description: Lamentum is a cosmic survival horror inspired by Resident Evil, the Cthulhu Mythos, and our deepest nightmares.

games.title: Land of Mushrooms
games.description: Dive into the Land of Mushrooms 🍄, where enchanting fungi come to life! Combine a delightful array of mushrooms, from the elegant Parasol to the flavorful Chanterelle.

games.title: Land of the Vikings
games.description: Land of the Vikings is a survival colony sim game. Lead your village and expand it into a thriving city. A wise Jarl must manage resources, survive harsh conditions, and guide their fellow Vikings to work together through social conflict. Skál!

games.title: Landora: Own Your World
games.description: Build, explore, and shape a living online city. Landora: Own Your World is an open-world social game where players create landmarks & colonies and evolve the world together.

games.title: Larva Mortus
games.description: Larva Mortus is a fast-paced hack and slash top-down shooter. As an agent specializing in exorcism, you are tasked to hunt monsters of the supernatural in a dark, ominous, and randomly generated atmosphere full of undead, terrifying and demonic nightmares.

games.title: Lasciami dormire
games.description: Risolvi enigmi spettrali e prova ad andare a dormire. Se hai il coraggio. Esplora una casa infestata e aiuta il tuo amico assonnato a riposarsi in questo gioco d'avventura unico e inquietante di risoluzione di enigmi!

games.title: Last Bullet West
games.description: A Western tactical roguelike strategy game. Lead outlaws in fights, handle alliances, make irreversible choices, focusing on gunfights and weapon-character synergy. Its three-stage adventure has high risks/rewards, gritty style, great replay value and strategy over numbers.

games.title: Last Caveman
games.description: What do parachutes, augers and bazookas have in common? They help the "Cavemen", a troop of irresistible fellows with loincloths and three-day beards, to complete their search for a cozy home with as little loss as possible.

games.title: Last Day of June
games.description: Un'intensa avventura sull'amore e sulla morte, rappresentata meravigliosamente in una travolgente esperienza cinematografica. Cosa saresti disposto a fare per salvare la persona che ami?

games.title: Last Flag
games.description: Nascondi la tua bandiera. Trova quella dei nemici. Torna indietro e difendila per un minuto per vincere. Last Flag è un rapido shooter 5v5 con concorrenti sfavillanti, ambientato in uno show televisivo in cui strategia e caos si uniscono in un epico rubabandiera.

games.canonical_title: Last Hammashan: Awakening of a Hero
games.title: Last Hammashan: Awakening of a Hero
games.description: To save the people of his village, He enters the Hammashan castle from which no one returns alive. But he sparks a war for the power of a civilization which the world believed has been annihilated.

games.title: Last Labyrinth
games.description: Gioco di avventura in cui si lavora con Katia, una ragazza che parla una lingua misteriosa, per fuggire da una sala con trappole mortali.

games.title: Last Sniper
games.description: Last Sniper is a dynamic shooting game built on BNB Chain, offering an intense and immersive experience. With blockchain integrated at its core, players can truly own and trade their weapons, skins, and in-game items — unlocking real value in a player-driven Web3 economy.

games.title: Last Stop: House of Horror
games.description: Last Stop: House of Horror is a first-person indie horror experience where a late-night delivery takes a terrifying turn. As you approach a remote mansion, a pair of dogs suddenly begin chasing you—reacting to a dark presence inside the house.

games.title: Last Words
games.description: Last Words is a game of social deception. As a time traveler on a budget, when your improvised time machine malfunctions and you’re taken prisoner in an unknown era, you must work with another traveler to escape. Will you get home faster by working together, or through betrayal…?

games.title: Late Shift
games.description: Late Shift è un thriller poliziesco FMV ad alto rischio. Costretto ad una brutale rapina a Londra, devi scegliere la tua avventura in questa esperienza cinematografica interattiva con trame adattabili che portano ad una delle sette conclusioni. Le decisioni spettano a te.

games.title: Lawn Mowing Simulator
games.description: Vivi una dettagliatissima esperienza di giardinaggio nella grande campagna britannica di Lawn Mowing Simulator, l'unico simulatore che ti permette di manovrare un vasto assortimento di tagliaerba realmente esistenti di produttori prestigiosi mentre gestisci i tuoi affari.

games.title: Layers of Fear
games.description: Tutte le storie giungono al termine, anche quelle più inquietanti e contorte. La tela. Il palco. Il romanzo. Quest'esperienza horror narrativa attende la pennellata finale, la chiusura del sipario e il capitolo conclusivo. Riuscirai ad affrontare le tue paure ancora una volta?

games.title: Layers of Fear 2
games.description: Layers of Fear 2 è un gioco horror psicologico in prima persona, con enfasi sull'esplorazione e sulla storia. I giocatori controllano un attore di Hollywood che accetta la proposta di un enigmatico regista, il quale gli chiede di interpretare il ruolo del protagonista di un fi...

games.title: Layers of Fear: Masterpiece Edition
games.description: Layers of Fear è un gioco horror psichedelico in prima persona fortemente incentrato sulla storia e l'esplorazione. Immergiti nelle profondità della mente di un pittore folle e scopri i segreti della sua follia.   Layers of Fear: Inheritance espande la trama di Layers of Fear ...

games.title: Le Quizz des animaux
games.description:
Test your knowledge and find the animal you hear !
Listen carefully to the sounds of animals and birds and have fun finding which forest friend is making each noise. A gentle, playful way to discover nature alongside Edmond and Lucy.

games.title: League of Legends
games.description: Diventa una leggenda. Trova il tuo campione, padroneggiane le abilità e batti in astuzia i tuoi avversari in un'epica battaglia 5v5 per distruggere la base nemica.

games.title: Learning Factory
games.description: Costruisci sistemi di approvvigionamento per soddisfare le esigenze dei clienti felini. Scopri strati di trasporto sotterraneo e aereo, un vasto albero di ricerca, mondi procedurali, apprendimento automatico e automazione infinita in questo gioco rilassante senza nemici.

games.title: Leave
games.description: LEAVE is a cinematic 3D platformer blending exploration, puzzles, and seamless gameplay. Guide a young child through a hauntingly beautiful world, overcoming challenges and uncovering a powerful story of resilience, hope, and defiance against tyranny.

games.title: Legacy of Kain: Ascendance
games.description: Avventurati nell'oscuro mondo di Nosgoth: Ascendance è un frenetico gioco di piattaforme e azione 2D, incentrato su combattimento, movimenti in verticale, poteri da vampiro, in cui la propria abilità sarà essenziale per avanzare.

games.title: Legacy of Kain: Defiance Remastered
games.description: Sarai il vampiro Kain, ma anche il luogotenente che ha rinnegato: Raziel. Brandisci lame leggendarie, sfrutta abilità sovrannaturali e fatti strada tra battaglie, intrighi e profezie: le strade dei due si incroceranno nell'oscuro mondo di Nosgoth.

games.canonical_title: Legacy of Kain™ Soul Reaver 1-2 Remastered
games.title: Legacy of Kain™ Soul Reaver 1-2 Remastered
games.description: Vivi l'epico conflitto tra Kain e Raziel nella forma originale o con grafica rimasterizzata.

games.title: Legend Bowl
games.description: Legend Bowl is a throwback to the classic football games of the past. Take to the gridiron and fight your way to becoming a football legend! Enjoy sim-style gameplay, realistic weather, detailed stats, season mode, tournament mode, fully customizable rosters, and more...

games.title: Legend of Bum bo
games.description: The Legend of Bum-bo is a puzzle-based "deckbuilding roguelike." Collect items that can be modified, upgraded and combined with others in many interesting ways. Smash through cardboard monstrosities, giant bosses and dark, personal urges. It’s the prequel to The Binding of Isaac!

games.title: Legend of Grimrock
games.description: Legend of Grimrock è un gioco di ruolo di esplorazione di dungeon vecchia scuola ma dall'aspetto moderno. Un gruppo di prigionieri è stato condannato a morte certa, esiliati sul remoto Mount Grimrock per orrendi crimini che potrebbero avere o non avere commesso.

games.title: Legend of Grimrock 2
games.description: Un gioco di ruolo di esplorazione di dungeon con una scorza moderna e un cuore vecchia scuola. Un gruppo di quattro prigionieri è naufragato su un'isola lontana disseminata di antiche rovine distrutte, santuari misteriosi e una vasta rete sotterranea di dungeon e miniere.

games.title: Legend of Keepers
games.description: Legend of Keepers è la miscela perfetta di gestione di dungeon ed elementi roguelite. Sei stato assunto come Dungeon Master dalla Dungeons Company. Il tuo compito è semplice: proteggere i dungeon!

games.title: Legend Of The Crystal Skulls
games.description:
There are stories of ancient artifacts, hidden throughout the world that once found will unlock the true potential of humanity.

This is the story of one person, trying to seek their destiny.

games.title: Legend Of Valmorra
games.description: The king is dead. The realms fracture. As ruler, forge alliances or fall to ruin. In this dark fantasy RPG, every choice shapes power, morality, and survival. Will you unite the crown—or let darkness claim it?

games.title: Legendary Creatures 2
games.description: Creato da HideChara, questo sequel dell'acclamato Legendary Creatures combina meccaniche roguelike e autobattler. Assolda e fai progredire svariate truppe, creature e un arsenale di armi per sconfiggere il signore dei demoni che sta diffondendo corruzione ovunque.

games.title: Legendary Hoplite
games.description: A combination of Action RPG and Tower Defense: slay monsters, find weapons, upgrade your armies, defend your base… Prevent humanity from extinction at the hands of monsters from Greek mythology and ancient tribes. Don't let them cross the gate, commander!

games.title: Legends of Elumia
games.description: Step into Elumia — a next-gen MMORPG where epic loot, hidden dungeons, and monstrous bosses await. Explore a vast fantasy world and claim true ownership of your characters and items. Forge your legacy in battles that go beyond the grind.

games.title: Legends of Elysium
games.description: Legends of Elysium is a Free-to-Play fantasy strategy game blending collectible card and board game elements. Build decks, pick unique heroes, and engage in tactical PvP leagues and tournaments to rise through the ranks in epic battles.

games.title: Legends of Runeterra
games.description: Abilità e creatività trionfano sempre in Legends of Runeterra, un gioco strategico di carte con gli iconici campioni e alleati dell'universo di League of Legends.

games.title: Legion TD 2
games.description: Un tower defense per giocatore singolo e multigiocatore da rigiocare all'infinito. Difenditi da ondate di nemici e distruggi il re nemico prima che l'avversario distrugga il tuo. Legion TD 2 è un gioco unico di tattica, lavoro di squadra e intuito. Per 1-8 giocatori.

games.title: LEGO® Batman™ 2: DC Super Heroes
games.description: Leggende a rapporto! Il Dinamico Duo composto da Batman e Robin si unisce ad altri famosi supereroi dell'universo DC, inclusi Superman, Wonder Woman e Lanterna Verde, per salvare Gotham City dalla distruzione per mano dei malvagi Lex Luthor e Joker.

games.title: LEGO® Batman™ 3: Gotham e Oltre
games.description: Il Crociato Incappucciato si allea con i super eroi dell'universo DC Comics e parte alla volta dello spazio per impedire al malvagio Brainiac di distruggere la Terra.

games.title: LEGO® Batman™: Il videogioco
games.description: Quando tutti i criminali del manicomio di Arkham uniscono le forze e sfuggono al controllo, solamente il Dinamico Duo è abbastanza coraggioso da affrontarli per salvare Gotham City. Il divertimento dei LEGO, la storia avvincente di Batman e questa combinazione unica rendono co...

games.canonical_title: LEGO® Batman™: L'Eredità del Cavaliere Oscuro
games.title: LEGO® Batman™: L'Eredità del Cavaliere Oscuro
games.description: Diventa il Cavaliere Oscuro e combatti contro i più famigerati supercriminali DC di Gotham City in un’avventura d’azione open world di TT Games, lo studio pluripremiato dietro LEGO® Star Wars™: La Saga Degli Skywalker.

games.title: LEGO® Brawls
games.description: Dream up the ultimate Minifigure brawlers and bash your way through all of your favorite LEGO® themes in the first team action brawler set in the LEGO universe. Play with friends at home or around the world and see how you stack up against the competition.

games.title: LEGO® Bricktales
games.description: In this puzzle-adventure, use an intuitive brick-by-brick building mechanic to solve puzzles and bring your creations to life! Experience a charming story as you explore beautiful LEGO® dioramas and help the people inhabiting them.

games.title: LEGO® Builder's Journey
games.description: LEGO Builder's Journey è un gioco a enigmi geometrici ricco di atmosfera che a volte ti chiede di seguire le istruzioni... e a volte ti chiede di infrangere le regole.

games.title: LEGO® Horizon Adventures™
games.description: Join machine hunter Aloy as she leads a colourful crew of heroes on a quest to save the world. Dive into boundless adventure, customize to your heart’s content, and take on action-packed battles solo or with friends.

games.canonical_title: LEGO® Star Wars™: The Skywalker Saga
games.title: LEGO® Star Wars™: The Skywalker Saga
games.description:
Gioca a tutti i nove i film della saga di Skywalker, in un videogioco come non se ne sono mai visti prima. Con più di 300 personaggi giocabili, più di 100 veicoli e 23 pianeti da esplorare, la galassia lontana non è mai stata così divertente! 

* Include il classico personaggio giocabile di Obi-Wan Kenobi

games.title: LEGO® Voyagers
games.description: From the makers of LEGO® Builder's Journey comes a new 2-player co-op adventure about friendship and play. When two friends make it their mission to rescue an abandoned spaceship, they embark on a journey beyond their wildest dreams.

games.title: Lemon Cake
games.description: Restore an abandoned bakery and prepare pastries from farm to table! Grow fresh ingredients in the greenhouse, cook pastries & sweets in the kitchen and serve your baked goods to hungry customers in your own shop!

games.title: Lempo
games.description: Trova la via di casa prima che il Metsänpeitto, il piano di esistenza ultraterreno, ti consumi. Lempo è un gioco horror psicologico ispirato alla mitologia finnica che pone enfasi sull’esplorazione.

games.title: LeMrosh in the Lazy Kingdom
games.description: A humorous point-and-click adventure game, full of clever puzzles, quirky characters, and unexpected twists. Get ready for hours of fun, a long journey, a few fairies... and a little love story.

games.title: Lesson Learned
games.description: Help Frank travel through history in this unique approach to the tower defense genre. Enter a bizarre daydream world in co-op or solo mode. Gather resources, build defense towers, and manage your minions. Take up the challenge and defeat the incoming enemies!

games.title: Let Me See
games.description: A collection of fun and relaxing puzzle games.

games.title: Let Them Come: Onslaught
games.description: Survive the relentless offensive of the alien horde, in this sci-fi survival roguelite. The pursuit of the perfect build and an ever-expanding arsenal of abilities are the keys to your success.

games.title: Let's Build a Zoo
games.description: È ora di costruire uno zoo! Scatena il tuo lato selvaggio e crea il tuo impero di animali in questo simpatico gioco espansibile di simulazione gestionale. Importa e alleva creature rare, assumi il personale giusto, rendi felici i tuoi ospiti e gestisci molti eventi strani e me...

games.canonical_title: Lethal Honor - Order of the Apocalypse
games.title: Lethal Honor - Order of the Apocalypse
games.description: Questo roguelite d'azione e avventura brutale e implacabile è ambientato in un mondo post-apocalittico tormentato. Affronta incessanti battaglie isometriche in mischia con uno stile grafico ispirato al periodo dark delle graphic novel per adulti sui supereroi degli anni '80.

games.title: Lethargy
games.description: Edizione base del gioco

games.title: Letherfall
games.description: Letherfall is a first-person horror video game with Lovecraftian elements: the player must make their way through monstrous entities and intricate puzzles while exploring the abandoned village of Letherfall.

games.title: Letsss Play
games.description: A blogger investigates disappearances at a mall built on the ashes of a circus. Posing as a night guard, he must uncover the truth behind the tragic fire and learn whose restless souls now haunt the halls. Gather clues and survive before the past consumes you.

games.title: Letters & Legends
games.description: Embark on an epic linguistic adventure in Letters & Legends, where words, wits, and wisdom are your greatest weapons! Sharpen your tongue and show your enemies who the true wordsmith is!

games.title: Letters Of War
games.description: Letters of War - is an emotional adventure drama inspired by real events and and a spiritual successor to Valiant Hearts: The Great War. During World War II, help a British carpenter stay connected with his daughter through letters, as war threatens to tear them apart forever.

games.title: Levelhead
games.description: Costruisci, gioca, condividi e competi su Levelhead, il creatore di piattaforma. Crea dei livelli impegnativi grazie ai profondi ma intuitivi sistemi dell'editor di livelli, poi condividili col mondo e guadagna un seguito!

games.title: LHEA and the Word Spirit
games.description: LHEA and the Word Spirit is a charming roguelite adventure about life and death with a unique timeline battle system. May the stars align in your favor!

games.title: Liberte
games.description: Liberté is a deck-builder roguelite inspired by the French Revolution and body horror. Brave the war-torn streets as Rene - a regular Parisian entangled in a civil war caused by a cryptic invader, Lady Bliss. Collect cards, nurture alliances, and try to stay alive!

games.title: Life After End
games.description: Life After End is a harsh and cruel representative of the Survival genre, where you have to survive in post-apocalyptic Siberia. Be prepared for harsh climatic conditions and realistic gameplay.

games.title: Life is Feudal: Arden
games.description: Life is Feudal: Arden è un nuovo MMORPG ambientato nel Medioevo, costruito sulle basi di Life is Feudal: MMO. Affronta avvincenti battaglie PvP, destreggiati negli intrighi politici, padroneggia una serie di professioni e fabbrica oggetti unici.

games.title: Life is Feudal: MMO
games.description: Vivi la dura realtà del medioevo. Sopravvivi, padroneggia le profonde meccaniche GdR, scopri un'economia pulsante, fonda comunità e impiega strategie diplomatiche per prosperare nelle vaste distese di Abella.

games.title: Life Makeover Global
games.description: Explore Life Makeover: Unleash your style, dye outfits, and design freely. Dive into unlimited dress-up, build your dream home - all for free.

games.title: Life of Delta
games.description: Life of Delta è un'avventura punta e clicca ambientata in un mondo post-apocalittico.

games.title: Lifeless Moon
games.description: During an expedition to the Moon, two astronauts find themselves in a familiar town back on Earth. They soon discover the town is the beginning of a strange and mysterious journey...

games.title: Lifeless Planet: Premier Edition
games.description: PREMIER EDITION - Durante la ricerca di forme di vita su un pianeta remoto, un astronauta scopre una città russa abbandonata. Sospetta che la sua missione sia un imbroglio finché una misteriosa giovane donna lo salva da uno strano fenomeno mortale...

games.title: Lifeslide
games.description: Lanciati in una suggestiva avventura sulla vita a bordo di aeroplanini di carta e padroneggia un'esclusiva meccanica di volo mentre viaggi per un mondo in continua evoluzione verso la tua destinazione.

games.title: Lifespace Traveler
games.description:
Action-packed, easy to learn, hard to master cyberpunk game where reality is split into dimensions called Lifespaces. 
No hand holding. No mercy. Fight your way and test your reflexes in fast-paced, brutal combat as you reveal the mysteries of an unforgiving dystopian world.

games.title: Light - Die to Survive
games.description: Light - Die to Survive is a trial-and-error horror game with no hints. Use your flashlight to navigate through a road, forest, and haunted house. Observe, die, and retry as time rewinds with each death. Can you survive the night?

games.title: Light of Alariya
games.description: Light of Alariya is an open-world, third-person, exploration puzzle game in which you traverse ancient alien temples and ruins to restore the power of the stars and awaken your sleeping civilization.

games.title: LightBreak
games.description: LightBreak is a unique rhythm cozy game where you make melodies and ASMR sounds, and unravel a mysterious story.

games.title: Lightyear Frontier
games.description: Lightyear Frontier is a peaceful open-world farming adventure on a planet at the far edge of the galaxy. Start your new home on a distant planet with up to three friends as you farm alien crops, build your own homestead, and explore the untamed wilderness of is not set

games.title: Lil' Guardsman
games.description: Imagine you're a 12 year old, suddenly in charge of the guard shed at the castle gate, where you decide if elves, goblins and 100+ other characters should be admitted. It's a wonderful combination of deduction, narrative and puzzle games.

games.title: Lila's Sky Ark
games.description: Protect a psychedelic world from bizarre beasts and punishing bosses in this poetic mystery filled with secrets, puzzles and music.

games.title: Limbo
games.description: Limbo è un'avventura indie vincitrice di premi e molto apprezzata dalla critica per il design accattivante dei suoi enigmi, oltre alla sua musica e alle grafiche coinvolgenti. Non ti sarà facile dimenticare le sue ambientazioni tetre e nebulose, così come la sua narrativa inqu...

games.title: Liminal Exit
games.description: You choose to explore the backrooms, but now you are trapped in a looping building. Now find the anomalies, break the loops and reach the Exit in this familiar yet chilling liminal spaces.

games.title: Liminal Point
games.description: Drawn to Ashen Point by a cryptic voicemail, Lyra returns to the island where her band’s story ended in tragedy. Shrouded in fog and prowled by horrors, confront deadly creatures, explore the desolate town, and reveal the truth behind the night that changed everything.

games.title: LIMP HEROES+
games.description: "LIMP HEROES+" is an action game in which you control a hero who moves with physical behavior and fights against an army of evil villains.

games.title: Limsod
games.description: Limsod è un FPS ambientato in un universo post-apocalittico in cui si deve combattere per la sopravvivenza in un mondo infestato da zombie mangia-carne. Potenziate il vostro equipaggiamento e giocate in una varietà di mappe e modalità di gioco.

games.title: Lindwyrm
games.description: No one suspected what lurked beneath Sigiswal. Meet ancient creatures and save the village in this roguelite action RPG. Dungeons with hack'n'slay combat, platforming and puzzles? We've got it! Strong bosses, co-op mode? That's a given! Are you ready for the Underground?

games.title: Line Time
games.description: Time is on your hands! Challenge yourself in this strategy puzzle game where you move a ball to its destination through a grid. Plan your movements, interact with different balls, and become a master of your own Line Time.

games.title: Line's Guarder
games.description: AI robots launched an attack on humans, and the brave girls took up weapons to defend the defense line, for the humans! — A small fast-paced stand-alone FPS game, with a battle mode and a zombie mode, each game takes 10 minutes, and a variety of character costumes are available.

games.title: LISA: Definitive Edition
games.description: Esplora Olathe e smaschera i suoi contorti segreti con LISA: Definitive Edition, che include l'originale GDR narrativo LISA: The Painful e il sequel LISA: The Joyful.

games.title: LISA: The Joyful - Definitive Edition
games.description: LISA: The Joyful - Definitive Edition is the soul-twisting conclusion to the quirky side-scrolling RPG series, LISA. Explore Olathe in your quest to punish the world that has treated you wrong. The world’s out to get you… now, get it back.

games.title: LISA: The Painful - Definitive Edition
games.description: LISA: The Painful - Definitive Edition is the miserable, hilarious RPG of your wildest nightmares. Undertake a relentless journey through the post-apocalyptic wasteland of Olathe. In this world, you will learn that being selfish and heartless is the only way to survive...

games.title: Little Big Adventure – Twinsen’s Quest
games.description: Esplora il fantastico mondo di Twinsun in questo remake di azione-avventura! Little Big Adventure - Twinsen's Quest offre un comparto grafico rinnovato, nuove musiche ad opera del compositore originale e una giocabilità più fluida che segue le orme del classico iconico del 1994.

games.title: Little Big Workshop
games.description: Immagina una fabbrica magica apparsa proprio nel tuo salone. Gestisci i lavoratori, le stazioni, i macchinari e crea dei prodotti incredibili mentre la tua piccola grande officina cresce fino a diventare una fabbrica da sogno!

games.title: Little Brother Jim
games.description: Little Brother Jim alternates between the jeep parking game, and Paul's journey up to the hill.

games.title: Little Comet
games.description: Little Comet is a cute physics-based space minigolf.

games.title: Little Inferno
games.description: Qualcosa sta bruciando...

games.title: Little Max Bunny
games.description: Avventura platform del piccolo coniglio Max.

games.title: Little Orpheus
games.description: Questa edizione definitiva del pluripremiato best seller di Apple Arcade, sviluppato dai grandi narratori di The Chinese Room, è rimasterizzata per il grande schermo e include tutti i contenuti bonus dell'originale. EMERGERÀ UN EROE!

games.title: Littlelands
games.description: The Littlelands region brims with strange characters and magical landscapes to discover if you know where to look. For a big-headed little youngster like you every moment exploring, growing berries, searching for treasures or walking through these lands can be an epic adventure.

games.title: Live Link Hub
games.description: Live Link Hub is a stand-alone application intended for use with UEFN and Unreal Editor. It enables UEFN and UE to receive real time animation data from 3rd party motion capture devices.

games.title: Lizard Slayer
games.description: Malvagie lucertole antropomorfe hanno attaccato la vostra terra. Dovete risolvere questo problema. Scegliete un personaggio e fate a pezzi le lucertole!

games.title: Loca Deserta: Odesa
games.description: Gather. Build. Craft. Produce. Help NPCs. Solve Quests. Find Treasures. Bring them to the Hill of Glory.

games.title: Locks Quest
games.description: Costruisci difese e affronta l'orda dei Meccanismi in questo ibrido tra GDR d'azione in 2D e Tower Defense. Vivi una storia avvincente nel corso dei 75 giorni di guerra, supportato da una serie di torrette, trappole e attacchi speciali.

games.title: LOEK
games.description: LOEK is a FPS where the goal is to shoot farm animals with a rocket launcher.

games.title: Lofi Witch Hatch
games.description: Un gioco idle di raccolta rilassante con bellissime ragazze (supporto offline). Sei un custode di uova che aiuta le ragazze a far schiudere uova di mostri. 3 bellissime ragazze + 200 tipi di uova di mostri + splendida musica lo-fi♪

games.title: Loftia
games.description: Welcome to Loftia, a cozy, multiplayer world where you can build towards a brighter, more sustainable future! Connect with friends both old and new, to farm, craft, explore, decorate, and create a meaningful impact - together.

games.canonical_title: LONELINESS SIMULATOR IN THE RUSSIAN VILLAGE
games.title: LONELINESS SIMULATOR IN THE RUSSIAN VILLAGE
games.description: An old Russian hut, endless forests, and not a single person for hundreds of miles around.

games.title: Lonesome Village
games.description:
Lonesome Village è una cittadina accogliente e tranquilla che lotta per tornare alla vita dopo che una strana calamità ha spazzato via tutte le sue case.

Vesti i panni del coyote Wes e aiuta il villaggio a fare ritorno dal baratro della distruzione in questo simulatore di vita pieno di rompicapi!

games.title: LONESTAR
games.description: LONESTAR è un deckbuilder strategico roguelike con astronavi. Cattura criminali spaziali nei panni di un cacciatore di taglie. Vinci la battaglia a onde d'urto per ricompense e ferie. Trova tesori, personalizza astronavi, sblocca talenti, sconfiggi delinquenti e diventa leggenda!

games.title: Look Mum No Computer
games.description: Music meets mayhem in this twin-stick shooter action-RPG! Craft synthesizer modules to gain new weapons and experiment with the original music of Look Mum No Computer. Meet quirky NPCs, complete quests and battle huge bosses.

games.canonical_title: Looney Tunes: Wacky World of Sports
games.title: Looney Tunes: Wacky World of Sports
games.description: Preparati per un gioco di Looney Tunes che combina pallacanestro, calcio, golf e tennis!

games.title: Loop
games.description: Embark on a journey through Loop's captivating puzzles, enhanced by breathtaking visuals and an immersive soundtrack.

games.title: Loop Hero
games.description: Il Lich ha condannato il mondo a un loop infinito e ha fatto precipitare i suoi abitanti in un caos senza fine. Impugna un mazzo di carte mistiche in continua espansione per posizionare nemici, costruzioni e terreni nel corso di ogni spedizione in loop del coraggioso eroe.

games.title: Looper Tactics Deluxe Edition
games.description: Welcome again, wandering soul. Will this be the time of your success? Navigate through this roguelike-deck builder, battle escalating challenges, and grow stronger in each encounter. Overcome endless reincarnation and emerge victorious!

games.title: Loopstructor
games.description: This is a strategy game that combines tower defence with Roguelike.Unlike traditional tower defense game, the towers in the game are vehicles that move along ‘loops’.You need to create defence loop and build battle trains to defend against enemy attacks.

games.title: Loopweavers: Dimensional Alliances
games.description: Loopweavers: Dimensional Alliances is a sci-fi tactical card game where battlefield positioning, resource management, and planetary environments shape every encounter, offering multiple paths to victory.

games.title: Loot Stack - Relics Hunter
games.description: Puzzle rilassante di gestione dell’inventario ambientato in dungeon medievali. Organizza, impila e incastra reliquie dalle forme uniche, ottimizza la griglia e raccogli tesori nascosti in 25 scenari realizzati a mano.

games.title: Lord Ambermaze
games.description: Questo mondo e tutta la vita in esso si sono fermati. Solo i tuoi passi possono forzare il flusso del tempo a muoversi. Devi ripristinare il flusso del tempo - e a tal fine, dovrai addentrarti nelle profondità degli inferi e sfidare il malvagio Signore.

games.title: Lords & Villeins
games.description: In questa spensierata simulazione strategica di city-building in pixel art potrai far nascere e crescere intere dinastie medievali, osservandone l'evoluzione e le interazioni mentre costruisci le loro case.

games.title: Lords Mobile
games.description: Affronta milioni di giocatori globali in questo epico gioco strategico!

games.title: Lords of the Fallen
games.description: Un vasto mondo ti attende nel GDR d'azione dark fantasy medievale Lords of the Fallen. Sei un crociato nero che deve affrontare un'epica missione per sconfiggere Adyr, il Dio demoniaco. È disponibile la versione 2.0, con co-op con progressione condivisa e Pass Amici Gratuito.

games.title: Lords of the Fallen II
games.description: Lords of the Fallen II è un GdR d'azione dark fantasy con brutali combattimenti in stile Soulslike e ambientato in un mondo lacerato nel profondo. Combatti l'oscurità in un'epica avventura in un regno in rovina. Un mondo. Due regni. Nessuna pietà.

games.title: Loretta
games.description: Loretta is a psychological thriller that makes the player an accessory to the heroine’s crimes, leading her through a self-crafted nightmare. Loretta’s story revolves around a woman handling betrayal, her husband’s infidelity, and reclaiming her agency during the tumultuous 1940s

games.title: Lost Age
games.description: In the mystical world of Lost Age, darkness looms, and heroes rise to reclaim the light. Embark on a captivating adventure where card-based strategy meets the excitement of RPG.

games.canonical_title: Lost and Found 1: Agency Collector's Edition
games.title: Lost and Found 1: Agency Collector's Edition
games.description: Embark on an exciting Hidden Object adventure! Join the “Lost & Found Agency” as a detective to solve thrilling cases. Explore mysterious locations, find missing objects, crack puzzles, and uncover secrets. Enjoy the Collector's Edition with exclusive bonuses!

games.title: Lost and Hound
games.description: Scent-track and find the lost, hunt down criminals and save lives in this  canine adventure! Meet Biscuit, the one-and-only doggo detective! User her superpowered hearing and scent tracking skills to protect and heal those around you. Built to include blind and deaf players, too.

games.canonical_title: Lost Artifacts 6: Mysterious Book Collector's Edition
games.title: Lost Artifacts 6: Mysterious Book Collector's Edition
games.description: Embark on a heroic mission with Claire - quench her thirst for adventure and help her find all the stones!

games.canonical_title: Lost Artifacts 7: The Ghost of Florence Collector's Edition
games.title: Lost Artifacts 7: The Ghost of Florence Collector's Edition
games.description: Reveal the mystery of the Ghost of Florence, uncover the conspiracy, and save da Vinci’s inventions!

games.title: Lost Castle
games.description: Lost Castle è un RPG d'azione beat'em up con elementi roguelike e dungeon randomizzati per un massimo di quattro giocatori online e in locale!

games.title: Lost Colony
games.description: Lost Colony is a sci-fi twin-stick shooter roguelike. Battle aliens and rogue drones with your evolving combat drone companion. Explore a shifting colony, collect alien tech to upgrade weapons, boost your drone's powers, and uncover the dark forces behind the colony's fall.

games.title: Lost Eden
games.description: An adventure-strategy game in a world never before imagined

games.title: Lost Eidolons
games.description: Lost Eidolons è un GDR tattico a turni con una trama accattivante, ambientato in un impero in declino devastato da una guerra civile. Vesti i panni di un affascinante capitano mercenario, Eden, e guida gli alleati in incontri epici su un classico campo di battaglia a turni.

games.title: Lost Ember: Rekindled Edition
games.description: Explore the acclaimed animal adventure in never before seen beauty! Slip into the role of different animals to uncover the fate of an ancient world. Dive into deep waters, fly at lofty heights or climb steep cliffs, there are lots of ways of getting around.

games.title: Lost in Random™
games.description: Sfida la sorte in Lost in Random™, un'avventura ispirata alle fiabe gotiche in cui il destino di ogni abitante è determinato dal lancio di un dado.

games.title: Lost in Space: Madness
games.description: Un gioco di strategia di carte a turni di fantascienza in cui devi guidare la tua squadra di astronauti attraverso l'orrore, la scarsità di cibo mantenendo la loro sanità mentale e scoprire il mistero della missione.

games.title: Lost in the Hole
games.description: In the creepy world of an abandoned lab, where mutants and dangerous experiments await you! Search for clues and fight to stay alive! In the abandoned, yet living world of the lab, surprises await around every corner as the retro style of the 70s meets futuristic sci-fi elements.

games.title: Lost Islands
games.description:
You don’t remember how you got to this islands, but now you’re stranded in the wild.
Surviving here will be no simple task.
First you’ll need to find food, craft some primitive tools, and build a shelter. Think you have what it takes?

games.title: Lost Lullabies
games.description: "Lost Lullabies - The Orphanage Chronicles" is a Co-Op horror game set in 1980, inspired by the real stories of an orphanage ruined by a fire in 1960 Lowell. Playable with 1-4 players, the goal is to identify and expel malevolent spirits alone or with your team.

games.title: Lost Records: Bloom & Rage
games.description: Intraprendi un nuovo percorso narrativo dai creatori di Life is Strange. Filma la tua estate del 1995 e crea i ricordi di una vita con le tue nuove amiche. 27 anni dopo, affronta quei segreti oscuri che vi fecero promettere di non parlare mai più dopo quella fatidica estate.

games.title: Lost Relics
games.description:
Lost Relics is an ARPG set in the enchanting world of Lunaria.
Players embark on thrilling adventures, battle fierce monsters, and uncover valuable limited supply collectibles.
Players can customize their loadouts with a classless skill system through their artifacts and weapons.

games.title: Lost Ruins
games.description: Lost Ruins is a 2D side-scrolling survival action game. You play as a young girl who has awoken in a strange place without her memories. With the aid of weapons, spells, and the guidance of the mysterious Beatrice, you will explore a dangerous world and topple incredible bosses.

games.title: Lost Soul Aside™
games.description: Intraprendi un'epica odissea per salvare tua sorella minore, e l'intera umanità, da misteriosi invasori dimensionali provenienti dai cieli stellati in Lost Soul Aside™.

games.title: Lost Wing
games.description: Pilot a super fast ship through brutal environments, and try to top the leaderboards! Featuring numerous challenges, ships, enemies and traps, Lost Wing is a shot of pure unadulterated adrenaline.

games.title: Lost Words: Beyond the Page
games.description: Interagisci con le parole incise nella pagine del diario di una ragazzina per risolvere enigmi complessi, gestire dei particolari segmenti platform e scoprire un'emozionante storia ambientata nel vivace mondo di Estoria in Lost Words: Beyond the Page.

games.title: Lots of Things - Collector's Edition
games.description: Dive into the world of "Lots of Things"! Explore vibrant locations, search for hidden objects, and solve captivating puzzles. Enjoy thrilling mini-games, uncover surprises, and collect souvenir puzzles. Perfect for hidden object fans—start your adventure today!

games.canonical_title: Lots of Things 2: Travel and Search Collector's Edition
games.title: Lots of Things 2: Travel and Search Collector's Edition
games.description: Dive into the world of Hidden Object fun with "Lots of Things 2 Travel and Search"! Explore amazing locations like mountain peaks, African savannahs, and the Great Wall of China. Solve puzzles, find hidden objects, and enjoy mini-games. Adventure awaits—start now!

games.title: Lotus Lantern: Rescue Mother
games.description: Lotus Lantern: Rescue Mother is a roguelike top-down action game, inspired by a Chinese mythology. Players will experience the journey of Chenxiang rescuing his mother, Sanshengmu, after mastering martial arts skills from Sun Wukong.

games.title: Loulan: The Cursed Sand
games.description: Loulan: The Cursed Sand is an action RPG set along the ancient Silk Road in the Western Regions of China. You play as the Cursed Sand, a skeletal warrior wielding the power of sand to explore the lost kingdom of Loulan, battle mighty foes, and seek your beloved princess.

games.title: LOVE 3
games.description: Posiziona i tuoi checkpoint in questo gioco a piattaforme di precisione!

games.title: Love all my girls
games.description: What would you do with infinite resurrection and time travel? Predict the future, save the world, get rich overnight… or date six girls at once? You’ve lived every man’s dream but stepped into a fatal trap. You’re just trying to make them all happy—what’s wrong with that?

games.title: Love Is All Around
games.description: The player becomes Gu Yi, uses the first-person perspective to immerse himself in meeting six beauties, and embarks on a joyful and sweet love journey with them. Which girl will go to the end with you is up to you to decide.

games.canonical_title: Love is All Around: Echoes of Yesterday
games.title: Love is All Around: Echoes of Yesterday
games.description: In this product, "you" take on the role of Gu Yi, the male lead who is about to enter graduation season. In the midst of confusion and longing for the future, you will embark on a series of stories with six girls with different personalities and charm.

games.title: Love n Life: Lucky Teacher
games.description: After the pandemic, you lost your job as a space aviation expert and now become a teacher in a small town. Luckily, every cloud has a silver lining as you are stepping into a world where love blooms unexpectedly and leads you to captivating ladies with immersive romantic tales.

games.canonical_title: Love n War: Hero by Chance II
games.title: Love n War: Hero by Chance II Ultimate Edition
games.description: Love n War: Hero by Chance II is a tactical RPG with exciting battles and hot girls. The fight against the Drogakan empire goes on with a more sophisticated storyline this time. Build your economy, recruit gorgeous heroic girls, upgrade units, and immerse in stimulating love tale

games.title: Love Too Easily
games.description: A memory of a sweet kiss from last night. A lost cell phone. Three suspects. Become the main character's helper, make story choices, collect hints, and clear mini-games. A full-scale mystery romantic comedy interactive movie.

games.title: Love Yuri
games.description: A visual novel game about an unexpected Yuri romance.

games.title: Love, Death & Bikini
games.description:
Love, Death & Bikini is a live-action video interactive game.
The game takes you into the world of the main character, where you have complex interactions with 10 beautiful women, and the game does not contain romantic elements and a touching plot.

games.title: Lovecraft's Untold Stories
games.description: Lovecraft's Untold Stories è un rogue-lite d'azione con elementi GDR. Esplora livelli generati casualmente basati sulle storie di Lovecraft, combatti fanatici e mostri provenienti dai Miti, migliora il tuo equipaggiamento, risolvi enigmi e scopri come sconfiggere i Grandi Anti...

games.title: Lovecraft's Untold Stories 2
games.description: Lovecraft’s Untold Stories 2 is a sequel to the first action RPG with rogue-like elements based on the Lovecraft Mythos ever released. Brand new graphics, a new, complex crafting system, 6 playable characters, and lots of incredibly challenging content!

games.title: Lowlife Forms
games.description:
A massively-modular science fantasy RPG shooter filled with alien gangsters, cosmic smuggling and space shamans.

Starting in the the Can, an intergalactic prison, you will embark on an epic adventure around Cygnus X-1 where guns and magic do all the talking.

games.title: Lowlife Forms Demo
games.description:
A massively modular sci-fi shooter where survival, creativity, and fun chaos collide in endlessly shifting worlds.

Lowlife Forms is the flagship title from Right Trigger Entertainment, a new breed of sci-fi RPG shooter set in a universe where sci-fi meets organized crime.

games.title: Lucid Falls
games.description: Manipulate gravity, space and time, and survive terrifying nightmares in a deeply atmospheric lucid dream. Facing terrifying creatures, and solving challenges that bend reality, every moment reveals more of the dark truth behind Lucid Falls.

games.title: Luciferianism
games.description: A philosophical religious roguelike, the firstwork penned in the Luciferian canon, it takes place in the Netherworld. Explore a vast open world, encounter all the strange people, creatures, demons and God's that inhabit this odd land of dreams. April is the cruellest month.

games.title: Lucky Goal
games.description: Lucky goal offers an experience of a soccer game through a third-person view. Create or participate in an online match and show who is a better soccer player. A singleplayer adventure is waiting for you to improve your gaming skills.

games.canonical_title: Lucky Lord: The Coin Pusher of Fate
games.title: Lucky Lord: The Coin Pusher of Fate
games.description: Lucky Lord: The Coin Pusher of Fate combines slot-machine-style random strategy with roguelike card enhancement mechanics, creating a unique gameplay experience centered around a coin pusher.

games.title: Lucky Tower Ultimate
games.description: Fuggi da una torre generata proceduralmente e piena di pericoli in un roguelite demenziale che sembra un cartone animato e suona come una barzelletta. Taglia di qua, rompi di là!

games.title: Luctus
