- The Coma: Recut
- The Coma 2B: Catacomb
- The Coma 2: Vicious Sisters
- The Coma 3: Bloodlines

games.title: Pacific Drive
games.description: Survive the anomaly-filled Olympic Exclusion Zone with a car as your only lifeline. Scavenge resources from abandoned research sites, load up your trusty station wagon, and drive like hell to make it through alive. This run-based driving survival adventure arrives in 2023.

games.title: Paintball - the puzzle game
games.description: Paintball is a top down puzzle game for 1 to 3 players. Copy given colored geometric shapes by throwing a ball back and forth.

games.title: PaintBall War 2
games.description: Paintball War 2 è il seguito del più ambizioso gioco di simulazione sportiva basato sulla disciplina sportiva nella vita reale chiamato paintball!

games.title: Painter Simulator
games.description: PAINTER SIMULATOR is a new-generation game in which the emphasis is placed on the player's imagination and perceptiveness. Create the world in the colors you want to see with a brush.

games.title: Painting Werther
games.description: Painting Werther is an Paintable Visual Novel where all the visuals are living paintings, all the music are classics (with a twist) and the novel was written by Goethe.

games.title: Paladin's Passage
games.description: Intraprendi un viaggio epico in questo avvincente platform 2,5D dove attraverserai più di 100 dungeon realizzati a mano e traboccanti di mostri.

games.title: Paladins
games.description: Unisciti agli oltre 30 milioni di giocatori di Paladins, lo spettacolare sparatutto a squadre fantasy completamente gratuito. Impugna le armi e piega la magia al tuo volere nei panni di un leggendario campione del regno, personalizzando la tua base di abilità per giocare esatt...

games.title: PALGRAP
games.description: PALGRAP offers a virtual laboratory for quantum experiments such as double slit, free wave packet, and Mach-Zehnder Interferometer. Educational videos and PDF worksheets can be flexibly integrated. Results can be saved as PDF files for documentation and further use.

games.title: Palladium: Adventure in Greece
games.description: In this game you will play as an archaeologist who is driven by a desire to find an ancient artifact. The hero will travel to Greece to solve riddles and avoid hazardous traps. But he is not the only one who wishes to obtain the treasure...

games.title: Pallor Noctis Online
games.description: Survive the night in this dark fantasy multiplayer social deduction game. Gather resources by day, but trust no one when darkness falls. Uncover the traitor, or become their next victim.

games.title: Pandemic Train
games.description: In Pandemic Train you are in charge of the crew aboard a train roaming the postapocalyptic wasteland, ravaged by both war and a deadly plague. Your goal is to survive long enough to discover the cure… or die trying. Humanity’s fate is in your hands! Start your journey now!

games.title: Panic Room 2: Nascondino
games.description: Il viaggio in una villa abbandonata ha portato alla prigionia all'interno della casa del maniaco.

games.title: Panic Room: Fantasmi del Passato
games.description: Cosa attende un prigioniero che si risveglia nella casa di un padrone noto per i suoi giochi crudeli?

games.title: Pantheon Rift
games.description: Get ready for a thrilling party-style battle royale where your only weapon is a sword. Take down other players while avoiding environmental chaos and destruction. The fast-paced matches and unpredictable environment require quick thinking, adaptability, and strategy.

games.title: Panzer Corps 2
games.description: Panzer Corps 2 è il gioco di strategia definitivo ambientato durante la seconda guerra mondiale. Goditi la collaudata formula di gioco apprezzata da milioni di giocatori nel corso degli anni, portata a un nuovo livello di rifinitura all'altezza dei nuovi standard tecnici.

games.title: Panzerdogs
games.description: An action-packed multiplayer tank brawler where players battle head-to-head in fast-paced PvP combat. Customise and craft the ultimate tank to match your play style, strategise across various game modes, and outmanoeuvre opponents in thrilling matches.

games.title: Panzerkampf®
games.description: Command historically accurate tanks in thrilling PvP team battles! Enjoy realistic vehicle physics, actual armor-profiles and proper shell ballistics!

games.title: Pao Pao
games.description: Pao Pao is a chaotic blend of culinary adventure and animal mayhem! Run your own restaurant, gather ingredients, go fishing, and expand your business—solo or with friends. Every order is an adventure—jump in and see for yourself!

games.title: Paper Beast
games.description: Un gioco di avventura ed esplorazione alla scoperta della fauna scaturita dagli abissi di Internet. Un potere sconosciuto sembra romperne gli equilibri.   Fai squadra con creature esotiche per svelare i misteri di questo universo.

games.title: Paper Cut Mansion
games.description: In this papercraft roguelite, explore a mysterious mansion floor by floor. Solve puzzles, battle enemies and complete quests as you unlock new abilities to aid you on each run as you solve the mystery behind the Paper Cut Mansion.

games.title: Paper Trail
games.description: Paper Trail è un emozionante rompicapo con visuale dall'alto ambientato in un mondo di carta. Piega dopo piega, ti avventurerai lontano da casa.

games.title: PaperMadeRacing
games.description: A Game driving cars on the circuit, no nitrogen acceleration, no exaggerated drifting.

games.title: Paquerette Down the Bunburrows
games.description: The buns... you HAVE to capture them!! Think outside the bunburrow or get outsmarted by bunnies in this cute pathfinding-based puzzle game!

games.title: Paradigm
games.description: Paradigm is a surreal adventure game set in the strange and post apocalyptic Eastern European country of Krusz. Play as the handsome mutant, Paradigm, whose past comes back to haunt him in the form of a genetically engineered sloth that vomits candy.

games.title: Paradise Killer
games.description: Paradise Island, un mondo esterno alla realtà. Si è consumato un assassinio che solo Lady Love Dies, la “maniaca delle investigazioni”, è in grado di risolvere. Raccogli le prove e interroga tutti i sospettati in quest’avventura open world. Decidere chi è colpevole spetta a te.

games.title: Paradise XRPL
games.description:
PARADISE XRPL is a life simulation game with limitless possibilities. 
Play with your friends, engage in shootouts, race cars, complete daily missions, and reach the apex of life. Earn $PAR and buy what you want, from real estate to fancy clothes.
Endless World, Endless Play.

games.title: Paradox Tower
games.description: The Paradox Tower holds the key to the future. With only a magic staff and a demon cat at your side, will you be able to find your way to the top? Grow stronger, pick your battles, and rewind time to fix your mistakes!

games.title: Parallel TCG
games.description: Earth, 10,000 years in the future. Five parallel evolutions of humanity fight for control of the planet they once called home. Pick a faction, build a deck, and battle your peers from around the world for control over Earth and the ultimate source of power in the galaxy.

games.title: Paramnesia
games.description: Paramnesia is an interactive detective visual novel where Maria, the protagonist of this story, is a member of two radical sects with contradictory opinions. Delve into her mind to understand herself and the truth.

games.title: Paranoia: Happiness is Mandatory
games.description: Paranoia: Happiness is Mandatory

games.title: Parasite Mutant
games.description: Parasite Mutant è un gioco di ruolo survival horror che utilizza il sistema Active Time Chains.

games.title: Parkitect
games.description: Parkitect è un gioco di simulazione aziendale che ti affida il compito di costruire e gestire dei parchi a tema! Ripropone tutto il meglio che i classici giochi di parchi a tema hanno avuto da offrire insieme a tante nuove funzionalità e contenuti. Adesso supporta la modalità ...

games.title: Parkour Labs
games.description: Sei bravo nei videogiochi di parkour? Sei il numero 1 nel surf? Questo è il tuo gioco, benvenuto a Parkour Labs, un'esperienza che metterà alla prova le tue abilità.

games.title: PAROLE INTRECCIATE IN ITALIANO
games.description: Facile, rilassante e ottimo per la ment

games.title: Partisans 1941
games.description: Partisans 1941 è un gioco di strategia in tempo reale con elementi furtivi, ambientato nel fronte orientale della seconda guerra mondiale. Nei panni di un comandante infiltrato oltre le linee nemiche dovrai formare un gruppo di partigiani per scatenare una guerriglia contro gli invasori tedeschi.

games.title: Pascal's Wager: Definitive Edition
games.description: Pascal's Wager: Definitive Edition è un gioco di ruolo avvincente ambientato in un oscuro mondo fantasy. Entra nei panni di una Guida mentre scopre la storia dietro alla misteriosa Foschia oscura.

games.title: Passing By - A Tailwind Journey
games.description: Conquista i cieli a bordo della tua nave aerostatica e scopri un mondo variopinto costellato da isole fluttuanti.

games.title: Path of Exile
games.description: Sei un Exile che lotta per sopravvivere nel continente oscuro di Wraeclast, combattendo per guadagnare il potere che ti permetterà di ottenere vendetta contro coloro che ti hanno fatto del male. Creato da grandi appassionati di videogiochi, Path of Exile è un GDR d'azione onli...

games.title: Path of Exile 2
games.description: Path of Exile 2

games.title: Pathcross
games.description:
Pathcross is a nonogram-inspired puzzle game.
Use the numerical clues to find the path going from the green Starting cell to the red Finishing cell.

Play as you like with 3 levels of Difficulty and enjoy finding the unique solution of each puzzle in a Classic or Cosy experience.

games.title: Pathfinder: Abomination Vaults
games.description: Il primo ARPG hack and slash cooperativo basato su un Adventure Path, in cui i giocatori guideranno gli iconici eroi di Pathfinder nelle profondità della Gauntlight Keep per affrontare letali abomini e raggiungere la strega Belcorra Haruvex, ponendo fine ai suoi piani malvagi.

games.title: Pathfinder: Kingmaker - Enhanced Plus Edition
games.description: Pathfinder: Kingmaker - Enhanced Plus Edition è il primo GDR per PC in isometrica basato sulla squadra ambientato nell'universo fantasy di Pathfinder. Goditi un'esperienza GDR classica ispirata a giochi come Baldur's Gate, Fallout 1 e 2, e Arcanum.

games.canonical_title: Pathfinder: Wrath of the Righteous - Enhanced Edition
games.title: Pathfinder: Wrath of the Righteous - Enhanced Edition
games.description: Embark on a journey to a realm overrun by demons in a new epic RPG from the creators of Pathfinder: Kingmaker. Explore the nature of good and evil, learn the true cost of power, and rise as a Mythic Hero capable of deeds beyond mortal expectations.

games.title: Pathfinder: Wrath of the Righteous - Game of the Year Edition
games.description: Vai all'avventura nel miglior GDR del 2021 con tutte e sei le espansioni premium. Conduci un gruppo di compagni unici, stringi alleanze e diventa l'eroe mitico che deciderà le sorti dei mortali e degli dei.

games.title: Pathway
games.description: Esplora uno strano ignoto con Pathway, un'avventura strategica ambientata nella grande landa selvaggia degli anni '30. Svela misteri occulti da tempo dimenticati, saccheggia antiche tombe e supera in astuzia i tuoi avversari in combattimenti tra squadre a turni!

games.title: Pato Box
games.description:
Una missione surreale a tema pugilato con una papera!

Svela profondi segreti esplorando delle emozionanti ambientazioni 3D con uno stile visivo da graphic novel/fumetto.

games.title: Patrolling Mars
games.description: Drive over the rough Mars terrain, jump over holes and other obstacles, fire at attacking alien space craft and other dangers. Clear each stage and try to get the highest score. A good pallet cleanser with good old arcade fun.

games.title: Patron
games.description: Patron è un city-builder di sopravvivenza con un sistema di dinamiche sociali unico. Raccogli e produci risorse, trasforma il tuo giovane villaggio in una città prosperosa e gestisci le intricate tensioni sociali prima che raggiungano il punto di ebollizione.

games.title: Paug
games.description: Paug is a small game inspired by the hit of the 70s. It takes place in Egypt where the spirits of the pharaohs wake up, angry after your intrusion into their tombs. You can play alone or up to 2 players locally.

games.canonical_title: PAW Patrol: i Supercuccioli salvano Adventure Bay
games.title: PAW Patrol: i Supercuccioli salvano Adventure Bay
games.description: Un meteorite ha donato poteri incredibili ai cuccioli e lasciato Adventure Bay nel caos. Esplora l'universo di PAW Patrol, salva vecchi amici e rendi la città di nuovo PAWrtentosa!

games.canonical_title: PAW Patrol™ La squadra dei cuccioli: Il mondo dei dinosauri
games.title: PAW Patrol™ La squadra dei cuccioli: Il mondo dei dinosauri
games.description: Unisciti ai PAW Patrol e a Rex in missioni colossali sull'Isola dei dinosauri. Crea completi ruggenti, gioca minigiochi con amici e molto altro.

games.title: PAW Patrol™ Rescue Wheels™: Championship
games.description: Gioca con le Rescue Wheels! Sfreccia e vinci tra acrobazie e derapate, in solitaria o con gli amici!

games.title: Pawn of the Dead
games.description: Sell by day. Survive by night. A pawn shop simulator where you barter by daylight and battle zombies after dark.

games.title: Pax Autocratica
games.description: In Pax Autocratica, shape a grand colony where every life bends to your will. Feel the weight of absolute power as you decree laws, then lead your squads in roguelite FPS battles from brutal skirmishes to large-scale battlefields and unite the Tyris System under your banner.

games.title: Pax Dei
games.description: Welcome to a vast, social sandbox MMO inspired by medieval legends. Here, myths are real, ghosts exist, and magic is unquestioned. Join thousands of players as you explore the land, build your home, forge your reputation, and craft your own stories. What world will you make?

games.title: PAYDAY 2
games.description: PAYDAY 2 è un frenetico sparatutto cooperativo per quattro giocatori che permetterà di indossare ancora una volta le maschere della Payday Gang originale, Dallas, Hoxton, Wolf e Chains, mentre piomba su Washington D.C. per compiere una miriade di atti criminali.

games.title: PAYDAY 3
games.description: PAYDAY 3 è il fantastico sparatutto in prima persona definitivo sul mondo del crimine. Lavora in solitaria o cospira in modalità cooperativa, scegli il tuo approccio (furtivo o gettandoti nell'azione a testa bassa), assembla un arsenale letale e porta a termine il colpo perfetto.

games.title: Pazleum
games.description: Build 3D jigsaw puzzles of famous works of art in a virtual museum. An evocative, visually stunning experience with relaxing soundscapes and intuitive mechanics.

games.title: PBA Pro Bowling 2026
games.description: Rise from amateur to PBA legend in the most realistic bowling simulation ever made, featuring advanced physics, realistic oil pattern transition, licensed PBA pros, deep career progression, and multiple competitive game modes.

games.title: PC Building Simulator
games.description: Costruisci e fai crescere un'azienda di riparazione di computer imparando a diagnosticare, riparare e assemblare PC. Grazie alle componenti di marche reali e a una simulazione approfondita di hardware e software, potrai progettare e dare vita al PC definitivo.

games.title: PC Building Simulator 2
games.description: Fai crescere il tuo impero mentre impari a riparare, costruire e personalizzare i computer a un livello superiore. Prova una simulazione più intensa, una modalità carriera aggiornata e nuove potenti funzionalità di personalizzazione. Utilizza componenti reali di oltre 40 marche di hardware per dar vita al tuo PC definitivo.

games.canonical_title: Peaceful Gardens 2: Cute Cats Collector's Edition
games.title: Peaceful Gardens 2: Cute Cats Collector's Edition
games.description: Relax in cozy gardens and find hidden cats in this charming hidden object game.

games.title: PeakPals
games.description: PeakPals offers a multiplayer game where players strive to reach the top, either alone or with friends. The game involves overcoming obstacles, solving puzzles, enduring falls, and engaging in playful acts of sabotage, like throwing grenades at teammates' feet.

games.title: Pecker
games.description: You are Pecker, a cute bird with a bendable beak. Alone or with up to 3 friends: Climb, puzzle and overcome enemies in numerous levels!

games.title: Peggle Deluxe
games.description: Sfodera il tuo tiro migliore e vivi un divertimento arcade stimolante! Mira, spara, elimina i tondini arancioni, poi rilassati ed esulta: 10 stravaganti Maestri ti mostreranno la grandezza di Peggle.

games.title: Peggle™ Nights
games.description: Unisciti ai maestri Peggle in un'avventura da sogno tra alter ego e azione piena di tondeggiante gioia. La notte è giovane: spara ed elimina i tondini arancioni e assapora la gloria della Festa Estrema al chiaro di luna.

games.title: PengPong
games.description: PengPong is a bullet-hell roguelike where pinball meets gambling. Bounce your way through chaos and bet it all to survive.

games.title: Penguin Panic
games.description: The walruses stole your eggs. Time to get them back! Run, jump, and stomp your way through 17 vibrant levels in this fast-paced, family-friendly platformer. Uncover secrets and collect shiny fish—all with simple controls and tons of charm. Pure penguin-powered fun for all ages!

games.title: People and Zombies
games.description: People and Zombies is a post apocalyptic survival game that currently only supports single player gameplay. Its characteristic is the story of survival in a post apocalyptic world of extreme poverty and resource scarcity.

games.title: People of Note
games.description: In questo GdR musicale a turni, unisciti alla cantante pop Cadence mentre recluta un gruppo di musicisti nella sua scalata al successo.

games.title: Pepper Grinder
games.description: Pepper Grinder è un'avventura 2D ricca d'azione che mescola il platform tradizionale con una nuova modalità trivellazione che ti consentirà di "tuffarti" nel terreno come un delfino nell'acqua.

games.title: Perceptum
games.description: Un gioco horror psicologico in cui interpreti una medium che indaga sulla scomparsa di una famiglia. Esplora una casa dall'atmosfera opprimente, chiudi gli occhi per sentire l'aldilà, usa il tuo specchio per vedere l'invisibile e scopri la verità nascosta tra le sue mura.

games.title: Peregrino
games.description: Peregrino is a dark isometric survival adventure where you explore a cursed forest by day and manage your caravan by night. Gather resources, hunt deadly creatures, upgrade your caravan, care for your companions, and lead them through the vast wilderness in search of New Eden.

games.title: Perennial Order
games.description: Perennial Order è un gioco horror 2D in cui affronterai boss vegetali, ambientato in un mondo oscuro afflitto da bestie infestate dall’azione della natura.

games.title: Perfect Loop - Soleris
games.description: Perfect Loop – Soleris is a turn-based time-loop RPG: The Entity sends you to Soleris to prevent the world’s downfall. Progress through questlines across multiple runs, level up, and improve your gear to overcome ever greater challenges.

games.title: Perfect Plan
games.description: Enjoy uncapped health and deploy-able shields for intense action. It a FPS game combining shoot 'em up and platforming. Take on a solo robot's mission to rob a bank and defeat Multiple crazy hard bosses while unlocking a variety of guns, special items and shield upgrades.

games.title: Perimeter
games.description: Perimeter is an innovative Real-Time-Strategy game that pits players against each other or AI opponents in a life and death struggle to seize territory and establish crucial protective “perimeters.”

games.title: Perimeter: Emperor's Testament
games.description: The game expands the story of the original Perimeter in a vast singleplayer campaign.

games.title: Peripeteia
games.description: Peripeteia is a first-and-third-person role-playing stealth game taking place in alt-history cyberpunk Poland. Inspired by immersive sims from Ion Storm and Looking Glass Studios, Peripeteia expands on the formula with new ideas and an original setting.

games.title: PERISH
games.description: PERISH è un elegante FPS per 1-4 giocatori con una croce da sopportare. Uccidi orde di creature sulle sabbie bruciate del Purgatorio e vendi i loro cadaveri macchiati d'oro a vili sacerdoti. Uccidi magnifici boss e usa il ricavato per ottenere l'ingresso all'Elysium.

games.title: Permafrost
games.description: Permafrost is a story-driven survival sandbox set in a frozen, post-apocalyptic world. Discover a vast lore-rich open world, alone or in co-op with up to 4 players. Explore, scavenge, craft, and build a network of shelters to outlast the cold.

games.canonical_title: Persha and the Magic Labyrinth -Arabian Nyaights-
games.title: Persha and the Magic Labyrinth -Arabian Nyaights-
games.description: Cats and magic play a big role!? New experience! Puzzle battle RPG!

games.title: Pesterquest
games.description: Embark on a quest of epic importance in Pesterquest, a grimsical episodic visual novel adventure set in the darkly funny Homestuck / Hiveswap universe. Find all the answers you're looking for as you zap between Earth and Alternia making friends as you go.

games.title: Phantasy Star Online 2 New Genesis
games.description: Phantasy Star Online 2 New Genesis, the latest chapter in the Phantasy Star Online 2 series, is here at last! It's time to jump into adventures beyond imagination!

games.title: Phantom Blade Zero
games.description: S-GAME presenta Phantom Blade Zero, una fusione tra wuxia e azione su Unreal Engine 5. Vesti i panni di Soul, un guerriero con soli 66 giorni di vita. Sventa i piani degli assassini, svela complotti che minacciano il mondo e difendi i tuoi valori a costo della vita.

games.title: Phantom Breaker: Battle Grounds Ultimate
games.description: A side-scrolling beat'em up with the heart of a fighting game, supporting cross-platform pixel art anime action with up to 8P online multiplayer and all the characters from "Phantom Breaker: Battle Grounds Overdrive"!

games.title: Phantom Brigade
games.description: Phantom Brigade è un GDR a turni ibrido con elementi di strategia in tempo reale, incentrato su una personalizzazione dettagliata e su storie che si sviluppano in base alle decisioni del giocatore.   Fai parte dell'ultima squadra di piloti di mech sopravvissuta e dovrai imposs...

games.title: PHANTOM GALAXIES™
games.description: PHANTOM GALAXIES™ è un'avventura sci-fi di combattimento mecha epica. Sceglie la classe e le armi del tuo Starfighter e combatti contro pirati senza legge nello spazio dilaniato dalla guerra.

games.title: PHANTOM LAMB
games.description: Play a story-driven third-person psychological thriller set in a sinister early-20th-century asylum where reality bends under the weight of forgotten horrors. Phantom Lamb blends tense stealth gameplay with an immersive narrative of haunting secrets and psychological dread.

games.title: Phantom Line
games.description: Join the paranormal SWAT. Phantom Line is a co-op (1-4) shooter set in the post-nuclear European continent. Your mission is to search and contain paranormal events and activities (anomalies) hidden from the public eye, in an open world map full of dynamic events.

games.title: Phantom Watcher
games.description: Phantom Watcher is a chilling horror-strategy game. Survive the haunted hospital’s mysteries, navigating ghostly behaviors in a unique CRT aesthetic. Each playthrough is a new eerie challenge. Dare to uncover the secrets?

games.title: phase knight
games.description: Phase Knight, your body is half flesh and half machine.  Fight for the definition of "humanity"! In a galactic war of flesh, machinery, and data, reclaim your existence

games.title: Phoenix Contract
games.description: Phoenix Contract is an exhilarating MMORPG that immerses you in a world teeming with adventure, mystery, and relentless battles.

games.title: Phoenix Point: Complete Edition
games.description: Phoenix Point: Complete Edition, l'acclamato gioco di strategia del creatore di X-COM, è ora incluso nella raccolta definitiva insieme a tutti i DLC, gli aggiornamenti dei contenuti e i miglioramenti del prodotto creati nel corso di quattro anni di sviluppo.

games.title: Phonopolis
games.description: Phonopolis è un'avventura rompicapo narrativa in un mondo di cartone 3D dipinto a mano. Risolvi un ampio ventaglio di divertenti rompicapi nei panni di Felix e stronca il coercitivo Leader in una città intrisa di suoni e distopia ispirata all'arte avanguardista.

games.title: Phoots and the Pineapple Throne
games.description: Take action as a demon from another world takes over your home island! Play as Ridge, a Phoot who lost his memories and must save the island from being destroyed. Travel across hand drawn environments, unlock weapons and spells, and defeat challenging bosses.

games.title: Photo Studio Simulator
games.description:
Start your own photography studio!
Hire staff, upgrade your interior, and manage your business to attract more customers.
Transform your humble studio into a full-scale photography base.
Invite models, build relationships, go on dates, and unlock exclusive private photo shoots.

games.title: Pig And Chikin
games.description: This is the tale of 🐷Pig & Chikin🐔. In a world where pigs have wings, Pig loses her wings in an accident. Her friend Chikin takes her on a journey to fly again. On the way, they meet magical places and creatures who offer insights into companionship, community, and acceptance.

games.title: Pikuniku
games.description: Aiuta strani personaggi a superare avversità, scoprire una cospirazione dello stato profondo e dare il via a una mini-rivoluzione divertente in questa piacevole avventura distopica!

games.title: Pile Up! Box by Box
games.description: Pile Up! Salta, scivola, collabora e accatastati con i tuoi compagni di squadra in questo cooperativo platformer 3D ideale per le famiglie!

games.title: Pilgrims
games.description: Esplora liberamente il territorio, incontra nuovi amici, divertiti con i tuoi compagni di viaggio e aiutali a risolvere i loro piccoli problemi, a modo tuo. Quante diverse soluzioni troverai?

games.title: Pillars of Eternity - Definitive Edition
games.description: Prova il gioco che ha ridefinito il genere tradizionale dei GDR in un pacchetto completo e definitivo che include tutte le espansioni, i bonus e gli aggiornamenti, permettendoti di giocare a Pillars of Eternity al suo massimo splendore.

games.title: Pillazon - MMO Drug Lord Tycoon
games.description: Pillazon is an MMO virtual business simulation game where you work as the CEO of a new company. Your mission is to create your own website and build the world's extensive drug empire!

games.title: Pinball FX
games.description: Pinball FX è un flipper digitale evoluto. Ottieni un punteggio da record su tavoli ispirati ai più grandi colossi del mondo dell'intrattenimento. Verranno aggiunti regolarmente nuovi tavoli!

games.title: Pinball M
games.description: Preparati ad avere paura e... ad andare in tilt. La nuova piattaforma flipperistica d'ispirazione horror per i giocatori più indomiti. Dai prova delle tue abilità sui tavoli più sinistri, più truculenti e più tosti mai creati.

games.title: Pine
games.description: Un gioco di azione open world ambientato in un mondo simulato in cui gli esseri umani non hanno mai raggiunto la cima della catena alimentare. Combatti con o contro una varietà di specie mentre cerchi di raggiungere la nuova area in cui insediare la tua tribù di umani.

games.title: Pine: A Story of Loss
games.description: Solo nella radura nel bosco che condivideva con la moglie, un falegname fatica ad accettare la sua scomparsa. Aiutalo a conservare i loro ricordi più cari mentre lotta per prendersi cura di se stesso. Pine è un gioco breve incentrato su un racconto emozionante.

games.title: Pinguini 2: L'Oscura Ascesa
games.description: Lancia palle di neve e attraversa sette livelli impegnativi nei panni di Kaito, un giovane pinguino. Padroneggia le sfide platform, raccogli oggetti e affronta boss epici in questa avventura 2D.

games.title: Pipe Mania
games.description: Pipe Mania is a fast-paced puzzle game in which players lay down a set of pipes on a tiled grid in order to keep the Flooze - a constant flowing substance that speeds up with progression - moving through the pipes as long as possible without overflowing.

games.title: Pipistrello and the Cursed Yoyo
games.description: Are you ready for the first Yoyovania?! In this 2D top-down adventure you'll explore a sprawling urban landscape, reinterpreting your surroundings through your mastery of yoyo tricks. Navigate the districts, fight crime bosses, and regain the influence of the Pipistrello family!

games.title: Pirate Go: Bravo
games.description: Ultimate Nautical Adventure Monopoly

games.title: Pirate Mosaic Puzzle. Caribbean Treasures
games.description: Hoist the Jolly Roger and seek out the treasure of the Caribbean sea in Pirate Mosaic Puzzle. 120 new pirate mosaics!

games.title: Pirate Royalty
games.description: Party up in a stylized fantasy MMORPG built for co-op chaos. Team up for dungeons, trade and craft gear, hunt rare gems, and push your build with class skills—whether you’re duoing, roaming solo, or rolling deep with friends.

games.title: Pirate Ships
games.description: Pirate Ships is a PvP game about shipbuilding and naval battles. Embark on an epic journey together with other players and fight monsters, pirates and thieves to become the greatest pirate in all of the Caribbean!

games.title: Pirates Outlaws
games.description: A roguelike card game in which you navigate dangerous seas and challenge their masters.

games.title: Pirates Outlaws 2: Heritage
games.description: Pirates Outlaws is a roguelike card game in which you navigate dangerous seas and challenge their masters. Your expedition will be full of ambushes and will not be easy. Build your deck and combos to become a reputed pirate.

games.title: Piroker
games.description: 8 Enter. Only 1 Survives. The World's First Poker Roguelike Auto-Battler!

games.title: Pistonica
games.description: Pistonica invites you into a calm, open world where steam and machines meet. In this first-person steam automation game, you build and automate a refined factory, explore an island, research tech, and trade goods - all because of a strange radio signal.

games.title: Pit Panic
games.description: Escape the sinking Aztec temple in this cartoonish rogue-like arcade platformer. Dig your own path up, jump and climb in blazing speed, hoard loot, trade lives for god-like powers, beat bosses and master 1000 handmade levels.

games.title: Pixel Art Coloring Book
games.description: Unleash your inner artist with a captivating pixel art coloring book! Immerse yourself in a world of vibrant pixels and intricate designs. Perfect for all ages, this book combines nostalgia with creativity, providing hours of relaxation and self-expression.

games.title: Pixel Gun 3D
games.description:
The legendary FPS mobile multiplayer - fast, fun, and unforgettable!
Experience dozens of game modes and maps, 1500+ guns plus cross-platform multiplayer and progression.

games.title: Pizza Bandit
games.description: A wild co-op shooter where hilarious bounty hunting collides with panic-fueled cooking. Travel through time, blast enemies, and cook under fire to fund your dream pizzeria. Guns, gadgets, and dough—what could go wrong?

games.title: Plague: London 1665
games.description: Plague: London 1665, an RPG with pixel art, unfolds in 1665 during the Bubonic Plague in crowded London. As a body collector, graveyard keeper, and family provider, navigate the outbreak's perils while clearing the streets. Will you survive, or succumb to become another victim?

games.canonical_title: Plambra Dash: The Parkour Game Part I
games.title: Plambra Dash: The Parkour Game Part I
games.description:
Jump, climb, and race your friends in this thrilling parkour adventure set in a mysterious tropical village reaching up to the sky!
Dive into fast-paced, action-packed fun.
Don’t miss out! Grab your spot and start the climb now!

games.canonical_title: Plambra Dash: The Parkour Game Part II
games.title: Plambra Dash: The Parkour Game Part II
games.description:
Jump, climb, and race your friends in this thrilling parkour adventure set in a mysterious tropical village reaching up to the sky!
Dive into fast-paced, action-packed fun.
Don’t miss out! Grab your spot and start the climb now!

games.title: Planescape: Torment: Enhanced Edition
games.description: Planescape: Torment: Enhanced Edition riporta in vita il bizzarro ed elettrizzante classico! Svela i segreti delle vite passate in questo GDR tattico dalla trama ricca, ambientato in un oscuro mondo fantasy nel cuore del multiverso di Dungeons & Dragons.

games.title: Planet Alpha
games.description: PLANET ALPHA, un bellissimo mondo alieno ricco di misteri e pericoli. Inseguito da nemici inarrestabili, devi controllare il potere della notte e del giorno mentre lotti per sopravvivere.

games.title: Planet Coaster 2
games.description: Fatti un tuffo in Planet Coaster 2, il sequel del miglior simulatore di parchi a tema al mondo!

games.title: Planet Cube - Edge
games.description: Il Planet Cube è stato invaso! Preparati a correre, sparare, saltare e scattare in quest'avventura ad alta velocità ambientata in un mondo disegnato a mano in pixel-art, pieno di momenti platform e di emozioni.

games.title: Planet of Lana
games.description: A young girl and her loyal friend embark on a rescue mission through a colorful world full of cold machines and unfamiliar creatures. Planet of Lana is a cinematic puzzle adventure framed by an epic sci-fi saga that stretches across centuries and galaxies.

games.title: Planet Zoo 2
games.description: Crea un mondo selvaggio in Planet Zoo 2. Crea in tutto il mondo zoo unici e abitati da animali maestosi, tra cui specie acquatiche e volanti.

games.title: Planeticus
games.description: Planeticus è un gioco di strategia spaziale multiplayer in 2D sulla conquista del pianeta e delle risorse. Cattura quanti più pianeti possibile per allevare invasori. Conquista l'intero spazio!

games.canonical_title: Plants vs. Zombies™ Edizione Game of the Year
games.title: Plants vs. Zombies™ Edizione Game of the Year
games.description: Gli zombi stanno per attaccarti e la tua unica speranza è un arsenale di piante! Dovrai pensare in fretta e piantare ancora più in fretta per sconfiggere diversi tipi di zombi all'istante.

games.title: Plants vs. Zombies™ GW2: Deluxe Edition
games.description: Prepara le sparasemi e scopri le battaglie più folli e divertenti dell'universo in Plants vs. Zombies Garden Warfare 2.

games.title: Plants vs. Zombies™: BDN Deluxe Edition
games.description: Fai di tutta l'erba uno sfascio con Plants vs. Zombies: La Battaglia di Neighborville, lo sparatutto più bizzarro di sempre! La Deluxe Edition include il gioco base e sensazionali contenuti esclusivi.

games.title: Plants vs. Zombies™: Replanted
games.description: Il classico Plants vs. Zombies ritorna in grande spolvero in HD! La battaglia originale tra piante e zombi è di nuovo qui: più grande, vivace e folle che mai! Rimasterizzata con una splendida grafica HD e ricca di nuovi segreti e contenuti da scoprire.

games.title: PlateUp!
games.description: Cook and serve your dishes, design and decorate your restaurants, and expand your culinary kingdom with new unlocks, abilities and dishes in procedurally-generated locations. Classic cooking action with permanent roguelite progression. Hire your friends - or do it all yourself!

games.title: Play with Me - Escape Room
games.description: "Play With Me: Escape Room" is a horror point and click game inspired by the movie "Saw". As Robert Hawk, an investigative journalist, you must survive a dark maze of puzzles and illusions. Use unconventional solutions real items from Your room.

games.title: Playa Golf
games.description: Experience golf on your PC with Playa Golf, a casual simulator tuned using real-world data from launch monitors for ball flight and feel. Solo play, or friendly matches with local multiplayer. Golf that feels real without the hassle. Your fairway awaits!

games.title: Player Non Player
games.description: Explore a strange island and meet four enigmatic characters. Interact with them, tame them and uncover their dreams. Can you help these characters so they can finally rest in peace?

games.title: Plot of the Druid
games.description:
A mystical comedy adventure with sarcastic British wit, hand-drawn cartoon art, and an innovative shape-shifting ability for solving puzzles.
Plot of the Druid is a classic-modern point-and-click game that’s reminiscent of Simon the Sorcerer, Discworld, and Harry Potter.

games.title: Pluto Lost Its Colors
games.description: Join Pluto in its quest to reclaim its colors in this chaotic yet rewarding experience! Pluto Lost Its Colors is a fast paced platformer with physics based controls. Master the physics of Pluto as you roll, jump, and dash through challenges. This game is your next addiction.

games.title: PNX Labs Mechanics of Materials 101
games.description: This virtual lab package focuses on materials testing and solid mechanics, offering an interactive environment to explore the mechanical behavior of engineering materials. It includes tensile, compression, torsion, fatigue testing and more experiences to evaluate materials.

games.title: PNX Labs Thermal Fluids 101
games.description: This virtual lab package provides an immersive, interactive environment for exploring key principles in thermodynamics, fluid mechanics, and instrumentation. It includes experiments on heat transfer, fluid flow, and energy systems such as centrifugal pumps, and more.

games.title: Pocket Cars
games.description: Pocket Cars è un gioco di corse arcade di combattimento ad alta velocità, dove puoi guidare auto radiocomandate che sfrecciano su tracciati straordinari.

games.title: Poetic Trio
games.description: A game about rain, a game about snow, and a game about wind. All in one.

games.title: Poker Club
games.description: Ecco la simulazione di poker più immersiva mai creata. Vivi la vita di un professionista del poker in un Poker Tour globale, o unisciti a un Club e fai salire il tuo nome in cima alle classifiche.

games.title: Police Car Armored Cop Simulator
games.description: If you like police games, this police car driving simulator is for you.

games.title: Police Car Escape Simulator
games.description: Are you ready for the multi-directional chase of the cops? Experience an adrenaline-filled police game with Police Car Escape Simulator. Escape, crash and beat the cops in fast vehicles!

games.title: Police Car Simulator
games.description: If you like police simulator car driving, a great cop game is waiting for you.

games.title: Police Car SUV Simulator
games.description: Police Car SUV Simulator is a police car simulation with realistic graphics. Catch criminals, take them to the police station, and customize your vehicle with the rewards you earn.

games.title: police vs criminal
games.description: In this game, players are divided into two camps: the police to catch criminals, and the criminals to steal treasure.

games.title: Police, Open The Door!
games.description: Police Open The Door is the ultimate decision-making game for anyone who's ever wondered what it's like to be a police officer. With realistic scenarios, this immersive game will put you in the shoes of a cop responding to emergency calls and making split-second decisions

games.title: Political Punchers 2024 Arena
games.description: Choose from 11 politician fighters and battle across 10 stages. Featuring cross-platform multiplayer match-ups and 11 hilarious single player stories. As the 2024 presidential election approaches, Political Punchers offers a humorous way to make light of the political chaos.

games.title: Political Run: World Leaders
games.description: A fast-paced 3D endless runner where world leaders sprint through busy city streets, smash cars with powerful boosts and chase high scores in chaotic, comedy-driven arcade action.

games.title: Poly Bridge 2
games.description: L'acclamato simulatore di costruzione di ponti è tornato ed è il migliore di sempre! Nuovi livelli, nuove meccaniche, un motore fisico personalizzato, campagne Workshop e molto altro! Riscopri la tua creatività ingegneristica con ore e ore di rompicapi divertenti!

games.title: Poly Plaza 2
games.description: The next opus in the Poly Plaza Series, an open world idle tycoon rpg about making money.

games.title: Poly Plaza ULTIMATE
games.description: Un gioco sandbox imprenditoriale open-world. Vendi risorse, acquista proprietà, diventa ricco. Include tutti i DLC e nuovi contenuti da Poly Plaza!

games.title: PolyClassic: Wild
games.description: Questo gioco è un'azione che combina elementi del classico sparatutto retrò e stile low poly. Distruggi tutti i nemici sul tuo cammino e diventa il cowboy più duro del selvaggio West!

games.title: Polygon Bit Battle Royale
games.description: Polygon Bit Battle Royale è uno sparatutto multiplayer di massa a basso numero di poligoni, che supporta 50 giocatori per server. Combatti su una mappa su larga scala con vari combattimenti tra veicoli. Atterra, saccheggia e sopravvivi per vincere la battaglia!

games.title: Polygon War
games.description: Polygon War is an idle and roguelike game. You choose a turret, select a weapon, and launch yourself into a series of increasingly difficult enemy waves.

games.title: Pompeii: The Legacy
games.description: Pompeii: The Legacy is a historical city builder where you rebuild the Roman city of Pompeii from the ashes, manage citizens, laws, trade, and guide your city through disasters and centuries of change.

games.title: Ponchiqs
games.description: Immerse yourself in the ultimate gaming experience with Ponchiqs, a meta universe that seamlessly blends a first-person shooter game.Unleash a wide array of customizable psycho powers, and engage in enjoyable social interactions with fellow Ponchiqs.

games.title: POOLS
games.description: Simulatore di camminata. Esplora, ammira e ascolta. Strano. Rilassante. Inquietante. Misterioso. Immersivo. Nessun mostro ti insegue o salta sullo schermo, ma può risultare opprimente evocando paure di perdersi, del buio, degli spazi stretti e dell'architettura liminale.

games.title: Poor Artifact Maker
games.description: The Poor Artifact Maker is a tower defense game based on Chinese fairy legends. The refiner has to explore the dangerous world in order to find his lost companion.

games.title: Poosh XL
games.description: Poosh your way through the obstacles and see how far you can get in this neon-infused, one-button, arcade score chaser!

games.title: Popcorn Rocket
games.description: Popcorn Rocket is a silly old-school arcade space shooter. Pilot the Popcorn Rocket as you blast through hordes of spaceships in order to save the galaxy from the evil Nebula Empire! With a wacky cast of heroes and villains, Popcorn Rocket will leave your stomach wanting more!

games.title: Poppy Playtime: Capitolo 1
games.description: Sopravvivi in quest'avventura horror con puzzle. Fuggi dai vendicativi giocattoli che ti attendono nella fabbrica abbandonata. Usa il tuo GrabPack per manomettere i circuiti elettrici o afferrare gli oggetti da lontano. Esplora la fabbrica misteriosa... e non farti acciuffare.

games.title: POPUCOM
games.description: POPUCOM è un gioco di piattaforme multigiocatore co-op. Nei panni di un avventuriero, vieni evocato su un pianeta sconosciuto per affrontare un'avventura cosmica con i tuoi amici.

games.title: Populous™
games.description: Sposta montagne, separa i mari e guida eserciti di mortali alla vittoria in Populous. Assumi i poteri di una potente divinità e combatti per sopraffare un dio nemico, usando una strategia ponderata per modellare un mondo isometrico e il destino del tuo popolo.

games.canonical_title: Populous™ II: Trials of the Olympian Gods
games.title: Populous™ II: Trials of the Olympian Gods
games.description: Sconfiggi potenti divinità nel Pantheon greco, pupillo di Zeus, e prendi il posto che ti spetta sul Monte Olimpo. Impara a scuotere il cielo con i fulmini e a inondare la terra col fuoco. Evoca eroi per aiutare il tuo popolo e piaghe per distruggere i nemici.

games.title: Populous™: The Beginning
games.description: Nel terzo capitolo della serie Populous, devi controllare il tuo sciamano e la sua tribù di seguaci nella difficile missione di conquistare tutti i 25 pianeti di un sistema solare e ascendere allo stato di divinità.

games.title: Port Royale 4
games.description: In Port Royale 4 assumerai il controllo di una colonia nel ruolo di un giovane e ambizioso governatore pronto a compiere tutte le azioni necessarie per gestire e far diventare il suo piccolo insediamento una fiorente città commerciale.

games.title: Possessions
games.description:
Navigate surreal landscapes, solve mind-bending puzzles, and uncover a silent story set in a beautifully minimalist world.
In Possessions, nothing is as it seems.

games.title: Potato Sack Racing Simulator 2024
games.description: The only Potato Sack Racing Simulator to feature Potato-Tracing technology up to 240FPS in 4K HDR and lower if you run it on a potato.

games.title: Potion Craft: Alchemist Simulator
games.description: Potion Craft è un simulatore di alchimia in cui interagisci fisicamente con strumenti e ingredienti per preparare pozioni. Hai il pieno controllo della tua bottega: inventa nuove ricette, attira i clienti e sperimenta a tuo piacimento. Ma ricorda: la città conta su di te.

games.title: Potion Permit
games.description: Gli abitanti di Moonbury hanno bisogno di cure e tu sei il miglior farmacista disponibile! Grazie ai tuoi fidati attrezzi, un calderone e un compagno a quattro zampe, diagnostica i sintomi, raccogli gli ingredienti, crea le pozioni e cura i malanni in questo GDR di simulazione.

games.title: Potion Tycoon
games.description: Potion Tycoon è un gestionale con un tocco di stregoneria! Costruisci e sviluppa il tuo negozio di magia. Gestisci le risorse, imposta linee di produzione, mescola pozioni e vendile con intelligenza per battere la concorrenza. Benvenuto nel business delle pozioni!

games.title: Power to the People
games.description: Build and maintain a power grid for a constantly growing population, while fighting off all kinds of disasters in this thrilling resource management experience. It's time for you to give "Power to the People"! Do you have what it takes to keep the lights on?

games.title: PowerWash Simulator 2
games.description: PowerWash Simulator è tornato, ricco di nuovi luoghi, attrezzature potenziate e funzionalità spruzzose. Trasforma facilmente ambienti sporchi in oasi di pulizia e pace, in solitaria o in compagnia. La soddisfazione è a portata di spruzzo!

games.title: Pray for Death
games.description: The Ultimate Combat Challenge!

games.title: Pre-Armageddon
games.description:
Pre-Armageddon

The goddess NEPHTHYS was seduced by the dragon, the ancient serpent, so it is now up to her to defeat it.

games.title: Predator: Hunting Grounds Standard Edition
games.description: Gioca a un coinvolgente sparatutto multigiocatore asimmetrico e vivi in prima persona lo scontro tra uomini e Predator. Come membro del fireteam, dovrai completare le missioni prima che il Predator ti trovi. In alternativa, calati nei panni del Predator e dai la caccia alla tu.

games.title: Predecessor
games.description: Nato dall'eredità di Paragon, realizzato con passione dalla community e alimentato da Unreal Engine 5, Predecessor è la fusione definitiva tra azione FPS e strategia MOBA. Unisciti a oltre 2.000.000 di persone e gioca GRATIS ora!

games.title: Prehistoric Kingdom
games.description: Prehistoric Kingdom offre un punto di vista moderno al genere di simulazione di gestione, con l'attenzione puntata sulla creazione e la gestione del tuo vero e proprio zoo preistorico. Prendi il controllo di un potere illimitato e costruisci, gestisci e fai crescere lo zoo sup...

games.title: Prehistorik
games.description: Eat and beat your way through 150 scenes of awesome nourishing fun and relive the "Prehistorik" epic in this incredible platform game.

games.title: Prehistorik 2
games.description: Back to hungerland!

games.title: Presences: Dark Awakening
games.description: Explore a dark reality, discover a forgotten ritual, interact with the world around you, solve ancient puzzles, platform treacherous underground chambers, and feel the terror. Survive the night in this interactive haunted house narrative adventure from a first-person perspective.

games.title: Preserve
games.description: Preserve is a relaxing puzzle nature-building game in which you flourish a vibrant ecosystem by cleverly placing plants and animals to create a perfect symbiosis to your liking.

games.title: Prey
games.description: In Prey, ti risveglierai a bordo di Talos I, una stazione spaziale che orbita intorno alla Luna nell'anno 2032. Sei l'oggetto principale di un esperimento che mira a modificare l'umanità per sempre. Ma le cose sono andate terribilmente storte.

games.title: Priest Simulator: Vampire Show
games.description: A mockumental action game. Go forth and rock in the absolute weirdest and most messed up simulator in the history of sandbox shooters. Fully unprofessional English language version. This dub will have you in stitches.

games.title: Primordials: Battle of Gods
games.description: Primordials: Battle of Gods

games.title: PRINCE OF INDIA
games.description: It's a story of a prince, who crosses many traps and kills all the enemies and recovers a magical gem (which was stolen by the enemy mastermind), to bring his dead father, i.e. the king, back to life with the power of the gem, and also rescues the princess from there.

games.title: Prince of Persia Standard Edition
games.description: Prince of Persia Standard Edition

games.canonical_title: Prince of Persia The Lost Crown
games.title: Prince of Persia The Lost Crown
games.description: Dash into a stylish and thrilling action-adventure platformer set in a mythological Persian world where the boundaries of time and space are yours to manipulate. Play as Sargon and evolve from sword-wielding prodigy to extraordinary legend as you master acrobatic combat and unlock new Time Powers and unique super abilities.

games.canonical_title: Prince of Persia: Sands of Time
games.title: Prince of Persia: Sands of Time
games.description: Prince of Persia: Sands of Time

games.canonical_title: Prince of Persia: The Forgotten Sands
games.title: Prince of Persia: The Forgotten Sands STANDARD EDITION
games.description: Prince of Persia: The Forgotten Sands STANDARD EDITION

games.canonical_title: Prince of Persia: The Two Thrones
games.title: Prince of Persia: The Two Thrones Standard Edition
games.description: Prince of Persia: The Two Thrones Standard Edition

games.canonical_title: Prince of Persia™ - New Era Bundle
games.title: Prince of Persia™ - New Era Bundle
games.description: Put your platforming and combat skills to the test to save Persia in this bundle that reimagines the legendary Prince of Persia™ franchise.

games.title: Prince of Qin
games.description: The game balances team-fighting, with up to five heroes per team, and the use of various skills and abilities.

games.title: Princess Farmer
games.description: Be the magical bunny farmer you've always wanted to be! Princess Farmer is a charming visual-novel meets match-3 gameplay, with a host of adorable characters to befriend, mysteries to solve, and fashion to collect. Smash rocks! Make combos! Win hearts!

games.title: Printfarm Simulator
games.description: Start with your first 3D printer and grow your printing farm step by step. Manage your printers, organize materials, and fulfill orders while finding the best way to run your business smoothly.

games.title: Prism 2033
games.description:
Prism 2033 is a next-generation Futuristic Parallel-Universe MMORPG built with Unreal Engine 5.
Travel across parallel worlds, take on new challenges, and shape the future of the Parallverse.

games.title: Prison Architect
games.description:
Benvenuti, direttori penitenziari!

Solo il direttore più spietato del mondo può contenere i detenuti più spietati del mondo. Progetta e sviluppa il tuo penitenziario personalizzato in Prison Architect.

games.title: Prison City
games.description: Prison City è un gioco d'azione distopico a scorrimento orizzontale, con meccaniche serrate e livelli intricati. Affronta i tecno-terroristi con chakram e granate, mangia gli hot-dog per recuperare salute e trova i contatti affinché ti aiutino ad abbattere i boss.

games.title: Pro Basketball Manager 2024
games.description: Benvenuto in Pro Basketball Manager 2024, la migliore esperienza manageriale di basket che offre una profondità e autenticità senza pari con oltre 175 competizioni d'elite. Fai vedere al mondo di essere il miglior manager!

games.title: Pro Basketball Manager 2025
games.description: Preparatevi a diventare manager di una squadra di basket. Avrete il controllo su tutto: sullo scouting, sull’allenamento, sulle strutture e altro ancora. Vi focalizzerete sul mercato o sullo sviluppo dei giovani giocatori? Il successo ti aspetta in campo.

games.title: Pro Basketball Manager 2026
games.description: Lead your club to greatness in Pro Basketball Manager 2026! The Basketball Champions League arrives with 53 licensed teams, putting you in charge of every decision as you aim to dominate both domestic and continental basketball.

games.title: Pro Cycling Manager 26
games.description: Dal reclutamento alla gestione dello staff, dalla pianificazione della stagione alla strategia di gara, prendi ogni decisione e guida la tua squadra verso la vittoria nelle competizioni più prestigiose del ciclismo.

games.title: Problematic
games.description:
Where your friends reveal their true selves.
A gothic party game where someone always goes too far.
Fill blanks, judge answers, score points, and secret rules govern the table.
Use your power-ups wisely.
Dark humor. Questionable decisions. No regrets.

games.title: Production Line
games.description: Production Line è il gioco di gestione/simulazione di una fabbrica di automobili che spinge al limite le tue competenze organizzative e imprenditoriali. Riuscirai a costruire una linea di produzione di automobili super efficiente, battendo la concorrenza e ottenendo al contemp...

games.title: PROHIBEAST
games.description: Immergetevi nella Chicago degli anni '30, afflitta dalla corruzione e dal traffico illegale di carne. In questo gioco di infiltrazione tattica, controllate Eliot Ness e la sua squadra. Sfruttate l’ambiente e colpite la mafia per smantellare l’impero criminale di Al Capone.

games.title: Project Canopy
games.description: Harvest, Build, Craft and Explore the different biomes among massive trees, plants, and hostile creatures to survive and unlock the mysteries of an alien jungle in a first person sci-fi survival adventure.

games.title: Project DeepWeb
games.description: This is a deep web exploration simulator. Discover hundreds of websites and files around the Web to get to the Silent House and save your friend. Find out creepy stories from the Web and meet its inhabitants. It's showtime!

games.title: Project DeepWeb: Eternal Nightmare
games.description:
This is a desktop-like adventure game about exploration of the Deep Internet.
Inspired by Internet lore and real netstalking experience, it tells a story of a person who got stuck in the wrong place at the wrong time.

games.title: Project First Contact
games.description: As of lately, there has been a rising occurrence in strange events and people reporting hallucinations. Unidentified objects are approaching Earth, while mankind in is full alert.

games.title: Project Freefall
games.description: Grab your squad and dive into a frantic chase for the lone parachute. Project Freefall is the ultimate game of tag at 10,000 feet. Toss a grenade or dodge the shark as you skydive with your friends and try to survive the fall. Will you go on to victory or go splat? Free to play.

games.title: Project Highrise
games.description: Project Highrise è un gioco di simulazione di costruzione e gestione

games.title: Project Jazzgame
games.description: Project Jazzgame is An open-world action adventure where fluid parkour meets fast-paced free-flow combat. Leap across dense rooftops or fight through gang-controlled streets in a city built for momentum and mayhem.

games.title: Project Motor Racing
games.description: Tutta la passione, la bellezza e l'intensità degli sport automobilistici professionistici, con l'unione tra auto e circuiti iconici e un nuovo punto di riferimento per il comportamento dei veicoli.

games.title: Project Nightmares Case 36: Henrietta Kedward
games.description: A survival horror game with a procedural structure, creating unique scares every time you play. A machine will induce you into a dream state, throwing you into a living nightmare firsthand in order to discover the story of Henrietta Kedward, an old woman with a dark past.

games.title: Project Origin
games.description: Project Origin is an immersive MMORPG set in a fractured world where players explore, battle, and shape their own journey. Engage in dynamic combat, uncover hidden lore, and traverse a vast, evolving landscape filled with challenges and secrets waiting to be discovered.

games.title: Project Pastorate
games.description: Project Pastorate is a visual novel set in the land of crime and sin that needs to be cleansed. The Devoters take up such tasks, their unique service whose primary purpose is to preserve the country's safety, and the Pastor — the leader of this post-apocalyptic community.

games.title: Project Smile
games.description: Uncover the dark secrets of The Haven Institution in this psychological horror adventure. Under Dr. Evelyn Vane’s rule, patients endure twisted experiments in pursuit of “perfection.” Escape is uncertain. Compliance is expected. Eventually, you will find your smile too.

games.title: Project Vesperi
games.description: Project Vesperi is a branching narrative sci-fi game where you play as Doctor Evelyn Roth, sent to investigate a sign of life on Venus. When an intruder threatens the only habitable station on the planet, your choices will shape the fate of those around you—and humanity itself.

games.title: Project Warlock II
games.description: Adrenaline-pumping gore retro funhouse that’s full of guns, magic, demons, vertical arenas, 3D visuals, 2D sprites, and heavy metal music. Inspired by FPS classics like Quake and Doom 64, Project Warlock II is the explosive boomer shooter sequel you were too shy to ask for.

games.title: Project Winter
games.description: In Project Winter, survival is just the beginning. Work with your friends to escape the icy wilderness, but don’t get too comfortable. Traitors lurk among you, ready to lie, sabotage, and turn even the closest of friends against each other. Who will you trust?

games.title: PROJECT_ORIGINS
games.description: PROJECT_ORIGINS is an Action RPG video game. Explore a fantastic world in a variety of different ways, such as fishing, crafting, harvesting, smithing, and more. Players can tame animals, find mounts, and interact with a valuable wealth of audio knowledge in real time.
games.developer: TAG Technology Group LLC dba Together Again Gaming
games.publisher: TAG Technology Group LLC dba Together Again Gaming

games.title: PROJECT_ROGUE
games.description: A fast-paced rogue like game that tests your skill and adaptability. Battle through handcrafted levels where enemies and items shift each run. Unlock upgrades, abilities, and characters, forging a path to mastery with every attempt.
games.developer: TAG Technology Group LLC dba Together Again Gaming
games.publisher: TAG Technology Group LLC dba Together Again Gaming

games.title: PROJECT_WAR
games.description: PROJECT_WAR is a real time tactics strategy game. Who is the best commander? TAG! You're it.
games.developer: TAG Technology Group LLC dba Together Again Gaming
games.publisher: TAG Technology Group LLC dba Together Again Gaming

games.title: Prologue: Go Wayback!
games.description: Prologue: Go Wayback! is a single-player open-world emergent game within the survival genre. With classic survival mechanics and machine learning-driven terrain generation resulting in millions of possible maps, it challenges the players to explore their limits.

games.title: Promise Mascot Agency
games.description: Explore the cursed town of Kaso-Machi! Recruit and train mascot friends! Help out when jobs go wrong! Solve the mystery of your exile! Help Pinky work through her many anger issues! Turn Promise Mascot Agency into the best agency in Japan! Go go, Michi and Pinky!

games.title: Prop Sumo
games.description:
Prop Sumo is a party fighting game that pits ordinary props against each other in extraordinary battles!

Beat up your friends and dominate the scoreboard!
games.developer: Barrel Roll Games GmbH & Co. KG
games.publisher: Barrel Roll Games GmbH & Co. KG

games.title: PROPHUNT
games.description: L'esperienza definitiva di Prop Hunt. Nasconditi tra i numerosi oggetti che compongono il mondo o trova gli impostori nascosti tra gli oggetti.

games.title: Propulsive Liberation
games.description: Propulsive liberation is a speedrunning based 2d platformer where you navigate fun levels with a grappling hook.

games.title: Protector Goddess Fight
games.description: The main core of the game is to determine the subsequent story development through options. Each option is related to the heroine's future life, whether to protect or escape.

games.title: PROTOBOT
games.description: Run, jump, destroy enemies, save others, complete the simulation!

games.title: ProtoCorgi
games.description: Bark’em Up! Play as Bullet, a C³ class (Cute Cybernetic Corgi) pup on his quest to save his owner, a brilliant scientist kidnapped by an alien race that wants to rule the galaxy. ProtoCorgi is a retro pixel art shoot’em up with a strong arcade feel!

games.title: Providence
games.description:
Survive the harsh alien environments and its inhabitants, extract valuable resources back to your home base to craft, build and prepare for bigger challenges.

Providence is a sci-fi survival game where resources are scarce and everything has to be built from scratch.

games.title: Psychiatrist Simulator
games.description: Have you ever wanted to be a psychiatrist? Now you can! Be a shrink for 14 days. Meet 14 patients with unique story of their lives. Diagnosis, treatment, chosen dialogues have impact on history of patients. The choice is yours.

games.title: Psychiatrist Simulator 2
games.description: Take role as Dr. Smith, psychotherapist. Game consists of real people video recordings. Talk with them, treat, learn about psychology. Your choices have consequences, at the end you will see what happened in their life after meeting with you.

games.title: PUBG: BATTLEGROUNDS
games.description:
Gioca gratuitamente a PUBG: BATTLEGROUNDS.
Atterra in luoghi strategici, fai incetta di armi e rifornimenti e sopravvivi per far sì che la tua squadra sia l'ultima a rimanere in gioco.

games.title: PUGS Agents
games.description: P.U.G.S. Agents è una classica avventura 2D Top-Down in stile anni '80 con eroi completamente nuovi. Due agenti dell'organizzazione segreta P.U.G.S. deve risolvere il mistero della misteriosa esplosione nella fabbrica locale S.N.A.C.K.S.

games.title: Pumpkin Jack
games.description: Pumpkin Jack è un terrificante gioco platform in 3D nel quale vesti i panni di Jack, il mitico Signore delle zucche (Mythical Pumpkin Lord)! Lanciati in un'avventura agghiacciante attraverso lugubri paesaggi e aiuta il male a trionfare sul bene!

games.title: Punch Club 2: Fast Forward
games.description: You came here to read game descriptions and play fighter management sims…and you’re all outta descriptions.

games.title: Pupperazzi
games.description:
Metti alla prova il tuo amore per i cuccioli. Ci sono tanti cagnolini a cui vanno scattate delle foto e dovrai occupartene tu! Fotografa e cataloga i cani più belli (e più buffi) per fare carriera, migliorare la tua fotocamera e scoprire nuovi canidi. 

BAU.

games.title: Puppergeist
games.description: Journey through the Doggie Underworld in this heartwarming rhythm and visual novel hybrid. Reunite with your lost Pup by connecting with the souls of other dogs, learning their stories, and lifting their spirits through rhythm games full of charm and playful challenges!

games.title: Puppet House
games.description: Puppet House è un puzzle-avventura horror con elementi di escape room. Indagate sulle sparizioni locali e affrontate un pupazzo assassino!

games.title: Pure Instinct Katana
games.description: Open world, 3rd person, slasher action. Engage in real time combat that adapts to your instinct and strategy. Explore a world of vivid fantasy and artful slaughter. Earn coins and buy a blade, outfit, or a fairy healer. Slay hidden bosses to gain their fighting style and element.

games.title: Pure Pool Pro
games.description: Pure Pool Pro ridefinisce il biliardo moderno. Domina l’8-Ball, il 9-Ball e molto altro in solitaria, in locale o online grazie al crossplay. Un’ampia modalità Carriera, grafica in 8K, ambientazioni immersive, fisica realistica, controlli precisi.

games.title: Purpose 1951
games.description: "Purpose 1951" is an almost pure walking simulator set in the United States of 1951.  You play as a retired doctor whose life falls apart.

games.title: Puzzle Agent
games.description: Created with indie comic artist Graham Annable's unique narrative and visual sensibilities, delivered with the distinctive Telltale storytelling style, Puzzle Agent is sure to challenge, thrill and engage in more ways than you can shake a cryptogram at!

games.title: Puzzle Agent 2
games.description: Agent Nelson Tethers just solved his biggest case yet. So why isn't he satisfied? Venture back to eerie Scoggins, Minnesota to solve the mystery of "the Hidden People" once and for all!

games.title: Puzzle Biblico: Gioco Cristiano
games.description: Puzzle Biblico offre un'esperienza rilassante e stimolante mentre componi splendide scene bibliche. Quando sei completamente rilassato, è il momento di affrontare la sfida delle partite classificate. Pensi di avere ciò che serve per battere gli altri giocatori?

games.title: Puzzle Quest - Immortal Edition
games.description: Puzzle Quest: Immortal Edition unisce la classica meccanica match 3 a un'esperienza GDR coinvolgente. Abbina tre o più gemme per ottenere Mana, lanciare incantesimi, affrontare avversari, raccogliere oggetti e ricompense e progredire in missioni tratte da quasi 20 anni di storia!

games.title: Puzzles for Clef
games.description: Unisciti a Clef in un'avventura ambientata su un'isola magica nei cieli dove un tempo viveva la sua famiglia. Risolvi enigmi, scopri segreti e vivi una storia di amore fraterno e tanto altro, se solo vorrai addentrarti più a fondo…

games.title: PyramidValley: Reborn
games.description: Play PyramidValley: Reborn and establish a flourishing ancient city on the banks of the Nile!

games.title: Q.U.B.E. 10th Anniversary
games.description: Entirely rebuilt from the ground up, Q.U.B.E. 10th Anniversary is the ultimate celebration of the decade-old original, bringing refined visuals, completely redesigned and revised gameplay sections, and a whole new chapter to the award-winning, brain-twisting first-person puzzler

games.title: Q.U.B.E. 2
games.description: Nei panni dell'archeologa in difficoltà Amelia Cross, dovrai risolvere gli enigmi di questo misterioso mondo e trovare il modo per tornare a casa.

games.title: qomp2
games.description: An artful reimagining of Pong.

games.title: QuackSquad
games.description: Quack Squad is a frantic top-down arcade shooter. Face endless hordes, restart with more intensity and danger. Discover familiars, weapons, and minigames in one arena. Can you survive until the nightmare ends?

games.title: Quake
games.description: Sviluppato dal pluripremiato team di id Software, Quake® è l'innovativo e originale sparatutto dark fantasy in soggettiva che ancora oggi è fonte d'ispirazione per gli FPS classici. Con Quake (versione migliorata) puoi giocare all'originale, aggiornato e graficamente migliorato.

games.title: Quake + Quake II Enhanced Bundle
games.description: Play the authentic, updated and visually enhanced versions of Quake and Quake II, and experience the ground-breaking first-person shooters that inspire today's retro-style FPS games. Also included are brand new expansions, online multiplayer PvP and more.

games.title: Quake II
games.description: Developed by id Software in 1997, Quake II is a critically acclaimed first-person shooter that introduces an entirely new science fiction narrative and setting.

games.title: Quantic River
games.description: Dive into the dystopian world of Quantic River, where frenetic action meets captivating exploration. Master katana combat, unlock cybernetics, slice through environments, hack obstacles, and explore dual-layered levels for speedrunners and explorers.

games.title: Quantum Command
games.description: Quantum Command is a thrilling web3 TPS where players travel through time to battle the Dark Prophets and protect Earth's history. Featuring AI-generated maps, dynamic combat, and play-to-earn model, players can earn rewards and unlock new eras as they fight to secure the future

games.title: Quantum Fight : Aero 2299
games.description: Take part in the ultimate galactic show. An intense mix of Tower Defense and tactical assault: manage your resources, deploy your AI squads and destroy the opposing camp before the gaze of billions of spectators. the universe is watching you. Will you be the champion?

games.title: Quantum Frame
games.description: After the collapse of the Quantum Transfer Project, humanity's souls shattered into immortal fragments. As a Quantum Soul, possess cybernetic shells, battle across fractured worlds, and uncover the hidden truths of a civilization that tried, and failed, to escape death.

games.title: Quantum Recharged
games.description: Dodge and encircle your enemies in this neon-drenched revival of the one-of-a-kind arcade classic!

games.title: Quantum Storm
games.description:
Il Quantum Computer è diventato autocosciente!
Distruggi la sua libreria di immagini prima che impari abbastanza per conquistare il mondo...

Breakout Arcade Game con 300 livelli retrò preparati da Clive Townsend, famoso game designer a 8 bit.

games.title: Quartet
games.description: A series of unlikely train robberies. A mysterious deck of cards. A fleet of deadly airships. An accidental mage. Choose from four stories, in any order, and discover how they intertwine in this turn-based RPG.

games.title: Quasimorph
games.description: Take on a role of a hardened PMC fighter in a dark turn-based extraction RPG. Engage in unforgiving combat, manage your ship and pile up the bodies of your clones to unravel the dark mystery behind threat to all life.

games.title: QUBIT
games.description: Qubit is a magic-combat arena game set in a nostalgic voxel world, beloved by many. Players create their own unique characters and battle it out. The gameplay is fast-paced, easy to pick up, and expands as you play, offering depth and progression over time!

games.title: Queen's Wish 2: The Tormentor
games.description: You are in a barbarian land. They are trying to kill you. The Queen demands you tame them. What now? Escape into an exciting, open-ended story and cunning tactical combat. Epic, indie fantasy adventure. Freely explore a huge world, fight for fame and power, and reshape the world.

games.title: Queens Wish: The Conqueror
games.description: The full version of Queen's Wish: The Conqueror.

games.title: Quest Hunter
games.description: Quest Hunter è un gioco di ruolo isometrico in cui le tue scelte guidano la storia. Gioca sul divano, da solo o con gli amici, o rendilo una festa online per un massimo di quattro giocatori!

games.title: Quest Master
games.description: Quest Master is a dungeon maker inspired by the classics that made us love dungeon crawling. Use your imagination, alone or in local co-op, to make dungeons full of puzzles, traps and monsters. Upload them for others to explore and challenge yourself with others’ creations.

games.title: Quest of Dungeons
games.description:
Quest of Dungeons is a turn based dungeon crawler game, a roguelike.
An evil Dark Lord has stolen all the light, so your mission is to enter his lair and defeat him. The dungeons layout is procedural so you won't find items/enemies in the same place each time you play.

games.title: Quest Room
games.description: Una stanza delle missioni è un luogo da cui bisogna uscire interagendo con gli oggetti e utilizzando vari indizi. Ma attenzione, non siete soli in questa stanza.

games.title: Quick Race
games.description:
Everything you need to do is very simple – just race and overtake every other car on the track to win the race! Quick Race is a simple racing game where you can compete with AI or on a split screen with your friend.
Main features included in the game.

games.title: QUIET
games.description: Your ship crashed, your crew is stranded, and this house is somehow your best chance of survival. Search for ship parts while every movement and real-world sound risks alerting the homeowner. Stay QUIET, keep your flock together, and try not to quack under pressure.

games.title: Quiet is the Eyes
games.description: All your coworkers are gone and the halls are quiet, except for the pitter-patter of rain on the window. Explore a desolate laboratory as a creature stalks you, always watching. Run and hide as you solve puzzles and learn more about what happened to the facility and its secrets.

games.title: Quills: The Medieval War
games.description: Step into the chaos of the Hundred Years’ War—where swords clash and magic shatters history. Fight for glory as humans or mystical Quills in this medieval team-based action game. Forge your path in a world torn by steel, sorcery, and conquest.

games.title: Quiplash 2 InterLASHional
games.description: Tutto il divertentissimo contenuto di Quiplash 2, ora in francese, italiano, tedesco e spagnolo! Con 100 NUOVI suggerimenti in ciascuna lingua! Prendi QUINTILINGUAL Quiplash ora, e porta in giro per il mondo la tua prossima festa!

games.title: Quiz Time
games.description: Quiz Time is all in one Quiz Package for everyone. You can play any type of quizzes like Sports Quiz, G.K Quiz, Songs Quiz, Maths Quiz, Entertainment Quiz and Many more.
games.developer: Yash Future Tech Solutions Pvt Ltd
games.publisher: Yash Future Tech Solutions Pvt Ltd

games.title: Quiztopia : The Ultimate Trivia
games.description: Quiztopia : The Ultimate Trivia is Quiz Game for kids for age 5 and above. This game helps everyone to increase their knowledge by completing various different trivia challenges.
games.developer: Yash Future Tech Solutions Pvt Ltd
games.publisher: Yash Future Tech Solutions Pvt Ltd

games.title: Quriocity
games.description: Quriocity è un simulatore di colonie sci-fi ambientato su un desolato pianeta alieno molto simile alla Terra. Costruisci e aggiorna una grande varietà di strutture per estrarre risorse e fornire servizi, come manutenzione, educazione, intrattenimento e molto altro.

games.title: R-Type Final 2
games.description: Il leggendario sparatutto a scorrimento laterale ha fatto il suo ritorno con una bellissima grafica 3D, un gameplay eccitante e una moltitudine di ambientazioni, astronavi e armi che ti permetteranno di dirigere una sinfonia di distruzione sui tuoi nemici.

games.title: R-Type Tactics I • II Cosmos
games.description: L'azione sparatutto a scorrimento verticale si combina con la strategia a turni in R-Type Tactics I • II Cosmos! Al suo debutto su console moderne, questa raccolta di due giochi offre una grafica rielaborata, la possibilità di giocare online, varie campagne e missioni ramificate!

games.title: R.I.C.E.
games.description: Un paragrafo che cerca di stuzzicare l'interesse, volendo catturare l'attenzione in un mare di concorrenza e usando parole di moda come "bullet heaven" e "meta-progressione in profondità", nel vano tentativo di far credere che questo gioco sia diverso dagli altri del suo genere.

games.title: Ra Ra BOOM
games.description: Prendi i pon pon e preparati a un'azione co-op a 4 giocatori in una rivisitazione moderna!

games.title: Racing League: Evolution
games.description: Racing League Evolution is a vibrant, stylized racing game that blends arcade-style thrills with a narrative-driven career mode. Drive more than 10 unique cars across beautifully crafted tracks.

games.title: Rad Rodgers - Radical Edition
games.description: Rad è un ragazzo vivace ma turbolento, che forse usa un po' troppo i videogiochi.

games.title: Radiant Arena
games.description: Early access: multiplayer hero shooter featuring distinct classes, verticality, and destructible environments.

games.title: Radiolight
games.description: Ashwood Creek, 1985. A child disappears without a trace. A policeman is drawn into a national park, seeking the truth. Mysterious radio signals beckon him further and further. Investigate, survive and face the unknown in Radiolight— an '80s thriller by solo dev Krystof Knesl.

games.title: RAGDORE
games.description: RAGDORE is a single-player physics sandbox where damage isn’t cosmetic—it is the experience: a fully simulated character reacts in real time as bones break, limbs are lost, and movement adapts to what remains.

games.title: RAGE 2
games.description: RAGE 2 è frutto della collaborazione di due eccellenze videoludiche: Avalanche Studios, i maestri della follia a mondo aperto, e id Software, i creatori degli sparatutto in soggettiva, insieme per sconvolgervi con un mondo delirante in cui andare ovunque, sparare a chiunque e ...

games.title: Rage Quit
games.description: Rage Quit is a first-person melee game where the player uses only the sledgehammer for combat, traversal, and defense against hordes of office-bots. Use a fluid variety of light, heavy, dash-based, and reflective attacks to smash your way through your foes and enact revenge!

games.title: Raging Bill
games.description:
A wild TPS sandbox in a mini open world, inspired by Goat Simulator.
Shooter, melee, racing, loot, exploration, bodycam… all mashed into one!
A love letter to the 80s/90s and pop culture, packed with Easter eggs.

games.title: Ragnarok Survivors Valhalla
games.description: Prove to Odin that you deserve a place at the table in the afterlife and survive Ragnarok. Or die, and leave your wordly belongings to the next Viking. Unlock new characters and buy new weapons and abilities to improve your chance of survival.

games.title: Rags to Riches
games.description: The Financial Market Simulation!

games.title: Raid Shadow Legends
games.description: Raid
