games.title: Solargene
games.description:
Guida una corporazione spaziale nel simulatore fantascientifico Solargene! Gestisci il tuo personale, progetta e sviluppa colonie e stazioni orbitali in tutto il sistema solare!
Estrarre risorse, stabilire la logistica, ricercare nuove tecnologie, commerciare e completare compiti

games.title: Solaris FPS
games.description: Solaris FPS is a first-person shooter with fast-paced movement and unique character abilities.

games.title: Solarpunk
games.description: Solarpunk è un gioco di sopravvivenza ambientato in un mondo tecnologicamente avanzato composto da isole fluttuanti. Da solo o insieme agli amici, puoi costruire edifici, coltivare cibo, creare oggetti e partire con il tuo dirigibile per esplorare isole lontane nel cielo.

games.title: Solars Dominion
games.description: Solar Dominion is a battle royal game where users can go toe to toe to battle to see whos the best.

games.title: SOLDIEVAL : DIO DIREWOLF
games.description:
Step into the blighted realm of Eldenwarth—a dark fantasy world plagued by the undead, twisted knights, and demonic forces. Wield steel and sorcery as Dio Direwolf, a vengeance-driven fighter bound by prophecy and blood.

Face the blight. Embrace the steel. Survive the legend.

games.title: Soliloquio
games.description: In a vast desert, a lost young man's voice interrupts its silence. While he tries to survive, reality and fiction blur, questioning the perception of existence, freedom and control.

games.title: Solitaire Game Halloween
games.description: Trick or treat? No tricks! 120 new Halloween-themed levels is a real treat for solitaire fans on Halloween!

games.title: Solitairica
games.description: Solitairica porta il combattimento dei GDR e la progressione complessa dei roguelike in una nuova ambientazione: il mondo del solitario! Combatti orde di nemici sempre diversi usando un assortimento di oggetti magici e incantesimi, e sconfiggi l'orribile imperatore Stuck!

games.title: Solo Path
games.description:
Enter at night in an abandoned place in the middle of the forest.
Realize that you are trapped inside.
Trying to escape to survive ...

games.title: SolPlex
games.description: SolPlex is a multiplayer economic strategy game with city-builder elements set in a vast sci-fi world. Players compete to build and expand their empires, manage resources and outsmart rivals.

games.title: Solvimus
games.description: Un gioco di rompicapi cooperativo per due giocatori con 30 impegnativi livelli. Collabora, risolvi rompicapi e fai un respiro profondo quando il tuo compagno di avventure dice che "c'è quasi".

games.title: SOMA
games.description: SOMA è un gioco horror di fantascienza realizzato da Frictional Games, i creatori di Amnesia: The Dark Descent. È una storia inquietante su identità, coscienza e sul significato di essere umani.

games.title: Somber Echoes
games.description: Armed with God-given powers, the revived tribune Adrestia is given a second chance to save the universe from her twin sister. Find secrets, acquire upgrades, and dominate mighty foes through sheer combat prowess as you explore and conquer the horrors Atromitos.

games.title: Somerville
games.description: All'indomani della catastrofe, trova i mezzi per ricostruire la tua famiglia.

games.title: Son of Thanjai
games.description: A spoiled prince is betrayed, exiled, and remade into something far more dangerous than a king. Outnumbered and alone, take an empire apart from the inside, with deception, fear, and the Surul Vaal, in a cinematic action-adventure set in an alternate-history medieval South India.

games.title: Song of Farca
games.description: Entra nella scena del crimine, cerca e analizza le prove, interroga i criminali, segui le tracce dei sospettati e affronta le conseguenze delle tue scelte. Tuffati in una storia poliziesca oscura con un'atmosfera di dominio digitale in stile Black Mirror.

games.title: Song of Horror Complete Edition
games.description: A 3rd person, fixed-camera survival horror adventure. Fear the Presence, a mysterious entity you cannot fight: stay alert, hide, breathe slowly... Explore cursed places where unseen spirits and lost souls linger in a true horror story for the ages.

games.title: Song of Kings
games.description: Song of Kings is a narrative platformer inspired by Sri Lankan myth. A Yaksha boy, captured by humans, must escape a ruthless king. Guided by his grandfather’s spirit and armed with a mystical flute, he uncovers his heritage and fights to return to his people.

games.canonical_title: Song of Nunu: A League of Legends Story
games.title: Song of Nunu: A League of Legends Story
games.description: Due grandi amici in una selvaggia avventura. Unitevi a Nunu e Willump in un'avventura tra le lande ghiacciate del Freljord. Song of Nunu: A League Of Legends Story è un'avventura per giocatore singolo sviluppata da Tequila Works.

games.canonical_title: Songs for a Hero - Definitive Edition
games.title: Songs for a Hero - Definitive Edition
games.description: A classic platform with a twist: A dynamic soundtrack and funny lyrics that sings the player's actions and responds to what is happening during the adventure.

games.title: Songs of Conquest
games.description: Raduna potenti eserciti, brandisci magia antica e forgia un impero. Questo gioco di avventura a turni unisce le decisioni strategiche ai combattimenti tattici e alla gestione di un regno.

games.title: Songs of Silence
games.description: Guida eserciti, ricostruisci regni caduti e raggiungi la grandezza. Parti per un viaggio epico di strategia in un mondo visivamente sbalorditivo. Combatti battaglie intense e scopri una storia coinvolgente!

games.title: Sonic Colors: Ultimate
games.description: Unisciti a Sonic nella più bella avventura ad alta velocità di tutti i tempi attraverso un pittoresco luna park interstellare. Colora l'universo in Sonic Colors: Ultimate!

games.title: Sonic Frontiers
games.description:
Experience Sonic like never before!

Accelerate to new heights in Sonic the Hedgehog’s newest high-speed, open-zone adventure

games.title: Sonic Mania
games.description: Un'apoteosi di passato e futuro. Un'avventura completamente nuova piena di boss esclusivi, paesaggi in 2D accompagnati da uno stile di gioco classico e divertente. Sonic Mania porta ai giorni nostri il frenetico platform rétro attraverso una perfetta grafica 2D in pixel a 60FPS.

games.title: Sonic Origins
games.description: Sonic Origins

games.title: Sonic Racing: CrossWorlds
games.description: Sfreccia sul tracciato, sull'acqua, in aria e nel tempo con Sonic Racing: CrossWorlds! Sfrutta i Ring di trasferimento per teletrasportarti in nuove dimensioni in cui ogni angolo nasconde una sorpresa.

games.title: Sonic Superstars
games.description: Sonic Superstars

games.title: SONIC X SHADOW GENERATIONS
games.description: Shadow the Hedgehog is back with Classic and Modern Sonic in SONIC X SHADOW GENERATIONS, an all-new collection featuring two unique experiences!

games.title: Sons of Valhalla
games.description: Sons of Valhalla è un gioco di strategia roguelike ambientato nell'Epoca vichinga. Costruisci fortezze, raduna guerrieri, assedia le roccaforti nemiche, lanciandoti in scontri fisici mentre saccheggi e conquisti l'Inghilterra.

games.title: Sophia the Traveler
games.description: Unisciti alla nostra amabile eroina mentre gira per Venezia, la città dell'acqua. Come nei libri cerca e trova della serie "Dov'è Wally", dovrai cercare oggetti e personaggi in splendidi e vivaci paesaggi urbani dipinti a mano!

games.title: Sorry We're Closed
games.description: Sorry We're Closed è un survival horror dai toni nostalgici per giocatore singolo, con una storia fitta, personaggi profondi e svariati finali. Esplora luoghi inquietanti con inquadrature fisse. Apri il tuo Third Eye per vedere tra mondi, scoprire segreti e risolvere puzzle.

games.title: SOS OPS!
games.description: SOS OPS! è più di un gioco. Il tuo compito è salvare la città. Ti ritroverai nell’epicentro di una follia totale, dove le missioni cooperative con gli amici porteranno l’adrenalina al limite! Preparati!

games.title: Souldiers
games.description: Combatti per la libertà in un vasto mondo fantasy in bilico tra i vivi e i morti. Affina le tue abilità in un'epica retrò che offre enigmi platform, esplorazione da metroidvania e combattimenti in stile soulslike.

games.title: Soulless - Ray Of Hope
games.description: Soulless is a 2D side-scrolling puzzle platformer. Set out on your adventure to save your childhood friend by traveling through a colorful world using mechanics and items to complete both relaxing and rushed puzzles. How far would you go to save a friend?

games.title: Soulmask
games.description: Soulmask is a sandbox game that prioritizes an authentic survival experience. As the "last one" blessed with the mysterious mask, players will grapple for survival in a primitive land steeped in mysterious faiths, carving out a path to ascendance.

games.title: Souls Of Chronos
games.description: The Apocalypse shattered a world in disarray. Facing his impending death, a young boy named Sid crossed paths with Torii, a girl who feeds on the energy of time. In the harbour town of Astella, a mysterious adventure is about to unfold...

games.title: Soulslinger: Envoy of Death
games.description: You are a gunslinger in limbo, involved in a gritty war against "The Cartel", a ruthless organization harvesting souls to break free of the shackles of the afterlife. Grow stronger with each new run to take on the biggest threats in this rogue-lite FPS!

games.title: Soulstice
games.description: Esplora un mondo oscuro ricco di misteri nascosti, padroneggia un sistema di combattimento diversificato e gestisci le forze combinate di due sorelle in una cupa storia di formazione dalle atmosfere dark fantasy che si sviluppa a ritmi frenetici, con nemici feroci e spettacolari combattimenti contro i boss.

games.title: Soulstone Survivors
games.description: Affronta i Signori del Vuoto e i loro infiniti servitori, raccogli le Pietre dell'Anima e diventa un dio! In questo Roguelite d'azione, svela incantesimi segreti, crea armi potenti, sblocca più personaggi, scopri sinergie rivoluzionarie e conquista il potere del vuoto.

games.title: SOULVARS
games.description:
Fai ardere la tua anima...
SOULVARS è un RPG a turni con elementi di deckbuilding realizzato in splendida pixel art.
Affronta battaglie entusiasmanti e sconfiggete i mostruosi Dominator!

games.title: Soundfall
games.description: Soundfall è un dungeon crawler che combina l'azione spara e saccheggia a una dinamica basata sul ritmo. Avventurati da solo o con fino ad altri tre giocatori online o in locale. Ogni azione compiuta al ritmo della musica ti permette di diventare più forte!

games.title: Source of Madness
games.description: Source of Madness is a side-scrolling dark action roguelite set in a twisted Lovecraftian inspired world powered by procedural generation and AI machine learning. Take on the role of a new Acolyte as they embark on a nightmarish odyssey.

games.canonical_title: South Park™: Il Bastone della Verità™
games.title: South Park™: Il Bastone della Verità™
games.description: Dai pericolosi campi di battaglia nel cortile della quarta elementare, un giovane eroe sorgerà, destinato a diventare il salvatore di South Park.

games.title: South Park™: Scontri Di-Retti™ Standard Edition
games.description: Assumi il ruolo di Novellino in questa nuova opera dei creatori di South Park; unisciti a Stan, Kyle, Kenny e Cartman in un'esilarante e irriverente avventura RPG.

games.title: Space Accident
games.description: Il vostro eroe è Andy Freeman, un ingegnere tecnico della navicella Zeus-M700, inviata in spedizione sul satellite di Giove per colonizzarlo. Tuttavia, ciò che è stato concepito non va sempre secondo i piani...

games.title: Space Adventure Cobra - The Awakening
games.description: Impersona Cobra, il pirata dello spazio, in un gioco d'azione tratto dalla famosa serie anime. Insieme a Lady Armaroid, la tua fedele compagna, ed equipaggiato con la tua iconica Psychogun, dovrai risolvere una misteriosa minaccia che incombe sull'intero universo.

games.title: Space Base
games.description: Build a base for the first settlers of a new planet!

games.title: Space Battle
games.description: In questo emozionante gioco di strategia e azione, conquista la galassia superando i tuoi nemici e costruendo una flotta inarrestabile.

games.title: Space Chef
games.description: Conquer the final frontier with nothing but your grandma’s recipe book and your trusty spatula! Space Chef is a 2D open-world action adventure where you’ll get to explore alien planets, harvest exotic ingredients, and cook cosmic cuisine.

games.title: SPACE ELITE FORCE
games.description: Preparati per un'avventura intergalattica mozzafiato! Space Elite Force è uno sparatutto spaziale frenetico, ricco di personalizzazione delle armi ed epiche battaglie contro i boss. Prendi il comando della tua astronave e combatti per la sopravvivenza dell'umanità!

games.title: SPACE ELITE FORCE II
games.description: Gear up for an intergalactic thrill ride! Space Elite Force is a frenzied space-shooter packed with weapon customization and epic boss battles. Take command of your ship and fight for the survival of humanity!

games.title: Space Empires I
games.description: Space Empires I is the first chapter of the Space Empires series. A classic galactic conquest and turn-based strategy video game where you are the leader of a race of intelligent beings building large spaceships for interplanetary and interstellar travel through warp points...

games.title: Space Empires II
games.description: Explore the galaxy, discover and colonize new planets to acquire enough resources. Design your ships, choosing from different hulls, weapons, shields, and several devices. Once you advance with technologies, new systems will be available, and you will have to update your designs

games.title: Space Empires III
games.description: The third game within the Space Empires series brings the dawn of a new age of exploration. Your race keeps running through the fabric of space and moves to other solar systems beyond your own.

games.title: Space Empires IV
games.description: The award-winning Space Empires IV is the latest edition in the Space Empires series. A grand strategy title in the space 4X (explore, expand, exploit, and exterminate) genre, Space Empires has already found a place in the heart of strategy gamers everywhere.

games.title: Space Empires V
games.description: Space Empires V is the latest edition in the Space Empires series. This new chapter completely updates the UI and takes the player into a real-time rendered 3D universe.

games.title: Space Explore
games.description: Scopri come la navicella spaziale decolla in orbita. Unisciti all'equipaggio nelle missioni dello Space Shuttle e assisti nella manutenzione della stazione spaziale. Fai un viaggio in orbita e vivi la Terra dall'alto.
games.developer: Yash Future Tech Solutions Pvt Ltd
games.publisher: Yash Future Tech Solutions Pvt Ltd

games.title: Space Grunts
games.description: A turn-based game on a planet outpost - with no waiting between turns!  Play it at the speed of an arcade game, or take your time and think about your next step.. no matter how fast you take your turn, it might be your last!

games.title: Space Grunts 2
games.description: Space Grunts 2 combines some of the fastest turn-based gameplay with card-battling mechanics in a 1950's sci-fi roguelike setting.

games.title: Space Grunts: Chrono Shard
games.description: Master time. Stop the Ooze. Outsmart a galactic infection in this high-speed, turn-based roguelike. Use your Chrono Shard to loop the timeline, leaving gear and upgrades for future runs. Craft your arsenal, evolve skills into elite sub-classes, and turn death into an advantage.

games.title: Space Hack
games.description: Space Hack is a sci-fi hack and slash action RPG dungeon crawler. A strange anomaly appears and the colony ship you are traveling on is quickly overtaken by aliens that prey on the helpless colonists.

games.title: Space Haste 2
games.description:
SPACE HASTE II is an adrenaline pumping, futuristic racing game that puts players in the driver’s seat
of the hottest hovercrafts on the planet.

games.title: Space Outpost Silicon One
games.description: Shoot, loot, level-up and fight your way to the Vault in this single-player first-person shooter. Solo-dev indie game made by an industry veteran. Now supports Unreal5 advanced graphics with hardware ray tracing, Lumen global illumination & reflections, NVIDIA DLSS 4 and more!

games.canonical_title: Space Rangers HD A War Apart
games.title: Space Rangers HD A War Apart
games.description: Space adventure, open world RPG, strategy, arcade, quests, and more!
games.developer: SNK Games / Elemental Games / Katauri Interactive

games.title: Space Road: Elite
games.description: Trade between star systems. Fight against pirates and alien invaders. Modification of the ship.

games.title: Space Rocks!
games.description: Game is tribute to the classic Atari 1979 arcade game in which player tries to survive through waves of various obstacles and enemies. How long can you survive?

games.title: Space Savory
games.description: In una galassia non troppo lontana... Nel nulla cosmico c'è un locale dall'igiene discutibile, ribollente di oscuri segreti e umorismo ancora più oscuro. Eppure, è proprio qui che si preparano le leccornie più squisite dell'universo. (Ma sconsigliamo di frugare nel retrobottega.)

games.title: SPACE SMASH
games.description:
A retro-style, fast-paced, and addictive shoot 'em up. A throwback to the classic arcade games of the 80s. Great for playing while waiting in line for another game. 🎮
(shmup)

games.title: Space Trader - Merchant Marine
games.description: Space Trader is an open world trading colony sim wrapped in a shooter. Start as a Rookie and earn your way to Master using shrewd trades, back alley deals, bribes, and well-placed bullet. Buy low, sell high and don’t take no for an answer.

games.title: SPACE WAR - INFINITY
games.description: Space War: Infinity is a semi-procedural shmup that will test your skills. Level up your ship, unlock amazing weapons, and defeat 5 formidable bosses. Challenge the infinite by facing real-time waves of enemies after completing all missions. Become the intergalactic hero now!

games.title: Space Wolf
games.description: Suit up as Liv, the deadliest and sassiest mercenary in the galaxy. Run, jump, slide and shoot through various levels like a futuristic city or a volcano as you lay waste to the evil robot empire.

games.title: Space Wolf 2
games.description: Continue your adventure as Liv, the wolf-lady badass space mercenary. Explore derelict space stations, ancient ruins, cyberpunk cities,  underwater sites and other locations. fight various enemy soldiers as well as giant, horrific boss monsters.

games.title: Spacebase Startopia - Standard Edition
games.description: SPACEBASE STARTOPIA affascina con il suo mix originale di simulazione economica e strategia di creazione di un impero accoppiata con classiche schermaglie RTS e una buona dose di umorismo.

games.title: Spacelines from the Far Out
games.description: Guidare la navicella per la galassia è già di per sé abbastanza difficile, ma se oltre a questo bisogna soddisfare passeggeri alieni selvaggi, allora il tutto diventa alquanto bizzarro. Gioca online insieme ai tuoi amici nei panni dell'equipaggio di questa folle avventura coop...

games.title: Spaceman Defender
games.description: Un nuovo gioco ispirato al classico Defender che riprende lo stile retrò degli arcade. Difendi dagli alieni dei piccoli astronauti! Fatti strada tra orde di rapitori alieni e di UFO mentre porti in salvo i piccoli astronauti in questo moderno remake del frenetico gioco anni '80.

games.title: Spaceman Memories
games.description: Spaceman Memories is a retro-futuristic JRPG set in a distant future, inspired by Japanese folktales. Play as Ichiro 94, an astronaut awakening from hypersleep to recover fragments of his lost past— go on a journey filled with wonder and nostalgia.

games.title: SpaceSlog
games.description: Build your spaceship, manage your crew and explore the cosmos whilst trying to keep your crew alive and your ship fully functioning. This game uses an events driven director to ensure gameplay is kept challenging and every game you play tells a different story.

games.title: Sparrow Country
games.description: Embark on a mystical journey as a Sparrow, explore enchanted worlds and meet new characters. Level up your character to increase in size and capability. Earn XP by collecting stars and by completing quests, races and challenges.

games.title: Speakrit
games.description: Introducing the world's first Speakrit combat game! Generate customized spirits using advanced technology, and experience high-level bluff combat! Collect creativity energy, and unlock new levels of evolution in your own speakrit adventure!

games.title: Special Agent Training
games.description:
First-person shooter game with red and blue factions facing off. There are 8 scenarios and 6 weapons, which can be played alone or with a LAN connection.
In the edit map list interface, you can freely configure your favorite scenes and weapons.

games.title: Spectacular Sparky
games.description: A throwback to the golden age of white-gloved 16-bit video-game mascots, Spectacular Sparky is an action-packed platformer with wacky characters, explosive weapons and boss battles to treasure!

games.title: Spectacular Team: Assemble
games.description: Spectacular Team: Assemble is a physics-based action game where heroes collide in chaotic battles. Create outrageous characters, unleash wild moves, and watch them crash, tumble, and brawl their way through hordes of villains. Pure, unpredictable action in every fight!

games.title: Spectra
games.description: Valentina: un modello di linguaggio sofisticato per ricerche, scritti, soluzioni di problemi e conversazioni naturali. Compagno fedele per blocchi creativi, affari e compagnia. Risposte rapide, soluzioni creative e assistenza personalizzata.

games.title: Speechless
games.description:
Speechless is an Escape the Loop experience. Every "loop" consists of different puzzle(s) solutions and actions
you have to perform to escape the building.

games.title: Speed Brawl
games.description: Speed Brawl è un combat-racer in 2D in cui dovrai muoverti rapidamente e colpire duro! Prendi lo slancio, metti a segno grandi combo ed esegui potenti mosse. Trova lo stile di combattimento che più ti si addice e assembla la squadra di brawler migliore al mondo. Quindi ripeti ...

games.title: Speed Dates
games.description: Embark Speed Dates, where you control first dates with 18 attractive women in this interactive FMV game. Shape your story with charm and humor for a personalized romantic journey.

games.title: Speedborn: The Parkour Game
games.description:
A physics-based parkour game with climbing over objects.
Jump with the right timing and climb the walls.

games.title: SpellBound
games.description: SpellBound is fast-paced and action-packed. It combines the Mysticism, instant gratification style of an dimensional shifter Mystical-blazing maelstrom with longer term rewards more usually associated with adventure games, including the acquisition of status and loot.

games.title: Spellbound Survivors
games.description: Welcome to the mesmerizing world of Spellbound Survivors, a single-player action-roguelike game! Embark on an epic adventure, conquer maps, acquire mighty powers, and gear up for an ultimate showdown with the Overlord Wizard. Your destiny unfolds in this captivating journey!

games.title: Spellcasters Chronicles
games.description: LANCIA MAGIE. VOLA. COMBATTI. COLLABORA. Evoca centinaia di creature in intense battaglie d'azione strategica 3 contro 3, lancia magie micidiali e richiama la potenza dei Titani per emergere come membro più potente della COMMUNITY DI SPELLCASTER per plasm

games.title: Spellfarers
games.description: Coltiva, pesca, crea e lancia incantesimi con i tuoi amici in questo idilliaco e magico simulatore di fattoria MMO. Fai amicizia con gli abitanti di Wenngrove, prenditi cura della tua casa con gli amici e il tuo famiglio, e fai magie in Spellfarers.

games.title: SpellForce 3 Reforced
games.description: SpellForce 3 - The perfect blend between RTS and RPG! It is the year 518. The rebellion of the renegade mages, known as the Mage Wars, has been quashed by the Crown.

games.title: SpellForce 3: Fallen God
games.description: Prendi il comando dei troll e guidali in un viaggio epico attraverso il selvaggio continente di Urgath. Vesti i panni del capotribù dei Lunanuova, un popolo costretto ad abbandonare la propria dimora a causa di bracconieri e malattie: ora la loro sopravvivenza è nelle tue mani.

games.title: SpellForce 3: Soul Harvest
games.description: Tre anni dopo le Guerre della Purezza, Nortander è al culmine di una nuova era.  Mentre un seminatore d'odio minaccia di distruggere il regno dei nani, un enigmatico culto di elfi oscuri miete anime per ragioni sconosciute.

games.title: SpellForce 3: Versus Edition
games.description: SpellForce 3: Versus Edition ti dà la possibilità di entrare nei campi di battaglia di Eo gratuitamente, permettendoti di mettere alla prova le tue abilità in questo gioco strategico in tempo reale contro nemici controllati dall'IA o anche contro altri giocatori umani.

games.title: SpellForce: Conquest of Eo
games.description: Mentre accumuli potenza arcana, esplora le terre di Eo in questo gioco di ruolo strategico a turni in continua evoluzione. Schiera armate ed eroi in combattimento, completa centinaia di missioni e colleziona incantesimi e artefatti per diventare il mago più potente.

games.title: SPGP (accesso anticipato)
games.description: È semplicemente una questione di velocità, è semplicemente una questione di competizione.  di guida e corri contro una AI altamente competitiva a velocità da capogiro in un'ampia varietà di scenari. Sblocca 48 tracciati e 20 auto nella Modalità Progresso. Classifiche online.

games.title: Sphere 3
games.description: Sphere 3 è un MMORPG in cui ti aspettano battaglie su larga scala per castelli con macchine d'assedio, scontri epici con mostri antichi, un sistema di progressione flessibile e un sistema di combattimento non-target. Unisciti a Sphere 3, diventa una leggenda!

games.title: Spider Fox
games.description: A ridiculous, web slinging adventure game where you play as a Spider Fox. The Mad Scientist has made some wild animal combinations. Climb, use Grappling Webs, and other items to overcome his obstacles to save them all

games.title: Spider Tanks: Cores of Chaos
games.description: Spider Tanks: Cores of Chaos is a Multiplayer PvP Brawler in which Players customize their Tank from a wide variety of Parts in the garage, then battle it out in high octane 3v3 mayhem. Assemble your tanks, defeat your opponents, climb the ranks and get components!

games.title: Spiderbro
games.description: Help Spiderbro through a strange dystopia and overcome the shadow spider that is constantly hindering you. Collect items and solve puzzles and keep moving, don't let the shadow spider get the better of you.

games.title: Spiderbro 2
games.description: Help Shadowbro overcome a computer worm come to life and save the multiverse from colliding! Collect items, talk to employees, solve puzzles and explore the secrets of a company that caused everything to happen!

games.title: SpiderHeck
games.description: Ragni con spade laser! Duella fino alla morte o fai squadra per sconfiggere gli sciami di vespe feroci. Colpisci, affonda e spara per superare la mappa volteggiando con acrobazie di parkour.

games.title: Spin Park
games.description: Master the physics of speed in Spin Park! Roll your way through twisting rails, narrow paths, and explosive bumpers. Collect stars and conquer mechanical mazes in a race for the top. Precision is your only ally here.

games.title: Spinch
games.description: Transcend the material realm and assume your true form as Spinch, a hyper-agile organism consumed by the quest to rescue a litter of its missing offspring, in this side-scrolling, psychedelic platformer from the mind of award-winning Canadian cartoonist, Jesse Jacobs.

games.title: Spine
games.description: SPINE is a single-player action game featuring close-quarters gunfights with Gun Fu aesthetics. In a cyberpunk world, rebellious artist Redline and her sentient implant Spine defy an AI regime to rescue Redline's captured brother.

games.title: SPINGUN
games.description: SPINGUN is a "manic two-button arcade shooter". Two buttons. One spaceship. Zero chance to survive.

games.title: Spiral
games.description: Spiral è un gioco di narrazione esplorativa in terza persona che propone una visione poetica della degenerazione cognitiva. Calati nei panni di Bernard, aiutalo e sostienilo mentre affronti la sua mente che si deteriora e rivivi i suoi momenti più preziosi.

games.title: Spirit Castor: A Father's Trust (Chapter 1)
games.description: A 1937 spirit-filled thriller about a village high in Castor Mountain. Strange events keep New Goshen relatively isolated and busy. But, the cold mountain range is not the only thing keeping outsiders at bay: For rumors abound that this community holds secrets to a gateway

games.title: Spirit Catcher 93'
games.description: Awaken as a fragmented soul in a retro-futuristic digital nightmare. Wield the Spirit Catcher to navigate shifting landscapes, evade the relentless Shepherd, and uncover the truth buried deep within this fractured realm.

games.title: Spirit of the Island
games.description: Spirit of the Island è un simulatore GDR in co-op ambientato in un arcipelago tropicale. Costruisci la tua fattoria, coltiva piante e alleva animali, raccogli risorse, costruisci negozi e musei per attirare i visitatori e trasforma un'isola desolata in una fiorente destinazion...

games.title: Spirit of the North
games.description: Spirit of the North is a single-player 3rd-person adventure game inspired by the breathtaking and mysterious landscapes of Iceland. The story takes root from various pieces of Nordic folklore.

games.title: Spirit of the North 2
games.description: Unveil the mysteries of a beautiful ancient world in this breathtaking 3rd-Person Adventure, a sequel to the acclaimed ‘Spirit of the North.’ Take on the role of an isolated fox with a raven companion on a quest to restore the lost guardians and return home.

games.title: Spiritfarer®: Farewell Edition
games.description: Spiritfarer®: Farewell Edition è un confortevole gioco gestionale che parla di morte. In quanto traghettatrice dei defunti, costruisci una nave per esplorare il mondo, prenditi cura dei tuoi amici spiriti prima di condurli finalmente nell'aldilà. Cosa ti lascerai alle spalle?

games.title: SPLASH - Paintball
games.description: SPLASH-Paintball delivers the most authentic FPS paintball experience with licensed gear, true-to-life ballistics, and detailed tournament & scenario maps. Play Speedball, CTF, or Arcade - solo or online with friends. Regular updates driven by community feedback keep it fresh.

games.title: Splash Cars
games.description: Dipingete il mondo con il tuo veicolo e trasforma ogni quartiere in un luogo migliore. Vivi un'esperienza di guida libera in 3D isometrico.

games.title: Splatter - Zombiecalypse Now
games.description: You like top-down-shooter with a film-noir singleplayer campaign, challenging fights against zombies and monsters, gory splatter effects and destructible level environments?

games.title: SPLINE: PART ONE
games.description: His Future Is Dark...

games.title: Splinter Cell Chaos Theory
games.description: The year is 2008. Citywide blackouts ... stock exchange sabotage ... electronic hijacking of national defense systems ... this is information warfare.

games.title: Split
games.description: In the future, giant city-states have emerged, separated from each other by indestructible barriers. Most professions have been taken over by machines. People work mainly as mechanics, programmers or operators.

games.title: Split Fiction
games.description: Vivi momenti unici mentre ti immergi nei numerosi mondi di Split Fiction, l'innovativo gioco d'avventura cooperativo creato dallo studio di It Takes Two.

games.title: SPLITGATE: Arena Reloaded
games.description: SPLITGATE: Arena Reloaded fuses the best of Splitgate 1 & 2, bringing back that classic arena shooter feel. No Factions. No Abilities. No Limits. Play free now.

games.canonical_title: SpongeBob SquarePants: Battle for Bikini Bottom - Rehydrated
games.title: SpongeBob SquarePants: Battle for Bikini Bottom - Rehydrated
games.description: Siete pronti, ragazzi? Questo grande classico cult è tornato, ricreato fedelmente in uno splendore a dir poco spugnastico! Gioca nei panni di SpongeBob, Patrick Stella e Sandy e mostra al cattivo Sheldon J. Plankton che il crimine non paga, ancora meno di quanto non faccia Mr....

games.title: SpongeBob SquarePants: The Cosmic Shake
games.description: Wish-granting Mermaid’s Tears in the hands of SpongeBob and Patrick… What could go wrong? Sure, the very fabric holding the universe together could come undone, opening portals into wild Wishworlds. But that’s nothing our favorite sponge can’t handle.

games.title: Spookware
games.description: Play through loads of hand-crafted fast-paced microgames based on horror tropes, explore the world of the afterlife and help the skelebros live their death to the fullest.

games.title: Spooky Mahjong
games.description: Take part in a Spooky Mahjong. Complete over 100 unique levels to gain experience and points. Improve your rank and progress.

games.title: SPRAWL
games.description: Fuggi dalla città fortificata e affronta il governo nei panni di un soldato potenziato in questo sparatutto cyberpunk hardcore e adrenalinico. Alimentato dal sangue del tuo nemico e da una voce misteriosa nella tua testa, vai alla SPIRE per abbattere ciò che si trova all'interno.

games.title: Spy 1 Lovecraftian
games.description: This visual novel is a must-play for fans of Comedy, Romance, and Lovecraftian. It features a heartwarming romance, hilarious comedy, and edge-of-your-seat thrill. With its engaging story and memorable characters, this visual novel is sure to leave you wanting more.

games.title: Spyder: Agent 8
games.description: Salva il mondo con Agent 8, un ragno robot superspia! Arrampicati su muri e soffitti, cammina e usa i gadget integrati per risolvere divertenti rompicapi ambientali in questa nuovissima avventura per tutta la famiglia dello studio premiato ai BAFTA Sumo Digital.

games.title: Squad
games.description: Squad is a large-scale combined arms multiplayer first-person shooter emphasizing combat realism through communication, team play, and strong squad cohesion feeding into larger-scale coordination, tactics, and planning.

games.title: Squawky
games.description: A mascot horror game where a rubber chicken is your flashlight. Enhance it with strange energies to progress, survive twisted enemies, and whatever you do, don’t let Squawky catch you.

games.title: Squirrel with a Gun
games.description: Scoiattolo, ti presento la pistola. Il cattivissimo roditore comincia a capire come funziona la criminalità, e si getta nel caos alla ricerca di ghiande dorate in questo sparatutto sandbox e platformer a enigmi.

games.title: sqwrk
games.description: Sqwrk's tribe have been captured by the evil golem. Help him rescue them in this fast paced 3d platformer with momentum based movement

games.title: SSR Summoners
games.description: SSR Summoners is a turnbased combat online idle fantasy RPG, featuring the Gacha system, allowing players to summon powerful heroes and rare characters to build their ultimate team.

games.title: STALCRAFT: X
games.description:
STALCRAFT: X is a free-to-play MMOFPS with RPG elements.

Explore an open world, engage in PvPvE activities, participate in events, and choose from a variety of weapons — all set in the post-Soviet Chernobyl Exclusion Zone!

games.title: Standard Edition di MechWarrior 5: Mercenaries
games.description: •Include download del gioco completo •Include manuale del gioco in PDF

games.title: Standard Edition di Yaga
games.description: Distruggi, colpisci e pesta le leggende assassine della mitologia slava in questo gioco di ruolo d'azione e dall'umorismo nero che cambia ogni volta che si gioca. Gioca nei panni di Ivan, un fabbro con una mano sola e dalla sfortuna incredibile, che deve svolgere i compiti imp...

games.title: Star Overdrive
games.description: Star Overdrive è un’avventura dinamica ad alta velocità ambientata in un mondo aperto. Sfreccia su un pianeta alieno con il tuo Hoverboard, padroneggia acrobazie, affronta nemici, risolvi enigmi e usa i tuoi poteri per superare le sfide e forgiare il tuo destino!

games.title: Star Renegades
games.description: RESISTI. RISCATTA. SOPRAVVIVI. RIPETI  Star Renegades è un GDR di strategia rogue-lite interdimensionale. Supera in astuzia avversari unici, forgia legami tra gli eroi e metti fine al ciclo!

games.title: Star Sentry
games.description: Star Sentry is a tower defence game demo where you defend your star against enemies that intelligently pathfind around obstacles you place.

games.title: Star Stuff
games.description: Star Stuff is a deceptively cute programming puzzle game. Program and work alongside bots to tackle the most important (and undoubtedly safest) task in the galaxy: fixing a star factory. Ready for your first day on the job?

games.title: Star Trek Legends
games.description: Lasciati coinvolgere da una storia epica per il controllo del misterioso Nexus e il destino dell'universo, mentre i giocatori vestono i panni dei loro eroi e cattivi di Star Trek preferiti con il GDR a squadre ufficiale di questo grande franchise.

games.title: Star Trek Online
games.description: In Star Trek Online, l'universo di Star Trek appare per la prima volta su una scala enorme, coi giocatori al comando della propria astronave. Esplora strani, nuovi mondi alla ricerca di forme di vita per arrivare dove nessuno è mai giunto prima.

games.title: Star Trek Prodigy: Supernova
games.description: Dal R’El e Gwyndala corrono contro il tempo per salvare i loro amici, la Protostar e nuove specie aliene prima che una supernova li distrugga!

games.canonical_title: Star Trek: Voyager - Across the Unknown
games.title: Star Trek: Voyager - Across the Unknown
games.description: Star Trek: Voyager - Across the Unknown is a story-driven survival strategy game in which the fate of the iconic starship is in your hands. Take the helm, manage the ship and resources, and make difficult decisions. Will you be able to bring home the ship and its crew?

games.title: Star Vikings Forever
games.description: Star Vikings Forever is a humorous Puzzle/RPG developed by the award-winning creators of Chroma Squad, Dungeonland, and Relic Hunters Zero.

games.title: Star Vortex
games.description: Star Vortex è un gioco di ruolo d'azione ispirato a classici come Diablo 2. Progetta la tua nave, fatti strada attraverso settori alieni ostili, potenziati trovando armi rare e sperimenta diverse configurazioni finché più nulla sarà in grado di opporsi a te.

games.canonical_title: STAR WARS Jedi: Fallen Order Edizione Standard
games.title: STAR WARS Jedi: Fallen Order Edizione Standard
games.description: Una nuova avventura galattica ti attende in STAR WARS Jedi: Fallen Order, un nuovo gioco d'azione e d'avventura in terza persona sviluppato da Respawn Entertainment.

games.title: STAR WARS Jedi: Survivor™
games.description: La storia di Cal Kestis continua in Star Wars Jedi: Survivor™, un gioco d'azione-avventura in terza persona ambientato in un'intera galassia, sviluppato da Respawn Entertainment e Lucasfilm Games.

games.title: Star Wars Outlaws
games.description: Star Wars Outlaws

games.title: STAR WARS Zero Company™
games.description: Guida una squadra d'élite in una storia autentica e audace in STAR WARS Zero Company™, un gioco tattico a turni da giocare in solitaria.

games.title: STAR WARS: Galactic Racer™
games.description: STAR WARS: Galactic Racer™ è un'interpretazione estrema, basata su run, delle gare di corsa. L'Impero è caduto, la galassia è in ricostruzione; nell’Orlo Esterno nasce il Campionato Galattico, gara clandestina in cui i sindacati foraggiano il caos ed emergono campioni.

games.title: STAR WARS™ Battlefront™ Edizione Definitiva
games.description: STAR WARS™ Battlefront™ Edizione Definitiva include tutto ciò di cui i fan hanno bisogno per vivere le battaglie dei loro sogni di STAR WARS™, inclusi quattro strepitosi pacchetti di espansione, armi aggiuntive ed emote.

games.canonical_title: STAR WARS™ Battlefront™ II: Celebration Edition
games.title: STAR WARS™ Battlefront™ II: Celebration Edition
games.description: Metti alla prova la tua padronanza di blaster, spada laser e potere della Forza online e offline in STAR WARS™ Battlefront™ II: Celebration Edition.

games.title: STAR WARS™: Squadrons
games.description: Domina la galassia con il tuo caccia in STAR WARS™: Squadrons e scopri una nuova esperienza di gioco in cui i piloti sono i veri protagonisti. Allaccia le cinture, prova il brivido dei combattimenti stellari multigiocatore in prima persona con la tua squadriglia e scopri cosa ...

games.title: StarbaseSim
games.description: Operate the Starship space launch system and learn how to catch a rocket to understand what it takes to colonize Mars in this ever-evolving simulation of SpaceX Starbase Texas.

games.title: Stardash
games.description: A "punishing" 90's inspired platformer with retro looks, retro gameplay, and VERY challenging run and jump action. Can you manage to survive the normal levels, and unlock the 10 secret temple levels?

games.title: Stargate: Timekeepers
games.description: "Stargate: Timekeepers è un gioco strategico in tempo reale in cui guidi una squadra di specialisti in una campagna dalla narrativa intensa ambientata nell'universo di SG-1. Usa le abilità uniche dei tuoi personaggi, progetta un piano per svelare il mistero del loop temporale ...

games.title: StarHeroes
games.description: StarHeroes is the first-ever multiplayer space shooter crafted for e-sports, where every match is a high-octane test of skill and strategy. Dive into adrenaline-fueled, fast-paced battles and prove your dominance in the galaxy!

games.title: Starland
games.description: Adventure game of a boy and a dog, puzzles and a land in space.

games.title: Starlight X-2: Rompicapi galattici
games.description: Posiziona stelle e asteroidi intorno ai pianeti in questo divertente e coinvolgente rompicapo a tema spazio!

games.title: Starmasons
games.description: Starmasons is a multiplayer FPS where you embody one of many identical statues fighting to become the last one standing. Sneak around in the fast-changing shadows or hide patiently in plain sight by posing as a statue before picking the perfect moment to raise your crossbow.

games.title: Starsand
games.description: Starsand è un gioco di sopravvivenza mistico ambientato tra le dune di un deserto arcano. Un open world pieno di pericoli, vaste ambientazioni ed eventi misteriosi che aspettano solo te! Esplora, caccia, crea, costruisci e... SOPRAVVIVI.

games.title: Starship Crafter
games.description: Assumi il ruolo di meccanico di astronavi e paga l'immenso debito che tuo padre ti ha lasciato. Migliora il tuo laboratorio, crea componenti, costruisci astronavi, completa contratti per le fazioni, leggi gli eventi sul giornale e, soprattutto,paga il debito prima della scadenza.

games.title: Starship Troopers: Extermination
games.description: Starship Troopers: Extermination is a 16 player co-op FPS that puts you on the far-off front lines of an all-out battle against the Bugs! Squad up, grab your rifle, and do your part as an elite Deep Space Vanguard Trooper set to take back planets claimed by the Arachnid threat!

games.title: Starship Troopers: Terran Command
games.description: Un avvincente gioco di strategia in tempo reale ambientato nell'universo cinematografico di Starship Troopers. Assumi il comando della Fanteria Mobile e prendi parte alla guerra contro la minaccia degli Aracnidi. Assicurati che siano gli umani, e non gli insetti, a dominare la...

games.title: StarSim
games.description: Salvate la galassia in questo epico gioco di ruolo fantascientifico che combina combattimenti RTwP, combattimenti a turni, missioni testuali e altro ancora. Siate un eroe, un commerciante, uno spazzino, un mercenario o un pirata.

games.title: Startup Panic
games.description: Licenziati e crea una nuova esaltante startup! Sopravvivi alla bolla tecnologica, competi con CEO rivali ed espandi il tuo ufficio partendo dalla tua stanza fino ad arrivare ai vertici della concorrenza spietata fra aziende! Sempre che non ti hackerino... o che non ti rapiscan...

games.title: Starvin Martian
games.description: Build your own empire with STARVIN MARTIAN! This farming style game, located on the red planet, will be a fun,

games.title: STASIS : BONE TOTEM
games.description: Una coinvolgente avventura con meccaniche punta e clicca da scoprire con tre personaggi. Con grafiche isometriche, video renderizzati e una colonna sonora a cura di Mark Morgan, STASIS: BONE TOTEM catapulta in un viaggio verso luoghi nascosti nelle profondità oceaniche...

games.title: State of Decay 2: Juggernaut Edition
games.description: I morti si sono risvegliati e la civiltà è in rovina. Adesso tocca a te riunire un gruppo di superstiti, trovare nuove risorse e creare una comunità con un massimo di tre amici in un mondo post-apocalittico.

games.title: STATION
games.description: Station is a single-player, tactical first-person shooter game with elements of survival through combat or avoidance, navigation, and resource management. It is designed with a minimalistic approach, focusing on tactics and orientation.

games.title: Stay on the white lines
games.description: The concept of this game is to remind your childhood memories and adventures.  You (and the kid) only walk on the white lines.  While heading home, he will drift into his own fantasy. Can you get over his fantasy and get home?

games.title: Stay Reserved, Beauty
games.description: Stay Reserved, Beauty. A live-action interactive movie game. You stand in a seductive battlefield, surrounded by six sensual goddesses—none of them a pushover. There's no "pick one" choice here, only the ultimate challenge to have them all. Every twist rests in your hands.

games.title: Steal It
games.description:
Steal It is an online multiplayer game 🎮 where it depends on who has the most coins 🪙 at the end of a round. 
Coins can either be obtained as rewards by completing tasks ✅ or by stealing them from other players 🕵️‍♂️.

games.canonical_title: Steal, Then Just Escape: The Real Thrill
games.title: Steal, Then Just Escape: The Real Thrill
games.description: Steal, Then Just Escape: The Real Thrill has ReTurn to Coming Soon! After PostPoning the ReLaunch in February. I would like you to know that the game will be back on Coming Soon! Stage. Now, this is Real Thrill, escaping for a few months. But I shall ReLaunch.

games.title: Steam To Teach Chemistry 101
games.description: Steam to Teach Chemistry 101 is a virtual laboratory platform designed to provide experiment-based chemistry learning in a fully digital environment. Covering a wide range of topics—including thermodynamics, phase changes, gas laws, equilibrium, electrochemistry and more.

games.title: Steam To Teach CI Biology 12
games.description: This Steam To Teach Biology 12 Virtual Labs package provides an immersive, curriculum-aligned practical learning experience designed to strengthen scientific understanding through inquiry-based experimentation. Students investigate concepts in genetics, cell biology and more.

games.title: Steam To Teach CI Chemistry 10
games.description: Steam To Teach CI Chemistry 10 Virtual Labs package provides an immersive and curriculum-aligned learning experience designed to support advanced chemistry education through interactive experimentation. Fully aligned with Cambridge International standards for grade 10.

games.title: Steam To Teach CI Chemistry 11
games.description: This Steam To Teach Chemistry 11 Virtual Labs package provides an interactive and curriculum-aligned practical learning experience that enables students to investigate advanced chemical concepts through immersive experimentation.

games.title: Steam To Teach CI Chemistry 12
games.description: Steam To Teach CI Chemistry 12 Virtual Labs package provides an immersive and curriculum-aligned learning experience designed to support advanced chemistry education through interactive experimentation. Fully aligned with Cambridge International standards for grade 12.

games.title: Steam to Teach Physics 101
games.description: Steam To Teach Physics is an interactive virtual laboratory platform designed to deliver comprehensive, experiment-based physics learning in a fully digital environment. Covering a wide spectrum of topics—including kinematics, dynamics, energy, momentum, E&M and more.

games.canonical_title: Steampunks Vs Skeletons: Adventure Puzzle Park
games.title: Steampunks Vs Skeletons: Adventure Puzzle Park
games.description: Play a Beautiful and Atmospheric Steampunk Arcade Puzzle Adventure to collect the Gears, PowerUps, Treasures and Secrets, Solve Progress Puzzles, and Respawn the Humourous Skeletons & Spinning Sprits out to suck your lifeforce!

games.title: SteamWorld Build
games.description: Riscopri il mondo di SteamWorld da una nuova prospettiva! Costruisci la tua città, scava a fondo e fuggi da un pianeta morente!

games.title: SteamWorld Dig
games.description: SteamWorld Dig is a platform mining adventure with strong Metroidvanian influences. Take the role of Rusty, a lone mining steambot, as he arrives at an old mining town in great need.

games.title: SteamWorld Dig 2
games.description: SteamWorld Dig is back! Dig deep, gain riches and unearth the terrors of the underworld in this platform mining adventure influenced by classic Metroidvania style games.

games.title: SteamWorld Heist II
games.description: Unisciti al capitano Leeway nel colpo definitivo per salvare i bot da una crisi idrica!

games.title: SteamWorld Quest
games.description: Lead a party of aspiring heroes through a beautifully hand-drawn world and intense battles using only your wits and a handful of cards. Take on whatever threat comes your way by crafting your own deck choosing from over 100 unique punch-cards!

games.title: Steel Fury Kharkov 1942
games.description: Steel Fury: Kharkov 1942 is based on real-life events that took place from May 12 to 28, 1942. During a vicious German counterattack three Soviet Armies were surrounded and were forced to fighting in what has become known as the “meat grinder.”

games.title: Steel Rats
games.description: Salta sulla tua moto e scorrazza per le innovative ambientazioni di questo gioco d'azione arcade in 2.5D. Una perfetta fusione tra potenza distruttiva, combattimenti ad alto numero di ottani e acrobazie, il tutto all'interno di un mondo retrofuturistico.

games.title: Steel Seed
games.description: Steel Seed è un action adventure stealth a singolo giocatore ambientato in un mondo sci-fi dark. Nel suo epico viaggio in un sotterraneo di robot, Zoe ha come unico compagno Koby, un drone volante.

games.title: Steel Shell
games.description: Steel Shell is a third-person shooter in the style of dark cyberpunk.

games.title: Steelrising
games.description: Parigi 1789. La Rivoluzione francese è stata soffocata nel sangue da Luigi XVI e il suo spietato esercito meccanico. Aegis, un misterioso capolavoro dell'ingegneria, deve affrontare da sola l'esercito del re per salvare la storia in questo appassionante GDR d'azione.

games.title: Steep Standard Edition
games.description: Lanciati a perdifiato in un mondo aperto tra le Alpi, dove la neve è sempre fresca e la discesa non finisce mai.

games.title: Stellar Blade™
games.description: Salva il genere umano dall'estinzione nell’avventura d'azione post apocalittica Stellar Blade™. Vivi feroci combattimenti e una storia intricata mentre sveli i misteri della caduta della Terra.

games.title: Stellar Forger
games.description: Stella Forger delivers an exciting fusion of survival and roguelike genres. Set in a futuristic universe, players take on the role of blacksmiths traveling across planets to battle alien monsters and collect rare materials to craft powerful weapons.

games.title: Stellar Interface
games.description: Run through the universe in this rogue-like-ish space-shooter. Discover the numerous perks/consumables and their synergistic effects. Explore the randomly-generated galaxy to find merchants, unlock spacecrafts, and checkmark your kills of the various galactic Overlords.

games.title: Stellar Subterranean
games.description: In Nexus Prime, a futuristic underground city, crime festers. Kael Vortex, ex-security officer turned vigilante, fights to cleanse it after a loss. With hacker Lira and reformed criminal Rax, he battles gangs, aliens, and a conspiracy, facing moral dilemmas to save the city

games.title: Stereoscopy
games.description: A virtual theater experience for Desktop PC with VR support - capable of playing Standard and 3D Video files. Supports Keyboard/Mouse, Gamepad, and XR Controllers.

games.title: Stick it to the Man!
games.description: Ray, collaudatore di caschi, ha un incidente bizzarro e si risveglia con un braccio rosa gigante in testa! Con questo nuovo potere sensazionale può leggere la mente e cambiare il mondo con degli adesivi, però è costretto a scappare perché accusato di un reato che non ha commesso.

games.title: Still Joking
games.description:
What do mirror reflections do once they have no one to repeat after anymore? 
Play as Iris, quite a sarcastic reflection torn between the urge to unravel the mystery of death of her “prototype” and the need to find her place in a mirrored world.

games.title: Still There
games.description: Description is not set

games.title: Still Wakes The Deep
games.description: 1975. Un disastro si abbatte sulla piattaforma petrolifera di Beira D, al largo delle coste della Scozia. Attraversa i resti della piattaforma per salvare il tuo equipaggio da un orrore ultraterreno che sfida ogni logica.

games.title: Stillborn Slayer
games.description: Stillborn Slayer is a beautifully crafted pixel-art bullet hell RPG game set in a cursed Dark Continent, with challenging boss fights, exploration, and complex combat. Master dodging and rolling skills to fight incomprehensible monsters and slay the Horned God to end the Curse.

games.title: Stocking Salon2
games.description:
Stocking Salon2 is a live-action video interactive game.  
The game immerses you in the protagonist's world, where you interact with 11 beautiful women through emotions of love and hate. This game does not include romantic elements or a gripping storyline.

games.title: Stone 4 Souls
games.description: Stone 4 Souls is a medieval fantasy metroidvania with RPG elements. Explore a world full of secrets and dangers while wielding powerful swords and equipping stunning visual items. Unlock new abilities and level up your character with a skill tree.

games.title: Stone Guardian
games.description: a low-poly style 3rd person action-adventure game where you play as a guardian that needs to find the disappeared Stone.

games.title: StoneHold
games.description: StoneHold is a F2P 5v5 action MOBA where card game strategy meets intense third-person combat. Pick a Warden, build a deck, draw by crushing turrets and defeating enemies, then swap cards at base for constant counterplay. UE5 visuals and a world of chiseled stone magic.

games.title: Stonekeep
games.description: Interplay brings its most electrifying epic from the computer screen into your mind, body, and soul.

games.title: Stoneshard
games.description: Stoneshard is a challenging turn-based RPG set in an open world. Experience the unforgiving life of a medieval mercenary: travel across the war-torn kingdom, fulfill contracts, fight, mend your wounds and develop your character without any restrictions.

games.title: Store It!
games.description: Store things, earn money with it and improve your warehouse! You play a small, cute robot who uses his Gravity-Gun to take care of his customers' belongings, but be careful not to break anything!

games.title: Store Simulator

games.title: Storebound
games.description: A 1-3 co-op puzzle horror game. Lost in an accursed megastore, work together to find the exit before its lurking horrors trap you forever.

games.title: Stories Untold

Si tratta di un mix di avventure testuali, punta e clicca e tanto altro. 4 storie brevi condensate in una singola antologia misteriosa che è stata descritta c...

games.description: Storm Lancers è un roguelike con sessioni dai ritmi rapidi in cui dovrai eludere la morte, sconfiggere i nemici e padroneggiare potenti abilità.

games.title: Storm Warfare
games.description: Get ready to rewrite history with Storm Warfare, the free-to-play WW2 strategy card game. Fight on epic WW2 battlefronts, collect cards, and truly own and trade your in-game assets.

games.title: Stormedge
games.description: Dodge enemies' attacks, activate lethal traps and customize your hero in StormEdge. Team up with friends for an exhilarating co-op experience. Brace yourself for the dangerous Elemental Storms that will put your skills to the test!

games.title: Stormshot: Isle of Adventure
games.description: 300 brilliant levels await! Come unveil the myth of Treasure Isle!

games.title: STORROR Parkour Pro
games.description: The city is your playground. The risk is real. The path is yours. A physics-driven experience that will immerse you in an authentic urban environment. Master your movement, challenge your instincts, and traverse a city designed for limitless creative potential.
games.developer: Hole in the Sleeve Game Studios
games.publisher: Hole in the Sleeve Game Studios

games.canonical_title: STORY OF SEASONS: Friends of Mineral Town
games.title: STORY OF SEASONS: Friends of Mineral Town
games.description: Your farming life begins in Mineral Town, a charming village surrounded by nature. You've returned after many years to restore your late grandfather's farm to its former glory. Care for crops, livestock, and more as your very own story of seasons unfolds.

games.title: Stranded Deep
games.description: Sei sopravvissuto a un incidente aereo e ti ritrovi isolato in un luogo sperduto dell'Oceano Pacifico. Affronta alcuni degli scenari di vita più rischiosi e vivi un'esperienza diversa ogni volta che giochi. Cerca. Scopri. Sopravvivi.

games.title: Stranded: Alien Dawn
games.description: Affronta un nuovo mondo in Stranded: Alien Dawn, un simulatore survival che ti affida il destino di un piccolo gruppo bloccato su un pianeta. Crea la tua storia con dinamiche strategiche e coinvolgenti mentre prendi decisioni per proteggere i sopravvissuti.

games.title: Strange Antiquities
games.description: Strange Antiquities is a game set in Undermere, where you explore occult artifacts and solve dark mysteries. As an apprentice thaumaturge, you'll identify magical items and help townsfolk. A sequel to Strange Horticulture, it blends exploration to uncover strange secrets.

games.title: Strange Horticulture
games.description: An occult puzzle game in which you play as the proprietor of a local plant store. Find and identify new plants, pet your cat, speak to a coven, or join a cult. Use your collection of powerful plants to influence the story and unravel Undermere’s dark mysteries.

games.canonical_title: STRANGER OF PARADISE FINAL FANTASY ORIGIN
games.title: STRANGER OF PARADISE FINAL FANTASY ORIGIN
games.description: In this hard-core action RPG, Jack must hazard numerous challenges to bring the light of the crystals back to Cornelia, a kingdom conquered by darkness.

games.title: Strategic Mind: Blitzkrieg
games.description: Strategic Mind: Blitzkrieg is a turn-based strategy set in the period of WW2. It brings a modern look and new features to a good old wargame genre. You are to lead the German Armed forces overcoming unthinkable odds and claiming the ultimate bittersweet victory in Europe.

games.title: Strategic Mind: Fight for Freedom
games.description: Strategic Mind: Fight for Freedom is a history-driven turn-based strategy set in WW2. Take command of the Allied forces and protect your homeland and the whole of Europe from totalitarian madness. Form armies. Win battles. Change history.

games.title: Strategic Mind: Spectre of Communism
games.description: Strategic Mind: Spectre of Communism is a (hi)story-driven turn-based strategy set in the WW2 period. It offers refined wargame mechanics, story-rich gameplay, and modern 3D graphics. Lead the USSR Armed forces staging the world Communist revolution.

games.title: Strategic Mind: The Pacific
games.description: Strategic Mind: The Pacific is a turn-based strategy set in the WW2 period depicting the war between the USA and the Empire of Japan waged in the Pacific Ocean with mindblowing historical accuracy and attention to detail. Two Sides. Two Commanders. Two Destinies.

games.title: Stray
games.description: Solo, sperduto e lontano dalla sua famiglia, un gatto randagio deve venire a capo di un antico mistero per fuggire da una cybercittà e ritrovare la via di casa.

games.title: Stray Blade
games.description: Stray Blade è un action RPG in cui vesti i panni di un avventuriero che esplora l'antica valle di Acrea con il suo compagno Boji. Svela il passato della valle dimenticata e domina i poteri dei tre metalli acreani per riportare la pace in una terra devastata dalla guerra.

games.title: Stray Gods: The Roleplaying Musical
games.description: Gods. Romance. Murder. Musical Numbers?! Play as Grace in a world where Greek Gods live in hiding among us. Change your fate as you draw friends, foes & lovers into song using your powers of musical persuasion to unravel the mystery of the Last Muse's death.

games.title: Strayed Lights
games.description: Un'avventura d'azione e di atmosfera che combina un'esperienza di sole immagini con combattimenti cinematografici basati sui colori. Ripristina la tua luce lacerata dalle ombre e affronta incredibili creature rese deformi dalle loro emozioni.

games.title: Streamlands: Defense
games.description: Difendi i Fiumati Uniti dall'aggressione della Repubblica di Diaccia in questo gioco Difendi la Torre in stile Guerre Mondiali.

games.title: Street Fighting Simulator
games.description: Alcuni strani ragazzi della strada accanto sono venuti nel vostro quartiere, cacciateli via.//////////////////

games.title: Strike Force 3
games.description: Join Strike Force 3, an elite unit combating ruthless terrorists. Engage in adrenaline-pumping firefights, stealth missions, and complete daring objectives. Enlist now for the ultimate combat experience!

games.title: Strike Protocol GemFI
games.description: Strike Protocol blends the excitement of dungeon crawling with strategic base building. Choose your role and immerse yourself in a world of modern warfare.

games.title: Strike Solitaire
games.description:
Solitaire or bowling? Two in one! 
Complete 120 levels in Strike Solitaire in the unique setting of bowling hotels.

games.title: Strike Solitaire 2
games.description:
The sea, the sun, and solitaire! Hit a strike on the seashore!

This is solitaire in a unique country bowling-hotel setting, allowing you to play two games at once – bowling and solitaire.

games.title: Striker Manager 3
games.description: Striker Manager 3 is the best Play to Earn multiplayer football manager game that combines the fun of traditional football games with the ability to be the owner of your in-game assets. Manager, your time has come!

games.canonical_title: Strings of Fate XI: Magic dream
games.title: Strings of Fate XI: Magic dream
games.description: This is an adventure about five brave heroes who have to embark on a journey where, sword and magic play a key role in the struggle to save the world. Nine schools of magic, about a hundred spells and dozens of weapon sets. More than fifty dungeons with riddles and monsters.

games.title: Strinova
games.description: Strinova is an anime-style third-person tactical competitive shooter. Switch freely between three-dimensional and two-dimensional forms in this one-of-a-kind game that offers a unique tactical shooting system for an unparalleled experience.

games.title: Strong Fortress
games.description: Este es un juego de tiro con elementos de defensa de la torre. Los jugadores conducirán armaduras para derrotar a los insectos alienígenas.Es necesario pensar estratégicamente durante el despliegue.Las operaciones de tiro son necesarias durante la batalla.

games.title: Stu the fisherman
games.description: Explore an ever-changing sea filled with fish, each with their own personality. Cast your line and fish the days away, scoring bigger and better catches as you go!

games.canonical_title: Stubbs the Zombie in Rebel Without a Pulse
games.title: Stubbs the Zombie in Rebel Without a Pulse
games.description: Gioca nei panni dello zombie. Prendi a calci nel c*** e mangia cervelli. È il 1959 e la città di Punchbowl, in Pennsylvania, è la culla del progresso e della vita ideale. Mostra ai vivi che la legge e l'ordine pubblico non possono competere con un morto in missione!

games.title: Stunt Paradise
games.description: Preparati per un'esperienza adrenalinica in Stunt Paradise! Affronta sfide epiche, esegui acrobazie folli e vivi la guida estrema. Allaccia le cinture e gioca ora!

games.title: Stygian: Outer Gods
games.description: Dive into a hostile world that challenges your very existence, in this survival horror game with RPG elements. Unravel a thousand-year-old mystery, risk your sanity and face the Outer Gods with your skills. Every bullet and the decision counts now, are you up to the task?

games.canonical_title: Stygian: Reign of the Old Ones
games.title: Stygian: Reign of the Old Ones
games.description: Delve into a role-playing game of horror, loss, and madness set in the strange worlds of HP Lovecraft. Stygian offers a mix of rich role-playing and turn-based tactical combat, represented in an illustrative visual style. Can you find salvation in a dead world?

games.title: Styx: Blades of Greed
games.description: Il maestro della furtività è tornato! Esplora il Continente di Iserian nella sua verticalità e supera i nemici in astuzia. Con il potere del Quarzo, la libertà non ha confini. Lasciati andare alla creatività, essere avidi non è mai stato così bello.

games.title: Styx: Master of Shadows
games.description: Styx: Master of Shadows è un gioco d’infiltrazione con elementi RPG ambientato in un oscuro mondo fantastico in cui impersoni Styx, un goblin di 200 anni che dovrà infiltrarsi, rubare e uccidere per farsi strada.

games.title: Styx: Shards of Darkness - Deluxe Edition
games.description: Styx torna in una nuova avventura segreta! Esplora e domina enormi scenari aperti, intrufolati o uccidi nuovi nemici e boss e prova il nuovo assortimento di abilità e armi letali nell’arsenale del nostro goblin assassino!

games.title: Sub Command
games.description: Take charge of the most deadly modern-day submarines in the world - three distinct submarines across two unique and challenging campaigns. Utilize cutting-edge sensor and weapon technology to locate, track and destroy the enemy - even deliver Tomahawk missiles to inland targets.

games.title: Submarine Titans
games.description: Submarine Titans is a real-time strategy video game that takes place in the year 2115 after a comet has struck Earth, driving two human factions, the militant White Sharks and the scientific Black Octopi, to establish underwater bases and fight for dominance over the oceans.

games.title: Submerged
games.description: Submerged è un gioco di esplorazione in terza persona: esplora una misteriosa città sommersa dall'acqua e la desolazione di bellissimi scenari esterni. Vestirai i panni di Miku, una ragazza che ha raggiunto la città su una piccola barca da pesca in compagnia del fratello ferito.

games.title: Submerged: Hidden Depths
games.description: Naviga, arrampicati, interagisci ed esplora le splendide rovine di un mondo sommerso.

games.title: Subnautica
games.description: Preparati a immergerti

games.title: Subnautica 2
games.description: Subnautica 2 è un gioco di avventura e sopravvivenza subacquea, ambientato in un nuovo mondo alieno, sviluppato da Unknown Worlds. Gioca da solo o con gli amici. Adattati per sopravvivere costruendo basi e strumenti. Esplora l'ignoto per scoprire i misteri degli abissi.

games.title: Subnautica Below Zero
games.description: Below Zero è un gioco di avventura sottomarina ambientato in un mondo oceanico alieno. Un nuovo capitolo nell'universo di Subnautica, attualmente in sviluppo da Unknown Worlds.  ![Subnautica Below Zero Image](https://cdn2.unrealengine.com/Diesel%2Fproduct%2Fsubnautica-below-ze...

games.title: Subterrain Mines of Titan
games.description: An uncompromising turn-based survival RPG set on Titan. After discovering your stasis pod, a doomed mining camp needs your help to survive the evolving horrors that lurk below. Research and craft equipment, fight against odds, and discover your destiny.

games.title: Subwar 2050
games.description: The Underwater Combat Simulation

games.title: Subway Midnight
games.description: Tutti in carrozza! Scappa da uno stramboide! Risolvi gli enigmi! Fai amicizia con dei fantasmi! Cerca di non diventare un fantasma anche tu!

games.title: Subway Outbreak
games.description: Subway Outbreak, defend and rebuild your metro station against mutant hordes in this pixel strategy game. Manage tasks like fortifying defenses, launching assaults, and gathering resources to survive 30 days of increasingly fierce attacks. Lose by death or generator destruction.

games.title: SubwaySim 2
games.description: Esplora tre linee metropolitane tra le più caratteristiche in Germania! La U1/U3 di Berlino e la U3 di Amburgo vi aspettano. Immergiti nella vita di tutti i giorni delle due metropoli tedesche e scopri luoghi famosi come il porto di Amburgo o l'Oberbaumbrücke di Berlino.

games.title: SuchArt: Genius Artist Simulator
games.description: Un gioco di simulazione artistica unico che presenta una miscela di pitture e una fisica realistiche, oltre a tanti strumenti di pittura. Migliora e personalizza il tuo studio, completa gli incarichi ed esponi le tue opere d'arte, acquista gli strumenti e ottieni fama!

games.title: Sucker for Love
games.description: Dai una svolta romantica agli "orrori lovecraftiani"! Effettua dei rituali terrificanti per conquistare orrori spettrali e sbaciucchiarli... a qualsiasi costo!

games.title: Sudden Strike 5
games.description: Una serie di opzioni tattiche e più di 300 unità giocabili aprono molteplici approcci per raggiungere gli obiettivi in una campagna di 25 missioni su campi di battaglia storici in Europa e Nord Africa.

games.title: Sudoku Zenkai
games.description: Sudoku Zenkai is a game for everyone, from beginning to advanced players. It brings a new dimension to sudoku - you can solve puzzles with your friends, wherever they are! You can start a new puzzle with a friend or call one over to help when you get stuck.

games.title: Sugar Shack
games.description: Sugar Shack is a maple syrup management game and world crafter set in a cozy, magical forest inspired by Quebec lore and art. Hungry villagers with endless sweet tooths make their way to this legendary shack. Grab some friends, fire up the boiler, and let the syrup flow!

games.title: Suicide Guy
games.description: Suicide Guy is set in the incredibile and extraordinary dreams of its protagonist. What would you do in order to save the thing you love most? Immerse yourself into his weird dreams and help him to wake up before it's too late.

games.canonical_title: Suicide Squad: Kill the Justice League
games.title: Suicide Squad: Kill the Justice League
games.description: From the creators of Batman: Arkham, Suicide Squad: Kill the Justice League is a genre-defying third-person action shooter where the ultimate band of misfits must do the impossible: Kill the Justice League.

games.canonical_title: Suikoden I&II HD Remaster Gate Rune and Dunan Unification Wars
games.title: Suikoden I&II HD Remaster Gate Rune and Dunan Unification Wars
games.description: Il destino di un eroe è scritto nelle Stelle. I leggendari videogiochi di ruolo KONAMI Suikoden I e Suikoden II sono stati rimasterizzati in HD!

games.title: Summer Dates
games.description: Summer Dates è una simulazione interattiva di appuntamenti che unisce romanticismo ed eccitazione. Incontrate personaggi unici, create legami e vivete un'estate piena di momenti memorabili

games.title: Summer Feast
games.description: To graduate, Li Lei works at his teacher's seaside inn. There, he meets a mysterious mafia heiress and a clever Girl, adding twists to his daily life. Players will guide Li Lei through complex relationships and key decisions in this romantic adventure.

games.title: Summer's Gone
games.description: A high-quality interactive Visual Novel that tackles many topics that plague today's world. This game is about healing, hope, and love.

games.title: Summer's Heartbeat
games.description:
Village romance hotter than summer's heat!

Drowning in debt, you escape to the countryside
only to meet the loan shark noona, your first love, and the tsundere village princess!

This summer, your heart’s melting faster than ice cream.
Who’s going to set your world on fire?

games.title: Summum Aeterna
games.description: Summum Aeterna, the prequel to Aeterna Noctis, is a Roguelite game that combines world crawler mechanics with fast-paced combat and a unique 2D art style. You'll explore uncharted territories populated with treasures, traps, enemies, and powerful bosses.

games.title: Sunblaze
games.description: Guida Josie all'interno del simulatore di addestramento del padre, supereroe in pensione! Ma fa' attenzione, la sala di addestramento potrebbe trasformarsi in un luogo ostile per intrappolarti... Sunblaze è un enigmatico platformer di precisione con centinaia di sfide e livelli fatti a mano che ti faranno morire per ore.

games.title: SunBlockers
games.description: A survival mini-adventure where the sun has fallen and darkness freezes everything. Stay near the light, explore, and survive as long as you can.

games.title: Sunday Gold
games.description: Sunday Gold è un'avventura punta e clicca a turni ambientata in un futuro tetro e distopico. Gioca nei panni di un trio raffazzonato di criminali per braccare e svelare i segreti oscuri di una multinazionale malvagia e del miliardario maligno che la gestisce.

games.title: Sundered: Eldritch Edition
games.description: Sundered è un caotico mondo di gioco disegnato a mano in puro stile Metroidvania dove dovrai resistere o adottare antichi poteri spaventosi, un classico reinterpretato e avvincente dai creatori di Jotun, ora anche cooperativo locale!

games.title: Sunderfolk
games.description: Rivivi le emozioni delle tue serate di gioco in questo GdR tattico basato su strategie condivise. Avventurati nelle Sunderlands con fino a quattro giocatori. Gioca online, con mouse e tastiera, o in co-op locale, con smartphone e controller. Prova gratis le prime 4 missioni!

games.title: Sunken Dreams
games.description: An atmospheric puzzle and exploration game from a solo developer. Stranded on a wave-lashed island, delve into the darkness, featuring a cinematic camera system and realtime player decay.

games.title: Sunless Sea
games.description: ABBANDONATI ALLA PAZZIA. DIVORA IL TUO EQUIPAGGIO. MUORI. Afferra il timone della tua nave a vapore e salpa verso l'ignoto! Sunless Sea è un gioco di scoperta, solitudine e morte frequente, ambientato nel pluripremiato universo gotico vittoriano di Fallen London.

games.title: Sunless Skies: Sovereign Edition
games.description: SAIL THE STARS. BETRAY YOUR QUEEN. MURDER A SUN. Sunless Skies is a Gothic Horror roleplay game with a focus on exploration and exquisite storytelling.

games.title: SunnySide
games.description: Bridge the gap between traditional practices and modern influences as you find harmony in the Japanese countryside. Cultivate new experiences, build a thriving homestead, and let your relationships with the locals blossom.

games.title: Sunset Motel
games.description: Welcome to Sunset Motel! Restore rundown rooms, design your dream motel, and keep your guests happy in this relaxing simulation game. Paint walls, place furniture, build entertainment areas and pools, and create a place where travelers will always want to return.

games.title: Sunshine Manor
games.description: Sunshine Manor is an 8-bit blood-soaked Horror RPG that pits you as Ada. Dared to spend the night in the haunted Sunshine Manor she encounters ghosts, demons, blood-soaked horror and more in this prequel to 2016's Camp Sunshine.

games.title: Super Adventure Hand
games.description: È la mano più intrepida del mondo! Gioca nei suoi panni in un'avventura che ti prende per mano e ti porta a dover maneggiare molti ostacoli, cercando di evitare i terribili piedi.

games.canonical_title: Super Arcade Boy in Defender of Planet Earth
games.title: Super Arcade Boy in Defender of Planet Earth
games.description: Il debutto di Super Arcade Boy in un classico sparatutto a scorrimento laterale in stile rétro! Sfreccia in 8 livelli, sconfiggi nemici e boss, divertiti con dialoghi umoristici, potenziamenti, grafica HD e supporto controller completo. Super Arcade Boy è pronto alla sfida. E TU?

games.canonical_title: Super Arcade Boy in Goodbye Greenies
games.title: Super Arcade Boy in Goodbye Greenies
games.description: Uno sparatutto rétro! In questa seconda puntata della serie, fai sfrecciare Super Arcade Boy in 8 livelli, sconfiggendo orde di alieni e grandi boss. Scherza con il capo degli alieni, destinato a perire per mano tua, e salva il pianeta dalla colossale invasione aliena!

games.title: Super Bit Blaster XL
games.description: A SUPER throwback to the classic quarter eating arcade games of the 80's. Super Bit Blaster XL is an (even more) enhanced version of the retro styled, addictive, and fast paced arcade shoot 'em up!

games.title: Super Buckyball Tournament
games.description: Super Buckyball Tournament è un gioco sportivo d'azione cyberpunk in cui porti uno dei tantissimi personaggi unici, ciascuno dotato dei propri superpoteri, in intense partite online o per giocatore singolo in modalità competitiva o casual.

games.title: Super BUFF HD
games.description: Super Buff HD is a fast-paced skate-surf-FPS. Dash, bounce, grind, blast, shred, shoot, and soar through a fever dream world of unhinged weirdness. Defeat all the buff dudes. Get a high score. Be a winner. Home for dinner.

games.title: Super Cauldron
games.description: You are Zmira, a brave little witch and your task is not an easy one. Use your spells and travel across worlds to save the Kingdom of Cauldron from the Evil Sorcerer in this unique action platformer.

games.title: SUPER CRAZY RHYTHM CASTLE
games.description: Ecco Super Crazy Rhythm Castle, la caotica avventura musicale! Un cervellotico mashup cooperativo mai sentito prima. In solitaria o in una band di tre amici… Riuscirai a conquistare il castello?

games.title: Super Fantasy Kingdom
