games.description: A steam-ship period naval combat games focusing on fleet-scale battles in real time. The naval combat game allows you to set up battle squadron groups, their formations and management, with realistic ship models and characteristics, as well as advanced ballistic and weapon models

games.canonical_title: Victory At Sea Atlantic: Epic Naval Battles in World War II
games.title: Victory At Sea Atlantic: Epic Naval Battles in World War II
games.description: Victory At Sea Atlantic transports you to the cold, unforgiving waters of the Atlantic Theatre in WWII. With a vast array of ships, planes, and subs, engage in epic sea battles & secure your place in history. Victory At Sea Atlantic is the ultimate naval warfare experience.

games.title: Video Game Trivia
games.description: Come te la cavi con i quiz sui videogiochi? Mettiti alla prova o partecipa a una serata di quiz sui videogiochi con amici e familiari grazie alla Party Mode. Arcade, Atari, Nintendo, PC, PlayStation, SEGA e Xbox: troverai domande su tutte le più popolari categorie di videogiochi!

games.title: VIDEOVERSE
games.description: Relive the days of the early internet and dive into this fictional video game era, where the 'Kinmoku Shark’ gaming system and its online social network 'Videoverse' were still popular…

games.title: Viewfinder
games.description: Sfida la percezione, ridefinisci la realtà e rimodella il mondo che ti circonda grazie a una fotocamera istantanea. Viewfinder è un nuovo gioco per giocatore singolo che offre ore di esperienze interessanti e divertenti, con l'obiettivo di svelare antichi misteri.

games.title: Viking City Tycoon
games.description: Embark on an epic journey of conquest and construction in Viking City Tycoon, where you'll build and manage your own Norse settlement from the ground up. With its charming low-poly graphics and deep management gameplay.

games.title: Viking Dynasty
games.description: Embrace viking life and earn Valhalla’s blessing. Survive in the harsh norse environments and praise the Gods. Become a Jarl, control every aspect of your village and protect your community at all costs.

games.title: Viking Rise
games.description: Competi contro altri giocatori e conquista il Valhalla!

games.title: Vintergard
games.description: Explore the mysterious castle Vintergard. Solve puzzles and unravel the mystery of why you were brought here. Make critical choices that will decide the fate of the castle inhabitants, in this first person point and click adventure inspired by the classics.

games.title: Virballs
games.description: Six outlandish planets are overrun with Virballs - viral elemental creatures that consume each other to create exotic hybrids. Clean up this ecological disaster using Virball hybrids as devastating weapons!

games.title: Virtual Rides 3
games.description: Design! Control! Ride! Virtual Rides III is here! Set foot in an even bigger, more colorful, and more impressive fairground than ever before! Let your imagination be your guide! Design, control, and ride more than 15 unique attractions!

games.title: Virus Infinite
games.description: Dive into the pulsating universe of Virus Infinite. Harness your logic to outsmart vibrant viruses, using color-matching prowess and Power Pill strategy in this captivating sci-fi puzzle game.

games.title: Viscerafest
games.description: Viscerafest è un gioco fantascientifico per giocatore singolo ambientato in un'arena sparatutto con sottili elementi del genere collectathon. Battiti tra orde di alieni e mostruosità eldritch brandendo una sfilza di armi potentissime, destreggiandoti tra le risorse ed esploran...
games.developer: Acid Man Games, Fire Plant Games

games.title: Visual Novel Sisters
games.description: Visual Novel Sisters è un'emozionante visual novel basata su un racconto popolare giapponese di due sorelle. Il giocatore intraprende un viaggio emozionante, con una trama ricca, scelte emotive e scene visive vivaci che lo immergono in un'incredibile atmosfera fiabesca.

games.title: Vitamin Girl
games.description: The Soda Aliens invaded The Great Earth, as they fight to conquer The World turning everyone to Cola Zombies, a young girl survives and turns into our heroine, Vitamin Girl! In this runner inspired on late 90s classic, control Vitamin Girl and reach the end of the stage!

games.title: Vivarium
games.description: Step into a summer that never ends in this life-sim adventure, featuring hand-illustrated art inspired by timeless anime classics.

games.title: Vivere in campagna
games.description: Giocherai a uno degli 'dei della montagna'. Non puoi solo imparare a piantare e coltivare colture diverse; Si può anche cucinare e fare deliziosi piatti; Può anche essere utilizzato per realizzare mobili e decorare l'ambiente.

games.title: Vlad Circus - Descend Into Madness
games.description: Vlad Circus: Descend into Madness ti sfida a fuggire da un labirinto di incubi e tormenti, per una prova al limite della sanità mentale.

games.title: Vlad Circus: Curse of Asmodeus
games.description: Vlad Circus: Curse of Asmodeus ti trascina in un mondo sordido di specchi e ombre, dove il demone si nasconde. Osa affrontare questa macabra avventura grafica in pixel-art di horror e follia. Risolvi enigmi ed esplora due linee temporali parallele.

games.title: Void Bastards
games.description: Void Bastards è un rivoluzionario gioco sparatutto di strategia che metterà alla prova il tuo ingegno e migliorerà la tua mira. Riuscirai a condurre gli emarginati prigionieri del Void Ark attraverso astronavi fatiscenti?

games.title: Void Dungeon
games.description: Void Dungeon brings you a 2D Action RPG with intense hack & slash combat, deep character options, and unyielding enemies, which you can face solo or with up to 4 friends. Oh, and quirky costumes. Because it’s better to look good when the void consumes you.

games.title: Void Prison
games.description: Void Prison is a fast paced, endless arcade twin stick shooter that puts you inside of an ever shrinking ring. Survive by fighting emerging enemies around you and don't get consumed by the void.

games.title: Void Tyrant
games.description: Raccogli una quantità intergalattica di alleati eccentrici e armi mortali, esplora pianeti vibranti e partecipa a rischiose battaglie a turni per recuperare gli occhi di Chronos (Eyes of Chronos) e salvare la galassia in questo gioco strategico roguelike di costruzione di mazzi!

games.title: Voidling Bound
games.description: Hatch, evolve, and upgrade powerful space creatures in this action-packed sci-fi 3rd person shooter that reinvents the monster taming genre!

games.title: Voidsayer
games.description: The world has fallen into darkness, cursed by the Abyss. Assemble your monster team, take on eldritch horrors, and return hope to the world.

games.title: Voidtrain
games.description: Diventa parte dell'equipaggio di un espresso interdimensionale! Scopri un mondo misterioso abitato da creature mortali, in cui troverai tesori e molto altro. Accumula materiali, migliora il tuo treno e crea armi più evolute. Gioca in solitario o nella modalità cooperativa a 4 ...

games.title: Voidwrought
games.description: Voidwrought è un videogioco d'azione a piattaforme 2D ambientato in un mondo di orrori cosmici disegnato a mano. Esplora i resti della Prima civiltà e combatti gli dei che la popolano. Accresci i tuoi poteri, scopri antichi Artefatti ed espandi il tuo santuario tra le rovine.

games.title: Volley Pals
games.description: Un caotico gioco di pallavolo arcade in stile cartone animato con multiplayer locale per un massimo di 4 persone. È progettato come un party game con ogni livello caratterizzato da temi e meccaniche differenti.

games.title: Voltage High Society
games.description: Punch, Evolve, Escape! Dive into a Japanese cyberpunk nightmare in this Metroidvania inspired FPS. Battle horrific cyber- monstrosities, master deadly abilities, and rip your way to freedom from the derelict Nemo Ultra.

games.title: Voltaire: The Vegan Vampire
games.description: Un gioco d'azione e coltivazione roguelite, pieno di buffe piante e dispettose creature! Voltaire, ultimogenito di Dracula, ha rinunciato alla carne umana per dedicarsi alla ~*carne vegetale*~. Ma occhio, perché la dieta vegana (㇏(•̀ᵥᵥ•́)ノ) non è per i deboli di cuore!

games.title: Voodolls
games.description: Voodolls is a co-op tower defence experience steeped in the dark & mysterious world of voodoo. Trapped in the jaws of hell, four souls are given the chance of freedom by a mysterious Puppet Master who distils their essence into Voodolls.

games.title: Voodoo Detective
games.description: Do you like adventure, comedy, and dime store detective novels? Then boy have we got the game for you! Join Voodoo Detective in a story-rich, hand-drawn noir where you’ll pit your wits and hoodoo know-how against a sinister evil that’s taken root on beautiful Zo Wanga Isle.

games.title: Voor De Kroon
games.description: Fight for control during the Friso-Hollandic Wars. Set in the 13th century, the game features a strategy campaign and large scale battles. Fight with your army in 3rd person battles and command your troops.

games.title: Vornyca
games.description: Set in a world where humanity has defeated its own creations, Vornyca follows the journey of a lone surviving AI struggling to find purpose, freedom, and identity in the ruins of a fallen civilization.

games.title: VR Soccer 96
games.description: Feel the soccer once again

games.title: W.A.N.T.E.D - WANTED The Game
games.description:
W.A.N.T.E.D - WANTED - WNTD - The WANTED Game - A Open-World Experience Action Adventure Game with a WorldWide inspired ambience.

Visit W.A.N.T.E.D Cities: Miami, New York City, San Francisco, Los Angeles, Las Vegas, Deserts, Country Sides, Tropical Islands, Japan, Australia

games.title: Waking Tides
games.description: Welcome to "Waking Tides," a small but captivating atmospheric adventure game that thrives on experimentation. Delve into a world where augmented reality extends your gameplay, seamlessly blurring the lines between reality and fantasy.

games.title: Walking Dead Final Season
games.description: Dopo anni trascorsi a fronteggiare minacce sia vive che morte, Clementine e AJ potrebbero finalmente aver trovato una casa all'interno di una scuola isolata dal resto del mondo. Tuttavia, proteggerla richiederà immensi sacrifici. In questa drammatica ed emozionante stagione fi...

games.title: Wall World
games.description: Explore the mysterious Wall World on your giant robospider: mine for valuable resources, upgrade your equipment to fight off hordes of monsters, and discover exotic biomes in-between attacks. Will you be able to survive and learn the secrets of the Wall World?

games.title: Wall World 2
games.description: The adventure in the mysterious world of the Wall continues! Pilot your robospider into its depths, uncover lost artifacts and technologies, upgrade your exosuit and spider, and battle the horrors lurking in the dark. Unravel the mysteries buried in the depths of the Wall!

games.title: Wallace & Gromit's Grand Adventures
games.description: Entra nel mondo colorato di West Wallaby Street con una serie di quattro fantastiche avventure realizzate da Aardman Animations, la casa creatrice dei film di animazione di Wallace & Gromit, e dal pluripremiato studio Telltale Games.

games.canonical_title: Wallace and Gromit's Grand Adventures - Episode 1
games.title: Wallace and Gromit's Grand Adventures - Episode 1
games.description: Wallace attempts to save his bumbling honey business with supersized flowers. This leads to an unintended consequence - giant bees! - and Gromit must save the town from the angry swarm!

games.canonical_title: Wallace and Gromit's Grand Adventures - Episode 2
games.title: Wallace and Gromit's Grand Adventures - Episode 2
games.description: Wallace & Gromit turn their basement into a beach resort when rains derail their holiday plans. After a resort guest gets bonked by an unknown assailant, Gromit and the deduct-o-matic invention must solve the case!

games.canonical_title: Wallace and Gromit's Grand Adventures - Episode 3
games.title: Wallace and Gromit's Grand Adventures - Episode 3
games.description: Town newcomer Monty Muzzle is holding a fundraiser to rebuild the local dog shelter. Gromit discovers that Muzzle's intentions aren't exactly charitable, and he must foil Muzzle's plot and rescue his canine friends.

games.canonical_title: Wallace and Gromit's Grand Adventures - Episode 4
games.title: Wallace and Gromit's Grand Adventures - Episode 4
games.description: Wallace has been admitted to Prickly Thicket, the oldest country club in Lancashire. Wallace and his faithful caddie Gromit get caught up in a club dispute, then must fight to save all they hold dear!

games.title: Wand
games.description: Interactive maps, game guidance, and customization tools for thousands of PC games. All in our free app.

games.title: Wanderers
games.description:
Wanderers is a free-to-play sci-fi based rogue-lite with card collecting and deck building elements. 

Each run is unique, and each season presents new stories, abilities, and challenges to overcome.

games.title: Wandering People
games.description: Wandering People is a third-person walking simulation game that captures the lives of drifting young people. Through the process of wandering for extended periods, players will directly experience the agony and deep contemplation of youth.

games.title: Wanderlust: Travel Stories
games.description: Wanderlust: Travel Stories is a bridge between literature and gaming. Step into the shoes of modern travelers—explore their desires, hopes and fears, and shape how their stories unfold. Make this journey your own.

games.title: Wanderstop
games.description: From the creator of The Stanley Parable and The Beginner’s Guide comes Wanderstop, a narrative-centric cozy game about change and tea.

games.title: Wanna Survive
games.description: Un complesso gioco di strategia/tattica con combattimenti a turni semplificati ambientato in un'apocalisse zombie. Incontra altri sopravvissuti, guidali attraverso una serie di scenari di combattimento unici e cerca di farli sopravvivere finché non avranno raggiunto la loro me...

games.title: War Hospital
games.description: Assumi il comando di un ospedale da campo della Prima guerra mondiale e prendi tutte le decisioni necessarie per aiutare i soldati a rimettersi e sostenere lo sforzo bellico. In questo gioco di gestione narrativa, sei l'ultimo baluardo dell'umanità.

games.title: War Mechanic
games.description: War Mechanic is an open-world action-adventure where you step into the boots of Jack, a mercenary sent to the hostile island of Nordhook to restore an abandoned base. Fight, manage resources, adapt your gear, and explore a dangerous world as you uncover the island’s hidden truth.

games.title: War Mongrels
games.description: Isometric real-time tactics game that takes place on the Eastern front of WWII. Its story-driven campaign takes inspiration in the grim events that actually took place and the real stories around them. Dive into the dark side of war alone or in co-op.
games.publisher: Destructive Creations sp z o. o.

games.title: WAR OF STEEL
games.description: War of Steel is a 100-player battle royale where you pilot massive mechs in fast-paced combat. Explore vast arenas, upgrade your mech, and outmanoeuvre opponents to be the last mech standing. Tactical gameplay, epic battles, and endless metal mayhem await!

games.canonical_title: War Tanks: Mondo PvP Battaglie tra carri armati
games.title: War Tanks: Mondo PvP Battaglie tra carri armati
games.description: Nel vortice delle battaglie tra carri armati, nasce il destino dei veri eroi. Benvenuti nel mondo emozionante di War Tanks gioco!

games.title: War Thugz - Satoshi City
games.description:
War Thugz - Satoshi City is gang warfare in a Fututist Paris taking place after the Grand rekt, the great war that pitted the central banks against the BlockChain-savvy Degen. 
Built with Unreal Engine 5, it is a MultiPlayer and Solo Third personn shooter ans strategy game

games.title: Warborne Above Ashes
games.description:
Step into the New Era of MMO Combat with Warborne Above Ashes!

Break free from traditional limits in this sci-fi galaxy, and experience the unique fusion of massive MOBA battles and true RPG freedom.

games.title: Warehouse Bots
games.description: Take on the role of a warehouse manager overseeing a bustling hub of automated activity. In this immersive simulator, you'll delve into the intricacies of logistics as you control robots, construct efficient road networks, and fine-tune traffic flow.

games.title: Warframe
games.description: Le fazioni in guerra hanno portato l'Origin System sul baratro della distruzione. Unisciti ai Tenno e proteggi l'universo in costante espansione. Padroneggia il tuo Warframe, amplia l'arsenale e diventa una forza inarrestabile in questo looter shooter che ha definito un intero...

games.title: Wargame: Red Dragon
games.description: Un nuovo livello di perfezione per i giochi strategici in tempo reale!  Ritorna la serie Wargame, più imponente, più ricca e più spettacolare che mai. In Wargame: Red Dragon affronterai un conflitto su larga scala, in cui le potenze occidentali si scontrano con il blocco comun...

games.title: Warhammer 40,000: Battlesector
games.description: Vivi esplosioni che ti faranno tremare le ossa e cariche devastanti in Warhammer 40,000: Battlesector, il gioco strategico a turni definitivo con combattimenti frenetici su vasta scala che ti porta sui campi di battaglia del 41° millennio.

games.title: Warhammer 40,000: Boltgun
games.description: Carica la tua Boltgun e scatenati col tuo arsenale da Space Marine in un tripudio di esplosioni, sprite, pixel e sangue in questa perfetta miscela tra l'azione frenetica di Warhammer 40.000 e l'elegante stile retrò degli sparatutto anni '90.

games.title: Warhammer 40,000: Chaos Gate - Daemonhunters
games.description: Guida l'arma più grande in possesso del genere umano, i Cavalieri Grigi, in questo frenetico GDR strategico a turni. Elimina e distruggi un male di dimensioni galattiche in una campagna dal sapore cinematografico: sfrutta abilità e strategie del tuo personalissimo commando di ...

games.title: Warhammer 40,000: Chaos Gate – Deathwatch
games.description: Mettiti al comando del corpo scelto di cacciatori di alieni dell'Imperium in un brutale RPG tattico a turni.

games.title: Warhammer 40,000: Dark Heresy
games.description: Become an acolyte of the Inquisition in this grim dark, party-based, story-driven cRPG. Lead investigations, uncover grand conspiracies, master tactical combat, and wage a secret war against heresy. Make tough choices as a conduit of the God-Emperor’s will.

games.title: Warhammer 40,000: Gladius - Relics of War
games.description: Warhammer 40,000: Gladius – Relics of War è il primo gioco di strategia a turni 4X ambientato nell'universo Warhammer 40,000. Quattro fazioni si affronteranno in una brutale guerra per il dominio sulle risorse del pianeta.

games.title: Warhammer 40,000: Mechanicus - Standard Edition
games.description: Assumi il controllo dell'esercito più tecnologicamente avanzato dell'Imperium, l'Adeptus Mechanicus. In questo strategico a turni, ogni tua decisione graverà sull'andamento della missione. Riceverai la benedizione dell'Omnissiah?

games.title: Warhammer 40,000: Mechanicus II
games.description: Il frenetico combattimento tattico incontra la gestione strategica in questo sequel dell'acclamato Warhammer 40.000: Mechanicus. Prendi il controllo delle antiche e immortali legioni Necrons o degli accoliti tecno-religiosi dell'Omnissia: il destino di un mondo è nelle tue mani.

games.title: Warhammer 40,000: Rogue Trader
games.description: Realizzato in stretta collaborazione con Games Workshop, Warhammer 40,000: Rogue Trader è un classico GDR dalla narrativa profonda realizzato da Owlcat Games, sviluppatori del già acclamato Pathfinder: Wrath of the Righteous.

games.canonical_title: Warhammer 40,000: Space Marine - Master Crafted Edition
games.title: Warhammer 40,000: Space Marine - Master Crafted Edition
games.description: Warhammer 40,000: Space Marine - Master Crafted Edition

games.title: Warhammer 40,000: Space Marine 2
games.description:
Mankind is in peril. The Imperium needs you. 

Embody the superhuman skill and brutality of a Space Marine, the greatest of the Emperor’s warriors, unleashing deadly abilities and devastating weaponry to obliterate the relentless Tyranid hordes.

games.title: Warhammer 40K Speed Freeks
games.description: High-octane combat racing in the Warhammer 40,000 universe.

games.canonical_title: Warhammer Age of Sigmar: Realms of Ruin
games.title: Warhammer Age of Sigmar: Realms of Ruin
games.description: Inizia una campagna di conquista senza pietà in questo gioco di strategia in tempo reale che scuote gli equilibri dei reami, ambientato nell'universo di Warhammer Age of Sigmar. Guida quattro fazioni uniche in battaglie dinamiche all'interno di una campagna dalla forte componente narrativa e metti alla prova la tua abilità nella modalità multigiocatore online.

games.canonical_title: Warhammer Age of Sigmar: Storm Ground
games.title: Warhammer Age of Sigmar: Storm Ground

games.title: Warhammer: Chaos And Conquest
games.description: Semina il caos nel Vecchio Mondo! Comanda un'orda mentre costruisci una fortezza capace di conquistare l'Impero dell'Uomo e qualsiasi altra banda di guerra del caos che si trova sul tuo cammino.

games.title: WarmSnow
games.description: 'Warm Snow' is a Rogue-like action game with a background set in a dark fantasy world, where the eerie 'Warm Snow' holds sway. You will play as the Warrior 'Bi-an' on a crusade against the Five Great Clans, in order to save a world teetering on the brink of destruction.

games.title: Warpath: Ace Shooter
games.description: THE BEST MILITARY STRATEGY GAME

games.title: Warpaws
games.description: Let slip the dogs of war or embrace your inner feline and settle the age old question of Cats vs Dogs in this classic RTS game where players fight over territory to eventually destroy their opponent’s base. One side may have nine lives, but even the good bois can get ruff!

games.title: Warped Universe
games.description: A co-op meta-driven sci-fi looter shooter where every mission counts for all. Explore the unknown, defend facilities, upgrade your Echo, and empower the galaxy.

games.title: Warpips
games.description: Warpips è un gioco strategico facile da imparare ma difficile da padroneggiare. Schiera la giusta combinazione di soldati, carri armati, elicotteri e aerei in questo frenetico gioco di guerra strategico. Crea il miglior esercito, ricerca la giusta tecnologia e distruggi i nemici!

games.title: Warrior Kings
games.description: Restoring the power of a kingdom to its former glory using innate cunning, military might and a fearsome will to win.

games.title: Warrior Lords
games.description: Warrior Lords is a medieval arcade experience, drawing inspiration from classic beat 'em ups. Battle through Western Europe wielding cold steel, delivering powerful kicks and summoning dragons. Choose from 6 unique heroes and defeat your rivals in a quest for supremacy.

games.title: Wartorn
games.description: Harness the elements in fierce real-time battles while gathering and upgrading a crew of fantasy creatures in this rogue-lite adventure across a world torn apart by war!

games.title: Warzone
games.description: Warzone is a free-to-play, cyberpunk-themed third-person shooter with team-based and solo game modes. Battle online or offline, with or without bots, across dynamic maps. Featuring split-screen support, portals, and cinematic gameplay built for domination.

games.title: Watch Dogs 2 Standard Edition
games.description: Ti diamo il benvenuto a San Francisco! Unisciti a DedSec, il più famigerato team di hacker. Il tuo obiettivo: completare l'attacco informatico più importante di sempre.

games.title: Watch Dogs Standard Edition
games.description: Nei panni di Aiden Pearce puoi hackerare il sistema e trasformare Chicago nella tua arma più letale per compiere la tua vendetta. Ma cosa succede quando le tue azioni si scontrano con un'intera città?

games.title: Watch Dogs: Legion Gold Edition

games.description: In Watch Dogs: Legion potrai organizzare una resistenza con praticamente tutti i personaggi che incontri, hackerando, infiltrandoti e lottando per riprenderti una Londra del futuro prossimo alle prese con il suo declino. La Resistenza ti aspetta.

games.title: Watch Over Christmas

games.title: Watching From Afar
games.description: After refusing to help someone in need, you’re cursed by a mischievous fairy to see the world only through other people’s eyes. Explore a realm of floating islands — not from your own view, but through the wandering gazes of strangers in this unique second-person platformer.

games.title: Water 2050 Expanded
games.description: Take on the ultimate challenge of being mayor of the last city with clean water reserves in 2050. Manage resources, discover new technologies and tackle the global water crisis. An innovative blend of city building, resource management, adventure, and survival all in one game.

games.title: Water Delivery
games.description: Water Delivery è un’esperienza horror in prima persona come ragazzo delle consegne d’acqua. Guida il camion di casa in casa, consegna taniche piene, trova quelle vuote e raccogli i pagamenti. Riuscirai a completare l’ultimo giro?

games.title: Wattam
games.description: Entra nella mente geniale di Keita Takahashi con Wattam. Esplora un mondo desolato dove ogni cosa è scomparsa e tutto sembra perduto. Gioca da solo o in co-op a schermo intero e aiuta il sindaco a riscoprire le gioie dell'amicizia, ritrovare i ricordi dimenticati e tornare in ...

games.title: Wave Gods: Ammo Night
games.description: In an abandoned world, the silence of death is broken by zombies! Conserve your ammo, team up with friends, and survive the nightmare. Single player or up to 6 players can join the online survival battle!

games.title: WaveBlock
games.description: Strategic tower defense game where you build and upgrade powerful turrets to stop relentless waves of machines and drones. Across 5 handcrafted levels, you’ll face 10 escalating waves per stage, using 6 unique tower types with 3 upgrade tiers each.

games.title: Wavecade
games.description: WAVECADE is a sci-fi, arcade-style #shmup where YOU control the speed of the game. Destroy blocks, minions and bosses in style as you collect powerups and avoid hazards. How far can you go?

games.title: Wavetale
games.description: Surf the waters of a submerged city! Unravel the past, save the islanders from mysterious sea monsters and discover secrets hidden under the surface.

games.title: Way of the Hunter
games.description: Diventa il nuovo proprietario di un capanno di caccia immerso in una natura lussureggiante e ricca di prede. Esplora liberamente estesi scenari imbracciando una delle numerose armi disponibili e goditi il brivido della caccia da solo o con i tuoi amici.

games.title: Wayfinder Mod Editor
games.description:
The Wayfinder Mod Editor is here — it’s time to create something amazing & unexpected. Remix dungeons, script unpredictable encounters, change systems entirely. Create challenges that push you and your friends to the edge.

Forge, break, rebuild — Wayfinder is yours to reshape.

games.title: WE ARE FOOTBALL
games.description: Conduci la tua squadra di calcio nei campionati nazionali fino alla fama internazionale. Diventa il manager di una consolidata squadra maschile o femminile a tua scelta o porta una piccola squadra nel campionato maggiore.

games.title: WE ARE FOOTBALL 2024
games.description: Preferite scegliere un club o crearne uno vostro? Gestire uomini o donne? In WE ARE FOOTBALL 2024 porterete il vostro club al vertice e diventerete una leggenda della gestione sportiva!

games.title: We Are Not Alone
games.description: A new twist on horror that combines first person exploration and third person point and click adventure. As a member of a "safe" isolation experiment you'll explore an underground facility, solve puzzles and uncover the mystery of an unknown creature. Just don't make eye contact.

games.title: We Are OFK
games.description: OFK, band pop indie, racconta la storia di come quattro amici siano riusciti a rilasciare la propria EP di debutto senza farsi sopraffare dalla frustrazione. Una serie interattiva su come la band si è formata e che narra di sogni, relazioni e affitti da pagare a Los Angeles.

games.title: We Heist Too
games.description: Set in the quirky, atomic 1960s-inspired city, step into the shoes of a thief leading a double life as a seemingly ordinary citizen. We Heist Too offers a playground to explore and experiment with various playstyles without quest markers, encouraging creative problem-solving.

games.canonical_title: We Love Katamari REROLL+ Royal Reverie

games.canonical_title: We Were Here Expeditions: The FriendShip
games.title: We Were Here Expeditions: The FriendShip
games.description: Collabora con unə amicə online e mettete alla prova la vostra amicizia risolvendo insieme gli enigmi del parco dei divertimenti abbandonato. Unite le forze per superare le sfide più impegnative in questa esperienza standalone di We Were Here.

games.title: We Were Here Forever
games.description: Tu e un amico esploratore vi risvegliate nell'inquietante Castle Rock e ora non avete via di scampo. Siete stati ingannati? O forse non siete stati poi così astuti? Affrontate le forze oscure di questo regno per fuggire o rimanete intrappolati... per sempre... Se ti interessa ...

games.description: Imbarcati in un'avventura ricca di rompicapi in cui tu e il tuo compagno dovrete dimostrare di saper comunicare e collaborare per scappare dal castello infestato di Castle Rock.

games.title: We Were Here Too
games.description: Mentre le vostre ultime ore si avvicinano, una grande struttura fa la sua comparsa in lontananza, sopra l'incessante bufera. Scoprite quale verità si cela dietro questo castello oscuro in un’avventura basata su collaborazione e comunicazione.

games.title: Weird West

games.title: Welcome to Elk
games.description: Welcome to Elk is a biographical adventure set on an island like no other, where every character you encounter has a story to tell. From the weird and wonderful to the dark and desperate, all the tales told on Elk are based on true stories of life on the road less traveled.

games.title: Welcome to Empyreum

games.title: Werewolf: The Apocalypse - Purgatory
games.description: Battle monsters, investigate insidious conspiracies and explore the dark side of (in)human nature in Werewolf: The Apocalypse — Purgatory, a unique blend of dark fantasy thriller, visual novel and tabletop RPG set in the World of Darkness universe.

games.title: Werewolf: The Apocalypse – Earthblood
games.description: Un'esperienza unica piena di combattimenti brutali e avventure mistiche. Sei Cahal, un potente Garou che può trasformarsi in un lupo e in un Crinos, un'enorme bestia feroce. Padroneggia le tue tre diverse forme e i loro poteri per punire coloro che contaminano Gaia.

games.canonical_title: Werewolf: The Apocalypse — Heart of the Forest
games.title: Werewolf: The Apocalypse — Heart of the Forest

games.title: Western Side
games.description: Un gioco di parkour a tema western! In Western Side: The Parkour Game salti e ti arrampichi, ma se cadi, riparti da capo!

games.title: Westlanders

games.description: Whacky committed a crime and was punished for it. Now he must stumble through humanity’s most idiotic moments because no cosmic punishment is crueler than living among humans.

games.canonical_title: What Is This Sorcery: Trading Card Game

games.description: WITS (What Is This Sorcery) is an immersive digital trading card game (TCG) that brings together the classic appeal of card collecting with the dynamic interactivity of online gaming.

games.title: What Lies in the Multiverse

games.title: What Remains of Edith Finch
games.description: What Remains of Edith Finch è una raccolta di bizzarri racconti legati a una famiglia dello stato di Washington. Nei panni di Edith, perlustrerai l'imponente casa dei Finch alla ricerca di indizi e farai luce sulla storia della tua famiglia per capire il motivo per cui sei l'u...
